Return to me when you're finished. Perhaps we can solve this issue together.

passages.title: Adventuring Anxieties
passages.text:
I see.

That shouldn't be too difficult to make.

passages.title: The Necessary Materials
passages.text:
In order to make this barding, we'll need a lot of leather. And I mean a LOT of leather.

I'll solidify our plans on fitting the pieces together. You go gather the leather.

Once that's done, we can begin crafting.

passages.title: The Necessary Materials
passages.text: This is probably the biggest project I've ever been a part of. It's quite exciting!

passages.title: The Necessary Materials
passages.text: I've got the plans. You have the leather?

passages.title: Battle Bonds
passages.text:
Do you like pets, <name>? I love pets. They're so cute!

But what I really want is more things with which to play with them.

I'm sure Lio over at the Magical Menagerie has some ideas for fun toys. You should go talk to her!

passages.title: Battle Bonds
passages.text: Oh, those are good ideas! Let's get started.

passages.title: The Final Lessons
passages.text:
<name>, Hrul has requested your presence. From his message it seems as though he's ready to impart to you all the wisdom he has gained from working with the skins of this land.

I envy you, <name>... but I'm also proud to see that you've gained so much respect with him.

Go now, and good luck!

passages.title: The Final Lessons
passages.text:
This will be the last of what I have to teach.

Are you ready for the trials that await you?

passages.title: A Debt Paid
passages.text:
Now, I've never heard of a ghost sending a letter before, but I'll be damned if'n I didn't just receive one now.

Celea has sent fer ye, <lad/lass>. I'd best be on me way if I were ye. Might be bad luck to keep a spirit waiting.

passages.title: A Debt Paid
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>. I wish to impart to you the remainder of my wisdom.

passages.title: Time Well Spent
passages.text:
Unfortunately, <name>, you have learned all that I have to teach. I am pleased we were each able to achieve our goals in this partnership.

Go now and share what you've learned with your allies in Dalaran. I'm sure they'd be eager to share in your training.

passages.title: Time Well Spent
passages.text:
<Namha listens to your tales with wide eyes and an eager ear>

That's it, <name>. You've inspired me. I've been stuck in this floating city for far too long. It's time to get out there and see the world again.

passages.title: Demon Flesh
passages.text:
Something we haven't really explored yet, <name>, are the creatures of Suramar. Specifically, the demons.

Now I certainly don't praise what they are, but you can't ignore the fact that some of their creatures have especially tough hides.

We could take a lesson from the demon hunters and use those hides to our advantage against the demons. I'll be damned though if I know the first thing about working with demon hide.

Perhaps there's someone in Suramar who can help...

passages.title: Demon Flesh
passages.text:
I says to him, I go, "The world is on the cutting edge of the knife, and we, we're just the shavings!"

And he says to me, he says, "But then who'll feed the sabers?!"

Wait... who are you? Leatherworking? Oh... right. I, I was once a great leatherworker...

passages.title: Wrong End of the Knife
passages.text:
There he is! The man that isn't there! He's... he's...

Wait... no, I'm sorry. My thoughts, they're just all over place lately. Ever since my exile, things have been a bit fuzzier than normal.

If you wish to learn from me before I completely lose my mind, then do me a favor, and kill those traitors who sided with the demons and exiled me.

passages.title: Wrong End of the Knife
passages.text:
Green is good. Green is good. Green is good? No way!

Oh, it's you <name>. Right, you needed something?

Wait, they're dead? And you slew them? Fantastic!

passages.title: Fel Tanning
passages.text:
Listen, you. I'm not sure when the crazy side of me will come out again, so let's make our time together short.

You want to learn how to make armor to rival the demons? Follow my instructions and you'll have an excellent grasp on the procedures.

passages.title: Fel Tanning
passages.text:
You're really here, right?

<Stalriss reaches out and pinches you>

passages.title: Fel Tanning
passages.text:
Yes, you've done it, <name>. Good work.

Now go, before I do or say something I'd regret, but probably won't remember.

passages.title: Mounting Made Easy
passages.text:
<name>, I'm glad you're here. I confess: I've been working on a secret project behind your back. Behold: the Stonehide Leather Harness! Now, we simply need to find a mount worthy of such a piece of art.

The vrykul sing songs of a snow-white elderhorn with endless stamina. Find it, place the harness on it, and tame it.

passages.title: Mounting Made Easy
passages.text: Now that's a beast worth riding. Here's the pattern for that harness, if you want one for yourself.

passages.title: Debt Repaid
passages.text:
I have a few urgent matters to take care of, but soon after I will make my way to Dreadscar Rift and aid you with your summoning.

You should warn Ritssyn to keep his distance. I'll be there to repay my debt to you, not to speak to the hypocrite who chose the council over his friends.

passages.title: Debt Repaid
passages.text:
It appears Kira travels faster than your word. She arrived moments ago, though her eyes purposely avoided mine.

In gaining her trust, you accomplished something I could not. With her help, we should be able to summon the gateway.

passages.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
passages.text:
It was in this place, ages ago, that Huln Highmountain challenged the great Deathwing.

Today we shall re-live moments of that day through the eyes of our ancestors.

For this next part of the spirit journey, we must seek out the three braziers set down many ages ago so that those who would follow in the footsteps of Huln might witness his deeds.

passages.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
passages.text: You are learning parts of our history few outsiders have ever known.

passages.title: In Defiance of Deathwing
passages.text: And so it was that Huln Highmountain came to this mountain, freeing the drogbar slaves of Deathwing, and came into possession of the Hammer of Khaz'goroth.

passages.title: Thorny Dancing
passages.text:
The Thistleleaf sprites have gone completely mad.

I suspect they are being manipulated by some very mischievous Thorndancers.

Please, friend of the forest, seek out these seductive troublemakers and bring peace to the shallows.

passages.title: Thorny Dancing
passages.text: Have you dealt with those Thorndancers yet?

passages.title: Thorny Dancing
passages.text: That should set those vexing Thorndancers on their way.

passages.title: Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly
passages.text:
These poor faerie dragons are being tortured!

What's worse, when the thistleleaf become bored they ensnare their victims to continue their torment later.

This behavior is simply unacceptable.

Please free any trapped Lunarwings you can find.

passages.title: Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly
passages.text: On behalf of the Lunarwings, thank you.

passages.title: Bad Intentions
passages.text:
Suramar is lost.

Our leaders struck a dark bargain, accepting the Legion as our allies. We were meant to be heroes, guardians - the people resting here. We are not like them any more. I cannot live with them.

But cut off from the Nightwell, we wither and devolve into a mindless existence. An existence without release or dignity, as you can see even here...

I rejected both of these options and found myself here. I will find a third way.

passages.title: Bad Intentions
passages.text: Why do you seek to dissuade me?

passages.title: Bad Intentions
passages.text: Honeyed words from a stranger. While comforting, they do not shake my resolve. Come, at this rate I will wither before we are through.

passages.title: Step into the Dark
passages.text:
With the threat to my people quelled, I believe it is time to introduce you to my kin.

Meet me at Stonedark Grotto, and you will see where we live.

passages.title: Step into the Dark
passages.text: Welcome to our humble home. You are free to move about here from now on.

passages.title: A Grim Equation
passages.text:
They were waiting for us when we crashed. It was all we could do to establish our small outpost.

Even now they drain the souls of our fallen to fuel their attacks.

Destroy their soul coffers. Free our comrades and let them join the Light.

When you have finished, find Y'mera in the field. She has been sorely missed, but she will not have fallen. Of this I am certain.

passages.title: A Grim Equation
passages.text: Good work. They will return in time, but we can use this advantage.

passages.title: Battle Bonds
passages.text:
Do you like pets, <name>? I love pets. They're so cute!

But what I really want is more things with which to play with them.

I'm sure Serr'ah over at the Magical Menagerie has some ideas for fun toys. You should go talk to her!

passages.title: Battle Bonds
passages.text: Oh, those are good ideas! Let's get started.

passages.title: That Guy in the Costume
passages.text:
Aye, when we were out huntin' on the coast, we ran into this ridiculous lad in in a costume. He says he's tryin ta blend in with the murlocs... but I'm pretty sure he's just not right in the head.

One of ours stayed behind to keep an eye on him when we headed back to camp... mind checkin' it out?

Ye can ask Tamara over there for a ride.

passages.title: That Guy in the Costume
passages.text: Hello, adventurer! Here to help me and Murky out?

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
We aren't going to get our forces anywhere near the Broken Shore without getting knocked out of the sky.

I think it best if you handle this matter yourself - there are none among us more capable on the field of battle.

Save Allari and her men if you can, but the Aldrachi Warblades will do far more for this war than warm bodies.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
What of the others? Did they...?

I see. They gave their lives for a worthy cause - the Warblades will change the tide of this war, mark my words.

passages.title: Stop Gul'dan!
passages.text:
After his defeat at the Black Temple, we brought Illidan's lifeless body here, to be interred forever within the Vault of the Wardens.

Gul'dan has found his way through our defenses and is trying to steal the Betrayer's corpse.

Even in death, Illidan's body can be used by the Burning Legion. Gul'dan CANNOT succeed.

passages.title: Stop Gul'dan!
passages.text: Excellent. You have absorbed the powers of these brutes. Look how strong you have grown!

passages.title: Forged in Fire
passages.text:
The fearsome demon, Immolanth, led a Legion army that conquered and eventually ruled a distant nexus world. 

Somehow, the Wardens imprisoned him, then kept him locked up in the chamber to our left. He is contained, but not for long.

The demon's power is a valuable prize to any demon hunter who can defeat him. Whoever can do so will gain power beyond imagining.

I believe that person could be you, <name>.

passages.title: Forged in Fire
passages.text: Do you have Immolanth's power, <name>?

passages.title: Forged in Fire
passages.text: Yes... just look you... surging with new power and knowledge!

passages.title: Between Us and Freedom
passages.text:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.

passages.title: Between Us and Freedom
passages.text:
We escaped the Vault, but our work is far from over.

The Legion's assault on this world is just beginning.

If Azeroth is to survive, we may have to work with this... Archmage Khadgar.

passages.title: Between Us and Freedom
passages.text:
The last of our survivors have fought their way into the final chamber ahead.

Only one obstacle stands between us and the vault's exit - the leader of this demon invasion, Bastillax.

Kill him, take his power, and claim our freedom.

passages.title: Between Us and Freedom
passages.text:
We escaped the Vault, but our work is far from over.

The Legion's assault on this world is just beginning.

If Azeroth is to survive, we may have to work with this... Archmage Khadgar.

passages.title: Demon Hunter Choice 1
Demon Hunter Choice 2
Demon Hunter Choice 3
The Maelstrom Beckons
passages.text:
Can you feel it, shaman? Here, in the heart of Azeroth, where earth and wind and waves clash together - it is as if one can speak directly with the world.

The artifact you wield houses great power but even greater potential. Carry it below and seek out the ancient elemental altar overlooking the fury of the maelstrom. From there, you can commune with Azeroth and imbue your artifact with even greater abilities. Do so, and then share with me what you have learned!

passages.title: The Maelstrom Beckons
passages.text:
I sense that your work here has only begun. As you get more familiar with your artifact, you will be able to continue augmenting its power.

The others are watching you carefully. You have become a symbol of hope in our struggle against the Legion!

passages.title: Training with Durian
passages.text: Show me that you truly have gained the trust of your companions.

passages.title: Lyana Darksorrow
passages.text:
<A captive demon hunter floats in stasis in front of you; her soul slowly draining into the harvester crystal.>

<In order to release her from stasis, you will need to destroy the soul harvester.>

passages.title: Lyana Darksorrow
passages.text:
My name is Lyana. What is yours, <class>?

You have my gratitude for releasing me.

I do not know how long I have been held captive... but I sense an overwhelming number of demons nearby.

We have much to do here, you and I.

passages.title: Glaive Circumstances
passages.text:
I came here on a mission to slay the demon eredar, Azoran. During my infiltration, I was shot down from my felbat and captured.

I'm not going to mince words, <name>. Azoran plans to use the Burning Legion command ship to destroy Dalaran.

To stop him, I will need my warglaives that were lost during my fall from the sky. I would retrieve them myself, but I'm still weakened from my imprisonment.

Search for the warglaives on the northern side of the crater, where I was shot down.

passages.title: Glaive Circumstances
passages.text: Do you have my glaives, <race>?

passages.title: Glaive Circumstances
passages.text:
Thank you. Now that my warglaives are returned, I will bring ruin upon Felsoul Hold.

My wrath is unending and my vengeance swift.

passages.title: Fragments of Memory
passages.text:
<The beautiful elven burial urn is shattered carelessly on the ground. It was clearly handled roughly, but not scratched by the talons of the harpies.>

<You find a trail of shards leading towards a cave. Those responsible are certainly within. Thaedris would be interested in the relics and their safe return.>

passages.title: Fragments of Memory
passages.text: What do you have there?

passages.title: Fragments of Memory
passages.text:
These relics are tokens and mementos of the former lives of those interred here. They like to be remembered and these offerings keep them in their eternal peace.

The spirits of the fallen will be at rest now. You have my gratitude.

passages.title: Shipwrecked Captive
passages.text: I spent my life playing the pet in other peoples battles. Now it's my time to be the pet tamer! Best part of being dead is I can do this forever!

passages.title: Shipwrecked Captive
passages.text: I'll get better. I have all eternity to train!

passages.title: Titanic Showdown
passages.text:
The greatest time scar of all is just ahead.

Khaz'goroth was the titan who shaped the world. Using his hammer against Deathwing, the aspect of earth, had dire consequences.

Go, speak with Huln and witness the reason why the name "Highmountain" is feared amongst dragons to this day.

passages.title: A Timely Opportunity
passages.text: Now that the whole "spirit journey" thing is out of the way we can get down to business.

passages.title: End of the Line
passages.text:
I cannot call Suramar my home any more, and I refuse to become a withered abomination. There is no place for me anymore, don't you understand?

We only need one last ingredient to complete the elixir. You will help me, won't you?

passages.title: End of the Line
passages.text: Please let me fulfill my wishes, <name>.

passages.title: End of the Line
passages.text: Your arguments are not without merit, <name>. But I remain steadfast.

passages.title: Arcane Communion
passages.text:
All of Kel'danath's experiments to connect with the withered failed, and some even made them more dangerous.

Until he found Theryn.

His arcane essence - the very soul of the shal'dorei - had been touched by something special. But what? 

By weaving my arcane essence together with Theryn's, I can create an empathic bond. This communion will bare his soul to us all - or what's left of it. 

We need only to feed him mana, and lots of it, in order to begin.

passages.title: Arcane Communion
passages.text: Feed Theryn as much as he will take.

passages.title: Arcane Communion
passages.text: Good. Let us see what we can learn.

passages.title: Scenes from a Memory
passages.text:
Theryn is at the mercy of his own mind. Whatever we find in there, it may be difficult to control.

I will need your help to sort through the visions, so be ready for anything.

With any luck, we will discover what makes Theryn special. And... whether there is anything left of who he used to be.

passages.title: Scenes from a Memory
passages.text:
The withered... Not only do they suffer a burning thirst for the Nightwell, but their own memories torture them as well.

Truly a fate worse than death...

passages.title: Scattered Memories
passages.text:
<As your fingers trace the elegant symbols on the page, a voice dictates the words in your mind.

It seems the nightborne have elevated even simple note-taking to a sorcerous art.

Arcanist Kel'danath was definitely working in this area. There must be more of his notes scattered around.>

passages.title: Scattered Memories
passages.text: <A bag containing countless pages of technical notes. Flipping through them, you find Kel'danath's last journal entry.>

passages.title: Testing the Metal
passages.text:
Alright, if we're going to get out of here, we're going to have to maneuver around the naga and the sea giants.

The naga probably won't pose much trouble for someone of your skill, but those sea giants are strong beyond belief.

Just get me out of this cave safely and I can find my own way home.

Hopefully this armor Celea made for me will protect me long enough to see this through.

passages.title: Testing the Metal
passages.text:
He made it out safely? Praise Elune, and you, <name>.

Your heroics continue to earn my trust and my tutelage, <name>. Here are some more efficient ways of crafting your armor.

passages.title: A Fate Worse Than Dying
passages.text:
When the Burning Legion takes a prisoner, it is not an act of mercy.

While death is the destruction of the mortal body... if you are captured by the Legion, they will seek to destroy your soul.

The Burning Legion uses sacrificial souls to power their demonic machinations of war. The soul engine is where the harvested souls are collected and stored.

Though countless have already perished in the soul engine, you may yet save those still alive inside.

Hurry and release them before it is too late!

passages.title: A Fate Worse Than Dying
passages.text: Have the soul engine cages been opened?

passages.title: A Fate Worse Than Dying
passages.text: The destruction of the soul is a fate far worse than death. You have done a great service to those you saved.

passages.title: Sashj'tar Accord DISABLED
passages.text:
<This stone tablet appears to be a contract between Tidemistress Sashj'tar and King Forgalash.

As far as you can decipher, the naga are recruiting the sea giants on behalf of Queen Azshara.>

passages.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
passages.text:
Wavespeaker Adelee tracked Sharas'dal to the Throne of Tides within the Abyssal Maw, then disappeared. <name>, if we go after her, we are almost certainly walking into a trap.

But the elements are with us, my friend. The naga will not expect a shaman of your caliber!

Swim to the Throne of Tides to the Northwest, within the Abyssal Depths. I will join you once you are inside. Let's find our missing shaman and get that artifact!

passages.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
passages.text: What news from the deeps, <class>?

passages.title: Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power
passages.text:
So the legends of the Scepter of Tides were true, <name>!

It lifts our spirits to have such a powerful artifact in the hands of the Earthen Ring.

passages.title: Surprise the Sashj'tar
passages.text:
The naga are preoccupied with recruiting the sea giants for Queen Azshara's battles in other lands.

Now is the time to strike!

passages.title: Burn the Candle at Both Ends
passages.text:
Why you come back already? Have to wait until jobs are done or I no let you through!

Go back to Throne of Ordering Around and make sure they finish!

passages.title: Burn the Candle at Both Ends
passages.text: You come in when jobs are done.

passages.title: Burn the Candle at Both Ends
passages.text: What that?! You have Candleking's Special Candle!

passages.title: Something in the Water
passages.text:
There is something fouling these waters, <class>.

We will need to purify the waters in order to restore balance to the elemental forces below this ruin.

The magic here has warped the elementals and they are beyond restoration. Release their corrupted forms so that they may be reborn pure.

passages.title: Something in the Water
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Something in the Water
passages.text: Now that we have cleared out the corruption the fresh water elementals will be able to flourish.

passages.title: Pristine Violetglass Vessel
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Inert Leystone Charm
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Quietwine Vial
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Pre-War Highborne Tapestry
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Nobleman's Letter Opener
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Trailhead Drum
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Moosebone Fish-Hook
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Hand-Smoothed Pyrestone
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Drogbar Gem-Roller
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Stonewood Bow
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Imp's Cup
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Flayed-Skin Chronicle
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Malformed Abyssal
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Orb of Inner Chaos
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Pristine Houndstooth Hauberk
passages.text: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition, suitable for display in Dalaran's archaeology shop.

passages.title: Needs of the Hunters
passages.text:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:

 To: <name>

The time has come to strike back at the Legion.

Meet me at Hunter's Reach in Dalaran as soon as you can.

 -Emmarel Shadewarden

passages.title: Needs of the Hunters
passages.text:
Your reputation precedes you, <name>.

It is important that we speak.

passages.title: The Spear in the Shadow
passages.text:
Many years ago, a corrupted nightsaber hunted my people. Our chieftain, Dorro Highmountain, took Talonclaw and pursued the beast, but never returned.

I have heard tales of a fearsome nightsaber that now stalks the mists of Stormheim. My brother and I believe this to be our ancient foe.

The weapon must be there too! If we kill the beast and reclaim the spear, it will be of great use against the Legion.

passages.title: The Spear in the Shadow
passages.text:
So the Bane of the Highmountain is dead and Talonclaw is recovered! Well done, <name>!

I mourn the loss of Apata and Wuho. They will be greatly missed in the conflict to come.

passages.title: Huln's War - Shadowsong
passages.text:
Someone with whom I believe you are familiar commands in the battlefield below.

Jarod Shadowsong speaks highly of you, and has requested that you join him in battle.

He has plans to put an end to this fight.

passages.title: Huln's War - Shadowsong
passages.text: I am happy to see you, great ally.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text:
I am glad you are here, <name>.

This... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.

He wishes to meet us at the entrance to the city as soon as possible.

Will you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text: Hello again, champion. I see we are all here now.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text:
You have long been a trusted hero of the Alliance, <name>. And like the rest of us, you have endured many hardships to reach this point.

Now, I must ask even more of you. Will you hear me out?

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: Now you must decide whether you will stand with me.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: The time to make our move is now.

passages.title: A Way Back In
passages.text:
I must get back into Suramar.

I was exiled unfairly! I cannot live out here like this. I need the Nightwell's energies...

I saw a message carved into a wall a few days ago. There is someone in the Water Gardens who can smuggle people into the city.

It said "We shall drink of the Well again."

I cannot survive a confrontation with the guards again. Will you go in my stead? Once I am back in the city I can repay you.

passages.title: A Way Back In
passages.text: Who are you to seek passage into Suramar?

passages.title: A Way Back In
passages.text: I hope for both of our sakes that you were not followed. We must work quickly, considering how close I am.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text:
As you well know, I have opposed the Horde at many turns. The orcs have taken... so much from me. From my family.

Yet I have witnessed your deeds firsthand, <name>. I have seen you fight for Azeroth time and again. And like the rest of us, you have endured many trials and hardships to reach this point.

Now, I must ask your help. Will you hear me out?

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: Now you must decide whether you will stand with me.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: The time to make our move is now.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text:
It is no small matter for me to seek the aid of a blood elf. Your leaders have turned their backs on the sacrifices made by my family and so many others.

Yet I have witnessed your deeds firsthand, <name>. I have seen you fight for Azeroth time and again. And like the rest of us, you have endured many trials and hardships to reach this point.

Now, I must ask your help. Will you hear me out?

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: Now you must decide whether you will stand with me.

passages.title: Clandestine Operation
passages.text: The time to make our move is now.

passages.title: The Fate of Azeroth
passages.text:
The Burning Legion devastated us at the Broken Shore - the greatest army this world has ever known reduced to cinders in mere moments. Our weapons glanced off of their armor... our spells lost in a sea of fel fire.

We need weapons capable of destroying Sargeras and his minions while we still have a chance.

The greatest paladins the world over have gathered at Krasus' Landing to discuss our next move - we're only missing you.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Our gathering has identified several weapons of immense power. In the right hands, these holy artifacts give us a fighting chance against the Legion.

We cannot pursue all of them at once. We risk too much if we spread ourselves that thin. We must agree on where our efforts are best focused.

That is why I asked you here, <name>. As one of our greatest champions, you must be our voice of reason and decide our next move.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text: Excellent choice! There's no time to waste.

passages.title: Azoran Must Die
passages.text:
You won't have much time before the Legion is aware of your presence on the ship.

When the alarm is raised, countless Burning Legion forces will attempt to board the ship through this portal.

I will not let them succeed.

I will guard this portal from enemy reinforcements until you return. It is up to you to slay Azoran and lay waste to his ship.

We don't have much time... you must attack swiftly and without mercy.

passages.title: Azoran Must Die
passages.text: Has Azoran been slain?

passages.title: Azoran Must Die
passages.text:
With Azoran slain, the Legion has been dealt a crippling blow that they will not soon recover from.

You have my respect, <name>.

passages.title: Well Spent Time
passages.text:
Your respect for our ways has earned you all the knowledge we have to teach. Go now, <name>, and spread our ways to those who fight against the legion.

Perhaps it will help to turn the tide in this war for our world.

passages.title: Well Spent Time
passages.text:
To think that leatherworking has been that ingrained in the highmountain tauren heritage for that long is absolutely amazing.

I suddenly wish I knew more about my own people's past as well as they do.

passages.title: Rescue Mission
passages.text:
The demon has told us how to open a portal to the world where he says Alleria is being held. You and I can go through and see if there is any truth to his claims.

In case it's a trap, Magus Solgaze has given me a portal stone to get us back to Dalaran.

This demonic magic is anathema to the mage, so we must move quickly. I'm ready when you are, <name>.

passages.title: Rescue Mission
passages.text:
We didn't recover Alleria, but at least we have proof she was there. She will be found... I know it!

Thas'dorah has long been symbolic of the Windrunner family, but until Alleria's return, it belongs in your hands.

Use it to rally the greatest hunters of Azeroth and drive the Burning Legion back to the abyss!

passages.title: Quality of Life
passages.text:
I am afraid, <name>. We're so close to home, so close to salvation...

Astoril says he knows the rest of the way through and can get us there safely. I believe him, but you've come this far to see us safe. Will you see this through to the end?

passages.title: Quality of Life
passages.text:
This is a most troubling tale. 

You have done a good thing, <name>. Now he will no longer torment our people.

passages.title: A Walk With the Spirits
passages.text:
The spiritwalker you saved from Riverbend has been insufferable since his arrival. He is insisting on showing you the ways of our people so that you better understand what is to come.

He is a strange one, even by spiritwalker standards.

Even so, only a fool would discard his insight. Please, go to speak with him when you get a moment.

passages.title: A Walk With the Spirits
passages.text: You made Mayla smile. That is the first time I have seen her smile in... ever?

passages.title: The Fallen Lion
passages.text:
I haven't left the deck of this ship since we got back. The fleet must be made ready for war. Don't know where we will be needed, but when the call comes, we'll be ready.

Truth be told... I welcome the distraction. The others are paying their respects to Varian, but I... I cannot bring myself to face that casket. To face his son.

Varian gave me a letter he wrote to Anduin. Please, take it to him on my behalf.

passages.title: The Fallen Lion
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. I am pleased you survived the battle. You have something for me?

passages.title: The Fallen Lion
passages.text:
<Anduin sighs and reads the letter from his father. Tears well in his eyes. He is silent for several moments.>

Thank you for bringing this to me, <name>, it means... more than I can say. I wish Greymane felt he could present it himself, but his mind is fixed on revenge.

I cannot blame him... or Jaina, for that matter, but we must find a better way.

Enough of such talk. It is good you are here. We will need heroes like you in the many battles to come.

passages.title: Legion: The Legion Returns
passages.text:
Heroes of the Alliance, I write to you in Azeroth's darkest hour. From the maw of hell, the burning armies of the Legion have returned.

Our fleets depart for the Broken Isles at once. As a grand lance, we will pierce the Legion's lines and drive them back to the nether that spawned them.

Your ship awaits in the Stormwind Harbor, make haste.

passages.title: Legion: The Legion Returns
passages.text:
Hail, <name>. I've got your ship assignment right here.

But first, a bit of readiness is in order!

passages.title: Fate of the Horde
passages.text:
It is a wonder any of our troops survived that bloodbath on the Broken Shore. If not for Lady Sylvanas...

High Overlord Saurfang has been asking for you at Grommash Hold. He will not say why... but he was insistent that I send you to him.

passages.title: Fate of the Horde
passages.text: Dark days are upon us.

passages.title: Fate of the Horde
passages.text:
You have served the Horde well in the past, <name>.

More will be asked of you... much more.

passages.title: A Familiar Ring to It
passages.text:
<name>! Let's talk bling. I'm looking for a ring.

See, the elves down in Azsuna were some fine master jewelcrafters back in the day... or so they say. The books all talk about a ring called the "Band of Farondis". Can't hurt to ask around for it.

Let's head to Azsuna. Bet I'll get there sooner!

passages.title: A Familiar Ring to It
passages.text: Have you tracked down the ring?

passages.title: A Familiar Ring to It
passages.text:
So the ring was stolen by murlocs? Sounds like another opportunity for you and I to work together!

Partners in crime, for the rest of time!

passages.title: Getting the Band Back Together
passages.text:
I like our dynamic, <name>. You're the muscle with all the hustle! And I'm the brains who entertains!

I think this next task is all on you. Try to find that ring, or whatever the murlocs left of it.

passages.title: Getting the Band Back Together
passages.text: How goes the hunt for the ring?

passages.title: Getting the Band Back Together
passages.text:
You got all the pieces!

<Timothy looks over each piece and nods his head.>

Yeah, I can fix this. No prob, bob.

passages.title: An Eye for Detail
passages.text:
<name>, if there's one thing I despise, it's slander. A rumor is spreading that one of my recent commissions is a fake.

We need to quell these rumors as quickly as possible.

I need you to visit the customers I recently worked for and examine their gems. If your claim of being a jewelcrafter is true, then you will be able to spot a fake gem from a mile away.

Here's the list of my patrons. Return immediately if you find any truth to these rumors.

passages.title: An Eye for Detail
passages.text: I will not let these falsehoods ruin the good name of Tiffany & Co.

passages.title: An Eye for Detail
passages.text:
What's this?

<Tiffany opens the bag and pulls out a jewel. She examines it and then drops it on the floor, where it shatters.>

These jewels were delivered by...

WINSTON!!! That thief! How dare he switch them out for these... pathetic imitations!

passages.title: Swift Vengeance
passages.text:
I swear, when I find him...

<Tiffany catches your eye and regains her composure.>

<name>, I need you to track down my FORMER associate, Harold Winston. I doubt he's gotten far, given our location.

When you find him, I would like you to recover the stolen property and return it to me.

Use any means necessary. And don't worry about Ms. Moore's jewels, I'll redeliver a fresh supply to her personally.

passages.title: Swift Vengeance
passages.text: Did you find him? Were you able to recover the jewels?

passages.title: Swift Vengeance
passages.text:
<Tiffany takes the bag from you and pulls out the jewels. She carefully looks over each one.>

Good, they're all here. And from the looks of it, they're all the original jewels.

How did you deal with... actually, nevermind. I really don't care.

passages.title: Drawing Blood
passages.text:
Hey, <name>! I have something exciting to tell you about, but you must keep a secret. Just between us scribes.

<Zooey gives you a wink and pulls out a large tome.>

This is the Bloodbound Ledger. Inscribing your name in it allows you to learn how to craft "blood contracts" which can hurt a little bit, but are absolutely worth it!

I currently know one of them and I get so excited when I use it 'cause it... well, you'll see.

So whaddya say? Interested?

passages.title: Drawing Blood
passages.text: It's just a little bit of blood, I swear! Unless you have a REALLY long name...

passages.title: Drawing Blood
passages.text:
Let's see here. Yes, everything looks in order and it appears the spell has already taken effect on you.

You're now able to learn how to craft the deadly, eerily haunting, "blood contracts". WoooOOOooo.

<Zooey puts on some theatrics as she says the last part.>

Haha, just messin' with ya, <name>. But seriously, these things can be pretty dangerous.

passages.title: Come at Me, Brul
passages.text:
<name>, I received a... well, what can only be constituted as a "letter", carved into a piece of flat rock.

That jewelcrafting master you found in Val'sharah has sent for you. He said he's in Stormheim currently.

When you see him, would you be so kind as to inform him that we don't wish to receive any more of his requests for your presence. They just make a mess.

passages.title: Come at Me, Brul
passages.text: Good to see you again, <name>. Jabrul wanted to know if you would like to learn some more designs.

passages.title: The Charge Within
passages.text:
Before Jabrul shares his designs with you, he needs you to help him with a special project.

Jabrul has a jewel that can trap storm energy. The more lightning it traps, the brighter it shines.

Jabrul thinks the storm drakes' power would be better spent in his jewel than terrorizing the skies of Stormheim.

Don't you?

passages.title: The Charge Within
passages.text: Jabrul has never seen something so radiant in all his life.

passages.title: Jabrul Needs You
passages.text:
Hello <name>,

Jabrul needs your help with something. Could you please come to Azsuna and find Jabrul?

Thank you,

Jabrul

passages.title: Jabrul Needs You
passages.text: <name>, good to you see you again! Now listen...

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
passages.text:
We could not save Ysera, but we did prevent her from destroying the temple.

Now I can finally turn my attention to my husband.

I do not know what fate he suffers now. I only know that if we stand any chance of saving him, you must go now.

Follow Xavius into the Nightmare and find Malfurion.

Please, save my husband if you can.

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
passages.text: Is he alive? Will my husband return to me?

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare
passages.text:
Praise Elune and all that her light touches... Malfurion is alive.

I thought I would spend the rest of my days alone, dreaming of the choices I did not make.

Thank you. Thank you for returning my love to me.

passages.title: Fury of the Storm
passages.text:
The Felskorn who ravage my brood were once Drekirjar - a tribe with whom we shared an ancient pact. Now, under the influence of the God-King, they forsake their oaths and strike at the forebears of their coveted drakes.

They should answer for this slight.

Awaken your fury, <class>, and take the battle to them!

passages.title: Fury of the Storm
passages.text: Are we rid of the Felskorn threat?

passages.title: Fury of the Storm
passages.text:
The Felskorn have witnessed true strength today. 

They will think twice before raising their blades to you again.

passages.title: The Legend of the Sands
passages.text:
Nothing! There is next to nothing in our records about this weapon!

I've checked and re-checked, and can find barely a shred of a tale. This can only mean that the story comes from a land outside Pandaria.

Li Li Stormstout is young, but she is the most traveled on the entire isle except for you. If anyone might know of this weapon, it is she.

passages.title: The Legend of the Sands
passages.text: What's up?

passages.title: The Legend of the Sands
passages.text: Do you think that the story is true? I bet you could control the power of those blades!

passages.title: Into The Heavens
passages.text:
This stone is saturated with elemental power, possibly the remnant of the magic used against Irmaat!

If you went outside and held the stone aloft, it should unleash the stone's essence as a mighty whirlwind. So potent a windstorm could carry you and your companion all the way to Skywall!

If the hand blades of Irmaat, the Fists of the Heavens, are as powerful as the old tales say, they would certainly be found there.

passages.title: Into The Heavens
passages.text:
That was a fantastic trip, <name>! We really should do this kind of thing more often!

Now that you have those blades I bet there's going to be a bunch of adventures ahead!

Maybe I should just stick around here a while.

passages.title: The Nightmare Lord
passages.text:
You arrived just in time, friend.

Kagraxxis was moments away from sacrificing me to his master... I was certain I would perish.

I am grateful, but we are not out of danger yet... Xavius has returned.

The Nightmare Lord is here in Val'sharah, personally orchestrating the corruption of this land. My captor revealed as much to me before I was to be sacrificed.

We must find Thaon Moonclaw and inform him before it is too late!

passages.title: The Nightmare Lord
passages.text:
Thaon Moonclaw was a great druid and a true protector of this land.

How can we hope to defeat the Nightmare Lord without him fighting beside us?

passages.title: Paying Respects
passages.text:
All I see is despair.

Look, <race>. The grounds are overwhelmed with these wraiths, spirits of those interred here. Something has made them angry and they are lashing out. I can feel their pain.

I will go look for remaining relics, and there is a tomb I must see. It is too late for these unfortunate souls. Please defeat any you find and return them to the rest they deserve.

passages.title: Paying Respects
passages.text: It pains me to see them suffering. In time they will return, but for now they will be at peace.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
As the greatest warrior in these halls, you require a great weapon to do both your will and mine. I have looked down on Azeroth and found artifacts worthy of your hands.

I leave it to you to choose which artifact you wish to seek out and wield against the Legion. We will recover the others in time.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text: Choose wisely, <name>.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text: I knew you would pick that one. Let us be about it.

passages.title: Thus Begins the War
passages.text:
The Legion thinks you are dead. It will be quite the surprise when you punish them for that assumption!

This allows us to see all across the Broken Isles and assign warriors to various tasks.

Once you've taken a look, you should choose your first area of operation. I've already picked out the best spots!

passages.title: Thus Begins the War
passages.text: An excellent choice, <name>. As more opportunities arise, I will bring them to your attention. Good luck in battle!

passages.title: Warrior Inbound
The Second Valarjar
passages.text: Whatever your feelings towards him, he is still one of the finests warriors on Azeroth. He has led battles from the front, advised Warchiefs, and mixes excellent martial prowess with tactical calm. You can trust his judgment as well as his axe. Speak with him yourself.

passages.title: Justice Rains from Above
passages.text:
Kill now, grieve later!

Here, champion, take flight with one of my war eagles. Use the powers bestowed upon you by our united tribes and help us rain destruction down on these drogbar.

Let us clog that new doorway to their lair with the bodies of their own!

passages.title: Justice Rains from Above
passages.text: The drogbar sure do love those rocks.

passages.title: Justice Rains from Above
passages.text: Well done. We will make a Skyhorn out of you yet.

passages.title: Seeking the Valkyra
passages.text:
We simply cannot risk another catastrophe like that; we have to protect the Heart against fel energy before we continue our work.

The mighty Ashildir has proven willing to aid those who she deems worthy, and her master just may be able to help us protect the Heart.

You should seek her out at the Vault of Eyir in Stormheim. I'll meet you there.

passages.title: Seeking the Valkyra
passages.text:
Speak not. I know what you seek.

Do you believe yourself ready to face the trials ahead?

passages.title: To Point the Way
passages.text:
Though the journal devolves into dark ramblings written in hurried scribbles, one entry stands out:

"Ulthalesh. The name rings in my head. I can hear it calling, but where?

"The spirits... the very land here is tied to it. It is no wonder we would so often get lost in this place. The forces pull my compass point in every direction...

"Perhaps if it had a stronger pull, the compass could show the way..."

passages.title: To Point the Way
passages.text: Is that the one?

passages.title: To Point the Way
passages.text:
There is definitely something wrong with this compass. 

It seems to be trying to point in all directions at once.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Three weapons... three worthy paths.

Acquiring one such artifact will be the first step in battling the Legion. The weapon will grow in power as you wield it, so you must choose the one which will be the focus of your efforts, <name>.

After a time, you will be able to pursue the other weapons. But you must decide which to seek first.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Now you must begin your pursuit of the artifact. It will not be easy to obtain, but a weapon this powerful seldom is.

After you succeed, return here to me and we shall speak at greater length. There is much for us to do!

passages.title: Basking in Glory
passages.text:
You... you glow with the radiance of Odyn himself...

You must return to your people at once. Odyn's light is a gift that must be shared with all.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text:
I am glad you are here, <name>.

This... Khadgar, the archmage who found my message, has called a meeting.

He wishes to meet us by the entrance to the city as soon as possible.

Will you accompany me? I have the strangest feeling that he will not be alone.

passages.title: Take Me To Your Leader
passages.text: Hello again, champion. I see we are all here now.

passages.title: Off To Adventure!
passages.text:
Oh I'd love to go see if that story is true! But Pops is too busy stuffing his gut and being a grouch to let me go do any real exploring. He even told me that I can't leave the village unless I have a guardian!

Is Pops for real? I can protect myself just fine!

Say, would you be my guardian? Please, get me away from this boredom and you will totally be my hero!

passages.title: Off To Adventure!
passages.text: Do you see this place? This is so neat!

passages.title: Off To Adventure!
passages.text:
Hey there, <name>. What took you so long?

While you were traveling the long way I've been doing some research of my own. King Phaoris offered to help us as long as we can take care of a problem for him.

I'm sure you'll be able to handle whatever it is.

passages.title: Thunder on the Sands
passages.text:
I know the tale of Irmaat well. It is said that his home was the ancient city of Ahmtul, long buried under the desert sands.

Recently a strange storm has appeared over the ruins. What's more, I am told that an elemental called Nader has attacked my people in nearby lands.

These events must be related.

Find this Nader and put an end to him. Make sure to search his body for clues as to what is behind this.

passages.title: Thunder on the Sands
passages.text: Have you found anything, <name>?

passages.title: Thunder on the Sands
passages.text:
So, you found this stone upon his body?

Interesting... Let me take a closer look.

passages.title: Sashj'tar Slayer
passages.text:
I cannot believe that Throndyr is gone.

By the horns on my head, we shall have revenge for all of the pain that the Sashj'tar have inflicted on us!

Press forward, <name>. Kill them! Kill them all!

passages.title: Prepare To Strike
passages.text:
The Burning Legion took us by surprise at the Peak of Serenity. We will not allow them to do so again!

We have trained hard, but we need weapons capable of destroying this great evil if we are to have any chance of success.

Our scrolls speak of several weapons that should prove suitable, but we are unable to decide which one to pursue first.

The choice, Grand Master, is yours.

passages.title: Prepare To Strike
passages.text: As you wish, Grand Master.

passages.title: Proof of Honor
passages.text:
<Brandolf breathes heavily.>

This cave will be my final resting place, <name>.

Find Toryl. Tell her of what happened here today.

Tell all of Jandvik that I died defending our village...

passages.title: A Summons From Moonglade
passages.text:
<name>, Your presence is requested at Moonglade at once.

We are preparing for a ritual of great importance and will require your assistance.

I will meet you there, so please come with haste.

passages.title: A Summons From Moonglade
passages.text:
<name>, I'm pleased you came on such short notice.

We have a great undertaking here in the Moonglade that is about to begin, one in which you will play a key role.

passages.title: The Dreamway
passages.text:
The preparations for the ritual are now complete.

Come with me, <name>, I will guide you to the ceremony.

passages.title: The Dreamway
passages.text: Are you ready to begin the ritual?

passages.title: The Dreamway
passages.text:
Well done, <name>!

Now that the path is open we can begin our journey to Val'sharah.

passages.title: To The Dreamgrove
passages.text:
The portal to the Dreamway is open and it is here where our paths must part. The Moonglade remains vulnerable to the attacks of the Burning Legion and I must ensure it is well defended.

I'm entrusting you with the mission to Val'sharah, <name>. Archdruid Greathoof is the leader of the druids there. He is wise in the old ways and will provide us invaluable assistance.

The Dream can be dangerous so I will send Keeper Remulos to guide you. Meet with him upon the other side.

passages.title: To The Dreamgrove
passages.text:
You did well to navigate through the Emerald Dream to get to this place. Still, there are times when you might wish to return here a bit more quickly. This spell will guide you.

Traveling the Dreamway is no small feat in itself, but it pales to the tasks ahead.

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
I agree with Keeper Remulos. To confront and defeat the Legion, we will need weapons of legendary power.

Among the history of our kind, there have been four weapons of renown.

Tell me, which weapon would you pursue first?

passages.title: Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
Excellent choice, <name>!

With the power of that weapon in your hands we will be able to bring balance back to Azeroth.

passages.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
passages.text:
Now that we have Ursol's blessing, we can safely pass the magical wards and reach the claws' resting place!

Now, we must pass into the Dream. Lay down before the Shrine of Ursol and drink of the moonwater you brought earlier and your spirit will drift off into the dream.

Be careful, the Dream can be a dangerous place.

passages.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
passages.text: Have you retrieved the Claws of Ursoc?

passages.title: When Dreams Become Nightmares
passages.text:
I owe you my life, <name>. If it wasn't for your actions I'd be dead or worse.

That traitor, Xavius, may have taken Ursoc but at least we were able to recover the claws. Hope is not lost to us yet.

passages.title: Meet with Mylune
passages.text:
It would seem we are fortuitous that you seek G'Hanir this day, <name> - the dryad Mylune arrived not long ago from the sacred shrine where the staff has been guarded for many centuries.

Few are privy to its hidden location within the roots of Shaladrassil, but you have certainly earned that right.

Speak to Mylune when you are ready to depart - I saw her last just east of here up the hill.

passages.title: Meet with Mylune
passages.text:
<Mylune's eyes are watery with dew, her usual smile an unsightly frown.>

Y-yes?

passages.title: The Seed of Ages
passages.text:
These weapons were crafted with ancient magic. The true power of your artifact lies in its ability to grow in strength. The more you use it, the stronger it will become.

Now that you have attuned your weapon to the Seed of Ages you can use its magic to unlock additional attributes in your weapon.

Use it now, and unlock your weapon's potential.

passages.title: The Seed of Ages
passages.text:
Excellent!

As your weapon grows in power you can return here and unleash its true potential.

passages.title: Word on the Winds
passages.text:
It is time that we turn our attention to matters in the Broken Isles.

Skylord Omnuron has gathered information on events from all over the Isles. If we are presented with any opportunity to strike against the Legion he will know of it.

Go and see if he has anything available.

passages.title: Word on the Winds
passages.text:
Greetings, Archdruid.

The threats we face are numerous. We must act quickly.

passages.title: Making Trails
passages.text:
The Burning Legion threatens the life of Azeroth, but the nightmare threatens its very soul. We must remove both threats if our world is to survive.

This map will allow us to track the developments all across the Broken Isles and respond to threats as they arise. Our forces are limited for now, so we should focus our efforts where they will be the most effective.

Once you've taken a look, you should choose where we shall begin.

passages.title: Making Trails
passages.text:
Yes, I agree. That is a good place to focus our initial efforts.

As new threats arise, I will bring them to your attention. Elune guide your path, Archdruid.

passages.title: Druids of the Claw
passages.text:
A new ally has joined our ranks. His name is Yaris Darkclaw, a skilled trainer among the Druids of the Claw.

Go speak to him now.

passages.title: Druids of the Claw
passages.text: Excellent. Soon enough, the Druids of the Claw will bolster our ranks.

passages.title: Lost Knowledge
passages.text:
We are indeed familiar with the Nightborne's magic, but we were never allowed access to the Heart. It was a right reserved only for the Queen's favored.

However, we can still learn how to properly tap its magic.

Thousands of years ago, a Nightborne scholar studied the Heart and documented his findings in great detail. He was executed and the scroll of his writings banned, but the Nightfallen secreted it away in their escape.

If you obtain the scroll, we can help you.

passages.title: Lost Knowledge
passages.text: The Nightfallen have become... distrustful... since the Nightborne's betrayal. You will have to earn their respect before they will let you near the scroll.

passages.title: Lost Knowledge
passages.text: <Thalrenus reads over the scroll carefully.>

passages.title: You Must Make Haste
passages.text:
I suggest that you set off immediately, <name>. You have been here for far too long - the Legion's assassins could close in at any moment to make an attempt on your life.

Do take caution when using the heart - even with the bindings to aid you the power within is dangerous.

passages.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
passages.text:
The book you carry is the key to your friends' salvation, and to your absolute power! It holds within information about many relics too dangerous to the Legion to leave unchecked.

Read, friend. And decide which of these artifacts you will use to strike Jagganoth down!

passages.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
passages.text: Have you made your choice?

passages.title: The Tome of Blighted Implements
passages.text: Yes, friend chose very wisely!

passages.title: Into the Mouth of the Nether
passages.text:
With the ritual failed and the council scattered, you find yourself trapped in the prison of the pit lord, Jagganoth.

The situation is grim, but with the help of the remaining council members, you may be able to escape.

passages.title: Purity of Form
passages.text:
Master, we have discovered a new technique that allows one with great focus to shape Chi within magical objects. This technique should allow you to considerably improve the abilities of your new weapon.

This technique requires a great deal of focus so we are limited to only a single upgrade for now, but that will have to do.

passages.title: Purity of Form
passages.text:
This weapon is truly amazing, yet much of its potential remains untapped.

If we are to end the threat of the Burning Legion once and for all we will need to fully unlock its power.

passages.title: Xalethar
passages.text:
The satyr known as Xalethar has been sighted near the Den of Dreams in Val'sharah.

Several reports have come in regarding demon activity in that area. I want you to go and investigate.

Search for Xalethar near the Den of Dreams and slay him without mercy.

passages.title: Priestly Matters
passages.text:
<Master/Mistress> <name>, I come at the behest of one who seeks to organize a stronger resistance to the Legion threat.

If you would meet him at Faol's Rest in Tirisfal Glades, he will guarantee both your safety and an opportunity to play a pivotal role in the conflict.

passages.title: Priestly Matters
passages.text:
Can I take that as a yes?

If you are ready, I'd like to get started immediately.

I know you are immensely capable, but let's not leave anything to chance!

passages.title: A Legend You Can Hold
passages.text:
To face the trials ahead, you require a weapon that can enhance your considerable abilities. I have learned of a few possibilities that you might consider.

You must decide which weapon to pursue first. I have the utmost confidence in your decision.

passages.title: A Legend You Can Hold
passages.text: A wise choice. My brethren and I stand ready to assist you on your next move, <name>.

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
I was wrong about you, warlock. Your assistance against the Dark Riders has proven a great service to the Light. Perhaps I should not be so quick to judge.

Nevertheless, you have allowed me to fill my purpose in returning these artifacts to their rightful owners. As for Ulthalesh, I can think of no safer place than in your care. 

May it serve you well against the Legion, warlock.

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
Friend has the weapon? 

Yes, Calydus can feel its power!

passages.title: The Call To War
passages.text:
<A chilling thought brushes your mind.>

Hear me, <name>.

The Legion has returned. They hope to control us, to bend us to their will. Fools - they only walk back within reach of our blades.

Your brethren within Dalaran have begun to gather at Krasus' Landing. Go, meet with Duke Lankral and all will be explained.

passages.title: The Call To War
passages.text:
I'm sure you have many questions, but they're just going to have to wait. We're at war now!

We have to move quickly, but I'll try to explain what I can.

passages.title: A Pact of Necessity
passages.text:
We have an unexpected ally in this war, <name>, and we're going to need every advantage we can get to defeat the Burning Legion.

The Ebon Blade will serve as the Lich King's arm as long as the Scourge is confined to Northrend. In return for our assistance, our ally has offered to assist in obtaining powerful weapons for the strongest of our knights. Weapons powerful enough to end the Legion once and for all!

You are one of our best, <name>. I want you to decide which weapon you would like to seek out.

passages.title: A Pact of Necessity
passages.text: Excellent choice.

passages.title: Calling of the Council
passages.text:
<The arcane anomaly addresses you in Khadgar's voice.>

Though I am loathe to interrupt your fight against the Legion, I must request your help in a matter of... diplomacy. We face a grave threat, and we require the full might of Azeroth's people to overcome it.

The Horde must become part of the Kirin Tor once again. Some will not agree with this position.

Please join me outside the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. We have repositioned the city to defend the Eastern Kingdoms, above Karazhan.

passages.title: Calling of the Council
passages.text:
Jaina's reaction was unfortunate, but not unexpected. She has endured so much...

Though it was Garrosh Hellscream who ordered the obliteration of Theramore, the only thing she can think of when she looks at you, or any Horde, is her desire for vengeance. I hope one day she can overcome that hatred.

Enough ruminating. We must prepare the Kirin Tor for war.

passages.title: Arganax
passages.text:
A satyr known as Arganax has infiltrated the village of Lorlathil in Val'sharah. I believe that Arganax has disguised himself as one of the local residents.

Use the demon Eye of Azzorok on the villagers in Lorlathil. If there is a demon disguised as a local, the Eye of Azzorok will reveal their true identity.

Uncover the demon infiltrator Arganax, and slay him without mercy.

passages.title: All Along the Waterways
passages.text:
I've noticed some wandering eyes, lately.

I am more than happy to continue delivering the goods to Vanthir, but it is getting increasingly dangerous to do so. 

The Duskwatch that walk the bazaar are by far the most observant.

Find and slay the Orbitists so that I may deliver the goods safely.

I will follow behind with the shipment.

passages.title: All Along the Waterways
passages.text: What of Deline?

passages.title: All Along the Waterways
passages.text: Deline was able to deliver the goods safely, thanks to you.

passages.title: One of the People
passages.text:
It is time for you to enter the city proper, <name>.

I am sending you to my loyal friend Vanthir. I do hope you remember him- I can guarantee that he remembers you.

I will not be able to accompany you, but I must stress that the disguise I have granted you is not impervious. Tread carefully, and avoid those who stare too long.

Farewell for now.

passages.title: One of the People
passages.text: Glad you could make it. Your help is sorely needed here.

passages.title: Network Security
passages.text:
We must lock down the facility. Otherwise my esteemed colleagues from the palace could uncover my secrets, which puts any teleporters I build for you and Thalyssra at risk.

<The inactive attunement device near Oculeth hums to life.>

This will take us to my secret test chamber beneath the mountain. From there we can begin the lockdown sequence and make our escape!

passages.title: Network Security
passages.text: Did we... make it?

passages.title: A Token of Remembrance
passages.text:
The flower rests peacefully in your hand, glowing softly.

While it doesn't appear to be growing anywhere nearby, there are small bouquets of the flower on some of the memorials around here.

Perhaps laying down some flowers on the remaining graves will ease the gloom.

passages.title: Emissary
passages.text:
As if things weren't unsettled enough, guests have arrived... the Illidari.

These demon hunters have been imprisoned since their master's fall at the Black Temple. For the Wardens to release them can only mean the peril is dire indeed.

Their delegation's leader, Allari "the Souleater," claims Orgimmar faces a hidden threat. I gave them leave to establish a camp within the city... for now.

You will speak with her at once. Find out whether this threat is credible.

passages.title: Emissary
passages.text:
<Allari furrows her brow as she speaks.>

You didn't think the leadership of the Horde could gather in one location and go unnoticed by the Burning Legion, did you?

passages.title: Whispers from Oronaar
passages.text:
Ethereals, the Void, a Dark Naaru... I feel they are all connected.

I explored the ruins below while you and Velen were seeking the Crown. There are survivors, <name>.

Broken wander the cluster of buildings to our west- I cannot understand much of what they say but I suspect that their minds are not their own.

If the Void is to blame, we will need to start our investigation there.

I will conduct my own search in the meantime.

passages.title: Whispers from Oronaar
passages.text: Something is very wrong here.

passages.title: Zealot's Dues
passages.text:
Commander Domitille represents the very essence of the Nightborne's corruption. Abhorrent of power not their own, enamoured with their Grand Magistrix to the point of zealotry, and focused utterly on the destruction of the Moon Guard.

Take her helm to Lothrius as proof of her demise.

passages.title: Zealot's Dues
passages.text: I was wondering why she had suddenly gone silent. It is a small comfort to my heart, but a great blow to the remaining forces of the Nightborne. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: Keeper's Request
passages.text:
The Blackroot have become savage and aggressive. The confluence of energy in this area was simply too much for these furbolgs to handle.

I have tried to soothe their minds, but my efforts have all ended in violence. There is little else that can be done, <race>.

They must be cut down to protect the neighboring lands.

passages.title: Wild By Nature
passages.text:
Furbolgs often empower totems to harness their natural power and ward off enemies.

Unfortunately, due to the malicious nature of the Blackroot, their totems are tainting any poor creature that comes near them,

We can't allow others to be corrupted by their totems.

passages.title: Trophy Hunting
passages.text:
Dat Hemet Nesingwary think he be such a great hunter. When we ask to join his hunt, he laugh at us and turn us away. We show him who da best hunter really be.

Only thing, mon, we be needin' your help.

Redtooth be da most dangerous prey in the area. I'd hunt it myself, but those pale creepers be all over da place.

passages.title: Kazok'thul
passages.text:
A rogue felhunter known as Kazok'thul has been terrorizing Azurewing Repose in Azsuna.

Felhunters feed on arcane energy and it seems that Kazok'thul has been gorging itself on the mana from nearby Azurewing whelps.

Travel to Azurewing Repose and speak with Ardonu to find the last known location of Kazok'thul.

Slay the demon and return here when your mission is complete.

passages.title: We Need Even More Power!
passages.text:
Good new, <race>! I have located another power orb.

I last saw it down by the Nightborne encampment to the southwest. I had to get out of there before their patrols saw me, but it should be no trouble for you, now should it?

passages.title: Hunting Impaired
passages.text:
<Kalla motions for you to come closer and whispers.>

I do not want Mom to hear, but as you can probably tell by all the wounded, these hunters are not very skilled. They are more likely to twist an ankle than they are to track down a lame deer.

I cannot be everywhere at once. If you come across any of our band in the wilds, please tend to them.

passages.title: Relief For Parim
passages.text:
The air around these flowers is sweet and crisp.

Parim Eversong would welcome the pleasant smell of these flowers.

passages.title: The Scythe of Elune
passages.text:
I have received word that Tyrande herself has authorized the release of a great artifact, the Scythe of Elune, to aid our cause. Valorn Stillbough has agreed to give up the weapon, which he has kept as part of an investigation into the cursed worgen of Duskwood.

I believe that you, champion, will be our best hope at wielding its power without succumbing to the animal rage that ebbs within. You must go to Duskwood, and take up the scythe against our foes!

passages.title: The Scythe of Elune
passages.text: The champion arrives. I hope you are prepared for this burden.

passages.title: The Scythe of Elune
passages.text:
Well met, champion. 

Are you ready for the burden you must bear?

passages.title: Its Rightful Place
passages.text:
Though it goes against my better judgment, it is Tyrande's wish that the Scythe of Elune be brandished once more against the new Legion threat. It is a small comfort to see it wielded by a keeper of the balance, such as yourself.

Know that the last time the scythe was wielded, it resulted in great calamity. You must be vigilant to contain the bestial wrath that ebbs within. 

With those words in your heart, take the scythe and bring its fury against our foes. May the light of Elune protect you.

passages.title: Its Rightful Place
passages.text: The scythe is yours, <class>.

passages.title: Its Rightful Place
passages.text:
Valorn...

That was.. a Dark Rider!

But how did they reach us here, under the protection of the grove?

passages.title: Withered and Creeping
passages.text:
Have you seen those pale creepers, mon? I've seem 'em lurching about outside da camp.

They be scarin' away our game and makin' us look bad.

<Mom'zula leans in and whispers.>

They also make my skin crawl. I bet dat even Hemet would turn hide and run if he saw one.

I'm tellin' ya, mon. They be bad voodoo.

passages.title: A Matter of Planning
passages.text:
Your weapon is stronger than ever, now is the perfect time to put it to use and take our fight to the Legion.

Master Hsu has set up a command table by the training grounds, and has collected reports from our friends and allies around all of Azeroth.

When you are ready, Grandmaster, he should have an update prepared for you.

passages.title: A Matter of Planning
passages.text:
Grandmaster, I've prepared a brief report on all that I've heard about the Broken Isles.

You may find it quite interesting.

passages.title: The Fight Begins
passages.text:
The Burning Legion has left a trail of ruin all across the face of Azeroth. We must strike at their bases within the Broken Isles if we are to have any hope of ending this war.

I've put together a map of the isles and a list of tasks that we will need to have done there.

Once you've had a chance to peruse the map, you should choose where we will begin our assault.

passages.title: The Fight Begins
passages.text: An excellent choice, Grandmaster.

passages.title: Lingering on the Edge
passages.text:
I h-have made... mistakes...

<Absolon draws in a rasping breath.>

I want to make it right... I want to live! But the madness... the WITHERING..

I am... fading.

<Absolon stares at you helplessly.>

passages.title: Lingering on the Edge
passages.text: Can you help me? Is there nothing you can do?

passages.title: Lingering on the Edge
passages.text: <Absolon immediately consumes the Ancient Mana and seems incapable of speech for a short while.>

passages.title: Meet The Master
Arcano-Plasm
passages.text:
Hey there, friend. I am in a bit of a bind and I was hoping that you could lend me some assistance.

I was studying the nearby ley line that runs through this area. Well, I was paying close attention to my scanners, but not to my fuel gauge.

I managed to put down my gyro safely, but I'm out of fuel.

According to my scans, there are deposits of Arcano-Plasm in this tunnel, which I can convert into fuel.

You'll need this Arcane-Drano to extract the samples.

passages.title: Clearing the Tunnels
passages.text:
The nearby tunnel runs right along the very ley line that I've been studying from the sky. It's a happy coincidence that I landed at this very spot, don't you think?

<Nedward frowns a bit.>

Well, it would haven been, but it seems that the ley line has also attracted every withered creature in Suramar.

Could you lend me a hand and get them to scoot?

passages.title: Fuel Transfer Worker
passages.text:
I knew that I could extract fuel from the Arcano-Plasm, but after getting an eyeful of all those withered creatures running about, I decided to send my Fuel Transfer Worker to collect the samples. I call him FTW-001 for short.

Unfortunately, FTW-001 never came back out and I there's no way in Gnomeregan that I am going in after it.

Keep an eye out for it if you go in there, would ya?

passages.title: Not to Scale
passages.text:
I was looking for my husband when I accidentally stumbled on this group of naga.

One of those large brutes nearly crushed me with his foot, but I ran and hid in this cage for protection.

If I am going to get out of here with my life, I'll need a disguise. I have the know-how, but I need the components. That's where you come in.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text:
We have long relied on Lord Illidan to vanquish the Legion's strongest warriors - many have expressed concern over our efforts without him.

Thankfully, their concerns may not matter much longer.

We know of two pairs of blades rumored to be more powerful than even Lord Illidan's that are not yet out of reach.

If we act quickly we should be able to hunt down one without forsaking our watch over the Legion's movements.

I must defer judgment on which is most worthy of our time to you, <name>.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text: Well chosen. There isn't a moment to spare.

passages.title: From Within
passages.text:
Our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.

I haven't heard from them in a while.

It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

passages.title: From Within
passages.text:
Oh, <name>, it's you. Good, we've got a little problem here .

Altruis didn't think that Cyana and I could handle this on our own? He might have been right this time.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text:
Illidan and I may have disagreed, but he was unarguably powerful. He was pivotal in vanquishing some of the Legion's most powerful soldiers.

However, that may not matter much longer.

There are two pairs of blades rumored to be more powerful than even Illidan's that may still be within reach.

Regrettably, our numbers are too few to hunt both while maintaining our vigil over the Legion. I fear our window of opportunity is waning quickly.

As the ranking Illidari, that decision falls to you.

passages.title: The Power to Survive
passages.text: You must move quickly - our time is short.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text:
Do you recall Varedis, <name>? He was once our lead trainer, but fell with the Black Temple years ago.

...or so we thought.

Kor'vas spotted the traitor alongside the Legion... wielding glaives imbued with power unlike anything she'd ever seen.

The Kirin Tor have an eredar lord locked away in the Violet Hold that will know where Varedis' stronghold lies. The prison warden has agreed to consider granting us access to the fiend.

Time to do some convincing.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text: I hold little love for these mages and their ilk, but they are necessary allies.

passages.title: Power Overwhelming
passages.text:
Jagganoth's minions are now yours to command, Overlord, but there is more power to this place than just that!

Here, at the Seat of the Overlord, you will find a special altar, formed of the pit lord's blood and charged with his power. This power can be transferred to your new weapon.

Approach the altar, Overlord, and claim Jagganoth's power for your own!

passages.title: Power Overwhelming
passages.text:
Yes, your weapon grows stronger! 

Friend cannot rest, though, for a new danger lies around the corner!

passages.title: Rebuilding the Council
passages.text:
It seems that friend has caught the attention of Mephistroth. This is very bad news, as the dreadlord will surely wish to seek revenge for losing his general.

Friend will need more than the Dreadscar to stand against him, you will need powerful warlocks such as those who were captured.

Calydus thinks the orc still lies in the pit where you were chained. Friend must revive him, and rebuild the council!

passages.title: Rebuilding the Council
passages.text: I will not rest until the council has been rebuilt.

passages.title: Rebuilding the Council
passages.text:
I can hardly believe my eyes. For one <class> to control an entire army of demons is beyond what I thought the council was capable of. 

I only hope such power is enough to turn the tide of this war.

passages.title: The Path of the Dreadscar
passages.text:
It would seem that where the council has failed, you have found untold success. These Dreadscar should prove powerful allies, but they may not be enough.

For now, we must look to rebuild. I will send agents out to locate the whereabouts of the captured council members, as well as any other warlocks who may be able to aid the cause.

Meet me at the scrying pool, and we will plan our action from there.

passages.title: The Path of the Dreadscar
passages.text: The plan is set, and the wheels are in motion.

passages.title: Arcano-Plasm
passages.text:
You got time to give a goblin a hand? Good, thought so.

I was flying my rocket and taking readings of this ley line, you see. Only I wasn't keeping an eye on my fuel reserves. Long story short, I ran out of gas.
