I set it down safely and all, but I don't have enough fuel to get me outta here. There's a nearby cave filled with Arcano-Plasm, which I can use to fuel my rocket. Wanna get some for me?

Oh yeah, you'll need this here Arcano-Drano to extract it.

passages.title: Clearing the Tunnels
passages.text:
Before I went down, I was tracing the nearby ley line. Turns out, it goes right by the nearby caves.

I'd like to get down there for a closer look, but that ley line is attracting every withered from here to Azsuna.

But hey, you look like a strong <race>. I bet you'd have no problem clearing them out of there. It's just like trying to clear rats out of a sewer.

Well, sort of.

passages.title: Fuel Transfer Worker
passages.text:
I'm no dummy, <name>. I let my brains do the work for me. When I landed, I sent in my personal Fuel Transfer Worker to gather up the Arcano-Plasm.

I call it the FTW-001. Great name, right? Well anyway, the darn thing never came back with my Arcano-Plasm.

I ain't about to go chasing after it with all of those withered things running about.

If you come across the FTW-001, would ya let me know? I'll even throw in a few coins for your trouble.

passages.title: Close Enough
passages.text:
<Oculeth's eyes have dulled. His voice trembles.>

Are we... are we close?

So hungry...

passages.title: Close Enough
passages.text: Where is Oculeth?

passages.title: Close Enough
passages.text: Thank you for recovering Oculeth. He will be an invaluable asset to our cause.

passages.title: Call of The Uncrowned
passages.text:
My masters gave me strict instructions to deliver this letter to you as quickly as possible.

Its contents are for you and you alone.

Good luck.

passages.title: Call of The Uncrowned
passages.text:
Your reputation precedes you, <name>.

Apologies for the secrecy. We simply could not risk the wrong person finding us here.

passages.title: Mograine's Recruit
The Deadwind Hunt
passages.text:
The Nightbane! If they are in Deadwind Pass, then they may be seeking the scythe as well.

Let's split up and try to track them down. We'll see where their trail leads...

passages.title: The Deadwind Hunt
passages.text:
The worgen appear to be drawn to the catacombs beneath Karazhan.

Could it be...

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
This sewer grate leads to the catacombs underneath Karazhan. I've never paid it much attention, but it seems to be where the Nightbane are being drawn to.

To think, the Dark Riders may have been under our noses this entire time! Come, let us see where this leads.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text: It is done.

passages.title: The Dark Riders
passages.text:
Today was a great blow against the Dark Riders, and a victory for the people of Duskwood. 

They are in your debt, as am I.

passages.title: The Final Shadow
passages.text:
You walk in the halls of the Uncrowned. We are the slayers of kings, the downfall of empires, the unseen blades that write the true history of this world.

Seated before you are the Shadows, the council which aims the blades of the Uncrowned wherever our will demands.

We have brought you here today with an offer. Take your seat as the final Shadow and help us lead the Uncrowned.

What do you say?

passages.title: The Final Shadow
passages.text: It's up to you, <name>.

passages.title: The Final Shadow
passages.text: Welcome to the Uncrowned, Shadow <name>.

passages.title: A Worthy Blade
passages.text:
For quite some time, we've been looking for someone who can operate outside these halls.

<name>, you are the answer to that search. You will be the blade in the dark that vanquishes our foes.

In order to do so, you require weapons capable of striking down the Legion's best.

Greymane, Tethys, and Valeera each have devised plans to obtain weapons worthy of the tasks to come. I suggest you hear each out before proceeding.

passages.title: A Worthy Blade
passages.text: Well chosen.

passages.title: The Aid of Val'sharah
passages.text:
The land is in pain, <name>, and we have felt its suffering. The druids of Val'sharah will not stand idly by and let our ancient home fall to ruin at the hands of the Leyspine naga.

Our charge is to protect nature. These naga seem only to want to destroy it. We must cut down their leaders and drive back their forces.

With you help, <name>, we may still be able to save this land.

passages.title: Coastal Healing
passages.text:
The earth has suffered wounds at the hands of the Leyspine naga. They have subjugated murlocs to tear up the land and extract its resources for their own devices.

<Lyris hands you a pouch of seeds.>

I have infused these seeds with restorative essences. Place a seed in any scar left by the murlocs and the healing can begin.

passages.title: A Friendly Accord
passages.text:
I'd like to offer ya an accord.

The Dread Admiral Eliza wields a pair of cursed blades that have made her the scourge of the south seas. She also stole one of me best ships - the Horizon's Edge - and has it anchored off the shore of Azsuna as we speak. 

If you help me take back me ship, then her cursed blades are yours.

Now, assuming that sounds agreeable, meet me aboard the Crimson Veil. We have her docked right in Booty Bay - not a cheap arrangement.

passages.title: A Friendly Accord
passages.text: Aha! I knew you'd come!

passages.title: Foe Underestimation
passages.text:
<The scroll is written in an elegant script.>

With the arrival of the Legion, we will be expanding our territory far beyond the confines of Suramar.

You are to enter the ruins underneath Featherfall Village and dispose of any and all creatures that are inhabiting it.

Take heed. Our scouts have reported many creatures roaming its ancient halls, including a large crystalline giant.

Report back to Suramar after the ruins are clear.

passages.title: The Dreadblades
passages.text:
I can promise ya a safe journey to Eliza's position, but once we're there... well, we both know there be no guarantees.

The plan is simple. We'll take the Crimson Veil as close as we can get her without being seen and disembark from there.

Once we're ashore, we'll board the Horizon's Edge, bribe her mutinous crew to hand it over, and hunt down Eliza and her legendary blades wherever she may be.

Just say the word when yer ready.

passages.title: The Dreadblades
passages.text: You did fine work today, lad.

passages.title: Darkwell's Request
passages.text:
When I was exiled from Suramar, I tried all manner of things in order to sustain myself.

Many of the creatures that reside in these ruins contain traces of Ancient Mana, but have converted into a crystalline form that is useless to me.

As chance would have it, Manashale loves to eat this crystallized mana. When he is, uh, done digesting it, the results are turned into a form that I can use.

If you have any of this crystallized mana on you, I'd sure like to have it.

passages.title: Endless Possibilities
passages.text:
Say, since you're down here, I have something that you might be interested in.

<Filgo points over to a husk lying in the junk behind him.>

I found that thingy down in Azsuna, just lying on the beach. I'm sure with a little tinkering, an engineer like you could probably get it up and running in no time.

Might even be useful against the Legion. Kind of like fighting fel with fel, heh!

passages.title: Endless Possibilities
passages.text: Is there something you need fixed?

passages.title: Endless Possibilities
passages.text:
How did you get your hands on this?!

<Didi begins inspecting the husk.>

Do you realize what we could do with something like this? Our own personal fel reaver?!

We could lay waste to our enemies!

We could advance our knowledge of science and technology!

We could make it serve us drinks!

passages.title: Our Man in Azsuna
passages.text:
Yikes! OK. This thing is missing a LOT of parts.

Why don't you go hunt down some new gears or whatever while I do what I can to its existing frame?

A colleague of ours, down in Azsuna, may be able to help out here. His name's Flintlocke.

Fetching parts should keep him out of trouble. Just don't let him BUILD anything.

passages.title: Our Man in Azsuna
passages.text:
Shush-it, <class>! This 'ere place is crawlin' with demony things.

Aye, Didi sent ye, did she? How is tha wee lass?

If yer lookin' for demon parts, I can certainly help yeh with that!

passages.title: It'll Cost You
passages.text:
If yeh need demon parts, oh aye, this place is right teeming with them fel buggers.

Yer bound ta find what'yer lookin' fer probably near them portals they've got jus' sou'east of 'ere.

passages.title: It'll Cost You
passages.text: Found what'cha need yet?

passages.title: It'll Cost You
passages.text:
Just wat are ye and Didi puttin' together exactly?

Is it big? Dangerous? Rer-diculous?

I want in!

passages.title: Bits and Pieces
passages.text:
So many artifacts to catalogue, and never enough time.

Good to see you again, <name>. Brann Bronzebeard and the Explorers' League are in Stormheim right now and could use your help tracking down an ancient titan relic.

Brann can fill you in on the details when you arrive.

passages.title: Bits and Pieces
passages.text: Oh good, another pair of hands. I'm on ta somethin', <name>. I jes' know it!

passages.title: The Missing Pieces
passages.text: Yeh seem ta 'ave everything yeh need. Head back to Didi now wit' yer supplies and giv'er a slap on tha back from me!

passages.title: The Missing Pieces
passages.text:
<You give Didi a slap on the back.>

Ugh! I take it Flintlocke says hello?

Let's see what you brought me! Oh good, these will work perfectly.

I'll get started on the repairs using a new invention of mine, the Auto-Hammer.

Here's a copy of the blueprints for it if you're interested in making one for yourself.

passages.title: The Latest Fashion: Headguns!
passages.text:
So Grapplehammer's got hisself a whole lotta extra guns, right? Glorious! An'it got me ta thinkin', "What if we put 'em on our heads?"

Hear me out!

See, yer hands are already busy with yer current weapons, but what's yer head doin'? It's just sittin' there LOOKIN' at stuff. That's me plan. Weaponize yer head!

You, me lucky <lad/lass>, can test it out. Strap this on. Now, go blast some fel-tainted critters down below. Blammo!

passages.title: The Latest Fashion: Headguns!
passages.text:
What'd I tell ya? Now THAT's usin' yer HEAD!

Yeh see what I did there?

Seeing as 'ow yeh tested them out fer me, I'll let yeh 'ave a copy of the blueprint fer 'em.

passages.title: Resupplying the Line
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to make a delivery for me.

Flintlocke's sent word from Val'sharah stating that they're out of bullets.

I sent him down there with enough ammo to cut the planet in half, but Flintlocke goes through ammunition the way you or I go through... air. Go help him out!

passages.title: Resupplying the Line
passages.text: Oh aye! This is exactly what we needed! I wuz about ta start flingin' wee animals.

passages.title: All Charged Up
passages.text:
If yer gonna wander inta these woods, ye'll be wantin' somethin' with some punch. These plants are a might grabby.

I've got me special explosive charges here that should send those fertilizer mutations back to the dirt.

Take 'em with yeh and give them viney beasties a what-fer!

passages.title: All Charged Up
passages.text:
Quite tha weed killer, eh? Haha!

I figure ye'll be wantin' more of them charges so I went ahead an' wrote down tha schematic fer ye.

I figure it's always good ta keep them plants an' trees in line when they get all uppity.

passages.title: It's Not Rocket Science
passages.text:
<name>, I need you to help me track down Flintlocke again.

I sent him to Stormheim to gather some materials for an invention of mine and he hasn't been back for days. I'm not worried about Flintlocke, but I DO fear for Stormheim.

See if you can find him!

passages.title: It's Not Rocket Science
passages.text:
<name>, what're ya doin 'ere? Hobart sent ye, didn'e?

Listen, I dunnae need yer help, but seein' as how yeh made yer way down 'ere, maybe we can stir up some trouble ta'gether.

passages.title: Locke and Load
passages.text:
Flintlocke's been looking for you, <name>. I think he needs your help again.

I sent him out to test out a couple of new inventions of mine back down in Azsuna. Look for him on the shoreline west of Oceanus Cove!

passages.title: Locke and Load
passages.text: Oh aye, there yeh are lad. I was kinda hopin' ta see yeh again.

passages.title: I'd Do It Myself, But...
passages.text:
If yer headed over ta tha sea giant caves, do me a favor give those slimy naga a right bludgerin'.

They done run oft with me rogue friend an' I figure some revenge is in order.

I'd do it meself but ol' Hobart would give me wut-fer if I abandoned his stuff.

passages.title: I'd Do It Myself, But...
passages.text:
Oh I wish I coulda been there ta see tha look on their fishy faces!

Eh, come ta think of it, fish always look kinda ser-prised.

passages.title: Locke, Stock and Barrel
passages.text:
Well that jes' about wraps up me work 'ere. I'll start packin up an'ead back ta Dalaran.

If yeh wouldn't mind, could yeh tell Hobart 'ow things went down 'ere? Maybe leave out tha bits with tha explodin', tha drownin', an' tha gettin captured an' what not.

Yer a proper friend, <name>!

passages.title: Locke, Stock and Barrel
passages.text:
So the gunshoes and pack were a success? I guess all these guns I made weren't such a waste after all.

Which reminds me, I saw the plans for those goggles Flintlocke made and I've got to say, they were rather crude in their design. "Dwarven Engineering" is a bit of an oxymoron.

I've updated the schematic to not require so many materials.

passages.title: Short Circuit
passages.text:
While I've got you here, I was wondering if you could track something down for me.

I'm sure you're familiar with a Blingtron, yes? Well, I started askin' around, and it seems no one really knows where the design for it came from. One rumor does pop up more than others, though:

Area 52.

Interested in a field trip?

passages.title: Short Circuit
passages.text:
An old schematic, still intact, is floating amongst the papers.

As you examine the schematic you realize that it's the circuit design for Blingtron!

passages.title: Corrupted Into Crystal
passages.text:
<class>, We need your help!

We came here from Val'sharah to lend aid to our sisters against the Legion. When we arrived, we found that they had been corrupted by the arcane energies that flow through these ruins.

Before we could act, our corrupted sisters attacked us. Those of us that remain have been backed into this corner. Here we must make a final stand.

If we are to survive this onslaught, we will need to fight our way out.

passages.title: Transplanting Their Cores
passages.text:
All dryads have a connection with nature, <name>. We live to nurture all living things. Even in their corrupted state, our sisters are fostering the growth of the plants in these ruins.

Sadly, these plants are feeding off of the corruption that has taken over.

The Shalebark have a natural resistance to this corruption. If their cores have not been tainted, there still is a chance to cleanse and replant them elsewhere.

Of course, that assumes that we escape with our lives.

passages.title: Verdant Search
passages.text:
When the Corrupted Sisters set upon us, many of the Watchers fell behind when we fled. Few made here it, and fewer have the ability to fight.

We cannot let the Watchers die in this accursed place, but we don't have the strength to go into the ruins and retrieve them.

This is a task that I must ask of you.

Use this salve to treat the wounds of any Watcher that still draws breath.

passages.title: Serpents from the Deep
passages.text:
Hail, <class>.

My village of Jandvik has fallen under siege by a group of naga called the Sashj'tar.

Normally I would not seek out the help of an outsider, but we are facing an enemy that we are incapable of defeating.

Many powerful elven relics can be found in the ruins around Jandvik. In exchange for your help, you will have your just rewards.

Do we have an accord?

passages.title: Removing Obstacles
passages.text:
<class>! Interested in earning some coin?

The jarl of Jandvik is missing and two headstrong whelps are vying to take over leadership. I should be the next jarl, not them!

I want you to enter Jandvik and defeat Calder and Eynar in mortal combat.

I would not normally put my trust in an outsider, but this situation requires the aid of someone like you. Jandvik would condemn me if I were caught with their blood on my hands.

Meet me in the center of Jandvik when the deed is done.

passages.title: Removing Obstacles
passages.text: Do not underestimate Calder and Eynar.

passages.title: Removing Obstacles
passages.text: With my adversaries gone, I can claim leadership of Jandvik unopposed.

passages.title: Jarl Come Back Now
passages.text:
You seem to follow my commands well, <name>. Perhaps I can use you again.

Jarl Throndyr, the leader of Jandvik, has been missing for some time now. I assume that he has fallen in battle to the invading Sashj'tar naga, but I must know for certain.

Find out what has become of him.

Do this task for me and I can assure you that my vrykul will not harm you.

passages.title: Jarl Come Back Now
passages.text:
<Throndyr mutters through shallow breaths.>

Poison... runs through... my body.

passages.title: The Light and the Void
passages.text:
Alonsus Faol has been a valuable ally, and his instincts about you have proven true. I believe you are uniquely suited to assist in a matter that will bring a great force of good into this world.

I must take you somewhere far from Azeroth to finish a task my people began long ago. Will you aid us?

passages.title: The Light and the Void
passages.text: We have important work to do, <name>.

passages.title: The Light and the Void
passages.text: Welcome back, Cardinal. I think you'll find we've done quite a job getting this place prepared for you. We should get started immediately.

passages.title: Test Quest Two
Not Their Last Stand
passages.text:
I've been watching you- you are not with them.

<Ivanel coughs quietly.>

I am not long for this world, but there is one thing I would have you do while you are here.

The hippogryphs here still fight bitterly to defend their home and their companions in the Moon Guard. They have not accepted that the Guard is no more. 

Please... send them away. Let them know there is nothing left for them to fight for here.

passages.title: Not Their Last Stand
passages.text: What is it?

passages.title: Not Their Last Stand
passages.text: Thank you. I feel better knowing they will not continue to sacrifice themselves for us.

passages.title: The Unseen Path
passages.text:
For a thousand years, the Unseen Path has watched and waited. We remained few in number, quietly acting behind the scenes when Azeroth needed us. Only a select few even knew our group existed.

But the time for lingering in the shadows is over.

Before we begin our work, you should hear more about the Unseen Path.

passages.title: The Unseen Path
passages.text:
The Legion has returned, and the Unseen Path needs new blood... new leadership.

The weapon you hold is proof there is no one better suited to this task.

Will you take up the mantle? Will you fulfill the oath my order took so long ago?

passages.title: Survey Says...
passages.text:
It is time to establish the first secure connection in our teleportation network.

Take this beacon to the Ruins of Elune'eth above us and survey the area to find a suitable location.

Once your survey is complete, place the beacon and I will anchor a connection to it from here.

passages.title: Survey Says...
passages.text: <This seems like a good location for the teleporter.>

passages.title: Luminous Pearl
passages.text:
Balanced upon your fishing hook, you find a pearl unlike any other you've seen before. It shines with a cold, steady light, and its size and weight fluctuate in your hand.

This is clearly a magical item, and should be brought to a magical person.

passages.title: Luminous Pearl
passages.text: A pearl, you say? Well now, let me have a good look at that...

passages.title: The Dalaran Fountain
passages.text:
You fished this up, did you? I'm... not quite sure what you want ME to do about that. Here.

<Khadgar pats you on the head.>

"Good job."

With regard to the pearl... it does seem to be magical, but I couldn't tell you much more than that. Perhaps it might look nice in the Dalaran fountain?

passages.title: The Dalaran Fountain
passages.text:
She's a BEAUTY! I've never seen the like!

Yeah yeah, sure, throw 'er in that fountain. Light knows people throw all sorts of other junk in there.

<The pearl glows brighter now, and moves to a spot above the water.>

passages.title: The Rift Between
passages.text:
I was with Lothrius when the Nightborne poured into the stronghold.

He and his constructs managed to get the majority of us out of the Athenaeum, but he was cornered before he could make good on his own escape.

I know he still lives- I feel it in my gut!- but I cannot go back for him myself. My injuries are too severe.

Beakbuck will take you to where we last saw Lothrius. Simply let him know when you are ready to leave.

Go quickly, and good luck!

passages.title: The Rift Between
passages.text: Serena sent you? Good... she still lives.

passages.title: Recovering Stolen Power
passages.text:
My injuries will not kill me, but I cannot fight. I have my own idea of how to deal with the remaining Nightborne.

They destroyed our defense matrix as soon as they arrived. Surely one of them carries the spell focus necessary to reactivate it.

Find it, then go to a hippogryph. They linger throughout the Stronghold.

These loyal beasts will take you to the skies and take care of the rest.

passages.title: Starweaver's Fate
passages.text:
I will take these tomes to Thalrenus.

There is one thing that weighs heavily on my mind, and I would like for you to attend to it in my stead. 

My wife and life partner, Syrana Starweaver, resides in the Starweaver's Sanctum across the bridge. It fell shortly after the Nightborne entered the Stronghold. 

If she still lives she will need to know of our efforts. Her power is sorely needed. 

Give her my best- I will be along shortly.

passages.title: Starweaver's Fate
passages.text: Lothrius and Thalrenus live, then. There may be some hope yet. Thank you for braving the bridge, stranger.

passages.title: Creating Time
Latosius' Trial
passages.text: I bow to Latosius' wisdom. If we are to endure, it must be you who claims the Amulet. Survive this challenge, <name>, and the might of the Moon Guard will be yours forevermore.

passages.title: Audience with the Warchief
passages.text:
Tensions are running high, demon hunter. Warchief Vol'jin was gravely wounded in a disastrous assault on the Broken Shore.

I suggest you offer your skills in service of the Horde before your presence is... misinterpreted.

High Overlord Saurfang commands the city's defenses. Though wary of the Illidari, I believe he will give you a chance to prove your worth.

Speak to him and request passage into Grommash Hold.

passages.title: Audience with the Warchief
passages.text:
Vol'jin's death was part of a larger plan. The Legion thrives on weakening its enemies from within. The demons will strike when their enemy is at its most vulnerable.

Whatever grief the Horde's people are feeling, they can no longer afford to ignore us.

Our time is now, Illidari!

passages.title: Second Sight
passages.text:
Sylvanas becoming Warchief may be problematic. In life she was a proud ranger, known to many in our ranks. But since the Scourge took her, some of her own allies do not trust the Banshee Queen.

The Legion will strike at the first hint of dissension.

Even now, I sense something amiss, <name>. I fear that not all is as it seems.

Quickly, use your Spectral Sight. We must know if there are foes among us!

passages.title: Second Sight
passages.text: Time is precious.

passages.title: Second Sight
passages.text: Of course the Legion would try to infiltrate this funeral. With the leaders of the Horde gathered in one place at one time, it was too tasty of a target for the demons to resist.

passages.title: Too Many Cooks
passages.text:
Greetings. I am called Nomi.

I couldn't help but notice that recipe that you just picked up and... well, you'd never guess it, but I'm a bit of a chef myself.

Unfortunately, I'm not much of a fighter, and this place is dangerous. You, on the other hand, are clearly an accomplished <class>.

Come find me in Dalaran. Maybe we can work together!

passages.title: Too Many Cooks
passages.text:
<class>! I was hoping you'd come back.

Here, take a sample of some of the recipes and dishes I've been working on.

passages.title: The Prodigal Sous Chef
passages.text:
<name>? Master, is that you?

Don't you recognize me? It's me, Nomi! Remember, we cooked together in Pandaria? More accurately, you cooked and I learned. I was not much more than a cub back then.

Boy, am I glad to see you!

I'm headed back to the Dalaran kitchens. Come find me! Maybe we can work together!

passages.title: The Prodigal Sous Chef
passages.text:
Master <name>!! I knew you'd come.

Here, take a sample of some of the recipes and dishes I've been working on.

passages.title: Right Tools for the Job
passages.text:
The blades you wield are among the most powerful in all of Azeroth, but we must always remain two steps ahead of the enemy. Even now their armies grow in strength, and those weapons will make you a prime target for their assassins.

Speak with Marin Noggenfogger in the Uncrowned Vault next door. He recently completed a project which you will find most intriguing.

passages.title: Right Tools for the Job
passages.text: So, what can I do for you today, Master <name>?

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text:
If I might impart some advice to aid you on the trials and tribulations ahead: do not hesitate to use the many resources of the Uncrowned to aid your efforts.

There is a communal board in the tavern beyond this chamber where we organize the efforts of our underlings.

Seek out Nikki by the board - she can show you the ropes.

passages.title: Delegation
passages.text:
I don't know nothin' about nobody.

Oh, who I am I kiddin'? I know everything about everybody! How's it goin', Shadow <name>?

passages.title: Lethal Efficiency
passages.text:
Word is you're headin' down to the Broken Isles. That true?

Soon as news got out about the place, we combed through every book, tome, and paper we could get our hands on. We put together quite the report! You should take a look.

While you're here, this board is where the magic of the Uncrowned happens. You can put a bounty on a king's head, offer a reward for felsilk cloth... just jot down your latest whim and your agents will take care of it.

passages.title: Lethal Efficiency
passages.text: Great choice! We have tons of intel on that place.

passages.title: Rendezvous
passages.text:
<class>t <name>, the recruitment operation was successful.

Rendezvous in the Hall of Shadows as soon as possible to debrief.

passages.title: Shatter the Sashj'tar
passages.text:
The Sashj'tar forces may have dwindled, but the Tidemistress has surrounded herself with her fiercest naga.

This is the time to strike a final crushing blow against the Sashj'tar.

If we can defeat them now, we may finally break the back of this menace and save Jandvik.

passages.title: Shatter the Sashj'tar
passages.text: We must defeat the Sashj'tar once and for all.

passages.title: Shatter the Sashj'tar
passages.text: We may have finally overcome this naga threat.

passages.title: A Weapon of the Horde
passages.text:
It would seem I underestimated your initial value.

We will have need of your kind in the coming war. I plan to hunt these demons to the ends of Azeroth, and your kind will be the arrow I shall loose upon them.

Tell your Illidari within Orgrimmar to make ready to serve the Horde.

But make no mistake, your kind once served the Betrayer. Betray me, and there is no world you can run to that will save you from my vengeance.

passages.title: A Weapon of the Horde
passages.text:
You have proven our worth to the new Warchief. Excellent work.

To vanquish the Legion, we will need the Horde's strength at our backs.

passages.title: Hunter to Hunter
passages.text:
I sense the threads of fate entwined about you. Your destiny is tied to that of the ancient night elf who started you on this journey.

I can send you back to the city in the sky. From there, you must begin the task of gathering allies against the ravenous darkness.

Fight well, <name>. May Talonclaw serve you well.

passages.title: Fish Frenzy
passages.text:
<name>!

<pant, pant>

You've got to see it! The fish, they're... they're everywhere!

Off the coast of Val'sharah, something's whipping them up into a frenzy.

I've never seen better fishing in my life!

I've got a boat down below. Grab your pole and I'll take you there!

passages.title: Fish Frenzy
passages.text:
What in the world have you brought me?! Nat told you to ask me to turn THIS into a pole?

<Marcia takes the severed lure from you. As she holds it close to the pearl, it begins to resonate with it.>

That's interesting. There seems to be a connection between this and the pearl. Maybe turning this into a fishing rod can yield some interesting results...

passages.title: Artifacts Need Artificers
passages.text:
Your weapon is indeed powerful, but we shouldn't rest on our laurels. I've managed to procure one of the dwarves' foremost experts on artifice and enchanting.

I'd like you to speak with Betild and see if she can't infuse the weapon with even greater potency.

passages.title: Artifacts Need Artificers
passages.text: Ach, there ye are. Let me see that priceless weapon ye're swingin' 'round like a stick ye bought at the gift shop!

passages.title: Empowering Your Artifact
passages.text:
Since ye're bound an' determined ta crack that thing against every demon on Azeroth, let's see if we can't squeeze what we can out of it. With Saa'ra's power I've reworked this 'ere draenei altar into somethin' ye can use to focus... eh, let's skip that part, shall we?

Just stick the thing in there and give it a whirl!

passages.title: Empowering Your Artifact
passages.text:
Well ain't that nice an' shiny!

You'll need ta get used to usin' that thing. Then we can mess with it rather than, ye know, puttin' it in a museum and respectin' it for the piece o' history that it is.

 You should head back to Alonsus, he's giving us the eye.

passages.title: UNUSED - Agent of Aid
passages.text:
I see ol' Alonsus there givin' us the eye. That man ne'er sleeps, I tell ye! And now neither will ye, heh!

Go on then, looks like he wants ta introduce ye ta someone.

passages.title: One Last Breath
passages.text:
<The parchment is soaked in seawater. A note is hastily scribbled on it.>

To whomever finds this note first,

Before I was cast from Suramar, I was a master alchemist. In my time, I have concocted many potions and elixirs for the benefit of the Nightborne.

All of this was forgotten when the Legion came.

Before I succumb to the hunger, I wanted to create one last draught to celebrate my love of sea.

Drink it and explore the vast deep in my honor.

passages.title: Stop the Spell Seekers
passages.text:
The Nightborne are here in force. As if that were not worrying enough, they now bring reinforcements.

I have seen them opening large portals to Suramar.

Through these portals they have called in their constructs. They are immune to much of my magic and so represent something of a stumbling block to rejoining the others.

Find the portals and close as many as you can. That should buy us some time.

passages.title: Stop the Spell Seekers
passages.text: I can still sense them, <name>.

passages.title: Stop the Spell Seekers
passages.text: Yes! I can feel their spells receding. Soon I will be able to rejoin Thalrenus!

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text:
The gateway is fully functional, <name>. Ooh, I am positively tingling with excitement!

Do let Jace and the others know that we eagerly await your arrival. There's so much to do and ever so little time.

You will be joining us aboard, won't you?

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text: This place is built for war - it's exactly what we need to level the playing field.

passages.title: Felstorm's Plea
passages.text:
You may not know me, but I need your help, <name>.

Meet me in the Violet Gate and I'll explain everything. 

Make haste. I fear we have little time.

passages.title: Felstorm's Plea
passages.text:
I was a fool. I thought that I could banish Kathra'natir once and for all, but instead the dreadlord broke free.

In the years he spent trapped within my body, he must have been privy to my secrets... such as those of the Council of Tirisfal.

The damage he could do with this knowledge is unthinkable. He must be stopped.

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text:
Although our forces have dutifully held this citadel since your departure, we have been unable to access most of its resources - the Fel Hammer can only be fully activated by those bearing the mark of a Legion lord.

Thankfully, your blades carry that very mark. Use them to activate the Fel Hammer - show your forces your limitless power!

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text: The Fel Hammer is fully operational.

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text:
The Storm Brew is created by a legendary vrykul brewmaster named Melba. Here is the location of her meadery along the northern Stormheim coast.

If we can convince her to share her secret recipe with us, we will gain a significant advantage over the enemy.

Grandmaster, how are your skills of persuasion?

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text: What do you seek?

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text:
My master was loved by many, and she passed her knowledge to me.

However, the recipe for Storm Brew, her most fiercely guarded secret, was stolen before she could teach it to me.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Brewmaster
passages.text:
I've made a new breakthrough with Melba's Storm Brew recipe.

We need the use of a special cauldron, one owned by Odyn himself.

This cauldron is located in none other than the Halls of Valor.

There is only one way to enter this exalted place, and that is through the storm god's favor.

You must find a way to enter the hall of warriors. You may require allies for this endeavor, <name>.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: The Brewmaster
passages.text:
Hello, champion.

I have been watching you from afar.

passages.title: Sashj'tar Allies DISBALED
passages.text:
Commander Malt'his was conferring with a sea giant?

We are prepared to battle the naga, but if they have yoked the strength of the sea giants, we will have to double our efforts to save Jandvik.

You must tell Toryl about this grave news right away.

passages.title: Infused with Power
passages.text:
The weapon you hold will strike a potent blow against the Legion... but the demons are relentless. Just as your battle tactics grow and evolve, so must your weapon.

The altar before you courses with ancient magic, and is alive with the skill and dedication of the hunters who have used it through the ages.

Place your artifact upon it, and over time you will awaken the full potential of your weapon.

passages.title: Infused with Power
passages.text: Wondrous! The growing power of your artifact will strike fear into the hearts of the demon army!

passages.title: A Desperate Plea
passages.text:
<name>, Saurfang has not been the same since our loss at the Broken Shore. Though he led well and slew many, he has taken our defeat hard.

I fear he is determined to return to the Broken Shore. Will you speak to him?

passages.title: A Desperate Plea
passages.text: Will you help?

passages.title: A Desperate Plea
passages.text:
Very well, let us see what awaits us on that ill-fated shore.

At the very least, a lot of dead demons! Hah!

passages.title: Altar of the Eternal Hunt
passages.text:
Now that you've rallied hunters from across Azeroth together, it's time to turn your attention to the battle against the Burning Legion.

Within the Trueshot Lodge is the Altar of the Eternal Hunt. It is an ancient relic alive with old magic, and I believe it can be used to infuse your weapon with even greater might.

Go inside the lodge and speak to Altar Keeper Biehn, who can instruct you in its use.

passages.title: Altar of the Eternal Hunt
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. It will be my honor to assist you with your artifact.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text:
Malfurion, my love...

In vision I saw him, enraged and then distressed, and now lost beyond my mind's reach.

<race>, I know we have little reason to trust one another, but I will not turn away your help.

If you value the sanctity of this world, you will come with me.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text: Pray my husband makes it through this alive, <race>.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text:
Malfurion, my love...

In vision I saw him, enraged and then distressed, and now lost beyond my mind's reach.

He is strong, but the horrors that have befallen this land are all-consuming.

I must find him, and you must help me!

Gather your wits, <race>, and follow me.

passages.title: Love Lost
passages.text: I pray it is not too late, friend.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
passages.text:
Your actions in Stormheim were courageous. I thank you for avenging me, and for helping my apprentice, Aegira. I can think of none better to inherit my knowledge.

With you, I will share the secret to my Storm Brew. The true strength of the brew comes from Odyn's Cauldron, which can be found in the great hall just ahead.

You have my blessing to borrow it. Good luck in your journey ahead, <name>.

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
passages.text: Did you pass the trials?

passages.title: Halls of Valor: Odyn's Cauldron
passages.text: Tell me, were the Halls of Valor as amazing as the stories say? Regardless, you got the cauldron. Now we can begin brewing.

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text:
Although our forces have dutifully held this citadel since your departure, we have been unable to access most of its resources - the Fel Hammer can only be fully activated by those bearing the mark of a Legion lord.

Thankfully, your blades carry that very mark. Use them to activate the Fel Hammer - show your forces your limitless power!

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text: Yes?

passages.title: Unbridled Power
passages.text:
The Fel Hammer is ours at last.

Nicely done.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text:
The Fel Hammer will be a fine home for our kind, but it is what we found within its depths that is the true prize of our conquest.

Battlelord Gaardoun and his Ashtongue have it closely guarded - you should have him show you.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text: It is my honor to serve, <name>.

passages.title: Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim
passages.text:
Even as we speak, the Legion's dark masters fashion new horrors in hopes that they might destroy us - especially you.

You must increase your own power as well.

The Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim, our greatest treasure from taking the Fel Hammer, waits in the chamber ahead. You can use it to further empower your blades and maintain our edge over the enemy.

passages.title: Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim
passages.text: Your blades... they glow with such power...

passages.title: Cursed Forge of the Nathrezim
passages.text: Such power! The Legion's armies will fall before you in droves.

passages.title: Troubling News
passages.text:
Master, there is one more thing I wish to speak to you about.

Below us lies an open chamber cut off from the rest of the citadel. We thought you might desire it as your personal sanctum - a place where you might gather your thoughts or scry upon your enemies.

The sanctum crystal before you will transport you there - Lady S'theno has already descended to help you get acquainted.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
As you can see, there is little time to spare - the Legion's armies already encroach on our world.

Kayn has gathered our best tacticians around the star map above us to discuss our plan of attack - your leadership would be invaluable to their efforts.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
<Kayn sighs.>

I know that look. I, too, gazed into the crucible and saw the horrors of the tomb.

We must act quickly.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text:
We must seal the Tomb of Sargeras at all costs or the flow of demons will never cease.

Until then, we must do what we can on the ground to alleviate their foothold before it grows further.

This citadel was created to spearhead Legion invasions on other worlds - we can use its navigation systems to plan our assault.

I think you would agree that none would be better suited to lead our charge than you.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text: Agreed. You are as skilled a tactician as myself.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text:
In conquering this citadel we obtained something that I think would be of great use to you.

Gaardoun's men have it well-guarded just below - I suggest you have him show you.

passages.title: Spoils of Victory
passages.text: It is my honor to serve, <name>.

passages.title: A Peaceful World
passages.text:
Word has reached us that the Legion is advancing on the Broken Isles.

They beset us from all sides, and if we do not stand strong, they will spill over into the rest of Azeroth.

<name>, we need your help more than ever. Lend your strength to those defending at the front. We cannot fail here.

passages.title: A Peaceful World
passages.text: Astounding, Grandmaster! Reports are flying in about your success. Without your help, many of our outposts around the Broken Isles would have fallen.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
As you can see, there is little time to spare - the Legion's armies already encroach on our world.

Altruis has gathered our best tacticians around the star map above us to discuss our plan of attack - your leadership would be invaluable to their efforts.

passages.title: Time is of the Essence
passages.text:
<Altruis nods knowingly.>

I saw it too.

We must consider our next move carefully.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text:
The Tomb of Sargeras is the Legion's primary entrance into our world - it must be destroyed.

No easy task, but until we have the means to do so we must do what we can to stop their invasion.

The Legion used this citadel to spearhead invasions on other worlds - we can use its navigation systems to plan our own assault against them.

You, of course, must take the honor of first breaking ground on their territory, but we will soon follow.

passages.title: Direct Our Wrath
passages.text: Well-chosen. The Legion will soon fear the very sight of the Illidari on the battlefield.

passages.title: Lady S'theno Calls
passages.text:
Master <name>, I have completed my reconnaissance in Dalaran as you asked.

I await your return at the Fel Hammer.

passages.title: The Sword of Kings
passages.text:
The first king of the humans, Thoradin, performed many acts of heroism and valor. While on a personal quest near the end of his reign, he stumbled upon the tomb of my brother Tyr... and the grave-prison of the monstrosity he died fighting. Thoradin unintentionally awoke the beast and gave his life to keep it from escaping.

It is Thoradin's sword, Strom'kar, that has kept the monster at bay. Retrieve it and finish what Tyr and Thoradin started. Kill Zakajz the Corrupted.

passages.title: The Sword of Kings
passages.text: Ah, you have returned...

passages.title: The Sword of Kings
passages.text: A mighty blade! Forged by the son of vrykul, enchanted by elven sorcery, and quenched in the blood of a C'thraxxi. It will serve you well, <name>. With it, you will put an end to our enemies!

passages.title: Rain Death Upon Them
passages.text: Aboard the hippogryph you now possess a unique opportunity. It is time for the Nightborne to regret letting you live.

passages.title: Waiting for Revenge
Waiting for Revenge
Rain Death Upon Them
passages.text: The hippogryph before you presents a unique opportunity. It is time for the Nightborne to regret letting you live.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text:
Do you remember Varedis? He was once our lead trainer at the Black Temple, but fell early in the siege.

...or so we thought.

Kor'vas spotted the traitor amongst the Legion wielding glaives imbued with power unlike anything she'd ever seen.

The Kirin Tor have an eredar lord interred in the Violet Hold that will know where Varedis' base of operations is. The hold's warden has agreed to consider granting us access to him.

<Altruis smirks.>

Time to play the friendly diplomat.

passages.title: Making Arrangements
passages.text: Let's get this done with. These bureaucrats already test my patience.

passages.title: An Artisan's Mark
passages.text:
You there! Do you have a moment?

I need you to meet with my friend in the Promenade and retrieve a signet ring. I would send my oaf of an apprentice, but he is not finished with the simple task I gave him.

I am expecting a guest at any moment and I simply must have it before he arrives. Can you help me, friend?

passages.title: An Artisan's Mark
passages.text: Do you have it?

passages.title: An Artisan's Mark
passages.text:
Oh, thank the Magistrix! I was worried it was lost forever.

I see that this ring has seen some... use. I do hope it doesn't belong to anyone important. Or... vocal.

passages.title: The Tirisgarde Reborn
passages.text:
The Tirisgarde is reformed. It is time we begin our mission in earnest.

The order will need leaders, and though I may be an experienced mage, I am no strategist. You have proven yourself capable, in both your past exploits and present. 

Will you take on this challenge, <name>?

passages.title: The Tirisgarde Reborn
passages.text:
So you're a Conjuror now, huh? Fan-cy!

We've got a good start with this Tirisgarde thing here, but I think we should keep up the recruiting if we actually plan on invading demon-town.

Fortunately for you, nobody negotiates contracts like a goblin!

passages.title: Unlocked Potential
passages.text:
In ancient times, the Forge of the Guardian was used to channel the power of the Council of Tirisfal into one mage, creating a Guardian. But this is not its only use.

It also serves as a font of arcane energy which can be used to manipulate and empower the artifacts of this world. 

This power will allow us to gain the upper hand against the dreadlord and the Burning Legion, and I ask you to be the first to tap into it.

passages.title: Unlocked Potential
passages.text:
Your artifact is well on its way to reaching its true potential, but even with this power you will not be able to fight the Legion alone.

We will need to begin recruiting other mages to our cause. Unfortunately, the protective wards surrounding the hall may be prohibitive to this. 

After all, I cannot personally teleport every one of them here.

However, a solution to this particular problem might be right under our noses.

passages.title: A Conjuror's Duty
passages.text:
I don't know about you but I'm ready to get this show on the road. This place is nice and all, but it's a bit stuffy.

I'll see what I can do to get some more mages in this group of yours. You go ahead and check the map over there. It'll help you plan your first moves.

passages.title: A Conjuror's Duty
passages.text:
Alright, then! I can get started recruiting, and you can get to taking the fight to the demons!

Yeah, I know I'm letting you take the easy job, but hey, what are friends for?

passages.title: A Re-Warding Effort
passages.text:
<This small device of elegant nightborne design crackles gently with arcane power.

Kel'danath's notes mention wards that keep the withered at bay. It seems he found some form of spellcasting that does not tempt their ravenous appetite for magic.

These may prove useful in your search for the missing arcanist.>

passages.title: A Re-Warding Effort
passages.text: <The ward snaps to life, giving you a slight pinch. Kel'danath must have put great care into developing a spell that would scare the withered away without harming them.>

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
Our goals have been met, warlock, and it is time we part ways. I think I will be glad to see the last of you.

Go on, return to your dark masters. We are done here.

passages.title: The Power Possessed
passages.text:
Friend has the weapon? 

Yes, Calydus can feel its power!

passages.title: Fragments of the Fjords
passages.text:
<name>, have you seen my ledger around here? I seemed to have misplaced it when I was stowing some canopic jars.

Oh, nevermind. Brann Bronzebeard has sent for you though. He's in Stormheim continuing his research.

Make your way out to him and let him know I'm still waiting on those flayed-skin chronicles he found.

passages.title: Fragments of the Fjords
passages.text: I'm gettin' closer to finding another piece of the titan relic, an' I need yer keen eyes.

passages.title: Process of Elimination
passages.text:
With so many places ta dig up fragments, it's become quite a pain figuring out where ta look for more of the titan disc.

I have a plan though. I need ye ta eliminate potential areas where the disc could exist so we can narrow down where in Stormheim it might exist.

You take part of the area an' I'll take the other part. Meet back here if ye find anythin'.

passages.title: Process of Elimination
passages.text:
Did ye run into any imps while ye were out diggen? Those blasted demons kept poppin' up on me!

Alright, if ye dinnae find the disc at any o' those places, then there's but one place left ta look.

passages.title: Out of the Frying Pan
passages.text:
Oh hello, <name>. I tell you, ever since I was given this shop, it's been nothing but a headache. I can't seem to ever find what I'm looking for.

Which reminds me, Brann Bronzebeard has sent for you. He's in Azsuna tracking down more pieces of whatever it is he's searching for.

Now where'd those pewter drinking cups go...

passages.title: Out of the Frying Pan
passages.text: I'm close, <name>. I can feel it in me bones!

passages.title: The Apocalypse Bringer
passages.text:
Right, well, I managed to piece the device back together.

I guess I'll jes' turn it on when you're ready and we'll see what happens, yea?

passages.title: The Apocalypse Bringer
passages.text: Be ready for anything, lad.

passages.title: The Apocalypse Bringer
passages.text: Well that was a bit... eh... underwhelming. But hey, at least we got a piece o' tha titan disc!

passages.title: One Step Closer
passages.text:
<name>! I just heard that Brann Bronzebeard - that crazy, titan-obsessed dwarf - has decided to go hunting for his precious disc in Suramar.

Talk about the last place you'd want to go digging around, given the current events.

I'm sure he could use your help.

passages.title: One Step Closer
passages.text: There's demon stink all over this place. But there's also a lot of clues as to where a piece of the titan disc is!

passages.title: Fel Fragments
passages.text:
Brann Bronzebeard has requested that I send him more surveying equipment, but I just don't have the time.

Would you be a dear and take this crate to him, <name>? I'd truly appreciate it.

passages.title: Fel Fragments
passages.text:
Me equipment? Thanks, <name>!

Ye know, it's a good thing ye're here. This place gives me tha willies!

passages.title: The Reliquary Calls
passages.text:
Tae'thelan of the Reliquary has asked me to send anyone who may be able to help them in Azsuna.

Seeing as how you happened into my shop purely by coincidence, I thought you'd be willing to go, <name>.

Back to work for me though. So much to do and so little help.

<Dariness lets out a sigh.>

passages.title: The Reliquary Calls
passages.text:
I ask for an archaeologist and they send an adventurer. Or perhaps you are both.

Either way, let's get to work.

passages.title: Echoes of My Ancestors
passages.text:
This land holds many secrets and many artifacts of ancient times.

From what I've been able to discern there's an artifact of great power close to here. I just need to narrow down its location.

I'd like you to dig up more artifacts and learn what you can. When you feel you've done enough research, come back to me and share your knowledge.

passages.title: Echoes of My Ancestors
passages.text:
<Tae'thelan listens to your recount of what you learned.>

Very interesting. If what you've said is true, then I believe I know where the location of the artifact is.

passages.title: Worth Its Weight
passages.text:
<name>, if you were a crate of black trilobites, where do you think I would have put you?

<Dariness begins looking around the shop.>

Oh, that reminds me. Tae'thelan has requested your presence. He's onto something in Suramar and needs your help.

passages.title: Worth Its Weight
passages.text:
<name>, good to see you.

I was hoping that the elves here would be a bit more... willing to let us inspect their artifacts, but such is not the case.

And that's where you come in.

passages.title: Goblin Archaeology
passages.text:
I'm not sure if you're in on this, but the Reliquary has commissioned the goblins to help them with uncovering artifacts in this land.

I'd like you to go and see if there's any validity to this rumor... and I'd also be interested to know the results.

passages.title: Goblin Archaeology
passages.text: <name>, you're just in time to test out a new method I've been working on.

passages.title: Explosive Results
passages.text:
As you may or may not have heard, I've been working with the goblins on using a new way of uncovering our artifacts.

And if you know anything about goblins, you know that I'm talking about explosives.

We've only run a few tests here at my camp, but I would appreciate your help in testing this method out in the field.

I've marked a location on your map that has some particularly difficult digs.

passages.title: Explosive Results
passages.text: The working theory is that due to the amount of gunpowder that's being used, it should only produce a small shock to whatever the artifact has been encased in.

passages.title: Explosive Results
passages.text:
It was successful? That's excellent news!

This will speed up our process ten fold!

passages.title: Unspeakable Power
passages.text:
<name>, I received an urgent message from the High Examiner requesting your presence.

He's finally found something powerful-- VERY powerful--and he wants your help in recovering it.

Be careful down there, <name>. Tae'thelan can be a tad fanatical when it comes to artifacts that hold any sort of energy.

passages.title: Unspeakable Power
passages.text: This is an exciting time, <name>. And you're going to get a front row seat to the show.

passages.title: Narrowing Down
passages.text:
I was right about the nightborne here having objects of great power. I found an ancient text referring to such an object called the Orb of Sciallax.

From what I recall in studying the War of the Ancients, Sciallax was a demon lord who came to Suramar and offered the elves at the time a powerful artifact in return for their servitude to the Legion.

I haven't discovered the exact location yet as to the whereabouts, but perhaps some digging can yield us an answer.

passages.title: Narrowing Down
passages.text: We must discover this artifact at all costs!

passages.title: Narrowing Down
passages.text:
You've found the location? Then we must make haste.

Let's go, <name>.

passages.title: Academic Exploration
passages.text:
<name>, good to see you. What do you think of my shop so far? Not too bad for just one person, huh?

By the way, High Examiner Tae'thalan has been digging around Azsuna, and asked that I send you to see him.

Knowing him, he probably thinks he's found yet another world-shatteringly powerful artifact.

passages.title: Academic Exploration
passages.text:
Hello, <name>. I'm glad you came.

I've found something that may serve both of our interests.

passages.title: History of Highmountain
passages.text:
Let's see, one... two... three... oh, hello <name>. Sorry I didn't see you come in.

Things have been hectic around here. I could really use an assistant.

I do have something for you though, a fellow archaeologist named Lessah has been asking for someone to help her in Highmountain.

I thought you'd be the perfect person for the job.

passages.title: History of Highmountain
passages.text: Good to see you, <name>. I hope you're as interested about the tauren here as I am.

passages.title: Surveying Student
passages.text:
The reason I sent for someone was that I've been having trouble keeping up with my research and training my assistant.

I was hoping you might be able to show him the ropes again. Get him reacquainted with surveying.

Just speak with him when you're ready to go.

passages.title: Surveying Student
passages.text: Thank you for your help, <name>. Now perhaps you can help me with my research.

passages.title: A New Lead
passages.text:
<name>, Lessah in Highmountain has been asking for you.

Apparently she's caught a lead on some ancient piece of armor that Huln Highmountain used to wear.

When you can, make your way out to her.

passages.title: A New Lead
passages.text: There's more to this land than I ever realized, <name>. Now listen...

passages.title: Drogbar Deception
passages.text:
According to my research and the information you gave me, I've isolated the location of the necklace.

It's deep in a drogbar cave, and I'm willing to bet they're not just going to hand it over to you, <name>.

I need you to recover that necklace at any cost.

passages.title: Drogbar Deception
passages.text: If only the drogbar were more reasonable.

passages.title: Drogbar Deception
passages.text:
<Lessah examines the necklace.>

How can this be?! All my research suggested that this belonged to Huln.

I'm sorry, <name>, but this necklace is a creation of the drogbar. I'll give it back to you to do with it what you want.

passages.title: The Right Path
passages.text:
This new shop is shaping up quite nicely, I think. Still, there's so much left to organize.

<name>, Lessah has requested your presence in Highmountain. Something about a moose?

I'm not sure to what she's speaking of, but as soon as you have a chance, please go see her.

passages.title: The Right Path
passages.text:
<name>, I've found an actual piece of something very close to Huln

I believe that this is the very bone of Eche'ro, Huln Highmountain's animal companion!

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Leystone
passages.text: Many thanks, <class>. This leystone shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Parts Unknown
passages.text:
Brambley... I still canna' believe it.

I canna' leave the lad here... not in this place... not like this.

Help me find the rest of him, so I can take his remains back home where he belongs.

We'll give him a proper burial... it's what he deserves!

passages.title: Parts Unknown
passages.text: Aye, is that all of him? We aren't missing any parts are we?

passages.title: Parts Unknown
passages.text:
<Angus wipes away a tear as he speaks.>

Brambley, lad... I promise ye'll have tha' best burial money can buy! An' all the ale ye can drink...

passages.title: They Become The Hunted
passages.text:
The trapper you slew was but one of many.

The Nightborne are subjugating the local creatures, creating a sort of pleasurable exhibit. I think we can strike them in two places at once.

Descend upon these trappers, <race>. Let us teach them a lesson in respecting their prey.

passages.title: They Become The Hunted
passages.text: With the number of trappers thinned, their ability to scout into Suramar will be sorely hampered.

passages.title: They Become The Hunted
passages.text: Excellent work. They do not respect the hunt, so they must be reminded of their place.

passages.title: Survival of the Fittest
passages.text:
The collar you took from the trapper is simple, but effective. Affixing the collar to a target will make them complacent and obedient to their Nightborne masters. Lilryia was able to reverse the spell using the traps you found.

The magics in the collar can now be used to cancel out the other collars.

How about giving the Nightborne a reminder that nature always finds a way?

passages.title: Survival of the Fittest
passages.text: I could hear their cries and see the carnage from here! That will teach the Nightborne to enslave creatures. Have they fallen so far during all those years under the shield?

passages.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
passages.text:
It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. <class>s like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.

Muffinus Chromebrew will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. He's waiting for you on the stands across the road.

passages.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
passages.text: For a <race> who has spent so much time inside Gnomeregan, you look positively fit and healthy, <name>. That's good. Before we can complete what Operation: Gnomeregan began, we're going to need more hunters like you.

passages.title: Down to Azsuna
passages.text:
<name>, we must find a way to reseal the Tomb of Sargeras.

I have uncovered information concerning an ancient relic, which might be the key to stopping the Legion.

Our search begins on the ancient elven island of Azsuna. Long ago, it was where the Highborne elves of Suramar perfected their mightiest of magics. Now it is a cursed ruin.

The Illidari demon hunters have established a camp on the island. As they are the only people we know in the area, that is where we will begin.

Ready to take wing?

passages.title: Down to Azsuna
passages.text: It would seem that we have arrived at the crucial moment.

passages.title: Down to Azsuna
passages.text:
As I suspected, the Illidari are holding the line against the Burning Legion, but just barely.

We must come to their aid, <name>.

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text:
The gateway is fully functional, <name>. Ooh, I am positively tingling with excitement!

Do let Jace and the others know that we eagerly await your arrival. There's so much to do and ever so little time.

You will be joining us aboard, won't you?

passages.title: Return to Mardum
passages.text: This citadel was one of the Legion's most valuable assets - it will serve us well.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Foxflower
passages.text: Many thanks, <class>. This foxflower shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Breaking Out
passages.text:
We cannot fight our way out of the Vault alone.

Two of your allies, Kayn Sunfury and Altruis the Sufferer, are imprisoned within this room. 

Free them with haste. Their strength will be of great use to us.

passages.title: Trapping Evolved
passages.text:
The Nightborne are using magic for everything, even trapping.

Nighteyes saw them at work, laying down magical snares to capture prey rather than the kind our people use. 

Bring me their traps so that I may study their make.

passages.title: Trapping Evolved
passages.text: Do you have the snares, <race>?

passages.title: Trapping Evolved
passages.text: These devices are peculiar. They are like the traps our hunters use, but can magically attract and trap nearby beasts.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: Many thanks, <class>. This leather shall not be wasted.

passages.title: Sowing The Seed
passages.text:
Your weapon is ancient and powerful but it holds the potential to be so much more.

Take this seed, it is all that remains of a forest that grew tall when the world was young. Plant it within the grove to the west and allow it to take root.

With its power both it and your weapon will be far more than they are alone.

passages.title: Sowing The Seed
passages.text: Excellent. There's no time to waste.

passages.title: Blast of Spice Fish
passages.text:
I have an ingredient that will make my fruit irresistible.

Not many remember the delicacy of manatrout liquor. Its pungent aroma, the unctuous mouthfeel...

The toads near the northern river concentrate this additive in their gizzards. Fetch some stomachs for me, and we will have plenty.

passages.title: Blast of Spice Fish
passages.text: Daglir is young and foolish!

passages.title: Blast of Spice Fish
passages.text: Manatrout was completely fished out of our harbors. Since the shield was raised all we have had of the liquor is memories on our palates.

passages.title: Fruit of the Doom
passages.text:
Now is the time to strike.

Shadowbloom has... potent digestive qualities. Go sprinkle some on Daglir's fruit bowls and watch the show.

Meanwhile, I will use the manatrout liquor to cement my position as the premier fruit vendor in the city.

passages.title: Fruit of the Doom
passages.text: Daglir will be ruined after this.

passages.title: Fruit of the Doom
passages.text: Victory tastes sweeter than any dish, even one of mine.

passages.title: Work Order: Cursed Queenfish
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, fisherman. We needed this queenfish badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Mossgill Perch
passages.text: Hail, fisherman. I can take these perch off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Stormrays
passages.text: Well met, <race> fisherman. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these stormrays.

passages.title: Work Order: Runescale Koi
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, fisherman. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Aethril
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, herbalist. We needed this aethril badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Aethril
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this aethril badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Dreamleaf
passages.text: Hail, herbalist. I can take this dreamleaf off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Dreamleaf
passages.text: Hail, <class>. I can take this dreamleaf off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Fjarnskaggl
passages.text: Well met, <race> herbalist. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this fjarnskaggl.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Fjarnskaggl
passages.text: Well met, <race> <class>. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this fjarnskaggl.

passages.title: Work Order: Starlight Roses
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, herbalist. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Starlight Roses
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, <class>. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, miner. We needed this leystone badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone
passages.text: Hail, miner. I can take this leystone off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone
passages.text: Well met, <race> miner. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this leystone.

passages.title: Work Order: Felslate
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, miner. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Leystone
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed this leystone badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Leystone
passages.text: Hail, <class>. I can take this leystone off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Leystone
passages.text: Well met, <race> <class>. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this leystone.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Felslate
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, <class>. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Pry It From Their Cold, Feral Claws
passages.text:
The shield being lowered presents a unique opportunity for new styles.

Feathers, bone and other primitive materials are suddenly fashionable again. Who would have thought they could grow tired of my masterpieces?

Venture out of the city and collect necklaces from the harpies on the southern cliffs. Etching my mark into them should net me a tidy profit.

passages.title: Pry It From Their Cold, Feral Claws
passages.text: Do you have my necklaces? They are of no use to me on the necks of those... creatures.

passages.title: Pry It From Their Cold, Feral Claws
passages.text:
Those wretched creatures are a scourge on our beautiful lands. At least they had good taste in their accessories.

Or maybe they just like shiny things.

passages.title: Work Order: Stormscales
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, skinner. We needed these stormscales badly.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Stormscales
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, <class>. We needed these stormscales badly.

passages.title: The Elements Call...
passages.text:
Nobundo is right. Conventional tactics will not work against the Legion - the Broken Shore taught us that. We must scour the world for weapons to use against the Legion!

The Doomhammer is missing and must be recovered. Rehgar and Erunak have some other ideas, as well. Whatever our course, we must act immediately.

Speak with me to go over your options, but the final decision is yours!

passages.title: The Elements Call...
passages.text: Have you made your decision yet?

passages.title: The Elements Call...
passages.text: A good choice. There is no time to lose - let us begin!

passages.title: Work Order: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: Hail, skinner. I can take this leather off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: Hail, <class>. I can take this leather off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Stormscales
passages.text: Well met, <race> skinner. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these stormscales.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Stormscales
passages.text: Well met, <race> <class>. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these stormscales.

passages.title: Work Order: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, skinner. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Supplies Needed: Stonehide Leather
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, <class>. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Lost Mail
passages.text:
TO: MADAM GOYA, DALARAN UNDERBELLY

URGENT!

TIME-SENSITIVE! 

DELIVER IMMEDIATELY!

passages.title: Lost Mail
passages.text: What's this? You are not my usual courier...

passages.title: Lost Mail
passages.text:
Ah, a bank note. Mr. Stonebrow's payment.

Just in the nick of time it would seem.

passages.title: Due Reward
passages.text:
You have served me well these past few minutes we've spent together - minutes I shall not soon forget.

I believe a reward befitting your unwavering loyalty is in order. You will have the distinct honor of placing Twinkles' favorite toy by his grave in honor of his memory.

Please, please - save your thanks for Twinkles; it is not every day that we may honor a horse made of STARS.

passages.title: A Huge Package
passages.text:
Due to the incredible volume of complaints in recent months we have been barred from delivering s... s...

<The Postmaster holds back tears, pain visible in his eyes.>

Solid stone. We're positively swimming in it - if we can't deliver it then pretty soon we will be overwh-

<The Postmaster's eyes light up suddenly.>

That's it!

There is an old Consortium portal not far from here that we could deposit it in with none the wiser!

Can you help, <name>? The stone is extraordinarily heavy.

passages.title: A Huge Package
passages.text: Is the deed done?

passages.title: Lost Mail
passages.text:
TO: MADAM GOYA, DALARAN UNDERBELLY

URGENT!

TIME-SENSITIVE! 

DELIVER IMMEDIATELY!

passages.title: Lost Mail
passages.text: What's this? You are not my usual courier...

passages.title: Lost Mail
passages.text:
Ah, a bank note. Mr. Stonebrow's payment.

Just in the nick of time it would seem.

passages.title: The Hunter's Call
passages.text:
I realize we have never met, but you will learn of my order soon enough. For now, pleasantries must wait.

The Legion has returned to Azeroth stronger than ever, and we need new weapons to fight them.

I have met three individuals here in Dalaran who have leads on ancient artifacts which could prove vital in the battle to come. Acquiring these weapons demands the skills of a master hunter.

Speak to each of them and decide whom you will aid first.

passages.title: The Hunter's Call
passages.text: Have you chosen a lead to pursue first?

passages.title: The Hunter's Call
passages.text:
Any of the three weapons you learned of would be a huge boon in the war against the Legion.

But your crusade must start with one of them, so you must choose.

passages.title: In Deep Slumber
passages.text:
This bed will be yours for the deep slumber that will usher you into the Dream.

Once you are comfortable, drink of the moonwater you brought. I will guide you from there.

Quickly, now - with every passing moment G'Hanir slips further into darkness.

passages.title: In Deep Slumber
passages.text: Were you able to retrieve G'Hanir?

passages.title: In Deep Slumber
passages.text: Delving into the Dream with such darkness encroaching is no simple task, one few druids dare attempt, but I'm afraid your journey is far from over.

passages.title: Join the Dreamer
passages.text:
I'm afraid I can't really help you actually enter the Emerald Dream - we dryads merely shift our bodies between the planes.

That's ok, though - Naralex has offered to help!

Go to the very bottom of the Tel'Andu Barrow Den. Naralex is already there setting things up for you.

passages.title: Join the Dreamer
passages.text: My preparations are complete. Are you prepared to enter the Dream?

passages.title: Feline Frantic
passages.text:
Greetings, stranger.

<Mayruna bows to you.>

We arrived from Val'Sharah a short time ago with hopes of settling here. Our journey was not easy and we are weary.

These owlcats have made a mess of our camp, as you can surely see. Would you be so kind as to assist us with cleaning up?

Then perhaps you can help us establish a new moonwell!

passages.title: Feline Frantic
passages.text: Is everything in its proper place?

passages.title: Feline Frantic
passages.text: All is in its proper place. We are that much closer to being settled.

passages.title: Missing Along the Way
passages.text:
As we retreated from Val'Sharah, our company was briefly separated by a conflict with some satyrs at the border.

One of our own did not make it here- Mythandros' brother, Kalendros. I would like you to try and find him if you could.

Search the woods just before the bridge back into Val'Sharah.

passages.title: Missing Along the Way
passages.text: How good of Mayruna to send help. I had nearly lost hope.

passages.title: The Only Choice We Can Make
passages.text:
Take this torch, <name>. 

We cannot reverse the Nightmare corruption once it has taken hold. All we can hope to do is destroy its manifestations.

Incinerate the root. Only then can we rest easy in Suramar.

passages.title: The Only Choice We Can Make
passages.text: What a disturbing tale!

passages.title: Mistress of the Claw
passages.text:
The great forest guardian, Ursoc, gave his life for this world ten thousand years ago. After the guardian's death his claws were hidden away, safe from any who would use their power for evil.

Lea Stonepaw and her Druids of the Claw consider Ursoc their paragon and dedicate their lives to following in his example. If anyone would know where the claws reside, it would be Lea.

She and her Druids of the Claw reside in the Tel'Andu Barrow Den just to the north.

passages.title: Mistress of the Claw
passages.text:
The Claws of Ursoc?

I thought I'd go the rest of my days without hearing of them again. Is our situation truly so dire? They were sealed away for good reason!

passages.title: Return to Irongrove Retreat
passages.text:
We have three blessings from the creatures we share this land with.

Combined with a blessing from Elune, the moonwell will watch over this land for years to come.

Meet Mythandros at the retreat. I am sure he would like to include you in the ritual.

passages.title: Return to Irongrove Retreat
passages.text: Welcome back. I see we are ready to begin.

passages.title: Redhoof the Ancient
passages.text:
While you were busy assisting the Owlcats across the river, Mythandros and Solendra ventured further to the east.

I believe Mythandros may have found the next creature that may offer us its blessing.

There is a secluded glade along the river's bend to the Northeast. There you may find our new ally, an elderly stag named Redhoof.

passages.title: Redhoof the Ancient
passages.text: This fine gentleman was just telling me how dearly he loves his forest. Let us assist him!

passages.title: Fertilizing the Future
passages.text:
Like most herbivores, our antlered friends will eat anything green enough to chew. 

However I have noticed that they seek these patches of dark grass, given their preference. I believe we can begin to earn their favor if we aid the forest in producing more of this most nutritious of stag food.

I will provide you with the seeds- all you must do is locate suitable growing soil and plant them. Our magic will do the rest.

passages.title: Fertilizing the Future
passages.text: How goes the planting?

passages.title: Fertilizing the Future
passages.text: They are looking better fed already!

passages.title: The Final Blessing
passages.text:
My friend Solendra Featherdown went to explore the habitat of the native Nightsabers. 

Now that we have the blessings of the Feathermane and the Sablehorn it is time to seek the blessing of the Nightsabers. She is just on the other side of this glade, to the North.

passages.title: The Final Blessing
passages.text: Welcome, <race>.

passages.title: Natural Adversaries
passages.text:
I have walked this land in the time since our arrival. Here, basilisks have emerged from the ravines to the east. They encroach upon the home of the Nightsabers.

To earn their blessing, I believe we should clear the way for their return.

Slay the basilisks that have taken more than their fair share of the land, <race>.

passages.title: Natural Adversaries
passages.text: Well done, <race>.

passages.title: Managazer
passages.text:
There is one basilisk here who has gorged himself so thoroughly on Nightsaber flesh that he seldom leaves his cave.

We will use this to our advantage.

Seek out the basilisk Managazer and use his death as an example to the others who have strayed from their home.

passages.title: Managazer
passages.text: Managazer must perish, <race>.

passages.title: Managazer
passages.text: Such a gluttonous creature.

passages.title: Squid Out of Water
passages.text:
Toryl told me about those squid creatures that are controlling my brothers.
