I have never seen anything like them before around Jandvik. The naga must have brought them from wherever they came.

I do not want any more of my kin to suffer the fate of being controlled by the naga.

Find out where those squids come from and stop them.

passages.title: Squid Out of Water
passages.text: The naga will not be taking any more of my kin!

passages.title: Azeroth Needs You
passages.text:
We shaman under your command will aid your efforts against the Legion. You may direct our actions from here.

Seek out Advisor Sevel just to the south and locate the scouting map from which you can direct your followers. We will also indicate on the scouting map various hot-spots around the Broken Isles that require your attention.

Azeroth needs you, Farseer! Visit the scouting map and choose our first point of attack.

passages.title: Azeroth Needs You
passages.text:
A sound decision, Farseer. Behind me I have opened up an astral portal to Dalaran to help our people move quickly between our base of operations and the Broken Isles. Step through to return to Dalaran. You may always use the portal to travel back here whenever you need to augment your artifact or command your followers.

May the elements guide you, Farseer.

passages.title: Rendezvous with the Courier
passages.text:
Thas'dorah is a mighty bow indeed! The weapon was carved from a limb of Thas'alah, the mother tree of Eversong, and infused with the magic of the Sunwell. I fought alongside its first wielder, Talanas Windrunner, during an Amani troll incursion.

Ah, but such tales can wait for another time.

Courier Larkspear was making preparations to depart. You can meet him at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: Rendezvous with the Courier
passages.text:
I don't know the full details, but a demon prisoner has given us the first solid lead on Alleria Windrunner's whereabouts in a very long time.

The ranger-general has joined with members of the Farstriders on the Broken Shore. She's putting a team together, and your presence is crucial to its success.

passages.title: A Beastly Expedition
passages.text:
I know the power of Titanstrike well. The Unseen Path battled the vrykul warlord Volund as he campaigned to conquer the Broken Isles. We sought to wrest the rifle from him, but he took it to his grave.

If Volund's tomb can at last be opened, the artifact would be a great boon to our cause.

I believe Grif Wildheart is making preparations to depart. You can meet him at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: A Beastly Expedition
passages.text:
There you are! I knew you'd be bitin' to find Titanstrike.

Don't mind ol' Huey here. The city of mages is no place for a gryphon.

passages.title: Preparation for the Hunt
passages.text:
Talonclaw is a mighty spear indeed! I first set eyes upon it when the Highmountain tauren led the members of my order up to Talon Peak to found the Trueshot Lodge.

But such tales must wait for another time.

Apata has been in Dalaran gathering supplies for her expedition. I imagine she's ready to depart by now.

Seek her out at Krasus' Landing. I know she will be eager to begin.

passages.title: Preparation for the Hunt
passages.text:
My brother Wuho and I will be honored to have you on this quest, <name>. Talonclaw is a sacred artifact to my people, and I know with your help we will recover it.

We just have to do one thing before we head out, speak with the Eagle Spirit.

passages.title: Felsoul Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Felsoul Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Felsoul Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Finding Brytag
passages.text:
<Kell barely manages to speak.>

That naga witch... has given many of my kin... to the sea giants.

Brytag was... the last one I saw alive.

Find him quickly.

passages.title: Finding Brytag
passages.text: I do not know who you are, but you are not a sea giant, and that is enough for me.

passages.title: Taking a Promenade
passages.text:
We must learn much about our long-lost kin if we are to fight them.

We dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and gather intelligence. The Sentinels sent their own scout as well, hopefully she is smart enough to not get herself killed before reporting in.

They have not returned in some time, and we must suspect the worst.

Find them and we shall see what we are up against.

passages.title: Taking a Promenade
passages.text: They are alive? That is good news. Their knowledge of the defenses will be invaluable.

passages.title: The Seawarden
passages.text:
The Seawarden made a deal with the Tidemistress. She handed us over to him like cattle.

I despise that sea giant! If I were not trapped in this bubble, I would choke the life out of him with my own two hands.

If you cross his path before I get out of here, make him regret ever making a deal with the naga!

passages.title: The Seawarden
passages.text: Have you slain the Seawarden?

passages.title: The Seawarden
passages.text:
I only wish that I had the chance to get to him first.

Bah! His body can rot in these waters for all I care.

passages.title: Crawliac's Legacy
passages.text: [ph] Defend the bluffs!

passages.title: The Light's Wrath
passages.text:
Light's Wrath... a bold choice. Though if you believe you can control its energies, it could prove vital to our cause.

Retrieving it won't be easy. It was last held by the Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away from the hands of men. Only they would know exactly where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides upon the Council of Six in Dalaran. Seek him, and your answers, there.

passages.title: The Light's Wrath
passages.text:
So you seek Light's Wrath? A dangerous weapon, to be sure.

Long ago the Kirin Tor entrusted its safekeeping to the blue dragonflight. It was locked away in the only place that could contain its rampant power  - the Nexus Vault.

I have not been there in some time, however. After the blue dragonflight was dissolved, the Nexus was abandoned. There is no knowing whether the Nexus Vault is still intact - or what may be waiting in the Nexus itself.

passages.title: A Forgotten Enemy
passages.text:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

passages.title: Eyes of the Dragon
passages.text:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, <name>. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

passages.title: Unleashing Judgment
passages.text:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Light's Wrath into these points of focused void, and the reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum likely won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

passages.title: The Nexus Vault
passages.text:
If the Ethereum managed to capture Azuregos, then they are more powerful than I imagined. 

We have not always seen eye to eye, Azuregos and I, but he is still my kin. Since you seek to put an end to the ethereals and claim Light's Wrath, I would ask that you also free my brother from their grip.

With the Surge Needles destroyed, the shield has dissipated. The Nexus awaits, <name>.

passages.title: The Nexus Vault
passages.text:
You have my gratitude for saving Azuregos, <name>. I can rest easy knowing that the Nexus is under his care.

As for you, I can see you're full of surprises. Never in my time have I seen a <class> who can control the chaotic energies of Light's Wrath. 

You are truly the hero we need to face the Legion.

passages.title: A Gift of Time
passages.text:
You have done a great thing for the blue dragons today, <name>, as well as for my own peace of mind.

Now, armed with Light's Wrath, I only ask that you fulfill your original goal, and take the fight to the Legion.

I believe Alonsus Faol awaits your return. Safe travels, friend.

passages.title: A Gift of Time
passages.text: So the dragons proved helpful? This is good, we may need their assistance in the war to come.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Greaves
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, blacksmith. We needed these greaves badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Breastplate
passages.text: Well met, <race> blacksmith. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this breastplate.

passages.title: Work Order: Leystone Pauldrons
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, blacksmith. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Battlebound Spaulders
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, leatherworker. We needed these spaulders badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Warhide Footpads
passages.text: Well met, <race> leatherworker. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these boots.

passages.title: Work Order: Battlebound Leggings
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, leatherworker. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Epaulets
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, tailor. We needed these epaulets badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Gloves
passages.text: Hail, tailor. I can take these gloves off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Bracers
passages.text: Well met, <race> tailor. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these bracers.

passages.title: Work Order: Silkweave Slippers
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, tailor. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Azsunite Pendant
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, jewelcrafter. We needed this necklace badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Queen's Opal Loop
passages.text: Well met, <race> jewelcrafter. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this ring.

passages.title: Work Order: Queen's Opal Pendant
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, jewelcrafter. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Draughts of Raw Magic
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, alchemist. We needed these potions badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Sylvan Elixirs
passages.text: Hail, alchemist. I can take these elixirs off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Skaggldrynk
passages.text: Well met, <race> alchemist. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these potions.

passages.title: Work Order: Skystep Potions
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, alchemist. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Elerethe Renferal
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, scribe. We needed these supplies badly.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Nythendra
passages.text: Well met, <race> scribe. The Valarjar thank you for bringing these supplies.

passages.title: Vantus Rune Work Order: Xavius
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, scribe. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Critical Strike
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, enchanter. We needed this enchantment badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Agility
passages.text: Hail, enchanter. I can take this enchantment off of your hands. Your gift will be put to good use.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Haste
passages.text: Well met, <race> enchanter. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this enchantment.

passages.title: Work Order: Word of Mastery
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, enchanter. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Work Order: Blink-Trigger Headgun
passages.text: Thank you for assisting us, engineer. We needed this device badly.

passages.title: Work Order: Gunpack
passages.text: Well met, <race> engineer. The Valarjar thank you for bringing this gunpack.

passages.title: Work Order: Deployable Bullet Dispenser
passages.text: You couldn't have arrived at a better time, engineer. Our people were running short on supplies.

passages.title: Reconvene
passages.text:
You found Lyessa in the Dream, didn't you, Shan'do <name>? I heard you mutter her name in your slumber.

Thank Elune she is well.

You must seek her out - I can sense her presence even now at the Circle of Spirits above.

If ever there were one who could help us cleanse G'Hanir, it is Lyessa.

passages.title: Reconvene
passages.text: I don't know how much longer I would have lasted had you not arrived - thank you.

passages.title: Subject 16
passages.text: <It seems Theryn is still under the arcanist's spell. In the absence of Kel'danath himself, a live subject could be useful in helping Thalyssra unravel his research.>

passages.title: Subject 16
passages.text:
So, Kel'danath turned in the end...

He deserved better. Thank you for giving him peace.

passages.title: Wormtalon Wreckage
passages.text:
As if Shaladrassil's encroaching roots were not enough to deal with, now the Wormtalon harpies have come to take advantage of our plight. 

Kill them, <race>. They deserve nothing less for feeding on our misery.

passages.title: Wormtalon Wreckage
passages.text: Such violence should not be necessary. Thank you, regardless.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text:
Xavius led Ysera past here, but their destination is unclear. This twisted wickedness smothers my mind!

These refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins of their home. If it somehow resisted this corruption...

I will beg of Elune a vision to give me direction. With her light, I may find my husband yet.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text: He is still alive, but the rest remains to be seen.

passages.title: Heart of the Nightmare
passages.text:
I know only that my husband is somewhere deeper in this twisted forest. He is still alive, but it remains to be seen if he is whole.

<Tyrande's expression hardens into a scowl.>

Elune herself cannot protect Xavius if he is not.

passages.title: Heart of the Nightmare
passages.text: No one is safe from this corruption.

passages.title: Slowing the Spread
passages.text:
Reinforcements. Just what we needed! Grandmaster, the monastery is under attack.

The Legion is using a foul device known as a Fel Spreader to scorch the very earth we walk on with disgusting fel energy.

Destroy those machines, and we can slow their efforts.

passages.title: Slowing the Spread
passages.text: You did well, little wicket. Stay strong together, that's the ticket! The enemies have tried to spread their taint, but we stopped them with a little restraint!

passages.title: Desperate Strike
passages.text:
Good, your timing couldn't have been better, <name>.

These foul Legion creatures have invaded our sanctuary. They have no place here on our world.

Kill every demon you see, <brother/sister>.

passages.title: Desperate Strike
passages.text: This is an invasion like none I have ever seen before.

passages.title: Desperate Strike
passages.text: Good wicket, strong wicket, thanks for helping! You've sent the demons off, groaning and yelping!

passages.title: The Hand of Keletress
passages.text:
The demons' leader is up ahead, taking prisoners it is said!

This dire storm, we will weather... if we fight her together!

passages.title: The Hand of Keletress
passages.text: Tian Monastery is safe again, thanks to you.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text:
A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour.

As with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him.

Please, <name>, bring him peace.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text: My sight fades, but I am glad that he rests.

passages.title: An Unlikely Ally
passages.text:
Channeling the demonic gateway will require the assistance of someone with intimate knowledge of the Burning Legion.

I know of such a warlock, though I imagine her blood still boils upon hearing my name. It might be best if you are the one to request her help.

passages.title: An Unlikely Ally
passages.text:
Ritssyn sent you, did he? I see my old mentor still refuses to do his own dirty work.

But of course, someone in his position can't be seen consorting with a purported member of the Argus Wake! What would the others think?

As much as I relish the idea of Ritssyn needing my help, I don't barter in kindness and favors, <name>.

My currency is power and knowledge. If you have either, then it's possible we can come to an arrangement.

passages.title: Winter Moose Roundup
passages.text:
My father, Karmaan, owns this farm, and our main livestock are talbuk. One of the podlings must have opened the gate to their pen and they all escaped!

The little terrors could have slaughtered them in the cage, but they like to hunt their prey. I'm afraid that if I stay out here much longer, I'll be their next meal!

Will you round up the talbuk and bring them here? I can't get them myself, and I can't let my dad find out about this! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(41761))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(41761))");

passages.title: Sympathizers Among the Shal'dorei
passages.text:
Elisande's decision to welcome the Legion into Suramar earned her plenty of enemies, though only some of us were bold enough to openly defy her.

We have allies in the city - we just don't know how many.

I need you to make contact with a spell-fencer by the name of Silgryn. He is loyal to our cause, and has been lying in wait since our failed coup.

He patrols the western edge of the city. Address him by name and tell him our cause is not lost!

passages.title: Sympathizers Among the Shal'dorei
passages.text: We should be safe to speak here for a moment.

passages.title: Close Enough to Touch
passages.text:
He is near, <race>, I can feel it.

We must search Shala'nir for Malfurion. If we do not find him soon, I fear he will be lost to me forever.

I was unsure of your worth when first we met. I know now that you will not fail me.

I am... grateful.

passages.title: Close Enough to Touch
passages.text: This cannot be!

passages.title: Walking in Their Footsteps
passages.text:
Spiritwalkers maintain balance between the world of the living and the spirit realm. We can travel into the memories of the dead to glean clues about the past.

The wards Ebonhorn maintained were placed long ago by heroes who fought the darkness. By walking in their footsteps, we may locate the wards and restore them.

Igrul, the drogbar known as the Scalebane, was a true friend to Huln Highmountain. Use the Water of Vision to enter his memories and find where he placed the first ward.

passages.title: Walking in Their Footsteps
passages.text: As a spiritwalker, I am able to see the memories of the dead.

passages.title: Walking in Their Footsteps
passages.text:
I am pleased you were able to place the first ward. We are one step closer to saving Ebonhorn.

But this mention of the Darkness is unsettling. It is a monster spoken of in our myths and folklore, tales told around campfires to spook the young.

Could these stories be based in truth?

passages.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
passages.text:
If we have any hope of curing this curse, we need to know what kind of magic we're dealing with.

I know of an alchemist who earned himself quite the reputation for his unconventional methods. Shunned from Gilneas long ago, I believe Mad Ernie has taken up residence in these lands.

His knowledge may be the first step to breaking this curse.

passages.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
passages.text: Have you come to lend a hand? We all must do our part.

passages.title: Mad Ernie the Alchemist
passages.text:
That's a name I thought I'd never hear again.

We may have worked together in the past, but Ritssyn needs to know I'm not the man I was before.

My priorities are Marl and this farm.

passages.title: The Skies Above
passages.text:
There has been no Windlord to lead the air elementals since the death of Al'Akir.

The realm of Skywall has been thrown into turmoil. The throne of Al'Akir is Thunderaan's by right, but what remains of the prince's essence within Thunderfury is diminishing. If we do not move quickly, Thunderaan may be lost forever.

Take the damaged Thunderfury to Vortex Pinnacle and speak with Celestos.

Celestos was a loyal servant of Al'Akir and he will share our desire to see Thunderaan reborn.

passages.title: The Skies Above
passages.text: Farseer Nobundo has told me of your plan to save Azeroth. I fear I may be the only zephyr to share your desire.

passages.title: Recharging the Blade
passages.text:
You have recovered the Blessed Blade of the Windseeker, and with it you hold all that is left of the soul of Prince Thunderaan.

Thunderfury can be restored, but it will require a rare essence known as the Heart of Skywall.

Vortos, the Duke of the East Winds, possesses the heart... but he will not give it willingly.

Vortos must be defeated, and the Heart of Skywall must be combined with the blade.

Only then can Thunderaan return and claim the Throne of Four Winds.

passages.title: Recharging the Blade
passages.text: Have you retrieved the Heart of Skywall?

passages.title: Recharging the Blade
passages.text: At long last, the Windseeker shall return to to his rightful place as heir to the Throne of Four Winds. This is a glorious day for Skywall!

passages.title: Ascendant of Flames
passages.text:
As we speak, an endless war rages for control of the Firelands. Of the two aspiring Firelords, Lord Smolderon hates mortals less.

If we help him defeat his rival and ascend to Firelord, he may unite with us in return.

The champions of the Earthen Ring have already made their way to the Firelands. Go and meet with Rehgar Earthfury and find a way to turn an old enemy into a new ally.

If anyone can succeed at this impossible task, I have faith that it is you, Farseer.

May the elements be with you.

passages.title: Ascendant of Flames
passages.text:
At last you have arrived, Farseer <name>.

It seems our presence in the Firelands has not gone unnoticed.

passages.title: The Firelord's Command
passages.text:
Greetings, mortal. I am Scaldius, emissary of Lord Smolderon.

I have just met with others from your order. They tell me that you will bring an end to those who oppose my master. This pleases Lord Smolderon.

Pyroth and his minions defy my master's rule and so an example must be made of them. You will slay Pyroth and his champions!

Nothing is more humiliating than death at the hands of a mortal. Do this and Lord Smolderon will grant you audience.

passages.title: The Firelord's Command
passages.text: I will devour the heart of Pyroth with great pleasure!

passages.title: The Firelord's Command
passages.text:
The son of Rhyolith slain by mere mortals? What an ignominious death!

You have done well, <class>. This pleases me greatly.

passages.title: The Great Stonemother
passages.text:
In order to unite the four Elemental Lords of Azeroth, you will need to seek out Therazane and convince her to join the cause of Azeroth.

However, the Stonemother currently has her hands full battling a Twilight's Hammer resurgence in Deepholm.

If we lend Therazane our aid she may agree to unite with the Earthen Ring against the Burning Legion.

Journey to Therazane's Throne in the heart of Deepholm. Aid her in defeating the Twilight's Hammer and convince her to join the defense of Azeroth!

passages.title: The Great Stonemother
passages.text: What would you have with the Stonemother, <class>?

passages.title: The Great Stonemother
passages.text: The Earthen Ring has come to offer help? This is unexpected... but welcome, nonetheless.

passages.title: Return of the Windlord
passages.text:
With Thunderfury recharged, Prince Thunderaan can now return to the physical realm.

In a moment, I will release my master's spirit from the blessed blade.

When the ritual is complete, Skywall will once again have its Windlord.

passages.title: Return of the Windlord
passages.text: At long last, I have returned to Skywall thanks to the help of mortal hands. I owe you a great debt, Farseer.

passages.title: Destroying the Cult
passages.text:
We are all that stands between the Twilight's Hammer and their conquest of Deepholm.

Azeroth cannot hope to fight the full strength of the Twilight's Hammer and the Burning Legion at the same time. It is up to us to put an end to their cult before they are able to fully rebuild.

Accompany me into their stronghold and we shall cut through their ranks together!

passages.title: Destroying the Cult
passages.text: How many have you slain? I've lost count.

passages.title: Destroying the Cult
passages.text: The Twilight's Hammer will not soon recover from the damage we've dealt to their numbers this day. It is an honor to battle at your side, Farseer <name>.

passages.title: Doom and Gloom
passages.text:
Doom curses are serious business, so much so that many warlocks didn't deal in them for some time. 

The magic grows stronger as time goes on, eventually leading to death. Only the caster of the curse can remove it.

I can craft an elixir that will slow its progression, but you'll need to collect an assortment of ingredients first.

passages.title: Doom and Gloom
passages.text: Have you found those ingredients yet? Time really isn't on your side, you know.

passages.title: Doom and Gloom
passages.text: This looks like everything I need. Just give me a moment to mix it all together.

passages.title: Herding Goats
passages.text:
In case you haven't noticed, things are a bit hectic around here.

Marl's doing a good job protecting the corn fields, but the commotion gave our goats quite the scare. They dashed out of their pen as soon as the fighting started, and are now running amuck!

Round them up for me and I'll do my best to figure out how to handle the curse you're dealing with.

passages.title: Herding Goats
passages.text: Have you found my goats yet?

passages.title: Herding Goats
passages.text:
I can see all my goats have been accounted for.

Now, let's see if we can do something about that curse.

passages.title: Finding Fizzlebang
passages.text:
I have reason to believe that Wilfred Fizzlebang's sister has made her way to Stormheim.

If she has half his power, but at least twice his intelligence, then we just might succeed in summoning the eredar twins.

passages.title: Finding Fizzlebang
passages.text:
You're the council's new leader, aren't you? I could tell by your weapon. I bet you have an amazing story to tell about how you got it.

My name's Lulubelle, or Lulu for short. But, uh... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention to anyone that you saw me, ok?

passages.title: Someone Else's Mess
passages.text:
A confession alone won't be enough to clear my name. As long as those demons run amuck, people will blame their presence on me. 

Someone needs to clean up the mess that warlock made. I'd do it myself, but I can't be placed at the scene of the crime.

You could banish them though. That would do the trick. Use this orb on newly summoned demons to send them right back where they came from - permanently!

passages.title: Someone Else's Mess
passages.text:
Thank you, <name>.

Your willingness to help an outcast will not be forgotten.

passages.title: The First Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
The Legion...

<the glow of Ursol's eyes begin to shine intensely>

Yes... I remember clearly that day long ago when my brother fell. Countless demons fell beneath his claws until, through the overwhelming numbers of the enemy, he was overtaken. My brother was the true spirit of the bear!

You must prove to me that the spirit of the bear resides within you as well.

passages.title: The First Trial of Ursol
passages.text: <The ancient stares at you expectantly.>

passages.title: The First Trial of Ursol
passages.text: You are powerful indeed, but strength alone will not impress me.

passages.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
Ursoc never backed down from a battle, even when faced with overwhelming odds. If you would take up his claws you will show me that you possess the same courage.

Your next trial will place you against an onslaught of my followers. Defeat all of the spirits and prove that you possess the courage of the bear!

passages.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
passages.text: <The ancient stares at you expectantly.>

passages.title: The Second Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
Well done, <name>. You handled yourself with honor!

You've done well so far, yet a single trial remains before I will give you my blessing.

passages.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
You've proven to me your strength and your courage, but do you possess the ability to apply yourself when it matters most?

This final trial will reveal all.

passages.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
passages.text: <The ancient stares at you expectantly.>

passages.title: The Third Trial of Ursol
passages.text:
You have passed every trial I've placed before you and emerged victorious. You are worthy indeed of my brother's legacy, and have earned my blessing!

Go, seek out the claws and claim them as your own.

passages.title: Lulubelle on Loan
passages.text:
What you plan to do is pretty risky, you know? Summoning one sister would be difficult enough, but both of them at once? That's just asking for trouble.

Luckily, I'm up for the challenge. I'll help you and the rest of the council summon those demons, and hopefully restore pride to the Fizzlebang name.

passages.title: Lulubelle on Loan
passages.text: With Lulubelle's assistance, we should be able to complete the summoning.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text:
As her name suggests, Imp Mother Dyala is adept at summoning imps.

While the council controls Dreadscar Rift, her services will be ours to use as we see fit.

Speak to her if you wish to train a pack of imps.

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Recruiting The Troops
passages.text: Excellent. These troops will be invaluable in our defense of the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text:
As First of the council, you have acolytes devoted to helping any way they can. Recruiter Jared is in charge of screening candidates, only selecting those that possess the skills we desire.

Speak to him now.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text: I'm here to help build you an army, <name>.

passages.title: Minions of the Darkness
passages.text:
Oenia Skyhorn was a legendary chieftain of her tribe. Though she crossed over to the spirit realm long ago, her presence is still felt all around us.

Ebonhorn told me that Oenia placed a ward here to protect the people she cared for so deeply... perhaps from the specter of the Darkness.

Use the Water of Vision to journey into her echoes. Worry not that this ritual might disturb her rest. A hero like Oenia would relish a chance to aid us in the present.

passages.title: Minions of the Darkness
passages.text: The spirits speak of the Darkness. A great danger rises, <name>.

passages.title: Minions of the Darkness
passages.text:
These shadows of the spirit realm grow stronger. I fear they may soon pierce the veil into our reality.

I pray restoring the wards will set things right.

passages.title: Servants of the Darkness
passages.text:
The heroes of Highmountain's past placed wards to protect our land from the insidious Old Gods. The deeds of these noble champions kept us safe for thousands of years.

We must not fail their memory.

Huln Highmountain himself placed the ward here at Snowblind Mesa. It must be reactivated for us to have any hope of saving Ebonhorn.

Enter the echo of Huln's spirit, and let his courage lead you to the location of this ward.

passages.title: Servants of the Darkness
passages.text:
Huln battled the Necrodark?

There are so many tall tales attributed to Huln that I assumed those drogbar to be just another story. But it is clear they served the Darkness.

A troubling discovery... but there is no time to dwell on it now.

passages.title: The Gates of Valor
passages.text:
Ye'd not normally know it, but the terraced entrance to the vrykul's Halls o' Valor is a fine place for findin' ancient artifacts. Problem is, the place is just a big mess with demons at the time.

Well, ye've not got much choice. If the disc isn't elsewhere in Stormheim, it most likely lies at the Gates of Valor. Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: The Gates of Valor
passages.text: Ye're back in one piece. What's the news?

passages.title: The Gates of Valor
passages.text:
Alright, let's see what ye brought me.

<Brann examines the disc pieces.>

Well look at this? There's a piece o' somethin' fel here. I betcha that's what was causin' all those imps ta show up 'round here.

I'll give it to ya to dispose of, or do whatever it is ye do with things like that.

passages.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
passages.text:
A Legion communicator? Hmmmm.

<Khadgar pauses to think for a moment.>

You know what, I think I have something in my lockbox upstairs that is just the ticket.

passages.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
passages.text: I'm always happy to help a friend.

passages.title: Ask and You Shall Receive
passages.text: No need to thank me, just promise you won't accidentally blow anything up in the city; our repair bills are already astronomical.

passages.title: Return to Jace
passages.text:
That crystallized soul should power your communicator long enough to reach your allies.

I must urge you to be cautious, <name>. If that device is of Legion origin, then you never know who among its creators might overhear your message.

I'm sure your allies eagerly await your return.

passages.title: Return to Jace
passages.text: Did the Archmage have anything of use?

passages.title: Curse of the Necrodark
passages.text:
It is clear that the Old Gods have long sought to control Highmountain. Their covetous desire speaks to the power of this land, and the strength of the spirits that echo through its peaks and valleys.

They will not take our sacred mountain, <name>. Not while I draw breath.

With the Highmountain tribes united, and with Baine Bloodhoof at our side, we will defeat the Darkness... once and for all.

Come. Let us take back the summit from the forces that would corrupt it.

passages.title: Curse of the Necrodark
passages.text:
Mayla charged ahead with Ebonhorn. Now they're cut off from the rest of us.

This is bad, <name>.

passages.title: The Final Ward
passages.text:
The Necrodark are readying their ritual to give physical form to the Darkness. They've sealed themselves inside and barred our way.

The shards you brought me should provide the means to bring down the barrier. Once it is done, we have to act quickly. We must restore the final ward before the Darkness can manifest.

Do not hesitate. The fate of Highmountain itself hangs in the balance.

passages.title: The Final Ward
passages.text: This is the hardest challenge I have ever had to face.

passages.title: The Final Ward
passages.text:
We failed! The ward is shattered.

I sense the Darkness rising...

passages.title: The Master of Swords
passages.text:
I got bad news fer ya - we don't have time to wait for reinforcements. They're sacrificin' prisoners now! Every minute we wait here jabberin' is another life on the line!

First things first, my friend Sylara is being held captive in the camp just across the road.

We need ta free her - she'll be a valuable ally.

We've got ta move move move!

passages.title: The Master of Swords
passages.text: Something need punching?

passages.title: The Master of Swords
passages.text: Good, ye did it. Sylara is worth ten well-trained monks.

passages.title: No Monk Left Behind
passages.text:
Most of the prisoners are being held in the main camp at the Gates of Valor.

Our people have been beaten and tortured, and worse still awaits for them if we don't save them.

Find the cages within the main camp and free as many monks as you can find.

I'll be right beside you, knocking heads and taking names!

passages.title: No Monk Left Behind
passages.text: Did we free them all?

passages.title: No Monk Left Behind
passages.text:
Good work, Grandmaster!

That should be all of them.

passages.title: Zero to Hiro
passages.text:
I have a favor to ask of you, <name>. My good friend Hiro is still somewhere inside the main camp.

Only problem is, the Gates of Valor are swarming with the biggest, baddest, nastiest Legion creatures I've ever seen. If we walk in there, we'll just get slaughtered.

But I've seen these vrykul chugging some kind of special brew called Storm Brew. It's some kind of combat tonic that makes them bigger and stronger.

Let's steal some of that drink, then storm in to save Hiro!

passages.title: Zero to Hiro
passages.text: Ahhh, tanks be to ya for freein' me. I thot I was demon-food for sure.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
Caria lies in the very heart of Legion territory - they'll see our forces immediately if we try to launch an all-out attack.

Failure is not an option.

However, if you go alone you might be able to slip by unnoticed long enough to avoid the brunt of the Legion army.

Remember, <name> - this is not a rescue mission. The power of the Aldrachi Warblades could tip the scales of this war in our favor; Allari and her men are expendable if need be.

passages.title: Vengeance Will Be Ours
passages.text:
What of the others? Did they...?

I see. They gave their lives for a worthy cause - the Warblades will change the tide of this war, mark my words.

passages.title: The Mead Master
passages.text: The vyrkul meadery overlooks the coast in northern Stormheim. Meet me there when you are ready, <name>.

passages.title: Lady Lunastre
passages.text:
Our friend Ly'leth contacted me. She requested that you meet her atop the Grand Promenade as it overlooks the city.

Have your disguise ready just in case, <name>.

passages.title: Lady Lunastre
passages.text: Hm?

passages.title: Lady Lunastre
passages.text: I hope you have prepared yourself to enter the City. It is time.

passages.title: The Gondolier
passages.text:
I need your help.

The wine you so graciously distributed to the needy was the last of my reserves. Without more, these people here will risk succumbing to their thirst, and eventually becoming withered.

I am dedicated to preventing this for as long as possible.

There is a woman by the name of Deline who owns and operates a small delivery service out of her gondola.

Find her, identify yourself as my messenger, and offer your aid in acquiring the next shipment.

passages.title: The Gondolier
passages.text: Unless you want a ride, you should keep moving.

passages.title: The Gondolier
passages.text: Let's get started, shall we?

passages.title: Den of Shadows
Whispers of the Darkness
passages.text:
Before our arrival, many of our own came to neutralize the threat here. They did not know what they were walking into.

Our people are now suffering from the whispers. The Old Gods seek to corrupt them and turn them against their own.

Wake them from their stupor. Free them from the whispers any way you can.

passages.title: Whispers of the Darkness
passages.text: Well done, <name>. If left unchecked, the whispers can turn even the best of friends against one another.

passages.title: Dark Tales
passages.text:
Spiritwalker Ebonhorn is stable... for now.

He once told me of the wards he maintains against the Old Gods. He placed them at key locations around this mountain, but kept them hidden from mortal eyes--even my own.

Incapacitated like this, his wards cannot hold back the evil ones. No doubt this is the reason for their attack.

To find the wards, we must enter the echoes of Ebonhorn's past and commune with the spirits we find there.

Meet me in Riverbend, <name>. It is there our search begins.

passages.title: Dark Tales
passages.text:
The spirits hold many truths, <name>.

Walking in their footsteps may reveal the locations of Ebonhorn's wards.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text:
Xavius has been this way, but his destination is unclear. The Nightmare smothers my mind!

These refugees tell of an ancient Moonwell hidden in the ruins ahead.

If it is uncorrupted, it will give me the focus I need. By Elune's light, we will find my husband yet.

Meet me at the Moonwell at once, <class>.

passages.title: Dark Side of the Moon
passages.text: He is still alive, but the rest remains to be seen. For your sake, let us pray that he is unharmed.

passages.title: Tainted Growth
passages.text:
The blood red petals of the Nightmare Flower seethe with chaotic energy. The plant twitches every now and then, releasing puffs of pollen into the air. 

The nearby satyrs and keepers can be seen harvesting similar plants for little crimson seeds.

These seeds must be destroyed.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text:
A final favor for an old friend, perhaps? My age-old companion, Varethos, has fallen to the nightmare's torment. We once worked in unison to protect this land. His close ties to the land brought him low in this dark hour.

As with all who suffer this fate, there is no restoring him.

Please, <name>, bring him peace.

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text: Is it done, then?

passages.title: Given to Corruption
passages.text: My sight fades, but I am glad that he rests.

passages.title: The Master's Plan
passages.text:
The purpose of the Twilight's Hammer has always been the same. They seek to bring about the end of the world. Their schemes may change, but their wicked purpose remains constant.

Defeating the Twilight's Hammer is not simply a matter of defeating them in battle. If we are to be successful, we will need to uncover their scheme and put an end to whatever terrible plans they have created.

Let us start by searching the encampment for clues as to their true purpose here.

passages.title: The Master's Plan
passages.text: What vile scheme have the Twilight's Hammer plotted against the world this time?

passages.title: The Master's Plan
passages.text:
If The Master is not stopped, the Twilight's Hammer will have all the power they need to conquer Deepholm and enslave the elements!

We must not allow that to happen.

passages.title: Unleashing the Elements
passages.text:
According to The Master's journal, the Twilight's Hammer has discovered a method of harnessing the void to subjugate even the most powerful of elementals.

The journal specifically mentioned the children of Therazane as test subjects. Whether The Master was speaking literally or figuratively in this regard, I do not know. Regardless, we need to free these elementals and stop these dark rituals from continuing.

It appears that our journey here is going to take us deeper into the depths of darkness...

passages.title: Unleashing the Elements
passages.text: Dark rituals such as these must not be allowed to continue.

passages.title: Unleashing the Elements
passages.text: The servants of Therazane are free and the dark rituals of subjugation have been halted... for now.

passages.title: Held Captive!
passages.text:
There are prisoners here, Farseer <name>, that are enslaved by the Twilight's Hammer.

The cultists work them to death in the depths of the mine.

I cannot abide such cruel mistreatment! Let us clear a path through the mine and rescue any Twilight's Hammer prisoners we find, so that they may return to their homes and families.

The Twilight's Hammer will pay for their crimes!

passages.title: Held Captive!
passages.text: Have the slaves been rescued?

passages.title: Held Captive!
passages.text: The captives have been set free, but there is still much more to be done if we are to dismantle the Twilight's Hammer cult...

passages.title: Gathering the Pieces
passages.text:
Grand Master, the Mission Table is now at your disposal.

There are several strategic areas where we can focus our Order's efforts.

First, we should check on the status of the other monk temples. It seems the Legion has a special focus on destroying us.

Second, we need to scour the seas near the Broken Shore. There are still many missing from the battle.

Finally, there is the continued appearance of demonic forces at numerous points across the Broken Isles. They must be kept at bay.

passages.title: Appropriations
passages.text:
I have come to lend my help to the Order of the Broken Temple.

My job is to create a solid base of operations around here. Right now, we have wounded to tend and bellies to feed. After this, we can worry about building our defenses.

Lao Shu is in charge of our supply inventory. Go and speak with him now in the inn.

passages.title: Appropriations
passages.text: Ah, yes yes yes! High Elder Cloudfall was right to send you to me.

passages.title: Tracking the Tideskorn
passages.text:
We have sent scouts to search for our kidnapped allies, and our efforts may have finally paid off.

They've tracked them to the vrykul homeland of Stormheim, but the unfamiliar territory has slowed our progress and we're in danger of losing the trail.

I suggest that we send our champions immediately to assist with the tracking effort.

passages.title: Tracking the Tideskorn
passages.text: Did we gather enough information about the Legion forces at the Gates of Valor?

passages.title: Tracking the Tideskorn
passages.text: Excellent. It will be extremely dangerous to infiltrate the Gates, but with this information, we will know exactly the enemy's location and numbers.

passages.title: Freya's Spring
passages.text:
First, we need water from Freya's Spring.

Once a year, on the first day of solstice, the sun hits the white-capped summit of the highest peak in Highmountain. The melting snow runs through a ravine and collects in a crystalline pool.

Some say these waters grant eternal youth. Silly stories if you ask me, but we will need this rare, purified water for our brew.

I suggest sending our champions to collect us a sample, for your skills will be needed elsewhere.

passages.title: Freya's Spring
passages.text: This water is filtered from only the freshest fallen snow every winter, and is a vital ingredient to our brew!

passages.title: A Better Future
passages.text:
We must move quickly, <name>. I must save as many of my people as I can before the attack begins.

Word has gotten out in the city that there is a safe haven with us and some no longer fear exile.

Venture into the Grand Promenade, champion. Find those willing to join us and let them know it is time they made their escape.

passages.title: A Better Future
passages.text: Each shal'dorei rescued is both a potential enemy vanquished and a new hope for our people.

passages.title: A Better Future
passages.text: Our strength grows and our enemies wane. We will win this fight, <name>!

passages.title: A Matter of Finesse
passages.text:
A rune of portals?! Who does Val'zuun think he is?

<Valeera takes a deep breath.>

It's worth the price, but those runes aren't exactly easy to come by. Unless...

Archmage Celindra, the Kirin Tor's portal master, has a study in the center of town. We rogues aren't particularly welcome there, nor would she simply hand a rune over even if we were...

<Valeera smirks.>

But who said anything about asking?

passages.title: A Matter of Finesse
passages.text: They say the Fangs of the Devourer have no equal. If that's true, they're worth any price.

passages.title: A Matter of Finesse
passages.text: Val'zuun actually kept his end of the bargain... I'm impressed.

passages.title: Closing In
passages.text:
The Legerdemain Lounge isn't far from here. We have agents nearby who can secure the area.

Come prepared for a fight. Akaari won't go down easily.

passages.title: Closing In
passages.text: I can't believe it...

passages.title: Closing In
passages.text: It was a ruse?!

passages.title: Traitor!
passages.text:
That lying demon SCUM! I should have known.

Let's show Val'zuun what happens to people who dare cross the Uncrowned.

passages.title: Traitor!
passages.text: He's lying again, I know it... but he might be our only option.

passages.title: Fangs of the Devourer
passages.text:
If you spare me I can use the rune of portals you provided to open a gateway to Akaari's citadel in the Twisting Nether.

Of course, killing the Legion's master assassin in her own domain will be no simple feat, but surely the Fangs of the Devourer are worth the risk, no?

<Val'zuun smiles.>

I will guide you through the citadel once you arrive, but you will have to defeat Akaari on your own.

passages.title: Fangs of the Devourer
passages.text: Any luck?

passages.title: Fangs of the Devourer
passages.text: I knew you'd succeed, <name>. I'm glad you're on our side.

passages.title: The Brand of Damnation
passages.text:
I require a symbol of my dominion as Firelord. A weapon that will strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to oppose my rule!

Deep within the den of the Cinderweb, there is an ancient spear born from within the heart of the Firelands. Emberscar is a living weapon whose wicked power is beyond mortal comprehension.

Prove your strength and claim Emberscar in my name! If you survive, perhaps I will aid the feeble races of humanity against the Burning Legion.

passages.title: The Brand of Damnation
passages.text: The Brand of Damnation will be mine!

passages.title: The Brand of Damnation
passages.text:
I see that you have successfully awakened Emberscar, and that it has been well-fed.

Perhaps you are stronger than I first thought...

passages.title: Combat Training
Tianji of the Ox
passages.text:
Greetings, Grandmaster. Beside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

The first task is critical. Tianji, a renowned trainer in the ox school style of martial combat, was on her way to the Broken Isles when she was attacked.

I suggest we send Chen Stormstout to help her. He will be uniquely suited to this task.

passages.title: Tianji of the Ox
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Tianji of the Ox
passages.text: Most excellent, Grandmaster! The mission was a success. Our new teacher, Recruiter Tianji, is getting situated as we speak.

passages.title: Building Our Troops
passages.text:
Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Tianji, a famed monk skilled in the school of the ox.

She is known for her brewmaster techniques, and is a valuable addition to the temple. She is already beginning to train a new batch of pupils.

Speak to her now and train an initiate of the ox.

passages.title: Building Our Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Building Our Troops
passages.text: Excellent. These troops will be invaluable in our defense of the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: Black Rook Holdings
passages.text:
Inside the chest, hidden amongst various knickknacks, is a signet engraved with a unique crest.

The band, made from a silvery, unbreakable metal, has been worn down by time, as if absently twisted and rubbed against its owner's finger.

passages.title: House Call
passages.text:
I thought Barrem was lost to us after the tragedy at Broken Shore, Light knows we lost far too many good soldiers just like him there.

I was shocked to see he was still alive when one of our patrols arrived carrying him. They found him floating in the sea with wounds that would kill any lesser draenei.

There is something about those wounds that resists everything we've done to treat them. Please, <class>, as a brother in the Light I ask you to do all that you can to help him to recover.

passages.title: House Call
passages.text:
I... I owe you my life, brother, but that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.

<You tell Barrem about his mentioning of T'uure in his sleep.>

I must have been dreaming of Alora, she was my cell mate in that accursed world the demons took me to. She told me she saw the crystal but never said much else.

I just hope she is still alive.

passages.title: Seeker of Truth
passages.text:
You may be familiar with Orik Trueheart. He has devoted his time after the Northrend campaign to learning more about Tyr. 

Orik has evidence of a powerful shield crafted by Tyr long ago. With the help of the Sunwalkers, we may finally be able to seek it out.

Please speak to him immediately.

passages.title: Seeker of Truth
passages.text: I'm glad yer in. We've quite the journey ahead.

passages.title: Seeker of Truth
passages.text: I'm glad yer coming. I've been wanting to pursue this for some time now. With help from the Seers, I think it can be done!

passages.title: Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna
passages.text:
Aluneth... a powerful and dangerous weapon. If tales are to be believed, Aluneth is actually the name of a very old and very powerful arcane entity, somehow bound to a staff through ancient magic.

When Aegwynn relinquished Aluneth many years ago, it was entrusted to Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away in secret. Only they would know exactly where it was taken.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides on the Council of Six.

passages.title: Aluneth, Greatstaff of the Magna
passages.text:
So you seek Aluneth? A dangerous weapon, to be sure.

Long ago the Kirin Tor entrusted the blue dragonflight with its safekeeping. It was locked away in the only place that could contain its rampant power  - the Nexus Vault.

I have not been there in some time, however. After the blue dragonflight was dissolved, the Nexus was all but abandoned. There is no knowing whether the Nexus Vault is still intact - or what may be waiting in the Nexus itself.

passages.title: To Northrend
passages.text:
Naturally I've done some legwork already. I believe this Gorvold is buried at Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord.

Tahu can help locate the grave, and with a short ritual we should have our answers!

Meet us at Shield Hill in the Howling Fjord and we'll move on to the next step.

passages.title: To Northrend
passages.text:
I trust the journey wasn't too long or hard.

Let's go find our dead adventurer, eh?

passages.title: Kept Secret, Kept Safe
passages.text:
With the scrolls in hand, now you must set to the task of finding the staff.

When Aegwynn relinquished it many years ago, it was entrusted to Kirin Tor, who, fearing its unbridled power, handed it to the blue dragonflight to secure away from the hands of men. Only they would know exactly where it was taken, or how to retrieve it.

The dragon Kalec may be our best chance. He now resides upon the Council of Six in Dalaran. Seek him, and your answers, there.

passages.title: The End of the Saga
passages.text:
Ye should read the saga yerself, it's right here.

We're here to speak to the spirit of that vrykul I spoke of. Tahu Sagewind is a powerful Seer and he should be able to bring his spirit back. It will be up to us to convince him to speak.

You should speak with Tahu so we can get started.

passages.title: The End of the Saga
passages.text:
I think I already have a lead on that island. Word around the tavern was a great warrior had broken into a vrykul king's tomb on an island in Stormheim.

That's got to be the one we're looking for!

passages.title: A Forgotten Enemy
passages.text:
The device still hums with power. It must have been abandoned not long ago.

The nearby switch appears to activate it.

passages.title: Eyes of the Dragon
passages.text:
You should travel at once to Coldarra in Borean Tundra, <name>. There, I would recommend you scout out a few key locations and report back to me. 

I know the area well, and should be able to tell you how to proceed.

Make haste!

passages.title: Arcane Unleashed
passages.text:
You have the power you need to destroy the Surge Needles. 

At the location of the breaches where the Surge Needles pierce the ground, there will be a large concentration of void energy. Focus the power of Aluneth into these points. The reaction should cause an overload, destroying the Surge Needle above.

You must act quickly. The Ethereum won't sit idly by as you lay waste to their machinations.

passages.title: A Gift of Time
passages.text:
You have done a great thing for the blue dragons today, <name>, as well as for my own peace of mind.

Now, armed with Aluneth, I only ask that you fulfill your original goal, and take the fight to the Legion.

I believe your comrades await your back in the Hall of the Guardian. Safe travels, friend.

passages.title: Shrine of the Truthguard
passages.text:
We'll be flying straight to the island. My friend said that the warrior who came here before us never entered the shrine itself, since they were after one of the tombs.

If a vrykul hero couldn't enter the shrine, I bet it's still protected by Tyr's power. I'm thinkin' we have a good shot at this.

My pal Cato will meet us there. We might be needin' the talents of a good healer!

passages.title: Shrine of the Truthguard
passages.text: I am heartened that your quest was a success, <name>. We have been awaiting your return.

passages.title: Rise, Champions [NYI]
passages.text: [Tutorial quest flow not yet implemented. Skip forward.]

passages.title: Building Our Troops [NYI]
passages.text: [Tutorial quest flow not yet implemented. Skip forward.]

passages.title: Dire Growth
passages.text: Naralex asks for you to join him. He is ready to analyze the sample that he brought back from Shaladrassil.

passages.title: Dire Growth
passages.text: I have never seen anything like this...

passages.title: Dire Growth
passages.text: You were just with Naralex? What were the results of the sampling?

passages.title: Sampling the Nightmare
passages.text:
There is still so much that we don't know about the Nightmare.

Before we can fight it, we must understand how it spreads.

Let us send our champions to the roots of Shaladrassil in Val'sharah, and ask them to bring back samples to study.

passages.title: Sampling the Nightmare
passages.text: Our champions returned from Shaladrassil just moments ago, Archdruid. The journey was a great success!

passages.title: Malorne's Refuge
passages.text:
I see... it is as we have always feared. The Emerald Nightmare has found our world.

We must call upon the ancient god, Malorne.

Travel southeast to the shrine at Malorne's Refuge. There, we druids have kept a sacred relic for thousands of years, a gift from the white stag himself.

I already sent Broll Bearmantle ahead to give word of your arrival.

passages.title: Malorne's Refuge
passages.text:
I'm glad you are here, <name>, but if only we had arrived earlier! This place was in chaos when I arrived.

The survivors claim they were attacked by satyr, but how can this be? No satyrs have roamed these woods since ancient times.

passages.title: Tracking the Enemy
passages.text:
The Idol may be stolen, but there is still hope.

While I was trapped at the shrine, I saw the satyr raiders make off with the relic. Their tracks will still be fresh.

With our heightened senses, we may still be able to pick up their trail.

We must follow their signs through the forest and recover the Idol!

passages.title: Tracking the Enemy
passages.text: Look what we dragged in.

passages.title: Gathering the Dreamweavers
passages.text:
Now that you've recovered the Idol of the Wilds, it's time to put it to use to commune with Malorne. However, the ritual will need the combined power of many druids.

Send your champions to gather the druids of our order, and tell them to meet us in Nordrassil. We will need to do this together.

passages.title: Gathering the Dreamweavers
passages.text: Good, the druids have gathered. Even now, they should be flocking to Nordrassil to prepare for the ritual.

passages.title: Enduring the Nightmare
passages.text:
We are under attack here, <name>!

Creatures of the Nightmare are spilling into the Dreamway as we speak.

Destroy them. They cannot be allowed to linger, or else the Nightmare will take root here, too!

passages.title: Enduring the Nightmare
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Enduring the Nightmare
passages.text: Good, I already feel the Nightmare's power waning.

passages.title: Teensy Weensies!
passages.text:
Oh <name>, I'm so very very happy to see you!

The woodland critters whispered there was trouble in the Dreamway so I came immediately!

There are so very many teensy weensy little creatures that live here in the Emerald Dream, and they're out there, all lost and alone!

Would you go out there and gather them up? You can use my flute to call them to you.

Thank you, brave druid!

passages.title: Teensy Weensies!
passages.text: Ohhh, the teensy weensy fae dragons are so cute! Are they all right?

passages.title: Teensy Weensies!
passages.text: Yay, they're saved! Thank you!

passages.title: Cleaning Up
passages.text:
When the Nightmare spreads, it consumes the life force of all that it touches.

The more it spreads, the weaker our magic becomes.

In its early stages, before the taint has taken hold, we can still cleanse the affected areas.

I will bless you with Elune's grace. By channeling her power, you can reverse the Nightmare's spread.

passages.title: Cleaning Up
passages.text: Did you restore the Dream?

passages.title: Cleaning Up
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>. I knew that Elune's power could purify the nightmare's taint. Her blessing is strong here.

passages.title: A Dying Dream
passages.text:
Deep in the heart of the swamp lies an ancient protector of the Dreamway, Witherheart.

He was among the first defenders to battle against the Nightmare, but he has fallen to total corruption.

It pains me to say it, but we must destroy him.

passages.title: A Dying Dream
passages.text: No one is safe from the Nightmare.

passages.title: A Dying Dream
passages.text:
Today I grieve for a fallen ally, one who has wandered these forests for eons.

He can now be at peace, knowing he gave his life to protect this sacred place.

passages.title: Communing With Malorne
passages.text:
Our work here is done, <name>. We have successfully defended the Dreamway. It will be only a matter of time before it is restored to its former state.

But we have more important matters at hand.

Take the Idol of the Wilds and go onward to Nordrassil. With any luck, they have already gathered. We will meet you there.

passages.title: Communing With Malorne
passages.text: I am glad to see you, <name>.

passages.title: Communing With Malorne
passages.text:
My grandfather, Malorne, the ancient god of the wilds himself... long have I wished for this day, only to find that he is in great peril.

If he is trapped in the Nightmare, then what hope remains for the rest of us?

passages.title: Powering the Portal
passages.text:
If Malorne is trapped in the Nightmare, we must try to save him. It may sound like a fool's errand, but we cannot sit by idly.

There is an abandoned portal within the Emerald Dreamway, one that we druids closed long ago because it leads to the Rift of Aln.

To infuse it with energy once again, we will need shards of Nightmare which can be found on satyr lieutenants.

Send our champions to hunt and kill these enemies.

passages.title: Powering the Portal
passages.text: How many shards have we collected?

passages.title: Powering the Portal
passages.text: Excellent. These shards are positively surging with negative energy. Be careful when touching them, <name>.

passages.title: Defenders of the Dream
passages.text:
Never has our order faced such a difficult challenge. To succeed, we must rely on each other's strengths.

However, we only have a few defenders to spare for the battle ahead.

Broll, Sylendra, Zen'tabra, and Mylune have all volunteered to accompany you into the valley below, but I can only spare one.

Which one will you choose to aid you in battle?

passages.title: Defenders of the Dream
passages.text: Have you chosen?

passages.title: Defenders of the Dream
passages.text: Well chosen. The others will aid me in defending here. We must hurry.

passages.title: Enter Nightmare
passages.text:
The portal to the nightmare is ready, <name>. Remulos and the others have already gone ahead.

There is no telling what horrors await on the other side, <name>. Good luck.

passages.title: Enter Nightmare
passages.text:
Do not be deceived, <name>. What appears to be the mountains of Hyjal, is in fact an illusion created by our enemy.

This is a re-creation of the darkest nightmare in Malorne's mind. This is the War of the Ancients, a battle that occurred thousands of years ago.

It was during this war that Azeroth was first threatened by the Burning Legion, and the War in which Malorne and the Wild Gods fell.

passages.title: The Shade of Xavius
passages.text:
Brightwing loves nice things - rainbows, unicorns, and flowers! But enemies, Brightwing does not forget. Brightwing remembers for a long, long time those that hurt the grove.

Now, we must destroy our enemies... so that the grove can be nice and happy forever!

Friend, go to Darkheart Thicket beneath the roots of Shaladrassil.

There, find the one named Xavius... the one who started it all. Kill him, and bring me his head.

passages.title: The War of the Ancients
passages.text:
To free Malorne, we must win the War of the Ancients. A millennia ago, this battle took the combined efforts of the greatest defenders of our world. To win now, we must do the same.

Go upon the battlefield and defeat Legion foes, rescue and revive our allies, and free the innocent who have been caught in the battle. Every enemy defeated and every ally saved will help turn the tide in our favor!

passages.title: The War of the Ancients
passages.text: You lead us to triumph today, <name>.

passages.title: Archimonde, The Defiler
passages.text:
We have turned the battle, <name>! The Burning Legion is greatly weakened.

Only one task remains. Malorne is locked in battle with Archimonde, the demon that slew him ten thousand years ago.

Remember, <name>, we are trapped in Malorne's nightmare. There is no telling what will manifest here, but we MUST do something.

May Elune guide us, <name>.

passages.title: Archimonde, The Defiler
passages.text: <Malorne gazes directly at you. Radiant, soothing energy exudes outward from his body. Suddenly, you feel a serene sense of peace and gratitude envelop your entire being.>

passages.title: The Twilight Master
passages.text:
There is only one more thing that remains, Farseer <name>. We must confront the leader of the Twilight's Hammer and put an end to their sinister plot once and for all.

Without their so-called master, the remaining cultists will be forced to retreat from Deepholm.

Only when The Twilight's Hammer has been crushed and Deepholm has been saved, will we have the support of Therazane against the demons of the Burning Legion.

passages.title: The Twilight Master
passages.text:
So, the Mistress of Twilight was actually a dragon... I thought the brood of Sintharia had all been defeated.

I wonder if Zeryxia was not the last of her kind...

passages.title: The Return of Twilight
passages.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has reemerged and they are building an army to overthrow my kingdom. A ludicrous fantasy on their part, but one that I cannot take lightly.

I cannot offer the mortal races my aid until the threat to Deepholm has been dealt with. If you truly wish to unite the Elemental Lords to your cause, I would see you prove it.

Go. Uncover the plot that the Twilight's Hammer is hatching and put an end to their scheme!

passages.title: The Return of Twilight
passages.text: It is good that you have arrived, Farseer <name>. The Twilight's Hammer has built a formidable stronghold here in Deepholm.

passages.title: Masquerade
passages.text:
Our family commands great respect in this city, thanks to my father. Through my network of contacts, we can organize the citizens to prepare Suramar for Thalyssra's return.

You must walk among the nightborne. You must earn the trust of our friends and foes alike.

You must become someone else.

<Ly'leth hands you a shimmering party mask.>

Put this on Anarys.

passages.title: Masquerade
passages.text: Not to worry, it will not hurt him.

passages.title: Masquerade
passages.text: My little brother is about to turn over a new leaf, whether he likes it or not.

passages.title: In With the New
passages.text:
Well, here's your new conduit. Try not to break this one, I really don't feel like making another.

Oh, and tell your boss, Deucus, that he owes me big time for this.

passages.title: In With the New
passages.text:
You're finished? Let's see it!

<Deucus takes the conduit from you and places it against the wall.>

Now that is a good looking decoction conduit. I'm glad I upgraded its strength from that old hunk of junk I had before.

You might even say Svena did me a favor by destroying that old one.

passages.title: Evacuate Snowmane
passages.text:
They just keep coming!

And now my scouts report some of the drogbar have managed to sneak around our flank and are attacking Snowmane Village.

Go, help the evacuation. We will hold the line here and try to buy you some time.

passages.title: Evacuate Snowmane
passages.text: I knew we should have secured this town better.

passages.title: Evacuate Snowmane
passages.text: And not a moment too soon. Our scouts report the Underking himself has come.

passages.title: Empowering the Soul
passages.text:
Creating the anchor will require more power than our soul shards will be able to provide.

Dreadscar's troops are capable of amassing a large amount of soul shards when they defeat enemies while on missions. Once we have enough, I can harvest the supply and use them to craft the anchor.

passages.title: Empowering the Soul
passages.text: With enough soul shards, we should have the power to create the anchor.

passages.title: Empowering the Soul
passages.text: Your troops have done well. Our soul shard supply is sufficient enough to create the anchor.

passages.title: Let it Feed
passages.text:
We can use the Bloodstone to control the sisters once they are in a weakened state, but first, we'll need to feed it.

The stone grows in power when consuming the blood of demons. Luckily for us, there's no shortage of demons to kill.

passages.title: Let it Feed
passages.text: We will need to feed the Bloodstone before it will be strong enough to control the eredar sisters.

passages.title: Let it Feed
passages.text: This should be more than enough blood to satiate the Bloodstone.

passages.title: The Underking Comes
passages.text:
Here, I'm too slow to get these laggards to safety. Take my horn and sound the evacuation.

We need to get the people out of here before the drogbar arrive. The warbraves can take it from there.

For now just send them over to Spiritwalker Ebonhorn. That fool can watch over them until it is safe.

passages.title: The Underking Comes
passages.text: Well, this is an unexpected pleasure.

passages.title: The Underking Comes
passages.text: The Underking is coming. Best keep that weapon of yours handy in case this does not go well.

passages.title: On the Trail of the Great Worm
passages.text: We need the Gjallarhorn to compel the armies of Odyn's children to join our cause. If the great worm swallowed it, we shall dig through the very earth until we find it in its entrails!

passages.title: On the Trail of the Great Worm
passages.text: Glory is ours, indeed! The great worm cannot hide from us!

passages.title: To the Summit!
passages.text:
Your armies have tracked the beast to the highest peak in Highmountain.

It has nowhere left to run, but it is protected by foul drogbar. You must go there yourself and slay Jorhuttam!

passages.title: To the Summit!
passages.text:
You're after the great worm? You must be very foolish or very brave

I know these mountains inside and out. Help me avenge my village and I will help you find the foul beast.

passages.title: The Ritual of Tides
passages.text:
Long ago, the first Farseer of the Earthen Ring was given a vision of the elements.

In the vision she foresaw the arrival of a new Farseer, one who would lead us through a time of terrible crisis and unite the elements.

<name>, I believe that you are the Farseer of this prophecy, called to lead before you were ever born.

The time has come to fulfill your destiny!

When you are ready, we will perform the Ritual of Tides and call upon Neptulon, the first of the four great Elemental Lords.

passages.title: The Ritual of Tides
passages.text: The time has come to fulfill your destiny, Farseer <name>.

passages.title: The Ritual of Tides
passages.text:
I have seen you before, Farseer.

<Lord Neptulon judges you silently for a moment before continuing.>

I sense the potential for great power within you. We shall see if this prophecy holds true...

passages.title: The Silver Hand
passages.text:
Too many know of its location, the tomb must be closed forever. First, we must reclaim the hammer.

Tyrosus has lent us a force to aid in the recovery of the hammer, and some of my order will meet us there as well, but I fear even that may not be enough. I'm glad we'll have you with us.

Take the portal to Dalaran Crater, then fly to Tirisfal Glades and meet us. I've marked the location on your map.

passages.title: The Silver Hand
passages.text: At last it is done.

passages.title: The Silver Hand
passages.text: I am heartened at your successful quest. We have been waiting for you to return.

passages.title: Archmage Omniara
passages.text:
Beside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

The first task is critical. Archmage Omniara, a renowned summoner, was on her way to the Hall of Guardians when she was attacked.

Send Archmage Kalecgos to help her. He will be uniquely suited to this task.

passages.title: Archmage Omniara
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Archmage Omniara
passages.text: Your champion did well! Archmage Omniara agreed to join us and is getting situated as we speak.

passages.title: Last, But Not Least
passages.text:
I think you already know what I am going to tell you... It is well past time to make Allari and Jace your champions.

The two of them were instrumental in the planning and preparation for the invasion of Niskara. They have earned it and you would be hard pressed to find better champions anywhere.

passages.title: Last, But Not Least
passages.text: There is just one thing left to do.

passages.title: Same Day Delivery
passages.text:
I've enchanted these weapons to counter the natural resistances that felhounds have to magic. In addition to that, the metal should splinter their scales on impact, allowing your allies to do increased damage to the demons.

While I don't expect the enchantment to decay over time, you should do your best to deliver these weapons to those who will use them immediately. The longer they remain here, the more demons their power will attract.

passages.title: Same Day Delivery
passages.text: These weapons will work well against Hakkar and his minions. I'll ensure that they are distributed to our allies.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text:
Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Sampson, an extraordinary tracker.

He has a way with animals, calling them to his side with the utmost ease. In fact, he's already beginning to fill the stables with animals that he has tracked and tamed.

Speak to him now.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text: It's my honor to be of service to the Unseen Path. I'll help in any way I can.

passages.title: Summoner Morn
passages.text:
Now that we have recruited champions of our order, we can use the Scouting Map to complete vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

The first assignment is critical. Summoner Morn, a renowned master of the elementals, was on his way to the Heart of Azeroth when he was attacked.

I suggest we send Stormcaller Mylra to help him. She will be uniquely suited to this task.

passages.title: Summoner Morn
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Summoner Morn
passages.text: Good, Mylra was successful in her mission! Our recruiting efforts have paid off.

passages.title: Some Knowledge Shouldn't Be Shared
passages.text: I noticed that quite a few of the Empyrean Society's books are inscribed with fel magic. That's blasphemous. We must confiscate as many as we can.

passages.title: Some Knowledge Shouldn't Be Shared
passages.text: I hope we've found all of the books.

passages.title: Some Knowledge Shouldn't Be Shared
passages.text: You'd better take those back to the Hall of the Guardian for safekeeping, <name>.

passages.title: The Creator's Workshop
passages.text:
My remote observation relay captured an astonishing amount of data from that tomb.

If we can download its memory to my core processing systems, I should be able to locate Titanstrike... and that unsavory vrykul who took it.

Since you're here, would you mind helping out? Processing that much information might overload a few failsafe mechanisms here and there, and I know you're the capable sort!

passages.title: The Creator's Workshop
passages.text: Remember, anything is science if you write it down!

passages.title: The Creator's Workshop
passages.text: The Temple of Storms is close by, so you should get there before that thieving vrykul.

passages.title: What Is Going On Here?
passages.text:
We don't know much about the Empyrean Society's activities here, but now that you appear to be a new recruit you should be able to ask some questions and take a look around for the strange magic Archmage Vargoth detected. 

Let's meet up at the rotunda on the hill.

passages.title: What Is Going On Here?
passages.text: What do you think they are up to?

passages.title: What Is Going On Here?
passages.text: They're using fel magic. I knew there was something off about them, but I never suspected this!

passages.title: The Dreamweavers
passages.text: Assist the Druids of Val'sharah by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Dreamweavers
passages.text: The Dreamweavers thank you.

passages.title: Final Exit
passages.text:
We've certainly reduced the Empyrean Society's numbers. I don't think they'll be luring any more members to their cause for a while. 

There's only one place we haven't investigated, and I suspect that rune we found is attuned to the door. Let's see what's inside the building.

passages.title: Final Exit
passages.text: I thought I'd snoop around a bit before I met you at the rotunda. Unfortunately my invisibility spell wore off at an inopportune time. I'm glad you found me! What is this you have found, <name>?

passages.title: Final Exit
passages.text: Thank you for uncovering the truth about the Empyrean Society, <name>!

passages.title: Growing Power
