passages.text: The Tirisgarde has need of your help now that you have grown in strength, <name>. Meet me in the Hall of the Guardian when you are done with your adventures.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: Good to see you here, <name>. There is much to be done!

passages.title: Mission: Elemental Diplomacy
passages.text:
The Lord of Tides has united with the Earthen Ring, but the matter of uniting the remaining Elemental Lords still remains.

For the next step of our campaign, I have organized a diplomatic mission to Skywall.

The goal of the mission is to ascertain the current political situation in Skywall, following the defeat of Al'Akir the Windlord, and to identify any elementals who would aid our cause.

The mission is currently waiting your assignment.

passages.title: Mission: Elemental Diplomacy
passages.text:
The Earthen Ring champions sent to Skywall have successfully returned to the class hall.

The plane of air is currently in a state of turmoil, however our champions identified a powerful elemental who may be willing to aid our cause.

passages.title: Never Hunt Alone
passages.text:
Prustaga is almost certainly on her way to the Temple of Storms, which is where I imbued Titanstrike with the Thunderspark.

If my deductions are correct, she'll attempt to reverse the process and infuse the spark into herself, thus attaining the godlike power she craves!

Hopefully Thorim isn't off cavorting with his hounds again. If Prustaga has the local vrykul on her side, things may get... complicated.

passages.title: Never Hunt Alone
passages.text: Brann will hardly believe his ears when I tell him what happened. What an adventure!

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
Iron-Body Ponshu has requested your presence.

Our campaign to defend the Broken Isles is getting under way, and we need you back at the Wandering Isle.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: Thank you for coming, Grandmaster.

passages.title: Nobundo Awaits
passages.text:
Nobundo and the other champions of the Earthen Ring have gathered down below. They are awaiting your arrival, Farseer.

A great ritual is about to take place and they have requested your presence. Do not worry about your administrative duties for now, I'll take care of things here.

Nobundo is waiting for you now. May the elements be with you, Farseer.

passages.title: Nobundo Awaits
passages.text:
I hear you have been making good progress down among the Broken Isles. Good. We, too, have been busy here at the Maelstrom.

There are important matters that await us...

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
Thanks to you, the Order of the Broken Temple is gradually re-assembling.

However, there is much more work to do. As our leader, you can determine the trajectory of our order's future.

Speak to Number Nine Jia. She will show you the ropes.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>! I can see that the Order of the Broken Temple is in good hands.

passages.title: The Gjallarhorn
passages.text:
You have proven yourself most thoroughly time and again, <name>. There can be no doubt that you are the one to lead Odyn's armies into the final battle.

You must first obtain the Gjallarhorn so that you may signal to our allies that the end times are upon us.

King Svergan Stormcloak was the last known living guardian of the horn.

Seek his spirit in the Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim and see what you can learn.

passages.title: The Gjallarhorn
passages.text: What is it you seek? Are you here to pilfer heirlooms like the others?

passages.title: Mission: Investigating Deepholm
passages.text:
In order for the Earthen Ring to bring the four Elemental Lords together in an alliance against the Burning Legion, we will need to convince Therazane the Stonemother to join forces with us.

Therazane has been absent from our negotiations with the elements thus far.

There have been whispers of a new threat arising from within Deepholm. If these rumors are true, she may have need of our aid.

I have prepared a diplomatic mission to Deepholm to ascertain the situation. It is awaiting your assignment.

passages.title: Mission: Investigating Deepholm
passages.text: The mission to Deepholm was a success. The champions of the Earthen Ring made contact with Therazane, but the situation there is worse than we feared...

passages.title: The Next Level Has Arrived
passages.text:
The Empyrean Society is certainly much more dangerous than they appear. It's unimaginable that any mage would study fel magic -- that's for warlocks and the Legion!

Since our friend, Ravandwyr, appears to be delayed, it looks like we'll have to deal with this ourselves. We should remove this sect so they can't corrupt anyone else.

passages.title: The Next Level Has Arrived
passages.text: Do you think we've reduced their numbers enough?

passages.title: The Next Level Has Arrived
passages.text: I like you, <name>. You don't hesitate to take action when necessary!

passages.title: Return to the Firelands
passages.text:
The time has come to return to the Firelands. I need not tell you how dangerous this will be, Farseer.

Ragnaros may be defeated, but the elementals of the Firelands destroy with reckless abandon. Our presence there will surely be seen as an act of aggression.

I have prepared a scouting mission to the Firelands. We should send only our very best champions to make contact with the elements there.

If the mission is successful, we may find the information we need to bring the Firelands into our fold.

passages.title: Return to the Firelands
passages.text: It seems that our mission to the Firelands was a success, Farseer. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Scrolls of Knowledge
passages.text:
Our troops are ready! It's time to test them out in the field, and I have the perfect assignment.

Number Nine Jia is a well-respected scholar. She has knowledge that can help us improve the order, however, many of her important scrolls were left behind during the attack on the Peak of Serenity.

Send our champions to retrieve these documents at once!

passages.title: Scrolls of Knowledge
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Scrolls of Knowledge
passages.text: It was very lucky that we were able to retrieve those scrolls. Number Nine Jia's help will be invaluable to our order.

passages.title: Knocked for a Loop
passages.text:
While you're focused on murlocs...

Many murlocs are known to wear jewelry to attract a mate. I'm willing to bet that we can use some of the same jewels they use.

Collect some of their jewelry and bring it back to me. The wetter, the better!

passages.title: Knocked for a Loop
passages.text: I could see how jewelry on a murloc might make it seem more attractive...

passages.title: Knocked for a Loop
passages.text: Oh yes! There are some fine looking jewels here. Let's just scratch the goop off, and...

passages.title: Shipwrecked Sailors
passages.text:
<The gilblin and makrura of Mak'rana have captured the forsaken sailors from the nearby shipwreck.>

<It looks like the sailors are being poisoned and worse. Best to put them out of their misery.>

passages.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
passages.text:
If you are heading east, there is something I would ask of you.

While we struck camp some of our caravan left to scout around the city. Lilryia Dawnwind has been gone too long.

I would be most grateful if you would go check on her safety. She said she was going to scout out the ruins of Dawncleft.

passages.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
passages.text: You could not have arrived at a better time, <race>.

passages.title: Cloaked in Moonshade
passages.text:
I do not know what Theryn found, but I know where he found it. 

Moonshade Sanctum, to the west. Beyond the Temple of Fal'adora. 

Whatever power altered Theryn's arcane essence... Whatever power allowed Kel'danath to create a spell to soothe the withered... Its source rests there. 

I know this as surely as if I had been there myself.

passages.title: Cloaked in Moonshade
passages.text: <You recognize the relic from Thalyssra's vision.>

passages.title: Breaking the Seal
passages.text:
<As you behold the relic, Thalyssra's voice echoes in your mind.>

You found it! But it is sealed away tight.

Search the room for a way to break those seals.

passages.title: Breaking the Seal
passages.text: <As the magical barrier begins to fade, you hear the rustling of leaves and the clattering of mandibles just outside.>

passages.title: Into the Crevasse
passages.text:
I have protected that seed for ten thousand years. You let it fall into the hands of the fal'dorei.

I should have let you die.

Repay your debt. Help me get the seed back.

passages.title: Into the Crevasse
passages.text: We must move swiftly.

passages.title: The Hidden City
passages.text:
Orathiss has underestimated the seed. It is sapping her power - slowing her down.

We must catch her and get the seed to safety!

passages.title: The Hidden City
passages.text: <Energy pulses around the ancient seed.>

passages.title: Shal'Aran
passages.text:
The chamber beyond may be the perfect hiding place, now that its guardian has been dealt with.

Come with me.

passages.title: Shal'Aran
passages.text: Such a temporary home will serve us well.

passages.title: The Valewalker's Burden
passages.text:
The seed is awakening. Without power it will quickly wither and die.

We must carry the seed out of here and plant it somewhere safe.

I am not strong enough to bear this burden. But you... you are brimming with power. I can sense it. 

Please take the seed.

passages.title: The Valewalker's Burden
passages.text: <The seed sits perfectly atop the stand and sinks in with a satisfying click.>

passages.title: The Mysterious Paladin
passages.text:
It appears we have been afforded a unique opportunity.

A small order of paladins has come forward claiming to know the location of Tyr's tomb. They say they are the protectors of his warhammer, but that the ancient weapon is now imperiled.

I'd like you to speak with Travard, their leader, to find out more about this artifact.

passages.title: The Mysterious Paladin
passages.text:
My order guards a powerful secret. We are the keepers of the final resting place of the mighty Tyr!

Recent intrusions have proven his tomb's location to be a secret no longer. We must protect the sacred relic stored there... the Silver Hand!

passages.title: The Valarjar
passages.text: Assist the Vry'kul of Stormheim by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Valarjar
passages.text: The valarjar thank you.

passages.title: Missing Demon
passages.text:
I seem to have misplaced my imp, Daglop.

If you see him, tell him to check in.

Normally I would just resummon him but I'm worried blind Marius here will kill him first and ask questions later.

No vision, that one.

passages.title: Missing Demon
passages.text: Yeah yeah, the new master sent you. I get it. I have to deal with my former master first.

passages.title: Shipwrecked Sailors
passages.text:
<The gilblin and makrura of Mak'rana have captured the forsaken sailors from the nearby shipwreck.>

<The sailors are being treated very poorly. It looks like a rescue operation is in order.>

passages.title: Focusing the Energies
passages.text:
In addition to shards of nightmare, we need Blood of Sargeras to reactivate the portal to the Rift of Aln.

This rare reagent can be obtained from around the Broken Isles. Rumor has it that emissaries are in search of hardened adventurers, and may offer these in reward.

passages.title: Focusing the Energies
passages.text: Were you able to find the Blood of Sargeras?

passages.title: Focusing the Energies
passages.text: Excellent, Archdruid. These will do nicely.

passages.title: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fel
passages.text:
I have had it with these small fry, assistant. Time to go straight to the top.

The tome is the key! The key to unlocking the potential within our people.

Do not worry, young one. I have enough power to complete the task at hand. Let us harness fel magic and change the future.

Follow me and witness the redemption of the shal'dorei!

passages.title: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fel
passages.text: Kyrtos, you old fool! You should have known the risks...

passages.title: Quantity Over Quality
passages.text:
The demons of Felblaze Ingress are amassing at an exponential rate.

We must cull these invaders before they have enough demons to flank our forces at Illidari Stand.

Will you join us in battle?

passages.title: Quantity Over Quality
passages.text: That should stall these demons for a time. We may need to return in the future to ensure they have not regrouped.

passages.title: They're Doing it Wrong
passages.text:
These demon portals are terrible and sloppy. No skill or finesse in it.

This physically hurts me and I haven't felt real pain in decades.

I "fixed" some of the Legion's precious Portal Stabilizer crystals.

I want you to take them and "modify" their main portal in the Ingress and watch the "hilarity" ensue.

passages.title: They're Doing it Wrong
passages.text: Did you see the look on those demons' faces? Priceless!

passages.title: They're Doing it Wrong
passages.text: If you think the explosion was big on our side of the portal, you should see what the other side looks like. Ha!

passages.title: Wanding 101
passages.text:
We'll start with some wand work. You have your wand with you? Good.

I've set up a number of targets around the hall. Use your wand to hit as many as you can.

And no point-blank shots! That's cheating.

passages.title: Wanding 101
passages.text: You'll never learn if you never practice.

passages.title: Wanding 101
passages.text: And... it looks like we're out of time for today's wand practice. Go on, then. Off to your next class!

passages.title: Felblaze Ingress
passages.text:
It is my mission to cover the rear guard of Illidari Stand. I have employed this warlock... thing, to assist me.

However, the two of us are insufficient for a task that needs doing.

To the east is a mass of demons at Felblaze Ingress. These creatures have begun to open portals to summon in countless reinforcements.

Meet us at Felblaze Ingress and together we can crush this fel insurgency.

passages.title: Felblaze Ingress
passages.text: Keep your voice down unless you feel like being felbat food.

passages.title: Eye See You
passages.text:
There is being blind, and then there is being stupid.

This eyeless wonder next to me wants to barrel into Felblaze Ingress without preparation.

Bah! I say we scout it first.

Here, I will provide you with an extra eye I picked up from a place better left unmentioned.

Enter Felblaze Ingress, investigate the area, and try not to get poked in the eye.

passages.title: Eye See You
passages.text: Don't ask where I got the eye. Worst case is I tell you and then it gets all awkward between us.

passages.title: Eye See You
passages.text: Why? Why would demons, of all things, be this bad at summoning their own kind?

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
The Earthen Ring is built upon the strength and dedication of its members.

If we are to help defend this world against the Burning Legion, we will need to grow our order, and recruit skilled champions to our side.

Begin by speaking to Stormcaller Mylra and Duke Hydraxis. Perhaps they would be willing to fight for us.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: Excellent. Stormcaller Mylra and Duke Hydraxis are worthy champions. We can trust them to carry out any task we ask of them.

passages.title: Scouting Reports
passages.text:
In the recent past, our order has spent a lot of time watching and waiting. With you at the helm, we'll be able to focus on our original calling.

Take a look around us, <name>. Azeroth needs us now more than ever. The same enemy that led to our formation is threatening us once again.

You should send someone to gather reports from our scouts. From there, we'll be able to focus our efforts where they are needed most.

passages.title: Scouting Reports
passages.text: I've received word from our scouts, and just in time it seems. There are plenty of people out there who could use our help.

passages.title: Lending a Hand
passages.text:
Our scouts reported seeing a village in Val'sharah being attacked by undead hounds.

This is the perfect opportunity for the Unseen Path to make good on our promise to help those in need.

You should head out to Bradensbrook and see what you can do to help.

passages.title: Lending a Hand
passages.text: I don't know who sent you, but I sure hope you're here to help.

passages.title: Rising Troubles
passages.text:
Our village is swarming with beasts risen from the dead!

The abominations never rest! They attack night and day.

We're doing our best to keep them at bay, but it's getting to be more than the townsfolk can handle. They're tired and losing their will to fight.

Anything you can do to lessen the burden would be greatly appreciated.

passages.title: Rising Troubles
passages.text: We'll keep fighting as long as the hounds keep coming. Bradensbrook will not be lost to those beasts!

passages.title: Rising Troubles
passages.text:
Whatever you did out there, it worked. The hounds' attacks have slowed.

Let's hope that the villagers can get some rest, and live to fight another day.

passages.title: Assassin Entrapment
passages.text:
Black Rook invaders are still targeting our farms and homes, even though there's not much left to pillage.

We had hoped that once they cleared us out that the attacks would stop, but it seems those mindless ghouls will follow any orders given by their commander.

We'd take him out ourselves, but he's a sneaky fella. The only way we're going to catch him, is if someone lays a trap. I can provide the supplies if you're willing to help.

passages.title: Assassin Entrapment
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. I think the children will be able to sleep better tonight knowing that those assassins aren't lurking just outside their door.

passages.title: Urgent Summons
passages.text:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:

 To: <name>

Our scouts have returned with reports from all over Azeroth. It seems that things are much worse than they initially seemed.

Return to Trueshot Lodge as soon as you can.

 -Emmarel Shadewarden

passages.title: Urgent Summons
passages.text:
I'm so glad we're able to help people once again. Your work in Bradensbrook just proves how much the Unseen Path is needed.

Since you've been away, we've had reports pouring in from all over Azeroth. With our ranks a little low, I'm not sure we'll be able to keep up.

passages.title: Calling Hilaire Home
passages.text:
With so many in need of our help, it may be time to call in some of our scouts in the field.

One such scout is a huntress by the name of Hilaire. Although she abandoned her clan long ago to join our order, she still feels a need to watch over them.

Her dedication to protect those who would shun her is admirable, but we need her here.

Seek Hilaire out in Stormheim, and let her know it's time to come home.

passages.title: Calling Hilaire Home
passages.text: Have you found Hilaire yet? She's a dedicated huntress, one who's more than willing to protect those who cannot protect themselves.

passages.title: Calling Hilaire Home
passages.text:
It's been quite some time since I've come across another from our order.

If you've come to collect me, I'm afraid that's not going to happen.

passages.title: Recruiting Rexxar
passages.text:
To do the most good, we need the best hunters at our side.

Having you leading the order is a great start, but we'll need others who share your skill and expertise if we plan on making an impact.

Rexxar has a reputation of being one of the greatest hunters of his time, yet he's never been eager to aid the Unseen Path.

He has a camp just north of here, where he and Misha live off the land. Maybe you can convince him to join our ranks.

passages.title: Recruiting Rexxar
passages.text: You're from the lodge on the hill, am I right? I've heard of your order, a respectable group no doubt, but a bit dull for my tastes.

passages.title: Survive the Night
passages.text:
Now it's time to put your skills to the test.

Your order seems to be a lot of watching and waiting without a lot of action.

Prove me wrong. Show me that I might have something in common with the Unseen Path.

If you survive a night in the wild, then I will consider joining your order.

passages.title: Survive the Night
passages.text:
You need to eat to survive in the wild.

Boar meat makes an excellent meal when cooked over an open flame. It should not be eaten raw, however.

There are many berries that grow in this region. Some are edible, while others cause minor sickness when ingested. You can often determine which are safe to eat by their smell. A sweet aroma often indicates the berry is unsafe to eat.

The best firewood can be obtained from dying trees. They are easily identified by their fading, purple leaves.

passages.title: Survive the Night
passages.text: Well, you've got my attention, <name>. Not many hunters have what it takes to survive a night in these unforgiving mountains.

passages.title: Homecoming
passages.text:
Cora has calmed enough to make the journey back to Trueshot Lodge.

You can let Emmarel know that we are on our way home.

passages.title: Homecoming
passages.text: It is so good to have Hilaire back at the lodge. Her dedication and skill will be useful in the times to come.

passages.title: Do The Thing!
passages.text:
Mrglrg! Mrlglr mrgllrg.

<Phin gesticulates wildly>

Mrlgrlg glrglmglr mrlglrg. Rglrgmrg mrglr glr. Glr! Gmrlgrmlg mrglmrgm...

<Phin looks at you expectantly.>

passages.title: Do The Thing!
passages.text: Mrlgr?

passages.title: Do The Thing!
passages.text:
<Phin grabs your shoulders and hops happily.>

Mlrglr! Grlrlrglrmg.

passages.title: Baron and the Huntsman
passages.text:
We've received word from Khadgar that he's lost contact with the mages he sent to investigate the Legion's camps. He's requested our assistance in tracking them down.

If we have any hope of locating those mages, we'll need to find ourselves a reliable hound capable of following a scent.

There is only one such hound that I know of, and he's long since retired. It's worth it to check in with his master, Hunstman Blake, and see if old Baron still has it in him.

passages.title: Baron and the Huntsman
passages.text: You traveled all this way to see Baron? It's been a long time since we've had visitors.

passages.title: Awakening the Senses
passages.text:
I'm afraid old Baron here is past his prime. His nose can't catch a scent the way it used to. Others told me to put him down, but I can't bear the thought of losing my loyal friend.

Baron was always at his best when working, though. Maybe if you let him wander through these fields and dig up some old bones, it'll be enough to awaken his senses.

passages.title: Awakening the Senses
passages.text: How's old Baron holding up?

passages.title: Awakening the Senses
passages.text: I don't know what kind of bones you and Baron found in these fields, but he hasn't had this much energy since he was a pup!

passages.title: Ready to Work
passages.text:
If Baron's ready to work, I am too.

We'll make our way to the hunter's lodge as soon as I pack up camp and get this dog fed. I'm sure with all that digging, he'll have a hearty appetite.

passages.title: Ready to Work
passages.text: Good work recruiting Huntsman Blake. His hound could be the key to tracking down Khadgar's mages.

passages.title: Missing Mages
passages.text:
The Archmage has already made his way to Suramar, where the missing mages were last seen.

Baron ran off, too. It seems that hound is eager to work again.

Meet them both near the road that leads into the city. With any luck, Baron will be about to pick up on their magical scent and find the missing mages before it's too late.

passages.title: Missing Mages
passages.text: Thank you for meeting me, <name>.

passages.title: The Scent of Magic
passages.text:
This is the last known location of the missing Kirin Tor. There isn't much evidence, other than a torn piece of cloth, which looks to be from one of our tabards.

The scrap may be small, but it should be heavy with the essence of magic. We can only hope that Baron can catch the scent and track down the mages.

passages.title: The Scent of Magic
passages.text:
The Houndmaster is an ancient and powerful demon who has attacked our world once before.

His return could have dire consequences for mages throughout Azeroth.

passages.title: Highmountain Hunters
passages.text:
I've just received word from our scouts that they've identified some potential recruits.

It seems as though the famed Hemet Nesingwary has set up camp not too far from our lodge.

While he isn't traditionally the type of hunter we'd invite into our ranks, his experience hunting large game could come in handy.

Head on over to his retreat and see if he's willing to aid our cause.

passages.title: Highmountain Hunters
passages.text: You're from the lodge up on the hill, aren't ya?

passages.title: Assisting the Archmage
passages.text:
Hakkar maintains an army of felhounds that feed off of magic. As long as he remains within Azeroth, no mage will be safe.

He and his hounds are immune to most spells, so I must ask for assistance in killing them.

You have proven yourself more than capable, but are you willing to help take down this demon?

passages.title: Assisting the Archmage
passages.text: If we can help, we should help. Hakkar isn't welcome in our world, and he won't be allowed to stay.

passages.title: Required Reagents
passages.text:
The Sentinels know of a trusted and talented enchanter who specializes in enchantments that affect demons.

She provides her services for free to the Sentinels, but she does require specific reagents to perform her enchantments.

passages.title: Required Reagents
passages.text: The enchanting process cannot be completed without the proper reagents.

passages.title: Required Reagents
passages.text: This should do.

passages.title: The Council is in Session
passages.text:
Archmage Vargoth's involvement with the Empyrean Society is troubling. However, as he has proven his loyalty to the Kirin Tor many times, we must give him the benefit of the doubt for now. 

Still, I am obligated to share our concerns with the rest of the Council. You had best travel to Dalaran and meet with them in the Violet Citadel. I will remain here to care for our old friend.

passages.title: The Council is in Session
passages.text: If it is true that Archmage Vargoth is exploring fel magic, I will be shocked! Still, we owe you our thanks in bringing this matter to our attention.

passages.title: An Unexpected Visitor
passages.text:
Archmage Vargoth's long-time apprentice, Ravandwyr, has arrived here in the Hall of the Guardian with an urgent message from his mentor.

He will be waiting for you upstairs. You had best find him quickly, <name>!

passages.title: An Unexpected Visitor
passages.text: Have we met before? Your face seems a bit familiar.

passages.title: Court of Farondis
passages.text: Assist the Court of Farondis in Azsuna by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: Court of Farondis
passages.text: The Court of Farondis thanks you.

passages.title: The Nightfallen
passages.text: Assist the Nightfallen of Suramar by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Nightfallen
passages.text: Assist us, and we will reward you.

passages.title: The Nightfallen
passages.text: The nightfallen thank you.

passages.title: The Wardens
passages.text: Assist the Wardens by completing 4 world quests.

passages.title: The Wardens
passages.text: The wardens thank you.

passages.title: Archmage Vargoth's Retreat
passages.text:
Archmage Vargoth has been absent for a while. You may have a look around his living quarters here in the citadel tower, <name>. Kalec will escort you there.

I will hold out hope that our esteemed colleague is merely up to his usual eccentricities.

passages.title: Archmage Vargoth's Retreat
passages.text: What have you discovered, <name>?

passages.title: Archmage Vargoth's Retreat
passages.text: Hmm. This appears to be Archmage Vargoth's notes on the Nightborne Soulstone. Supposedly the energy of captured souls stored within it can be channeled directly from the stone! If that's true, it is very powerful, indeed!

passages.title: Following In His Footsteps
passages.text:
Archmage Vargoth seems to be mixed up in something dangerous, not that that's unusual for an archmage of his caliber and experience!

The Arcway Vaults may be where he's headed, but we should investigate all leads in order to get a better idea of what he's up to.

passages.title: Following In His Footsteps
passages.text: Have your champions discovered anything of note about Archmage Vargoth?

passages.title: Following In His Footsteps
passages.text: Good news! Your champion found Archmage Vargoth entering the Arcway Vaults in Suramar.

passages.title: The Fangs of Ashamane
passages.text:
I have to admit, Verstok was right. The shrine was too easy of a target for the Burning Legion to attack. Still, he's gone and the Fangs are with him.

We're going to have to track him down for you to recover the Fangs. I should come with you but I have to stay with my people should we be attacked again.

Here, my companion Ebonfang has a sense of smell like no other. He will be able to guide you to wherever Verstok is hiding. Also take this shell, through it we can communicate.

May Elune guide you.

passages.title: The Fangs of Ashamane
passages.text: How goes your search?

passages.title: The Fangs of Ashamane
passages.text:
I've heard from Delandros about how you rescued the Ashen and protected the shrine.

We all owe you a great deal for your heroism, <name>. And it seems that you were able to recover the Fangs as well!

I suspect this war is far from over.

passages.title: Ancient Magic
passages.text:
Since the Broken Isles is the epicenter of ancient night elven learning, there must be countless magical artifacts secreted away in forgotten vaults and reliquaries. We must secure them so they do not fall into the wrong hands!

Perhaps you should send a champion in search of them.

passages.title: Ancient Magic
passages.text: What have you discovered?

passages.title: Ancient Magic
passages.text: Your champion has discovered some very powerful artifacts, <name>!

passages.title: A Covert Operation
passages.text:
Your champion discovered some sort of powerful magic emanating from the secretive Empyrean Society enclave in Azsuna. 

Archmage Vargoth asked me to request Meryl's aid in investigating it, but as you can see, Meryl is clearly too ill to travel at the moment. Would you be willing to go in his place?

You will need to prove yourself in order to gain entrance. We should be able to find something sufficient in the Hatecoil Warcamp in Azsuna.

passages.title: A Covert Operation
passages.text: Good; you found me, <name>.

passages.title: Aiding Our Allies
passages.text:
Our Skyhorn allies could use some assistance. 

Their ongoing war with the invading harpies has left them low on supplies. 

Anything we can give them will surely help with their efforts to rid those witches from their village.

passages.title: Aiding Our Allies
passages.text: Our alliance with the Skyhorn is stronger than ever, thanks to your efforts.

passages.title: Aid for the Ashen
passages.text:
Turn your eyes above and you will see the cause of our misfortune. Ever since that ship appeared the attacks have been relentless. Many of the Ashen have been captured and even now I can hear their screams of torture.

Please, go out there and rescue as many of my followers as you can. They do not deserve the fate that awaits them if left in the Legion's grip.

passages.title: Aid for the Ashen
passages.text:
<Delandros nods.>

Thank you, hero. Now that my people are safe we might be able to turn the tide of this battle.

passages.title: The Shrine in Peril
passages.text:
You've helped us greatly, champion. Now, it is time that you tell me what brings you here.

<You mention to Delandros that Archdruid Greathoof sent you to seek the Fangs of Ashamane.>

Hrm... if you had told me this at the outset, I would have told you to take a walk. The Fangs are our greatest treasure, but you've done a great deed for the Ashen today and I am an elf of my word.

Very well, let's clear out the rest of these demons and you shall have your weapons.

passages.title: The Shrine in Peril
passages.text: Did you check on that disturbance?

passages.title: The Shrine in Peril
passages.text: What? Verstok fled with the Fangs? That fool, he's going to get himself killed!

passages.title: Plight of the Blackfeather
passages.text:
<The ravenbear frantically gestures and points down the path. 

It seems he wants you to follow him.>

passages.title: Plight of the Blackfeather
passages.text:
Caw?

<The ravenbear chieftain seems preoccupied with the gathering of reagents for some sort of ritual. Perhaps you could help him?>

passages.title: Singed Feathers
passages.text:
Ca-caw! Caw caw!

<The chieftain flaps his wings and points outside where the storm dragons attack the ravenbears of his tribe. 

It's plain to see that he's seeking your help to save his flock.>

passages.title: Singed Feathers
passages.text:
The Blackfeather chieftain bows respectfully to you. 

You have helped ensure the survival of his tribe.

passages.title: Dances With Ravenbears
passages.text:
<The chieftain beckons for the ravenbears to gather the tribute and gestures toward the ritual circle outside.>

Caw! Caw ca-caw!

<It looks like he wants you to follow.>

passages.title: Dances With Ravenbears
passages.text:
It seems that Nithogg wasn't interested in the ravenbears' tribute.

It's probably a good idea to get out of here before he comes back...

passages.title: Unholy Destiny
passages.text:
The greatest heroes on Azeroth have gathered together to face the Burning Legion. But heroes alone cannot save this world.

The salvation of Azeroth will come at a price the living cannot pay. Only upon the shoulders of the dead and damned, will the world of the living be spared.

You shall be their pariah, <name>. Find the Grimoire of Damnation and do what must be done.

passages.title: Return of the Four Horsemen
passages.text:
The voice of the Lich King has spoken, Deathlord, and the Knights of the Ebon Blade will obey your command.

The Four Horsemen were no ordinary death knights, they were born of pure, unholy power gifted from the Lich King to Kel'thuzad.

This unholy power to raise the dead has now been passed to you, Deathlord. I am sure you will wield it with great conviction.

The Four Horsemen will be powerful allies against the Burning Legion... and Nazgrim is a worthy choice as the firstborn.

passages.title: Return of the Four Horsemen
passages.text: The world of the living will forever revile us for the dark task that we begin this day...

passages.title: Kalec's Plan
passages.text:
Your champion was unable to penetrate very far inside the Arcway Vaults due to the heavy legion presence around it. Hopefully you will have better luck following Archmage Vargoth inside.

Kalecgos will be waiting for you on the ridge overlooking Felsoul Hold.

passages.title: Kalec's Plan
passages.text: Good to see you again, <name>.

passages.title: The Mage Hunter
passages.text:
And with that, we have what we need to recreate the ritual... however flawed it may be. It must be conducted somewhere highly visible so that word reaches our target swiftly.

I've heard reports that the Legion is heavily invested in the Faronaar region of Azsuna. An excellent place to begin a ritual they won't want us to complete.

The chances of us dying horribly are exceptionally high.

passages.title: The Mage Hunter
passages.text: Do you have it?

passages.title: The Mage Hunter
passages.text: Your ability continues to astound me! Balaadur lies dead in his own realm, and you now wield Ebonchill. I look forward to seeing what you will do next.

passages.title: The Firstborn Rises
passages.text:
General Nazgrim was one of the finest warriors our world has known, and his loyalty was unsurpassed... even for an orc.

He deserves the peace of death, but this world cries out to be saved. The time for rest is over...

Come, Deathlord... let us welcome Nazgrim into the arms of the damned.

passages.title: The Firstborn Rises
passages.text: General Nazgrim will make a fine <class>.

passages.title: The Firstborn Rises
passages.text: Well done, Deathlord. One of the Horde's greatest generals in life now serves you in undeath as your first horseman!

passages.title: Little One Lost
passages.text:
I'm ready to go home now, but there are still scary men outside...

Will you stay with me? Make sure they don't take me away?

I don't want to go back in the cage...

passages.title: Little One Lost
passages.text: Oh my sweet little Korine! Thank you, thank you!

passages.title: Friends On the Outside
passages.text:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

passages.title: Friends On the Outside
passages.text: A gift? For me?

passages.title: Friends On the Outside
passages.text: Vanthir is a very pleasant fellow.

passages.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
passages.text:
Deep beneath Suramar is a defunct set of tunnels known as the Arcway. They were abandoned when a disaster disrupted the mana collectors operating there. 

I know not what awaits you down there, but I do know one thing.

We are not the only ones interested in this place. Make enough noise and one of the advisors with whom I served under Elisande is sure to appear.

His name is Vandros. Slay him, if you can.

His death will be our victory, as we deprive Elisande of one more weapon in her arsenal.

passages.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
passages.text: Thank you. It is one thing I no longer need to think about.

passages.title: PH: Withered Scenario
Impending Dooooooom!
passages.text:
Millhouse attracts trouble, so he's sure to find Archmage Vargoth if he's still here. 

Oh and if you do find the Nightborne Soulstone, best get it first!

passages.title: Impending Dooooooom!
passages.text: What did you discover?

passages.title: Impending Dooooooom!
passages.text: It is true, then. Archmage Vargoth has been corrupted by the legion.

passages.title: More Than Just A Food Vendor
passages.text:
Your champions made a good dent in thinning out the enemy's numbers. They also discovered a number of starving prisoners who could use our help. Your Conjured Mana Pudding or Fritters will be useful in getting them up on their feet. 

You should also dispatch as many of the remaining legion invaders back to the twisting nether as you can!

passages.title: More Than Just A Food Vendor
passages.text: Have you been able to help the prisoners?

passages.title: More Than Just A Food Vendor
passages.text: Good job, <name>.

passages.title: The Unseen Blade
passages.text:
We can't let Stormwind fall to the Legion, and I don't trust Shaw or his SI:7 goons to take care of the Hand on their own.

The two of us need to handle this while there's still time.

The entire city is on edge from murmurs of the cult's activities. They're as likely to turn on you as they are the cultists if you aren't careful.

The other Shadows spoke highly of your skills. Are you in?

passages.title: The Unseen Blade
passages.text: Every second I held those blades was torture. They're all yours.

passages.title: Not A Toothless Dragon
passages.text:
The Arcway Vaults have been buried and untouched for thousands of years. We have the legion to thank for it being accessible once again, though I would give much for it to remain hidden.

I think we are not far behind Archmage Vargoth's heels and he may yet be inside the vaults. We should make haste if we hope to intercept him.

passages.title: Not A Toothless Dragon
passages.text: I'll keep them busy outside while you head in.

passages.title: Highmountain Stands
passages.text: That will have to do. Dargrul has come and we need every able body on the front line. Go, I will be right behind you.

passages.title: Highmountain Stands
passages.text: The village. It... it is just... gone. They told me what happened to Riverbend but I figured that was an exaggeration.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
Archdruid Rensar Greathoof has requested your presence.

Our campaign to defend the Broken Isles is getting under way, and we need you at the helm.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: Good. I see you have grown in power.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
As leader of our order, other hunters will look to you for guidance. Many will be willing to pledge themselves to you, doing whatever is necessary in the name of the Unseen Path.

I know of two within our ranks who are impressed with what they've seen from you so far, and want to help any way they can.

Seek them out, and let them ease the burden of leadership.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: Excellent. Emmarel Shadewarden and Loren Stormhoof are worthy champions. We can trust them to carry out any task we ask of them.

passages.title: The Enemy of My Enemy...
passages.text:
Millhouse Manastorm has been quite vociferous about his intention to acquire the Nightborne Soulstone. If you find him, you may as well make use of him. 

However, he is unpredictable at best and you should always watch your back around him, <name>. Use my crystal to contact me once you have located him.

passages.title: The Enemy of My Enemy...
passages.text: Were you able to locate Millhouse?

passages.title: The Enemy of My Enemy...
passages.text: I hope you are able to put Millhouse's determination to good use!

passages.title: Leader of the Illidari
passages.text:
Illidan has officially placed you in charge, <name>. The Illidari are now yours.

Meet me upstairs. We will let everyone know together.

passages.title: Leader of the Illidari
passages.text: Ready, <name>?

passages.title: The Ruined Kingdom
passages.text:
So the Lich King has revealed the second of the Four Horsemen... it appears that not even kings may rest as the world burns around them.

So be it, Deathlord.

I will send Nazgrim and Thassarian to meet you at the fallen kingdom of Stromgarde.

Prince Galen Trollbane holds the key to the tomb of his father, a famous sword known as Trol'kalar. In order to raise the king as the second of the Four Horsemen, we will need to gain entrance to the tomb.

Do what you must to persuade Galen assist us...

passages.title: The Ruined Kingdom
passages.text: For what purpose do you intrude upon my kingdom, <class>? Speak quickly, for I have little patience...

passages.title: Our Oldest Enemies
passages.text:
I will grant the Ebon Blade access to my father's tomb. First though, I must ask a favor.

I have taken up the sword and banner of my father. I have reclaimed Stromgarde with its former citizens as my guard. Yet, one task remains.

Witherbark invaders have blockaded themselves in the former mage district of the city. My men have suffered heavy losses at their vile hands.

Cut them down to the last! Bring me their heads and I shall give you what you seek.

You have my word as the King of Stromgarde.

passages.title: Our Oldest Enemies
passages.text: Do you have the heads of my enemies? I want to look upon each and every face...

passages.title: Our Oldest Enemies
passages.text:
Soon the heads of my enemies shall line the walls of my kingdom! These shall be the first of many.

Not even Sylvanas will dare to step foot upon the free kingdom of Stromgarde!

passages.title: Death... and Decay
passages.text:
My family has fought the Witherbark trolls for generations... their presence in Arathi has always been a curse upon the land. I want to drive them out of Stromgarde for good!

Destroy their supplies and we shall give them no incentive to return. Blight their supplies... or whatever it is you death knights do to defile things. I care not.

Just make sure that it is done!

passages.title: Death... and Decay
passages.text: You have done my kingdom a service, <class>. Stromgarde will not forget the service you have done us this day.

passages.title: Regicide
passages.text:
Galen Trollbane is a fool if he thinks that he can betray the Ebon Blade.

I have had enough of his games. The fallen prince wastes our time playing the king of a ruined throne, while heroes sacrifice their lives to save this world.

If Galen Trollbane will not open the tomb of his father, then we must take the sword and do it ourselves.

If he chooses to resist, so be it.

passages.title: Regicide
passages.text: We need the sword Trol'kalar to open this tomb. Have you found it?

passages.title: Regicide
passages.text: We have tarried here long enough, Deathlord. The time has come to open the tomb and raise our champion.

passages.title: The King Rises
passages.text:
King Thoras was one of the greatest warriors this world has known.

His people loved him and his enemies feared him. He only ever spoke truth, often saying the words others were afraid to speak.

King Thoras lived a life of war and he certainly deserves the peace of death. But this is not a man who would sleep peacefully while the world around him burns.

The time has come, Deathlord, to welcome the last true King of Stromgarde into the arms of the dead and damned.

passages.title: The King Rises
passages.text: King Trollbane was a great man. He will be a powerful ally against the threat of the Burning Legion.

passages.title: The King Rises
passages.text:
Today, a great king has risen from the dead to once more take up the sword in the name of liberty.

It will be an honor to fight at his side against the legions of terror.

passages.title: A Blaze of Starlight
passages.text: I will deliver the good news of my recently-rediscovered vitality to my brood. You, on the other hand, have a Tidestone to deliver.

passages.title: Cursed to Wither
passages.text:
So Cedonu said he saw nightfallen going into Leyhollow?

I don't like the sound of that.

Grandfather seems to be holding his own, but the archmage and I will keep an eye on him. You go investigate our caves.

passages.title: Cursed to Wither
passages.text: <name>? Is that you, my friend?

passages.title: Preparation
passages.text:
<With Althea's escape there is only one place to go: Stormwind.>

<If Garona is keeping a similar pace on the cult's trail, she's bound to be making preparations to enter the city herself.>

<Finding her is paramount before moving into the city.>

passages.title: Preparation
passages.text: If you're with me, drench your blades with poison now. This is going to get bloody.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
The Legion's defeat cannot be accomplished alone.

To win this war, we must work together, just as we did in ancient times.

To begin, we must recruit more druids to our aid. Speak to the troll Zen'tabra and the night elf Naralex.

Both of them are accomplished druids. They will gladly defend the Dreamgrove.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: Good. I know Zen'tabra and Naralex, and they will serve the Dreamgrove bravely.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text:
In our champions' travels, they made contact with Sister Lilith, a fearless leader among the Laughing Sisters.

She is revered among the dryads as a seasoned warrior and a demanding teacher. She will serve as an excellent recruiter.

Speak to her now, and recruit some Treants.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: Additional troops will be very useful for the missions ahead.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: Well done. I knew that Sister Lilith would come through for us.

passages.title: The Arcane Way
passages.text:
Getting into the Black Temple is going to be tricky. Following the break-in by the Council of the Black Harvest, Akama had his Sha'tari priests erect a holy barrier. It prevents my teleportation.

However, I might know a way to bypass those protections and take us directly to the Temple Summit.

Long ago, I had a... liaison with a certain high elf wizard named Lan'dalock. He later joined the Kirin Tor.

If you were to ask him very nicely, and drop my name, I am certain that he would help.

passages.title: The Arcane Way
passages.text:
The matron mother?

<The archmage's face goes red as he chokes out a cough and looks around surreptitiously.>

Yes, of course. Anything for Malevolence.

passages.title: Move Like No Other
passages.text:
Sorry about the holographic projection... I literally need to be in two places at once these days.

A holy barrier that protects against fel magic, you say? I have just the thing to bypass it and enable Malevolence's teleport.

<The high elf rummages around in his pack, a shocked look quickly coming over his face.>

Sneaky! Look there... that imp just made off with it!

passages.title: Move Like No Other
passages.text: Did Archmage Lan'dalock prove useful, <name>?

passages.title: Move Like No Other
passages.text:
I'll make sure to give the grimoire to Malevolence so that she can unravel its mysteries.

Meanwhile, we have some Black Temple scouting to conduct.

passages.title: Odyn's Summons
passages.text:
Odyn would like to speak to you at once, my liege.

He is convinced that as you have grown in power you are ready to take direct command of his armies and would like to begin preparations.

passages.title: Odyn's Summons
passages.text:
It is as I predicted. You continue to grow in power and prove your worth.

The time has come for you to take command of my armies, <name>.

passages.title: Champions of Skyhold
passages.text:
You will soon command one of the greatest armies in existence, but before my own Valarjar follow your every command you must prove your ability to lead.

Speak to the two vrykul champions who ascended into these halls with you and tell them it is time for you to assume your duties as Odyn's chosen.

passages.title: Champions of Skyhold
passages.text: You are ready to command your forces. Let us begin!

passages.title: Captain Stahlstrom
passages.text:
The souls that make it to these halls are brave, yes. That's why they're here after all.

Valor alone does not make for an effective army, however. You will need someone who can train those who would be valarjar to fight with discipline.

Have your champions send word to Captain Stahlstrom. Unruly vrykul berserkers may not fear death, but they might fear Hjalmar Stahlstrom enough to make them follow your orders.

passages.title: Captain Stahlstrom
passages.text: Is it done, <name>?

passages.title: Captain Stahlstrom
passages.text: Excellent. Hjalmar will have the valarjar whipped into shape in no time.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
Friend is in a powerful, but lonely position. First of a council whose members are missing.

Friend does not have to be alone though. Others will be drawn to friend's power, willing to follow if friend leads.

Find those who want to help, and accept their pledge of loyalty.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: It says a lot that Ritssyn would give up his position and look to you for leadership. He must believe that you are the key to rebuilding the council.

passages.title: Einar the Runecaster
passages.text:
Being a leader is not just about sending your troops to combat. You will also make decisions about how we train and improve our armies.

Speak to Einar the Runecaster and let him know how you would like development to progress.

passages.title: Einar the Runecaster
passages.text: Yes, <name>?

passages.title: Einar the Runecaster
passages.text: A wise choice, <name>.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: Friend is getting stronger, and so is friend's weapon! Come back to Dreadscar. I have more to show you.

passages.title: The Unseen Blade
passages.text:
Stormwind is too important to fall to the Legion, and I don't trust Shaw or his SI:7 goons to take care of the Hand on their own.

The two of us will have to handle this while there's still time.

Use extreme caution. The entire city is on edge from murmurs of the cult's activities, and we're already kill on sight.

The other Shadows spoke highly of your skills. Are you in?

passages.title: The Unseen Blade
passages.text: Every second I held those blades again was torture. They're all yours.

passages.title: Bolas Bastion
passages.text:
I received word that a coven of harpies and their rocs plan to attack in force.

They'll be coming from the mountains to the north.

Use one of the bolas launchers and I'll man the other.

Quick!

passages.title: Bolas Bastion
passages.text: Let's show those harpies why they shouldn't even think about attacking Thunder Totem!

passages.title: Bolas Bastion
passages.text: That was some nice work you did there, <name>. Thanks for the assist.

passages.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
passages.text:
The book from Lan'dalock is very enlightening. It describes a technique which will provide a simple and elegant bypass around the Black Temple's holy barriers.

I will need but a moment to summon a gateway. Stand back, please.

passages.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
passages.text:
Who would have thought he would be working with us?

We are now one step closer to taking the fight directly to the Burning Legion on their own worlds.

passages.title: The Value of Knowledge
passages.text:
This crate is filled with relics from the nearby ruins. The pirates have discarded them, likely thinking they're of little value.

The Explorers' League would probably appreciate if you retrieved these relics for them to study.

passages.title: The Value of Knowledge
passages.text: What's this?

passages.title: The Value of Knowledge
passages.text:
Well that was most noble of you to save these ancient relics from a water-logged fate.

I will be sure that the Explorer's League puts these to good use!

passages.title: What the Bonespeakers Buried
passages.text:
Most Fascinating! It would appear that we're dealing with our very own vrykul vampyr!

All we have encountered have been of blood elven descent, but it has long been theorized that the vrykul have suffered the curse as well. It's too bad he's awake - I would dearly like a subject to study.

Oh well, guess there's nothing for it. Take this stake and put it through the old chap's heart. I'm pretty sure that should do the trick.

passages.title: What the Bonespeakers Buried
passages.text:
Oh, the stake didn't work you say?  My apologies, I must've had my immortal evil undead mixed up.

You're all in one piece though, and the evil has seen its end. Hopefully, at least.

Vampyr can die, can't they?

passages.title: Spilling Bad Blood
passages.text:
Ending the evil of the Blood Prince will be a boon to this land, but we can't just allow these crazed corsairs to run amok. I'm afraid there is no choice but to put them to the sword.

Carry out this noble deed, my good fellow, and we will celebrate with a nice warm lager.

passages.title: Spilling Bad Blood
passages.text:
Good riddance to bad rubbish, I say. 

Those louts were ne'er-do-wells before they went crazy. Just imagine what they would do if we let them run rampant!

Cheers to your bravery, sir.

passages.title: Svergan's Promise
passages.text:
I thank you for doing this for me. I swore an oath to protect the Gjallarhorn with my life, and so I did.

You must tell Hymdall that his Gjallarhorn was devoured by the great worm, Jorhuttam!

It devoured an entire army of my men who were swallowed whole trying to fend off the beast. Find Jorhuttam and you will find the horn!

passages.title: Svergan's Promise
passages.text: Jorhuttam! We must track the great worm at once. It will surely be a great battle.

passages.title: Ore Under the Sea
passages.text:
If we want to bring the fight to Hakkar, my rangers are going to need arrows and ammo that are capable of piercing the thick, magic-resistant hides of his hounds.

There's a versatile smith in Dalaran who does incredible work with both bows and blades alike.

He uses azure ore in his creations, which can only be found below sea level.

Due to its proximity to leystone, the ore is often overlooked, but in an expert smith's hands, it can be smelted into something nearly indestructible.

passages.title: Ore Under the Sea
passages.text: Have you mined the ore yet?

passages.title: Ore Under the Sea
passages.text: This looks like more than enough ore to craft weapons and ammo for our allies.

passages.title: Azure Weaponry
passages.text:
Take the materials to Blacksmith Kyriel in Dalaran, and he'll use them to craft whatever weapons he can.

As I mentioned before, he's skilled and efficient, so you shouldn't have to wait long.

When his work is complete, speak to Shandris Feathermoon about getting the weapons enchanted.

passages.title: Azure Weaponry
passages.text: We will need special weapons if we wish to take down Hakkar and his hounds.

passages.title: Azure Weaponry
passages.text: Halduron's blacksmith does fine work, but these weapons still need to be enchanted before they will work against Hakkar's hounds.

passages.title: Meeting in Moonclaw Vale
passages.text:
Lyana Stardust still lingers in a vale that has been overrun by demons. Despite its current start of upheaval, she refuses to abandon her home.

The strength and stubbornness she exhibits in the face of an enemy are also traits that shine through in her enchantments.

We want our weapons to be as strong and stubborn as she is.

Meet her in Moonclaw Vale, and see if she can work her magic with the weapons that Kyriel has crafted for us.

passages.title: Meeting in Moonclaw Vale
passages.text:
The Sentinels told me you would be coming.

I apologize for the state of my home. I've been having some trouble with unwanted guests, recently.

passages.title: Delicate Enchantments
passages.text:
As I'm sure you've noticed, demons have taken over the vale. Their arrival has forced many of my fellow druids to flee their homes, but I refuse to go down without a fight.

Despite all this, I'm happy to provide enchantments for your weapons, but you should know that it is a delicate process that takes time and concentration, something I have little of lately.

If you're willing to shelter me from attackers, I will certainly do my best to enchant your weapons.

passages.title: Delicate Enchantments
passages.text: Enchanting your weapons will require a great deal of power and concentration.

passages.title: Delicate Enchantments
passages.text: I'd get a lot more work done if I could convince you to stay, but I know you have pressing matters elsewhere.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
The Tirisgarde has been defunct for ages. To defeat the Burning Legion, we must first recruit the greatest champions of our class to fight by our side. Two powerful archmages, Archmage Kalec and Archmage Modera, have come to help us succeed. 

Speak to them and enlist their aid.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: Archmage Kalec and Archmage Modera are two of the greatest mages in Azeroth's present and past. They will be exemplary representatives of our order.

passages.title: Into Our Ranks
passages.text:
We should make a show of welcoming this Shade of Akama into our ranks. It is important that the others see him treated as one of us, rather than as an outsider.

Kor'vas Bloodthorn has proven herself invaluable, time and time again. Her skills in combat are unquestioned and unparalleled. You will find no champion better suited to destroying our enemies.

It is time to officially raise them up as champions.

passages.title: Into Our Ranks
passages.text:
Up until now, the Illidari have been a fairly exclusive club. Demon hunters only. But, as you have so clearly demonstrated, my dear, if we are to move forward trusting one-another, then bringing Akama in is an important step.

It gives one hope.

And, of course, making Kor'vas one of your champions is the obvious choice. No one fights as well as she does.

What's that?

passages.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
passages.text:
<name>, Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.

He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.

passages.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
passages.text:
Commander. I am glad to see that Asha was able to find you so quickly.

There is something important that you must attend to as soon as possible.

passages.title: Preparations for Invasion
passages.text:
We have the Sargerite Keystone. We have most of the forces we will need. We even have a plan.

Now we need to locate the Felsouls and prepare for an invasion of whatever demon world they're hiding out on.

Please leave it to me. If you will grant me the use of your champions, I and the Scythe of Souls will extract the information by any means necessary from the demons that we question.

passages.title: Preparations for Invasion
passages.text:
And now we know that Caria and Varedis are hiding away on the demon world known as Niskara.

Time to finish this.

passages.title: Additional Accoutrements
passages.text:
I heard a rumor that you are going to attempt to make contact with Illidan's immortal demon soul in the Twisting Nether. You are going to need many magical things.

I have taken the luxury of putting together a potential list for you. I do so hope that it proves helpful, <handsome/gorgeous>.

passages.title: Additional Accoutrements
passages.text: Have they come back yet with everything we need for the ritual?

passages.title: Additional Accoutrements
passages.text: Do we really need all of these ingredients to contact the Master's soul?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
Our troops are ready! It's time to test them out in the field.

We've received word of survivors near the Broken Shore, but the area is still crawling with Legion.

Send our troops quickly to help with the rescue!

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
It was very lucky that we found Chronicler Elrianne among the survivors. A well-respected archivist from the Kirin Tor, she also spent several months studying with the pandaren in their library in Tian Monastery.

Her knowledge of ancient magic will be invaluable to our order.

passages.title: Mrgls of Endearment
passages.text:
Mrmlgr! Mrglr rlmgrg mlrgr! Mrlgmr...

<Phin shows you a flaw on the side of the pearl.>

Mmlrgmlr rlmgr grlmrmlg mglrmglr. Mlrgmrl rmglr? Mlgrmglr!

Gmmlrgmrl mlrgmlr lrglrmgrl lrlgllrlm mglrlr grlm-grlm.

<Phin makes a pinching motion with his hand.>

Mrlgmlgr mgrlmlgr? Mlrgmlr gmrlmglr Mrgrlilgrl.

passages.title: Mrgls of Endearment
passages.text: Mrglmrlg? Mrgmlr. Rmlgrmlrg!

passages.title: Mrgls of Endearment
passages.text: Mlrgmlr! Rgmrlmg, grmlmglr lmrglmrg mrlgmlglr! Mlrgmlrg grmlgrl.

passages.title: Knowing Our Enemy
passages.text:
If we hope to gain the upper hand against Hakkar, we need to find out more about these hounds that he's breeding and pinpoint their weaknesses.

I know of a warlock that studies demons extensively. Maybe she has seen some of these hounds, and knows how to defeat them.

passages.title: Knowing Our Enemy
passages.text: Faronaar is crawling with demons, some familiar, and some peculiar.

passages.title: Leyworm Lure
passages.text:
Felhounds are attracted to magic, young ones especially.

They get a whiff and go into a feeding frenzy! You're not quite as enticing as a mage, so you'll need to cover yourself in something that can fool a felhound into thinking you're its next magical meal.

Leyworm entrails should do the trick.

passages.title: Leyworm Lure
passages.text: Leyworm entrails are filled with flecks of magical material that will be irresistible to a fledgling felhound.

passages.title: Leyworm Lure
passages.text: These entrails are rich with magic. They'll make excellent bait.

passages.title: Children of Nar'thalas
passages.text:
Hi! <name>, right? The archmages in Dalaran said we might see you down here.

My brother and I are here on a reconnaissance mission. We're looking for our parents.

We've lived our entire lives thinking that our family was killed in Azsuna several thousand years ago, but look around! Most of the elves here are ghosts.

Olothil's been searching through books for clues as to why, but we could use some help.

passages.title: Children of Nar'thalas
passages.text: We've hit a dead end here. Any luck out there?

passages.title: Children of Nar'thalas
passages.text:
This Prince Farondis opposed Queen Azshara, so she got mad and blew everything up? That's awesome!

Hey Olothil, listen to this!

passages.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
passages.text:
In order to find the spirits of our family, I will need materials to scry their location.

The naga carry magical trinkets imbued with ley energy that is better-attuned to this land than anything we have in Dalaran. If I had a few of those, I could do some real scrying.

passages.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
passages.text: I would have brought my own spell foci if SOMEONE hadn't been rushing me...

passages.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
passages.text: Perfect. Let's get this ritual started, shall we?

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text:
Thanks to you, the Hall of the Guardian is gradually re-assembling.

However, there is much more work to do. As our leader, you can determine the trajectory of our order's future.

Speak to Chronicler Elrianne. She will show you the ropes.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Our future is in your hands.

passages.title: Tech It Up A Notch
passages.text: Excellent work, <name>! I can see that the Hall of the Guardian is in good hands.

passages.title: Technical Wizardry
passages.text:
Now that you have your first two champions, there is an abundance of work they can do to help us.

Archmage Melis has been hard at work getting our command room up and running. Head downstairs and ask her to show you what needs to be done.

passages.title: Technical Wizardry
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. The fires of Azeroth give us the power to see beyond ourselves.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: A Magical Affliction
passages.text:
Archmage Vargoth's betrayal is an unimaginable loss to our cause, <name>. We will have to deal with him, but first Meryl's condition has become dire. 

Unfortunately it is not an illness at all, but a magical attack of fel origin. It may be his old nemesis Kathra'natir is behind it. We need to buy him time.

The Eye of Azshara contains a vast store of arcane energy from Queen Azshara herself. If we could obtain a vial of water from the Wrath of Azshara's body, that will sustain him for a while.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: A Magical Affliction
passages.text: Have you obtained a vial of arcane water yet?

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: A Magical Affliction
passages.text: Good -- you're back just in time! This will sustain Meryl while we search for his attacker.

passages.title: Friends in Cages
passages.text:
<Korine stomps her foot and refuses to move.>

They put my friends in cages!

Make the bad men stop hurting them! They take them out the garden and they never come back!

<Korine gestures stubbornly toward the door.>

I am not going home until they do!

passages.title: Friends in Cages
passages.text: Did you let them out?

passages.title: Friends in Cages
passages.text: You let them go? I'm glad. I didn't like being in a cage either...

passages.title: A Mlrglrmg For Grlmrgl
passages.text:
Mrglm, rmgrlg mrlgmrl.

Grmrglmrl mlrmglrgr mlrmlgr! Rglrmgl rmglrgmlr mlmlglr mglgrgrlm - grlgmr, mlgr - lrgmlrgr rmgrmlg mlrg! Mlrgr?

Mrlgmrlgmrl rmglrmglr!

<Pearlhunter Phin makes a stabbing motion.>

passages.title: A Mlrglrmg For Grlmrgl
passages.text: Mrrgml... mlrgmlrg. Mlrmglrg gmrlr!

passages.title: Noggenfogger's Reasonable Request
passages.text:
Oh, the gall of that little green twerp! Marin Noggenfogger is blackmailing us. He says that if we do not meet his "very reasonable requisition request", he is going to close off access to the crucible.

Marin's asking for a hefty amount of Aethril. He said something about you recently holding a blade to his throat and that he's simply returning the favor.

Of course, if you would rather, I can eliminate him.

passages.title: Noggenfogger's Reasonable Request
passages.text: Heya, <name>, you have those reagents I requested? You scratch my back, and well... I'll pay someone to scratch yours.

passages.title: Noggenfogger's Reasonable Request
passages.text:
No hard feelings, right? Business is business, baby, and business is good. I saw an opportunity and I took it, just like you.

To show my continued allegiance with your little organization, and as a gesture of goodwill, here's a little sample of the product. It's magic. Bottoms up!

passages.title: Working With the Wardens
passages.text:
As much as we might not like it, we need the aid of the Wardens if we're to locate the Sargerite Keystone. They took it from you when we were all imprisoned in the vault.

With Maiev missing, their current leader is Sira Moonwarden. On your behalf, I have agreed that we will assist them in tracking down some of the more powerful creatures that escaped from the Vault of the Wardens. In return, she will direct us to where we need to go to get the Keystone.

passages.title: Working With the Wardens
passages.text: Is Sira happy with our progress? Not that I care, but we do need her help.

passages.title: Working With the Wardens
passages.text:
Well, we did everything that she asked, but that wasn't enough for Sira Moonwarden.

She's asking for one more thing and she wants you to deal with it personally.

passages.title: Malace in Vrykul Land
passages.text:
I did some recon in Stormheim. What I discovered is that the Tideskorn are a tribe of vrykul who have been cut-off from the sea by their kvaldir brethren. Many of the Tideskorn have pledged their services to the Legion and become Felskorn.

Malace Shade was last seen heading toward the Felskorn Warcamp. It is likely that she was captured.

I have arranged a flight to Stormheim for you. When you are ready, you can use the gateway to travel to Dalaran and speak with Aludane Whitecloud at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: Malace in Vrykul Land
passages.text:
<name>, is that you? This is a rather odd turn of events, don't you think?

You're free and now I am the prisoner.

passages.title: Rune Ruination
passages.text:
A cage wasn't enough to hold me, so the vrykul ensorcelled these runestones to trap me in here. Each is powered by a different Felskorn rune.

Unfortunately, they gave the runes to different guardians, who have all scattered to different places around Stormheim.

So, if Sira said that you could have your precious keystone back, you're first going to have to get me out of here.

Then, we'll see.

passages.title: Rune Ruination
passages.text:
I guess I underestimated you. Good. I like to learn and grow.

Up to helping me out with one more little thing?

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runeskeld Rollo
passages.text: <Collect the rune from Runeskeld Rollo to deactivate this runestone.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runeskeld Rollo
passages.text: <The runestone thrums with fel-corrupted power. Disable it with its corresponding rune.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runeskeld Rollo
passages.text: <The runestone begins to vibrate as you approach, rune in hand.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runelord Ragnar
passages.text: <Collect the rune from Runelord Ragnar to deactivate this runestone. If you do not already have one, obtain a grapple launcher in order to scale the walls of Hrydshal.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runelord Ragnar
passages.text: <The runestone is keeping Malace Shade imprisoned. Use Ragnar's rune to shut it down.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runelord Ragnar
passages.text: <Ragnar's rune grows warm as you approach the runestone.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runesage Floki
passages.text: <This runestone is entrapping Malace Shade. It can only be destroyed by using Runesage Floki's rune upon it.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runesage Floki
passages.text: <Who knows how long the Felskorn vrykul will leave Malace Shade alive? Best to deal with the runestone sooner rather than later.>

passages.title: Rune Ruination: Runesage Floki
passages.text: <The rune and the runestone begin to glow and thrum with increased power.>

passages.title: Emerald Sisters
passages.text:
The owlbeasts here are disconnected from Elune.

A contingent of dryads went into their territory to find out what went wrong, but none of them have returned.

I fear the worst, and I believe they are in need of rescue.

While I try to learn if the owlkin can be saved, I would appreciate your help in freeing any Sisters you find in the grotto.

passages.title: Emerald Sisters
passages.text: The owlbeasts are... melting the dryads down and using their bones to create minions?! How... how could this even be?

passages.title: Strange Bedfellows
passages.text:
The reason why I came out here was to capture or kill a fel lord named, Lochaber. I am no longer in a capturing mood.

I'll grab my weapon and then head up to the bridge in front of the Gates of Valor. That place is a scary mess full of Felskorn vrykul and demons.

How do you think I got caught?

So, I'd rather not go back in there. But, I think I know a way to get the demon to come out to us.

passages.title: Dreamcatcher
passages.text:
I cannot hold on for much longer...

I brought a dreamcatcher with me. I was to use it to steal the magic from owlbeast totems.

It is the only way to break the barrier where they hold Keeper Remulos.

Please help where I have failed.

passages.title: Dreamcatcher
passages.text: Leirana? Oh no...

passages.title: Dreamcatcher
passages.text: I knew Leirana... she was one of Remulos' favored, and kindhearted soul. If he has been captured as she believes, we have no time to mourn her passing.

passages.title: Moon Reaver
passages.text:
We must not delay! If Keeper Remulos is in danger, he must be protected.

With the dreamcatcher, we should be able to enter the lair of the owlbeast Boneflux.

It must be defeated so Keeper Remulos can break free!

passages.title: Moon Reaver
passages.text:
My wounds are great, and my magic has been severely drained. I must recover from this enervation and return to the Dreamgrove.

The owlkin here are beyond saving by mortal hands, but perhaps Elune will one day shine her light upon them again.

Thank you, <name>. May your path be blessed.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
passages.text:
<All that is left now is to travel to the Isle of the Watchers off of southwest Azsuna. There, you will need to break back in to the Vault of the Wardens and descend down into its lowest recesses where once you were imprisoned.>

<Within the so-called Vault of the Betrayer, where the Wardens once held Illidan's corpse, the Sargerite Keystone awaits.>

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
passages.text: Were you successful, <name>? Have you recovered the Sargerite Keystone?

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
passages.text:
Finally, revenge against Cordana Felsong for all of the demon hunters whom she tempted into becoming Felsworn. Cyana, Tirathon, Glayvianna, Cailyn, Illysanna, and more.

Her death has been a long time coming.

The Sargerite Keystone is once more in our possession. Now, to look to the future.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
passages.text:
The Wardens made good on the deal. All that's left is to travel to the Isle of the Watchers off of southwest Azsuna. There, you'll need to break back in to the Vault of the Wardens and descend down into its lowest recesses where we were once imprisoned.

Within the so-called Vault of the Betrayer, where the Wardens once held the Master's corpse, you'll find Sargerite Keystone.

Good luck, <name>.

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
passages.text: Were you successful, <name>? Have you recovered the Sargerite Keystone?

passages.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
passages.text:
Finally, revenge against Cordana Felsong for all of the demon hunters whom she tempted into becoming Felsworn. Cyana, Tirathon, Glayvianna, Cailyn, Illysanna, and more.

Her death has been a long time coming.

The Sargerite Keystone is once more in our possession. Now, to look to the future.

passages.title: Hunger's End
passages.text:
I am weak. The hunger is devastating, my friend. I understand now why your dragon rests in these pools.

<cough, cough>

I came to warn you but... it looks like I was too late.

I hear him outside now. Ael'Yith... is... here...

passages.title: Hunger's End
passages.text:
Hah! Ha ha ha haaaa!

I haven't felt this alive in YEARS!

What you've done, <name> - not only to replenish my mana pools, but also to save my brood - will not be forgotten. The blues of Azsuna are ever in your debt.

passages.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
passages.text:
Sharks. They be the biggest threat to us pirates. Well... after scurvy, ninjas, and the judicial system. Luckily, we only have to deal wit' sharks today.

Go pull some teeth out of their ugly faces 'n bring 'em back to me. I needs a new necklace!

passages.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
passages.text: I require thirty-three Razor-Sharp Shark Teeth. Do not try to short me, lad.

passages.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
passages.text: Blimey! This one still has blood on it! Looks like he got a good bite on ye good, lad!

passages.title: Keeping the Peace
passages.text:
The lost souls roaming the cemetery grounds have been drawn to the realm of the living in the wake of the Light's disturbance. In truth, they merely seek comfort... as we all do in these dark times since Highlord Tirion's passing.

However, their unrest threatens the very sanctity of the tomb we have sworn to protect. If we are to restore peace here, then they must be exorcised.

passages.title: Keeping the Peace
passages.text: Your aid is greatly appreciated.

passages.title: Keeping the Peace
passages.text: Those poor souls are finally at peace. Thank you.

passages.title: Sacred Ground
passages.text:
We must ensure that those buried here are never again disturbed. Their spirits' very presence only further perturbs the Light.

This cannot continue.

I must maintain this barrier to ensure none of the wayward souls enter the Lightbringer's resting place. If you can purify the graves themselves, this madness can finally cease.

passages.title: Sacred Ground
passages.text: Have the graveyards been purified?

passages.title: Sacred Ground
passages.text: Good. Given time, the last few lingering souls will make their way home.

passages.title: The Light Reveals
passages.text:
We seek aid not from a living friend, but one who passed long ago.
