Uther the Lightbringer was more attuned to the subtleties of the Light than any paladin I've ever known. If we reach out to him, he may be able to help us find the Ashbringer.

The ceremony has been prepared. Approach the tomb when you are ready.

passages.title: The Light Reveals
passages.text: We must do whatever it takes.

passages.title: The Light Reveals
passages.text: Tirion... could it be?

passages.title: Hope Prevails
passages.text:
Tirion... still alive! We have to save him.

Light's Hope Chapel is not far from here. We must rally our forces and leave at once for the Broken Shore.

passages.title: Hope Prevails
passages.text: We're ready to depart when you are.

passages.title: The Crux of the Plan
passages.text:
We have Akama. Cordana Felsong has been eliminated. And, we have the Sargerite Keystone.

Everything is falling into place.

The honor is all yours, <name>.

passages.title: The Crux of the Plan
passages.text: No demon world is beyond our reach now.

passages.title: The Crux of the Plan
passages.text: With the Sargerite Keystone in our hands, all that we have to do is prepare our forces and formulate an invasion plan.

passages.title: Grotesque Remains
passages.text:
These grotesque remains are an amalgamation of jelly-like ooze and what appear to be dryad bones.

Guviena Bladesong would be interested in seeing these.

passages.title: Grotesque Remains
passages.text: These remains... this is horrible! They are turning dryads into mindless piles of ooze!

passages.title: Make Your Mark
passages.text:
While you were out, I asked around.

You are looking for Overseer Durant. Turns out he lives near the Shimmershade Garden.

I can help you confront him, but you will need help. There are three individuals with the necessary skills, and they serve our cause.

Tell Cyrille that the owl hoots at dusk.

Inform Lorin that the saber prowls the plaza.

Mention to Sylessa that the cruel caskmaster has breathed his last.

They will know what to do. 

Speak to Vanthir when the deed is done.

passages.title: Make Your Mark
passages.text: They will not so easily dismiss the Dusk Lily now. Well done.

passages.title: Back in Black
passages.text:
Before you head into the Black Temple, we need more information. The last thing we want is for you to teleport into a trap.

We must discern their force structure, patrol schedule, new defenses, and what Akama eats for breakfast.

<Belath grins.>

I suggest you send our broken warriors to handle this. They can blend in with the rest of Akama's Ashtongue forces inside the temple. We'll get what we need to know from the ones that make it back.

A champion handler or two can scout outside the temple.

passages.title: Back in Black
passages.text: Any word from your troops that we sent to infiltrate the Black Temple?

passages.title: Back in Black
passages.text:
Belath is such a dear. Very thoughtful of him to arrange for some scouting.

I do hope that not too many of the broken died to get us this information.

In any case, I now have the means and the perfect location within the Black Temple to make our grand entrance.

passages.title: Securing Mardum
passages.text:
There has been increased demonic activity below on Mardum. There are still demons leftover down there from when we first invaded.

To eliminate any threat to the Fel Hammer, it's time that they were destroyed.

passages.title: Securing Mardum
passages.text:
Ariana Fireheart?! I thought she died the first time we were here. How horrible that she's been down there all this time. But, what an amazing survivor!

I remember her being an excellent trainer of demon hunters. We should put her talents to good use immediately.

passages.title: Green Adepts
passages.text:
As much as I would love us to finesse our way to victory, the cold, hard reality is that we need more powerful forces.

We are already straining Gaardoun's ability to recruit more broken.

But now that we have Ariana Fireheart, she can train new demon hunters for us.

passages.title: Green Adepts
passages.text:
Glad to hear that Ariana has recovered and is ready to train up our first new demon hunters.

It's been awhile since we had some fresh blood in our ranks.

passages.title: A Final Offer
passages.text:
What was that? Sounds like something's outside.

Something big...

You'd better get up there, <name>!

passages.title: A Final Offer
passages.text: What happened?

passages.title: A Final Offer
passages.text:
Kil'jaeden?! If that's not the gauntlet being thrown down, I don't know what is.

Can we survive this, <name>?

passages.title: An Important Mission
passages.text:
Champion! I bear an urgent message from Danath Trollbane.

He requests that you join him at Krasus' Landing. He has an urgent mission that requires your expertise!

passages.title: An Important Mission
passages.text:
I am relieved you survived the Broken Shore when so many brave heroes were lost.

<Danath hangs his head in a moment of silence.>

I have been recalled from Honor Hold to aid the Alliance in its darkest hour. It is crucial that we learn from our mistakes.

Do you have time to speak?

passages.title: The Scarlet Assault
passages.text:
The High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade?!

You will not find High Inquisitor Whitemane listed in the annals of history alongside the names of fallen heroes.

Still... despite her madness and zealotry she held a bond to the Light unmatched by even the greatest paladins.

There are few scarlet crusaders left on this world, but Scarlet Monastery is far from abandoned. The monastery now houses the most zealous and crazed crusaders the order has left.

Success will require a full blown assault.

passages.title: The Scarlet Assault
passages.text: It is good that you are here, Deathlord <name>. The battle has already begun.

passages.title: Raising an Army
passages.text:
We underestimated the number of scarlet crusaders still residing in the monastery. The battle for control of the cathedral is taking too long.

It's time to take a more resourceful approach to the battle...

Raise the fallen crusaders as ghouls and send them back into the battle against their brothers and sisters.

The Scarlet Crusade will not be able to hold back the tide of undeath for long.

passages.title: Raising an Army
passages.text: Have you completed your mission?

passages.title: Raising an Army
passages.text: Soon, the Scarlet Crusade shall be overrun, Deathlord <name>. This battle is nearly finished...

passages.title: The Banner of the Ebon Blade
passages.text:
Although the Scarlet Crusade are murderous zealots, the monastery is still blessed by the Light. This places us at a disadvantage.

The battle for the Scarlet Cathedral will be hard fought, Deathlord.

With you fighting alongside our brothers and sisters of the Ebon Blade, they will surely be inspired to victory.

Take up the banner of our order and place it near our troops to empower them.

Not even the Light will stop us from our goal!

passages.title: The Scarlet Commander
passages.text:
There is only one more obstacle standing between us and the tomb of Sally Whitemane.

High Commander Goodchilde guards the path to the tomb. Although he is a zealot and a murderer, he is still a hardened knight who has dedicated his life to the eradication of our kind.

He should not be underestimated...

Slay him and our work here will be nearly done.

passages.title: The Scarlet Commander
passages.text: Has High Commander Goodchilde been slain?

passages.title: The Scarlet Commander
passages.text: Our path is clear now, Deathlord. The time has come for us to offer Sally Whitemane the opportunity for redemption.

passages.title: Moths to a Flame
passages.text:
No doubt you have noticed our guests.

I have watched them for a time and seen how they are attracted to the tree. I do not know if they are harmful to our sapling, but we cannot take that chance.

Collect a handful of the insects and bring them to me. I will examine them and determine if they are to be left alone.

passages.title: Moths to a Flame
passages.text: Have you acquired a sufficient sampling?

passages.title: Moths to a Flame
passages.text: Hmm, yes. It is as I suspected.

passages.title: Make an Entrance
passages.text:
I need you to infiltrate the Twilight Vineyards and bring back something to deal with these insects.

To do that, you will need a way to bypass the guards that keep the orchards secure.

Ly'leth will be able to help us there. I will arrange to have her meet you near the entrance.

Go quickly!

passages.title: Make an Entrance
passages.text: Can I help you?

passages.title: Make an Entrance
passages.text: Let me show you around, then.

passages.title: The Fruit of Our Efforts
passages.text:
It is my job to maintain appearances here.

<Margaux smiles apologetically.>

You will have to endure a little showmanship while I walk with you through the vineyard. It is the only way to avoid suspicion.

I will try to help you as I can, but only when it is safe to do so.

Come with me- our first stop is the tasting pavilion. There you can sample some of our work.

passages.title: The Fruit of Our Efforts
passages.text: Enjoying yourself?

passages.title: The Fruit of Our Efforts
passages.text: You may want to cleanse your palate - we craft some strong flavors here!

passages.title: Intense Concentration
passages.text:
This is a rare treat, I hope you know. Not just anyone is allowed to stand on this hallowed ground.

<Sylverin adjusts his cuffs in a dignified fashion.>

To participate in the demonstration, simply take up an energy vessel and wade into the pool beside us. 

Catch the delicate dewdrops of Nightwell energy in the bowl as they fall- this is the only way one can safely manage its essence.

Once your vessel is full, proceed to our demonstration cask and gently pour the amalgamation into it.

Enjoy!

passages.title: Intense Concentration
passages.text: Having trouble?

passages.title: Intense Concentration
passages.text: Simple, no?

passages.title: The Old Fashioned Way
passages.text:
While you experienced the raw majesty that is Nightwell Infusion, Margaux was busy preparing another demonstration for you.

Head across the bridge and to the left, then again across a bridge and to your right. You will find her on the juicing veranda.

Enjoy the remainder of your tour!

<Sylverin offers an intensely fake smile.>

passages.title: The Old Fashioned Way
passages.text: Having fun?

passages.title: The Old Fashioned Way
passages.text: I will be certain to have a bottle of your arcwine prepared for you before you leave.

passages.title: Silkwing Sabotage
passages.text:
Moths. Who ever heard of something so... barbaric!

They are eating our crop and the mana wyrms do nothing to deter them.

You. You seem capable. Deter these creatures so we can complete our harvest on schedule.

Ahem. Please.

passages.title: Silkwing Sabotage
passages.text: Are you sure you took care of this situation?

passages.title: Silkwing Sabotage
passages.text: Much better. You have my thanks.

passages.title: Balance to Spare
passages.text:
Our tour is just about over. I will let you loose to 'walk the orchard', as is proper at this stage.

While you are there, you will notice a large number of mana wyrms floating about.

I am certain the vineyard would not miss a handful of them.

Good luck with your insect problem, friend.

<Margaux smiles warmly at you.>

passages.title: Balance to Spare
passages.text: I will have these... ah... souvenirs... boxed for you.

passages.title: Reversal
passages.text:
<Sylverin regards you uneasily.>

I was meant to meet you and Margaux here so I could escort you from the Vineyard. 

My mistress Margaux is never late. I fear that something terrible may have happened.

Please find her and make sure she is well.

passages.title: Reversal
passages.text: How did your trip to the Vineyard go?

passages.title: Reversal
passages.text: Margaux... no!

passages.title: Seek the Unsavory
passages.text:
This is just... unspeakable.

Margaux risked everything to get these mana wyrms to us. I cannot let it end this way.

I need you to find someone who can make this right. Someone who will do whatever it takes to see Overseer Durant slain.

Speak with Vanthir. I am certain he will know exactly who we need.

passages.title: Seek the Unsavory
passages.text:
Steel yourself, <name>.

Margaux's loss is regrettable, but not likely to be the last in this effort. Far from it, I fear.

passages.title: If Words Don't Work...
passages.text:
Unless you have something worth risking my life for, I will not budge.

Vanthir must have told you that my services do not come cheap.

Let's say... enough mana to sustain me for a month.

<Arluin looks smug, as if you could never agree to this request.>

passages.title: If Words Don't Work...
passages.text: My price will not change. Do we have a deal?

passages.title: If Words Don't Work...
passages.text: Glad to know you understand the value of my services, partner.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
Lord Maxwell Tyrosus has requested your presence back at the Sanctum of Light.

Our campaign to defend the Broken Isles is getting under way, and we need you at the helm.

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text: Thank you for coming so quickly, Highlord.

passages.title: Dark Storms
passages.text:
Greetings, Highlord.

Beside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

The first task is critical - the storms above the Tomb of Sargeras are intensifying. We should send our champions to keep an eye on that region, and scour the area for possible survivors.

passages.title: Dark Storms
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Dark Storms
passages.text:
Maxwell Tyrosus has returned with important news. First, he did recover some survivors. They are recovering in the chapel now. Among them was Commander Ansela, a veteran <class> and trainer.

As for the second, I will let Sir Tyrosus tell you himself.

passages.title: Moist Around the Hedges
passages.text:
These fruit appear to be food to grell.

Old Grizzleback might appreciate it if they were removed from the village.

passages.title: Moist Around the Hedges
passages.text: You have found a fruit that might be of interest to me?

passages.title: Moist Around the Hedges
passages.text: Ah yes, this is the grell food supply. Perhaps I can use this to lure them away. Thank you.

passages.title: Grell to Pay
passages.text:
The ringleader of the grell must be sent to his final rest.

You will know him by the white of his skin and the bite of his tongue.

passages.title: Grell to Pay
passages.text: I miss the days when grell kept to themselves and played tricks on the night elves.

passages.title: Grell to Pay
passages.text: I don't know if grell have mothers, but I hope that one never kissed his mother with his mouth.

passages.title: A Sign From The Sky
passages.text:
Greetings, Highlord. I have important news to share with you.

During my expedition to the Broken Shore, I saw with my own eyes an extraordinarily luminescent object emerge from the Felstorm. It fell down towards the coast of Suramar, cutting a swath through the tempest itself!

From it I felt an incredible surge of power, before it vanished beyond the horizon.

We need to bring news of this immediately to Archmage Khadgar.

passages.title: A Sign From The Sky
passages.text: I see that you have an urgent message for me. What is it?

passages.title: The Monkey King's Challenge
passages.text:
You can roll, you can hit, even shoot flaming spit...
But can your training you heed? Tasty brew's what I need!
The goodies you've gathered are what you must mix,
The instructions to follow will come from my lips.
Just pass this final brewing lesson,
And I will point you to my weapon.

passages.title: The Monkey King's Challenge
passages.text: Ah! This brew is grand! It's fit for a King!

passages.title: The Monkey King's Challenge
passages.text:
This brew be excellent! Its taste be the best!

You've proved yourself well, now I'll tell you where my staff rests.

passages.title: Eternal Vigil
passages.text:
<Kor'vas glances at your glaives, her eyes widening.>

I'm excited to see what those can do in person! Maybe we can spar a bit before heading out on the next hunt?

While you were gone we built a camp just off of this landing to help us watch over the Legion's movements. We should head there right away - Jace needed your help with something. It sounded big!

passages.title: Eternal Vigil
passages.text: I have exciting news to share with you, <name>.

passages.title: The Scarlet Massacre
passages.text:
We have a single purpose here, to raise Sally Whitemane as a Death Knight of the Ebon Blade. Such is our goal and we will see it through.

However, the Scarlet Crusade has terrorized the people of Azeroth long enough. Therefore, our work here this day will not be done until every crusader has fallen, every stone has crumbled, and every banner burned.

Come, Deathlord, let us bring ruin upon the Scarlet Crusade.

passages.title: The Scarlet Massacre
passages.text: The Scarlet Crusade shall burn.

passages.title: The Scarlet Massacre
passages.text: The Scarlet Crusade will pay for their crimes. Soon the monastery shall fall, and with it so too does the Scarlet Crusade's last hope for survival.

passages.title: All Grell Broke Loose
passages.text:
The grell are in a frenzy, attacking my brethren and destroying our village!

Please, stranger, help us send these wicked miscreants to the soil.

passages.title: All Grell Broke Loose
passages.text: The grell can sometimes be a terrible nuisance.

passages.title: All Grell Broke Loose
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. You are welcome in our village anytime.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Tracking down the dreadlord Balnazzar is our highest priority. Let us send defenders of our order to pinpoint his recent movements.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Were you able to find anything?

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Good. This intel will prove vital to our operations.

passages.title: To Faronaar
passages.text:
We are keeping a close eye on Legion movements at Faronaar in Azsuna.

Our intel suggests that a high-ranking lieutenant, possibly the dreadlord Balnazzar himself, masterminds the attacks in that region.

This may be our chance to strike a blow at the Legion's leadership.

Vindicator Boros commands our forces at the front. He would welcome your help, Highlord.

passages.title: To Faronaar
passages.text: Excellent, Highlord. You've arrived.

passages.title: This Is Retribution
passages.text:
Anger seethes within me like smoldering coals.

One stoke, and that anger will flare into a roaring flame.

The Legion's attack on Exodar was just the motivation I needed, Highlord. I've watched my brethren die for the last time.

Now, I will be the one who does the killing. I WILL have justice! Help me, Highlord, and slay any demons you encounter in lower Faronaar.

passages.title: This Is Retribution
passages.text: Glorious.

passages.title: The Way Back Home
passages.text:
Hello? This is Chief Telemancer Oculeth. I see you have emerged safely!

I am locking in your location as we speak. I will need you to activate the beacon on your end so we can establish a teleportation link.

Got it? Good.

passages.title: The Way Back Home
passages.text:
When you suddenly vanished from our awareness we thought the worst.

I do not know what to make of your adventures... I will need time to process this tragedy.

Regardless, I am glad you are back safe and sound.

passages.title: Drowned Mana
passages.text:
How did you end up out here? Ah well, that's neither here nor there at this point. What matters is that I need your help!

I see you have some experience fishing. Think you could put that skill to use for me?

passages.title: Drowned Mana
passages.text: Any bites out there?

passages.title: Drowned Mana
passages.text: That's it! This will do nicely. Please bring me as many of these as you can!

passages.title: Demonic Runes
passages.text:
Hodir valiantly went through that demonic portal. He should've earned an honorable death, but instead was taken prisoner by Legion scum.

We always imagined the battles of the end days to take place here in Azeroth, but we shall bring the fight to the enemy if it means sparing one of our own that terrible fate.

Hymdall thinks that with the right power source, he can reactivate and redirect the Legion's own gateways. Gather demonic runestones from the Legion and let the final conflict begin!

passages.title: Demonic Runes
passages.text: You bring the demonic runestones, <name>?

passages.title: Demonic Runes
passages.text: Excellent! The Legion will rue the day they set their sights on Azeroth!

passages.title: The Scion's Legacy
passages.text: The leaders of the Silver Hand have gathered. Listen to their counsel.

passages.title: The Scion's Legacy
passages.text: Our next steps will be very important.

passages.title: The Scion's Legacy
passages.text: Our mission is clear, but what are our next steps?

passages.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
passages.text:
The book from Lan'dalock is very enlightening. It describes a technique which will provide a simple and elegant bypass around the Black Temple's holy barriers.

I will need but a moment to summon a gateway. Stand back, please.

passages.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
passages.text:
Who would have thought he would be working with us?

We are now one step closer to taking the fight directly to the Burning Legion on their own worlds.

passages.title: Where the Hammer Falls
passages.text:
You saved us all, shaman! Thank you!

Thrall wants to dive right into the Maelstrom and retrieve the Doomhammer, but I worry - he was badly wounded in that last fight, and that demon Geth'xun may still be alive down there. We should go with him.

Hop on Stormbeak when you're ready and we'll track down that artifact!

passages.title: Where the Hammer Falls
passages.text: The Doomhammer could be anywhere here. And that demon is still alive.

passages.title: The Troggs that Fel to Earth
passages.text:
"Demons" you say? A "Burning Legion?" Hrmph! Nothing burns here but for my ire, shaman, and if these monsters think to corrupt my domain, they will be crushed beneath my dainty beautiful feet!

I have not seen this hammer of yours, but the stone troggs witnessed everything that fell from the sky. Moreover, they've been running amok in the Pale Roost ever since the green fire landed near their home.

Be a dear and lay waste to the Felrock Troggs west of here. Perhaps you can get one of them to talk.

passages.title: The Troggs that Fel to Earth
passages.text: Well? Have you given them a solid thrashing?

passages.title: The Troggs that Fel to Earth
passages.text: Troggs. So tiresome. Pebbles for brains. Easily swayed by any cult, demon, or dragon that tries to interfere with my rule. Thank you for giving them a solid whomping.

passages.title: Clutch Play
passages.text:
I confess the stone drake broodmother and I have had a rocky relationship in the past. She supported Deathwing during the Cataclysm, you know. But Aeosera has been put back in her place and it is my responsibility to protect her.

The problem is that she refuses to abandon her eggs, even in the midst of a trogg attack.

You're a shaman! Use your natural magnetism to reassemble fallen Opalescent Guardians in the Pale Roost. Escort them to Aeosera so they can carry her eggs to safety of my bosom.

passages.title: Clutch Play
passages.text: Step to it, <class>! Reassemble those guardians and take them to Aeosera!

passages.title: Clutch Play
passages.text:
How delightful! Aeosera is very pleased with you, <class>. As am I.

Now then, it's time to find that artifact of yours. Thanks to your efforts, the stone drakes will help us.

passages.title: Tracking Down Uthalesh
passages.text: The logbook contains the latest information on Uthalesh. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

passages.title: When There's a Will, There's a Way
passages.text:
The Oculus appears to have fallen to the Burning Legion and is heavily shielded. We will need to figure out a way to get you inside. 

I suspect your champions can help us out quite a bit.

passages.title: When There's a Will, There's a Way
passages.text: Your champions have done well. I think I should be able to get you into the Oculus now.

passages.title: Tracking Down the Skull
passages.text: The logbook contains the latest information on the Skull of the Man'ari. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

passages.title: A Small Favor
passages.text:
Meryl's illness is troubling. I have seen something similar before, but I cannot think of its name...

Talk to my friend. I call her Ari. She has lived here in the Hall of the Guardian since it was last in use. If a tome on magical afflictions is to be found here, she would know where to look.

passages.title: A Small Favor
passages.text: Books on magical illnesses? I might know where such a thing exists...

passages.title: The Proper Way of Things
passages.text:
Archmage Khadgar is my friend. That he trusts you means much. 

I know of the book in which you seek, but it does not want to be found. It is old and angry and thirsts for power. We will have to convince it to emerge from hiding in the proper way. Perhaps if you bring it a gift of nightwell energy from the nightborne elves in Suramar City it will be mollified.

passages.title: The Proper Way of Things
passages.text: Have you found enough nightwell energy yet?

passages.title: The Proper Way of Things
passages.text: Power in its purest form. It is a lovely color, is it not? A fitting gift for a book of healing. Will you come out old one, now that you are no longer lost and forgotten?

passages.title: Ari's Package
passages.text:
Look! It was right here under our noses. "Arcanists Guide to Rare Diseases." Sheepish thing. Most books just want to be dusted off and read from time to time. We will leave the phials of nightwell energy and it will go with you meekly enough.

Here. I have packaged the book up for you to bring to Khadgar. I wrapped it in moth's wings to keep it soothed and light-hearted. And there is a gift for you. Just a small thing, really.

passages.title: Ari's Package
passages.text: Ari found just the book I needed! And she included a ring for you as well.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Good decision, Highlord. We should be bolstering our forces by increasing recruitment efforts. Let us send our champions to carry out these orders.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Excellent work.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text:
You are right, Highlord. Our military efforts cannot succeed without solid logistics.

That means we need a steady supply of weapons, food, medicine, and other provisions.

Let us send our champions to establish a supply line.

passages.title: The Highlord's Command
passages.text: Excellent. Our paladins will be well equipped for battle.

passages.title: Servant of the Windseeker
passages.text:
The elemental lords must be united, but there has been no Windlord to lead the air elementals since the death of Al'Akir.

Once, there was an heir to the Throne of Four winds named Prince Thunderaan, but the prince was defeated in the mortal realm and still awaits rebirth. Only one man holds the knowledge necessary to complete the prince's rebirth.

There is a servant of Thunderaan who wanders the sands of Silithus. Find him, and he will show you the way.

passages.title: Servant of the Windseeker
passages.text: What does the Earthen Ring want with an old servant of the Windseeker?

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text:
<name>,

My father lived by the sword, as you do. He taught me that if we truly want peace for our kingdom then we must be willing to fight to preserve it, as you have fought.

You have demonstrated valor of the highest order - bravery unsurpassed in the ranks of the Alliance. Valor that must be recognized.

Please join me in Stormwind Keep at once so that you can be properly rewarded for your service.

- King Anduin Wrynn

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text: It's an honor, <name>.

passages.title: Pure Water
passages.text:
I may have discovered the key to restoring the pillar's magical energy.

First, we will require a great deal of Pure Water. It is not easy to find, however I have heard that the naga in the Eye of Azshara are known to carry large quantities of this concentrated essence.

It will be not be easy, but if you can collect enough of the essence, we may be able to restore the pillar.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text:
It takes a true hero to put their life on the line day after day in defense of their home so that others do not have to.

You have dutifully safeguarded the people and interests of the Alliance, never faltering in your courage or devotion.

As a small token of our appreciation for your valiance, please turn to the gathered heroes before you, raise your weapon high, and be recognized.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Thank you for everything.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text: Well-earned, <name>.

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text:
<name>,

Those who do not stand with the Horde stand against it. You, champion, have cut down such enemies in droves.

I admire your dedication. It is through you that we will rise up, more powerful than ever, and put the Alliance in their place once and for all.

Join me in the Undercity at once. Your victories must be met with due reward.

- Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner

passages.title: A Royal Audience
passages.text: The pleasure is mine, <name>.

passages.title: Enemies of Air
passages.text:
Windlord Thunderaan has retaken the Vortex Pinnacle, but not all of his subjects have taken to his leadership kindly.

In his kingdom there is still unrest, and it appears there are four viziers who have risen up against him: Mistius, Zeph, Alacris, and Tulmos.

We will let Thunderaan focus on the war against the Burning Legion while we send our champions to aid Skywall against its enemies.

passages.title: Enemies of Air
passages.text: How are the missions going?

passages.title: Enemies of Air
passages.text: Excellent work, Farseer. With events in his realm calmed, Windlord Thunderaan can focus his efforts on the war effort.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text:
We will never be dominated so long as you stand at the front of our lines. Together we will slaughter anyone who stands in our way.

You have sacrificed as much as any in the name of the Horde. I will not let your dedication go unnoticed.

Face your fellow champions, <name>. Face them, and be recognized.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text: You have pleased me this day.

passages.title: The Victor's Spoils
passages.text:
You have impressed me, <name>. No simple feat.

Be sure you continue to do so.

passages.title: Worldmender
passages.text:
The elements have gathered, and though the Firelands have yet to unite with us, we have more strength on our side than ever before.

However, the war with the Burning Legion still rages, and for now we must turn our gaze to the Broken Isles.

When we have dealt sufficiently with the immediate threats of the war, we will turn our attention to uniting the Firelands to our cause.

passages.title: Worldmender
passages.text: How does the situation look?

passages.title: Worldmender
passages.text:
Impressive, truly impressive, Farseer! Everything I believed about your prowess has been proven true.

You have helped mend the rift caused by our enemies on the Broken Isles. We can rest easier, knowing what we have accomplished.

passages.title: The Maelstrom Pillar: Air
passages.text:
Elementalist Janai was looking for you earlier, Farseer. It appears that her study of the Maelstrom Pillar has been most enlightening.

If you have a moment, you should go and meet with her to discuss her progress.

passages.title: The Maelstrom Pillar: Air
passages.text: It is good to see you, Farseer. We have much to discuss!

passages.title: The Maelstrom Pillar: Earth
passages.text:
Elementalist Janai has been hard at work restoring the Maelstrom Pillar. As of late, she has been focusing her research on the element of earth.

You should speak with her when you have a chance. I have heard that she is close to a breakthrough.

passages.title: The Maelstrom Pillar: Earth
passages.text: Ah, good timing Farseer! I was hoping you would come by.

passages.title: Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
passages.text:
So the Earthen Ring wishes to resurrect my master?

<Highlord Demitrian laughs maniacally.>

I knew this day would come! At last, humanity understands the power of the Windseeker!

When Prince Thunderaan was slain at the hands of treacherous mortals, his soul was trapped within the sacred blade Thunderfury.

To resurrect my master you will need to find his sword and return it to Skywall. Last I heard, the betrayer who stole my master's sword traveled to the Broken Isles to fight demons.

passages.title: Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
passages.text: Have you found the key to resurrecting Thunderaan?

passages.title: Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
passages.text:
This blade could indeed be the key to resurrecting the Windseeker. However, it has been damaged and the elemental soul within has diminished in power.

Time may very well be running out...

passages.title: Return to Janai
passages.text:
<Ma'haat the Indomitable speaks to you with a low, rumbling voice.>

Here... is the Egg of Gaiath. It is yours now.

Go... in peace.

passages.title: Return to Janai
passages.text: It's true! The Egg of Gaiath does exist... right before my very eyes!

passages.title: Return to the Chamber of Shadows
passages.text:
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt sent me out to find you, <name>. He wants your counsel on some matter of importance.

He requests your presence back at the Chamber of Shadows.

passages.title: Return to the Chamber of Shadows
passages.text:
It is good that Valeera was able to find you so quickly.

There is something important that you must immediately attend to.

passages.title: The Big Bad Wolfe
passages.text:
You've heard of Winstone Wolfe, right? Of course you have. Who hasn't?

So, while you were off gabbin' with the headmistress, Lord Ravenholdt graced me with his presence. In the flesh. I didn't think he ever came out of that chamber.

Anywhoodles, he more than suggested, in that way of his, that we send Garona, Vanessa, and our new merry gang of bandits off to have a little chat with The Wolf at Ravenholdt Manor.

Just make sure they're nice and civil, or that's the last we'll see of them.

passages.title: The Big Bad Wolfe
passages.text: How'd the trip out to Ravenholdt Manor go?

passages.title: The Big Bad Wolfe
passages.text:
Phew!

<Nikki wipes her brow with a sense of relief.>

Whatever we offered him, I'm glad he was agreeable. I can tell you if he wasn't happy, I'd be on the first flight off this rock for sure.

passages.title: What Winstone Suggests
passages.text:
If anyone can improve the way things run around here, it's Winstone Wolfe. I tell ya, the man is a miracle-worker!

Now that he's workin' for us, shall we pick his brain an' see what he suggests?

passages.title: What Winstone Suggests
passages.text: I see that you were able to convince Mr. Wolfe to join us. Of course, that rather sizeable sum of gold we deposited into his bank account didn't hurt either.

passages.title: What Winstone Suggests
passages.text: Things are already looking up. But, of course, in my experience, there is always some amount of bad to temper the good.

passages.title: Making A Trade
passages.text:
Yes I do have Amaranthine Hops, but they took me quite some time to gather. I cannot part with them easily.

However, I'd be willing to trade them for Stonehide Leather.

If you come upon any, bring it to me and we can make a trade.

passages.title: Making A Trade
passages.text: Do you have leather to trade?

passages.title: Making A Trade
passages.text: Thank you, <class>. I'll make good use of this.

passages.title: An Eye for a Scepter
passages.text:
Sounds simple? Make nice with Shadow Council friend must... for now. Help with ritual enough to gain trust, then turn tables!

Council made portal device to Tol Barad here. Go, help Shadow Council find Eye of Dalaran, earn spot in big ritual! Then steal Scepter!

Calydus will try to keep eye on friend when possible.

passages.title: An Eye for a Scepter
passages.text:
Yes, yes! Found the Eye! Helped Shadow Council! Now you go to ritual. Scepter will be there.

Tricky it will be friend, but Calydus have great faith in you!

passages.title: The Raven's Eye
passages.text:
It is imperative that we decipher the SI:7 letter. We must uncover the secrets that it holds before it is too late. But, our best code breakers have yet to make a dent in the cypher.

However, we now know that the myth is in fact reality. The Raven's Eye truly exists.

Shall we tell the others?

passages.title: The Raven's Eye
passages.text: Are you interested, or not?

passages.title: The Raven's Eye
passages.text: Now, what do you say you and I go to Val'sharah and recover the most powerful jewel in existence?

passages.title: Off to Court
passages.text:
The Ravencourt of Black Rook Hold is where we begin our search. It is the ancestral home of Lord Kur'talos Ravencrest, night elven hero of the War of the Ancients. Some of my own ancient ancestors are interred in its cemetery.

Meet me there and make sure that you are not followed. SI:7 is very good at what they do. We have to be better.

passages.title: Off to Court
passages.text:
Now that you are finally here, we can begin.

The elves here have somehow risen from the dead. They are deluded. They think that we are the Burning Legion and have come here to destroy Black Rook Hold.

passages.title: In Search of the Eye
passages.text:
The Raven's Eye should be somewhere within the courtyard. This is where Ravencrest's lieutenants used to plan their strategies in life. Hell, it looks like they still might be doing so in death.

It has to be around here somewhere. Your skill at lock picking should prove invaluable.

passages.title: In Search of the Eye
passages.text: Have you found the Raven's Eye yet?

passages.title: In Search of the Eye
passages.text:
A ledger? Wait, let me look.

<Valeera reaches out and begins thumbing through the tome's pages.>

This is the key!

passages.title: Eternal Unrest
passages.text:
My ancient ancestors are buried here in the cemetery to the west. Because of whatever is causing the dead to rise, their souls are now at unrest.

All blood elves are descended from high elves, who in turn came from these lands before they were sundered.

I cannot bring myself to do it. Will you put my ancestors to rest?

passages.title: Eternal Unrest
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. It means a great deal to me that you have given my ancient ancestors the peace they deserve.

passages.title: Beware of the Crooked Tree
passages.text: <race>, you must be warned. There is great evil in Val'sharah. I've seen it, and I wish I hadn't. If you take my advice, you will stay far away from the crooked tree in Bradensbrook.

passages.title: Beware of the Crooked Tree
passages.text:
So you've come to the crooked tree,

To name a foe you ask of me,

But listen first to my tragic tale,

Then you will hear my sister's wail...

passages.title: Growing Power
passages.text:
The bond between you and your weapon has grown stronger, Deathlord. The time has come for you to direct the flow of power within your artifact.

Return to Acherus and speak with me when you have made your choice.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
Your power is great, Deathlord, but power alone will not be sufficient.

If we are to save this world from the onslaught of the Burning Legion, then you will need powerful allies. The Knights of the Ebon Blade are yours to command, it will be wise to make use of them effectively.

Go and speak with Nazgrim and Thassarian. They will be of great use to you in the fight against the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: Well done, Deathlord. Nazgrim and Thassarian are powerful champions. I am sure they will carry out their orders with deadly precision.

passages.title: Spread the Word
passages.text:
Now that you have recruited your champions, you can use the Scouting Map to complete vital missions across the Broken Isles.

The first mission is critical to the growth and power of our order. Send Nazgrim and Thassarian to seek out new candidates for the Ebon Blade.

Our order must grow in strength if we are to defeat the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Spread the Word
passages.text: What is the status of the mission?

passages.title: Spread the Word
passages.text: It appears that Nazgrim and Thassarian were successful in their mission. We have identified several promising candidates to aid us in the war against the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text:
A powerful necromancer has joined the cause of the Ebon Blade.

Dark Summoner Marogh has come a long way to us from deep within the realm of the Shadowlands. He will be a powerful ally of the Ebon Blade.

Speak with Dark Summoner Marogh to begin raising an army of ghouls for the Ebon Blade.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: Has Dark Summoner Marogh begun his work?

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text:
Good work, Deathlord.

These ghouls will be invaluable in the war effort on the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions just as you would your other champions.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: It's time to send our newly summoned ghouls out into the field. Look at the Command Table and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Troops in the Field
passages.text:
Excellent work, Deathlord. The mission was a complete success.

With continued success in the field, the Burning Legion will surely be beaten back.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text:
As leader of our order, other priests will look to you for guidance. Many will be willing to pledge themselves to you, doing whatever is necessary to bring down the Burning Legion.

After your display of power during the cleansing ritual, there will be many who are eager to serve at your side. Seek out those priests, and let them ease the burden of leadership.

passages.title: Rise, Champions
passages.text: Excellent. Calia Menethil and High Priestess Ishanah are worthy champions. We can trust them to carry out any task we ask of them.

passages.title: Champion: High Priestess Ishanah
passages.text: [PH]

passages.title: Champion: High Priestess Ishanah
passages.text:
Your efforts to restore Saa'ra have not gone unnoticed. As a humble servant of the Sha'tar, I thank you.

As leader of the Aldor, it is my duty to safeguard all that is holy. This temple is a beacon of light that must be protected.

You can count me among your allies, willing to do whatever is necessary to destroy the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Spread the Word
passages.text:
In the center of the dais is a map of the Broken Isles. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the world.

The first task is critical to the growth of our order - identifying skilled priests whom we can trust to train our order's troops.

This is a task we can easily entrust to one of our new champions.

passages.title: Spread the Word
passages.text: How is the mission proceeding?

passages.title: Spread the Word
passages.text: Calia's mission was a success! We may be seeing some new faces around here soon.

passages.title: reuse me
passages.text: [PH]

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text:
Our recruiting efforts have paid off. Grand Anchorite Gesslar has pledged his service to our order.

He has an eye for greatness, and can easily spot a recruit with potential. He takes those selected under his wing, and shapes them into worthy allies.

Speak to him now and train a troop of acolytes.

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: How did the training go?

passages.title: Recruiting the Troops
passages.text: Excellent. These troops will be invaluable in our defense of the Broken Isles. Deploy them on missions, just as you would with our champions.

passages.title: The Perfect Opportunity
passages.text:
I have heard whispers from Suramar City.

Recent unrest in the city has prompted the nobles to seek another advisor to fill Elisande's council. Such positions are rarely offered and hotly contested.

This is the perfect opportunity and Ly'leth is the perfect candidate. Fate smiles upon our cause!

I know she has historically chosen to avoid such politics and maneuvering, but we must now ask her to join the fray.

Seek her out at the Waning Crescent and ensure her victory.

passages.title: The Perfect Opportunity
passages.text: Thalyssra asks much of me.

passages.title: The Perfect Opportunity
passages.text:
Ahh, <name>.

So good to see you once again. I trust you are ready to assist me with my campaign.

passages.title: Either With Us
passages.text:
Thalyssra asks much of me, but our cause is worth the risks.

The title of advisor would grant us enormous influence. Information. Access.

I could change this rebellion. I could save so many lives.

I will need strong endorsement to ascend, though. There are many houses who stand with me by virtue of my family's name. Some are more hesitant.

Lady Aurore of House Astravar is the most prominent of these. Seek her out. Offer your aid in my stead. 

Earn her trust and the rest will follow.

passages.title: Either With Us
passages.text: I love Lady Lunastre like a sister, but I am afraid my hands are tied.

passages.title: Or Against Us
passages.text:
If Ly'leth is to achieve the role of advisor to the Grand Magistrix we will need to open a path for her.

It is true she will have some supporters but they alone cannot grant her the title.

There are other houses that Ly'leth must contend with. Fear and coercion are their tools. None dare stand against them openly, and we cannot win them over with favors and oaths. 

Seek out Arluin. I trust he will have some ideas of how to proceed.

passages.title: Or Against Us
passages.text: Yes, I know why you are here. Yes, I can get the jobe done. No, it will not be free.

passages.title: Or Against Us
passages.text: Very well. Let us talk strategy.

passages.title: Thinly Veiled Threats
passages.text:
How could I let this happen?

<Aurore wrings her hands.>

Yesterday Coryn Stelleris approached me about the appointment. He sought my support, but I did not offer it. 

He said my son's life would continue as normal... if I gave him my vote.

This morning my son was gone.

I can only think of the terrible things he may be suffering. You know what this family is capable of!

You want my support, but I can do nothing while my son is in danger. Nothing.

Please... save him!

passages.title: Thinly Veiled Threats
passages.text: Did you find my son?

passages.title: Thinly Veiled Threats
passages.text: He is unharmed! I owe you- and Ly'leth- a great debt.

passages.title: Rumor Has It
passages.text:
Coryn Stelleris and Ruven Duskmere were close friends, but one always overshadowed the other. Now the Stelleris family stands to gain from lord Ruven's death. Handsomely.

House Duskmere will soon learn of their loss. I want you to be the one to redirect their anger and grief.

A handful of well placed rumors should do the trick.

I won't be lingering in this part of the city for long, and Ly'leth will want to know of your efforts.

Return to her when you are finished.

passages.title: Rumor Has It
passages.text: The city is buzzing with very interesting gossip, <name>. Victory is that much closer.

passages.title: Death Becomes Him
passages.text:
There are two houses that pose a threat to Ly'leth's rise, but we concern ourselves with only one of them now.

House Duskmere commands respect through fear and that fear is not unfounded. Few can boast of magical talent equal to that of Ruven Duskmere. 

Without this charming specimen, however, their house is nothing.

I know you may find my methods distasteful. Know that there were demons in Suramar long before the Legion.

This one has lived long enough.

passages.title: Death Becomes Him
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Death Becomes Him
passages.text:
It seemed as though you had that well in hand. I did not want to... interrupt.

That is one less power hoarding noble to worry about. Well done, <name>.

passages.title: By Invitation Only
In the Bag
passages.text:
Already the city is abuzz with outrage.

I will not lie to you- it pleases me greatly that one such as Coryn is made a fool.

The other houses have sent their endorsements. It is done, and nothing remains but a formal ceremony to grant me the title of advisor.

Meet me there. You deserve to share in this success.

passages.title: In the Bag
passages.text: I am prepared. It is nearly time.

passages.title: In the Bag
passages.text: This may not end as cleanly as I would have preferred.

passages.title: Ly'leth's Champion
passages.text:
Tal'ashar is an honor duel.

If I lose, then I must forfeit my title to Coryn Stelleris.

<Ly'leth smiles gently.>

That is why you are going to fight for me. 

I will grant you a more powerful disguise for this task, and together we will put Coryn in his place.

Speak to me when you are ready to battle on my behalf.

passages.title: Ly'leth's Champion
passages.text: I know you will defend my honor, <name>.

passages.title: Ly'leth's Champion
passages.text: We made great strides today. I will not forget this.

passages.title: The Way of the Tiger
passages.text:
Among the allies who joined us from Tian Monastery is Gin Lai, a monk famed for his experience in the ways of the tiger.

With his help, we will be able to train Tiger Initiates, who strike swiftly and precisely on the field of battle.

Go speak with him now and request his services.

passages.title: The Way of the Tiger
passages.text: I will do my best to teach the way of the tiger, Grandmaster: to observe the enemy, and strike without hesitation. Soon, our initiates will be ready for battle.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: Let us speak, then, of events that have already come to pass.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: A moment to reminisce on how far we have come. A day to look to the future and where we might go. A year of reflection on what it means to grow and a lifetime of memories made by those brave enough to seize it.

passages.title: The Coming Storm
passages.text:
You saved us all, my friend! Truly you embody all the elements stand for.

If the Earthen Ring is to prevail, we will need weapons of great power. I know where to find some. After the Pandaren Campaign, the weapons of the storm god Ra-den were discovered beneath the Throne of Thunder. None have been able to wield them, so great is their power.

They were placed in the care of the White Tiger, who will give them only to one who is worthy. Come <name>! Travel with me to Pandaria and we will prove your worth!

passages.title: The Coming Storm
passages.text:
Welcome <class>! You seek the weapons of the storm god Ra-den?

Many have traveled here to Pandaria, but none have proven themselves worthy.

passages.title: The Aegis of Aggramar
passages.text:
Now that it's out of the hands of the Legion, the Aegis should be brought back to Dalaran for safekeeping while the hunt continues for the rest of the Pillars of Creation.

It should be safe in the central portal chamber until the time comes when it is needed.

passages.title: The Aegis of Aggramar
passages.text:
The Aegis of Aggramar is secure within the well-defended city of Dalaran.

Your quest to drive back the Legion is one step closer to fruition.

passages.title: Asset Security
passages.text:
With the demons and guards so agitated, I'm running out of safe places to store contraband. The guards have caught on to one of my favorite havens and will be making off with my goods any minute now.

Head to my stash and discourage their curiosity. You will need to use a grappling hook to access it- just look for something to latch onto along the ledge.

I will make sure there is something in it for you when you are done.

passages.title: Asset Security
passages.text: Did you deter them yet?

passages.title: Asset Security
passages.text: You're becoming quite the dependable associate.

passages.title: The Shardmaidens
passages.text:
Long have I walked this land and I have seen many forms of corruption.

The creatures that wander this hall are twisted by the magics unleashed by the failed arcan'dor. These dryads have lost their way, and cannot be saved.

You must destroy them. End their suffering.

passages.title: The Shardmaidens
passages.text: Thank you. This place will never recover, but their madness need not harm others.

passages.title: The Cycle Continues
passages.text:
Yay! The grove is regenerating nicely. Our flower friends thank you for helping them.

We were able to save most of the grove, but sadly, many living souls were lost as well.

Brightwing is so sad!

But you can help! Take this bag of Dream Seeds. Plant them onto fresh corpses, and in time, new flowers will grow!

Death is beautiful, and from death comes rebirth. This is the cycle that must continue!

passages.title: The Cycle Continues
passages.text: Thank you... it gives Brightwing much peace to know that life continues.

passages.title: Pixie Dust
passages.text:
Friend, you have done so much for Brightwing, but there is still so much more to do.

I've been working so hard to restore the grove, but my magic is drained.

<Brightwing's stomach grumbles loudly.>

Without magic, my work cannot continue. The enchanters of your people use a magical dust that can revitalize me quickly.

If you bring me some, I can work much faster!

passages.title: Whispers in the Void
passages.text:
Our priests are resting and recuperating, but one not as well as the others. Gilner Greymoss lingers within the Sanctuary of the Void, laughing to himself.

He refuses to leave, but his presence is making the other priests uneasy.

Perhaps you should speak to him and see what is wrong?

passages.title: Whispers in the Void
passages.text: Some wounds are too deep to heal.

passages.title: Whispers in the Void
passages.text: Gilner's hearing voices, is he? All that dabbling in the shadows has finally caught up to him.

passages.title: The Best and Brightest
passages.text:
If we wish to see the truth in Gilner's ramblings, I will need to induce a vision.

It is not the sort of thing that is typically forced, but we have within our ranks the best and brightest alchemists who can craft an extract that will grant me the sight I need.

Seek them out in Azsuna where they are currently aiding those on the front lines.

passages.title: The Best and Brightest
passages.text:
It's a good thing ya showed up when you did.

So Velen wants to induce a vision? That's no easy task, but it's nothing Yalia and I can't handle.

passages.title: Murloc Mind Control
passages.text:
Yalia and I were deliverin' antidotes to da front lines a Faronaar when we were attacked by a herd a murlocs. We dropped our supplies and made a run for it, but Yalia never made it out a da camp. Obviously I didn't fair much better, ma bones still ache from bein' turned to stone.

It's possible Yalia's still alive and bein' held captive. Please, ya have to find her!

passages.title: Murloc Mind Control
passages.text: Your quick thinking got me out of a terrible situation. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Problem Salver
passages.text:
Forcing a vision isn't easy by any means. Finding the ingredients for the elixir alone will take a considerable amount of time, time we don't have. Too many are suffering on the front lines as we speak, in need of the salve we were meant to deliver.

I suppose if we all work together, we can make this work.

Zabra and I will find the items needed for Velen's elixir, if you take the salve to Faronaar and cure the demon hunters. Does that sound fair?

passages.title: Problem Salver
passages.text: We've found the ingredients we'll need for Velen's elixir.

passages.title: Awakening the Light
passages.text:
This spark will only know its full potential once it's been filled with pure Light, gleaned from the holiest places in our world.

Nurture this spark, and it may grow to walk among you.

passages.title: Awakening the Light
passages.text:
<Saa'ra's soothing voice fills your mind.>

Nurture the spark with holy Light if you wish it to awaken and walk among you.

passages.title: Awakening the Light
passages.text: <The room begins to warm as the Light expands.>

passages.title: Demonic Runes
passages.text:
I cannot stand by idly and allow the Legion to destroy our home. 

I've been studying their language for some time, deciphering any runes I can get my hands on, but my supply is severely limited. 

If I had more runes to study, it's possible that I may discover something that will help us in locating Balnazzar.

passages.title: Demonic Runes
passages.text: Were you able to recover the runestones?

passages.title: Demonic Runes
passages.text: These are in excellent condition! Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Apostate Liberation
passages.text:
There are others like me, you know. Others that have removed the veil that the Scarlet Crusade has kept over our eyes for so long. 

They've been placed in cages, treated like animals, simply because their beliefs no longer line up with what the Onslaught deems is right and holy. 

They wish to redeem themselves. We should try to free them, if you think their lives are worth saving.

passages.title: Apostate Liberation
passages.text: All we want is a chance to redeem ourselves.

passages.title: Apostate Liberation
passages.text: The mercy you have shown brings tears to my eyes.

passages.title: Unexpected Guests
passages.text:
You helped me escape my fate by freeing me from the gallows, but allowing me to fight the Scarlet Onslaught by your side has truly freed my heart and mind from the guilt I have felt for so long.

I want to be a part of something greater than myself, a noble cause that won't distort the meaning of the Light. 

Let me travel to your temple and beg forgiveness of the Prophet. I may not be a welcome guest, but it's a journey I must make to complete my redemption.

passages.title: Unexpected Guests
passages.text: Is this the enemy we should welcome as an ally?

passages.title: Forgotten Shadows
passages.text:
The Light walks among us, as does one of our enemies. You have done well to bring the prophecy to life, but it is not yet complete.

The shadows must rise, and to do so, the Cult of Forgotten Shadows must be restored. 

You will find the few remaining followers at the cemetery in Duskwood. They linger there near the grave of their fallen leader.

passages.title: Forgotten Shadows
passages.text:
Alonsus sent you, did he? He's never shown much interest in us before.

Of course, we've never been ones to follow the Light, at least not in the way that most would want us to.

We embrace the Shadows as well, finding our faith in the balance between both extremes.

passages.title: Secrets of the Void
passages.text:
Our leader was murdered for her beliefs, or so most would believe.

Natalie Seline knew her fate, and took steps to protect herself from an inevitable death. 

The night her attackers came, Natalie sent her spirit to the Void, its location known only to Natalie herself.

She penned a spell to retrieve it in one of her many journals, but the tome has since fallen into the hands of those who wished her dead in the first place.

Without her journal, we will never be able to recover her spirit.

passages.title: Secrets of the Void
passages.text: We watch over Natalie's body, forever hopeful that her spirit will return.

passages.title: Secrets of the Void
passages.text: This is it! This is the journal that contains the spell to locate Natalie's spirit!

passages.title: Rising Shadows
passages.text:
News of my return will spread fast among those who share my beliefs. Soon Azeroth will see the rise of Shadows, but I imagine this is not news to you.

Whatever your plan may be, I hope it continues to see the Cult of Forgotten Shadows as allies.

passages.title: Rising Shadows
passages.text: The Forsaken will rejoice at Natalie Seline's return, and we will as well, knowing that the prophecy is being fulfilled.

passages.title: Fortifying the Temple
passages.text:
We've all worked so hard turning this temple into something all priests can be proud of, it would be a shame to see it fall to the Burning Legion.

We must strengthen our defenses in preparation for the attack. With the right resources, we can make the temple a nearly impenetrable fortress.

passages.title: Fortifying the Temple
passages.text: We will need to gather many resources in order to properly fortify the temple.

passages.title: Fortifying the Temple
passages.text: This should be enough to make the necessary improvements to our defenses.

passages.title: Lumenstone
passages.text:
To prepare for the battle, we will need the best armor and weapons we can get.

Lumenstone is an enchanted material that can withstand great amounts of fel magic.

It is found in rare quantities all over the Broken Isles, and many of the native races use it in their own metalcrafting.

We should send our champions to target enemies around the Broken Isles - there should be plenty of Lumenstone to be found in their stockpiles.

passages.title: Lumenstone
passages.text: Have you acquired any lumenstone?

passages.title: Lumenstone
passages.text: There's enough lumenstone here to craft armor and weapons for an army. Nice work, <name>.

passages.title: Defending the Isles
passages.text:
As druids, our charge is to defend nature... and in turn, our home, Azeroth.

Conflict breaks out all across the Broken Isles. The Burning Legion pushes forward, and numerous allies call out for our aid.

We must focus our efforts on defense, before we can mount an offense against the Nightmare.

Help our allies across the Broken Isles, then return to me when the situation is under control.

passages.title: Defending the Isles
passages.text: Conflict rages across the Broken Isles.

passages.title: Defending the Isles
passages.text: You have represented the Dreamgrove honorably, Archdruid. Your aid has helped many, and your victories will be spoken of for years to come.

passages.title: A Gathering for the Grand Master
passages.text:
<name>, err... <class>t,

Your presence is requested for a matter of the greatest importance at the Temple of Five Dawns.

Master Ponshu and the rest of the Broken Temple are waiting for you!

passages.title: A Second Weapon
passages.text:
We have strong leads on other ancient weapons that you might choose to pursue, if having one renowned, powerful piece of history in your hands is somehow insufficient.

I'll lay out the options for you. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

passages.title: A Second Weapon
passages.text: It is decided then.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: It is time to reflect on the events that have brought us to this moment. A celebration of our great history and the events that shape it.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: Let us speak, then, of events that have already come to pass.

passages.title: A Time to Reflect
passages.text: A moment to reminisce on how far we have come. A day to look to the future and where we might go. A year of reflection on what it means to grow and a lifetime of memories made by those brave enough to seize it.

passages.title: Mother Ozram
passages.text:
The fiendish imps in this region are an incessant pain on our allies defending the camps below.

They are the spawn of a wicked imp-mother named Mother Ozram, who has been seen on a hill to the south.

Destroy her, and we will end her brood as well.

passages.title: Mother Ozram
passages.text: Do not be deceived by the imp-mothers. They are devious and strong.

passages.title: Mother Ozram
passages.text: Good riddance.

passages.title: Hidden History
passages.text:
Filmaff believes with a little assistance we can give you more.

There are a few tomes I could point out - not easy to get, mind you - that would... <Cough>... that would push forward our research a bit.

Here, I'll give you a list.

passages.title: Blood for the Wolfe
passages.text:
We have a request in from Winstone Wolfe. He says that he needs a rather large amount of demon blood. He was not specific what for, and I did not ask.

I am inclined to do this for him with all expediency. The Wolf rarely asks for anything, so when he does, we jump. He gets results, one-hundred percent of the time and then some.

We should show him the same professional courtesy.

passages.title: Blood for the Wolfe
passages.text: The clock is ticking, <name>. Do you have the blood?

passages.title: Blood for the Wolfe
passages.text:
That ought to do it. I will make sure that The Wolf gets every drop.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Pruning the Garden
passages.text:
In a very real sense, the Uncrowned are gardeners. We snip and trim here and there. One clipping of a single branch may seem nonsensical until you step back and look at the garden as a whole.

On the greater theater of the Broken Isles, we must act decisively. The forces that arrayed against Azeroth are moving quickly. We need to prune some very ugly flowers to make our garden beautiful again, wouldn't you agree, <name>?

passages.title: Pruning the Garden
passages.text: There, now that is much better. I would say that our garden is much more beautiful.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, each year I visit Stormwind to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Stormwind Royal Library and we can speak more.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, you're here. You must have received my letter.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, each year I visit Orgrimmar to help adventurers like you reflect on our shared history. While our eyes must always be trained on the future, we must be mindful of our past. Come visit me in the Valley of Spirits and we can speak more.

passages.title: The Historians
passages.text: <name>, you're here. You must have received my letter.

passages.title: Cracking the Codex
passages.text:
I have been studying the Codex of Command that you recovered from Faronaar.

It is important to Balnazzar, but WHY? What does it say? I'm sure we could gain valuable knowledge if we could just crack this code.

I have a friend who might be able to help us: a priestess named Delas Moonfang. She has been studying Eredun, the language of the demons.

Take the sigil to her in Dalaran. Tell her I sent you.

passages.title: Cracking the Codex
passages.text: Aponi sent you? How is she? It is hard to keep in touch with friends in these times.

passages.title: Aponi's Trail
passages.text:
<The book is missing several pages. Nearby, you can see signs of a struggle.>

<If you can seek the missing pages on the nearby demons, perhaps you could learn what fate befell your allies.>

passages.title: Aponi's Trail
passages.text: I've never been so happy to see you, Highlord.

passages.title: Aponi's Trail
passages.text: Thank the Light, Highlord. I didn't want to give up hope.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Lord Ravencrest
passages.text:
Highlord, news has reached us of a Legion presence at Black Rook Hold.

It is rumored that the night elf commander, Kur'talos Ravencrest, amasses an enormous army behind the fortress walls.

Take a group of your most powerful allies, Highlord, and investigate these stories. Lord Ravencrest was a formidable general during Azshara's reign, and if the reports are true, then we must know more.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Lord Ravencrest
passages.text: It is vital that we stay on top of the Legion's movements. At any moment, they could attack.

passages.title: Black Rook Hold: Lord Ravencrest
passages.text: Incredible, Highlord. With the threat at Black Rook Hold contained, we can focus efforts on other areas.

passages.title: Silver Hand Knights
passages.text:
Good news, Highlord! We have recruited a paladin trainer named Commander Born.

He is a hard teacher, but has trained some of the greatest paladin knights in recent times. We are lucky to have his services.

Go speak to him, and train a squad of Silver Hand Knights.

passages.title: Silver Hand Knights
passages.text: Wonderful! These knights will serve the order well.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
My apologies for the unannounced intrusion, <name>. Do you have a moment?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

You are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: A Change of Seasons
passages.text:
It is time.

The arcan'dor is preparing to mature. With a final burst of growth, this gift will be fully realized.

We must make ready the leyline feed.

passages.title: A Change of Seasons
passages.text: It would seem our tree is quite thirsty.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Do you have a moment, Conjurer?

The power within your weapon has grown exponentially as you have fought the Legion, but I cannot help but wonder if there is something... more... hidden away deep within. Perhaps even a new form entirely!

The very thought demands we find out for sure.

You are familiar with the ancient blue dragon Senegos in Azsuna, yes? Meet me at his repose once you are able and we will discuss more.

passages.title: The Power Within
passages.text:
Senegos has generously offered us his assistance in the journey ahead.

A truly kind soul.

passages.title: A Vainglorious Past
passages.text:
The Heart's magic is attuned to Azshara's elite through powerful warding spells. If we tried to tap into its power now we would be met only with our own demise.

However, there may be a way we can bypass the wards.

Prince Farondis and his court were once a part of Azshara's empire, and still hold on to keepsakes of their sordid past. Among these is sure to be a Vainglorious Draught, said to further bind the queen's followers to her will.

See if you can convince the court to part with a bottle.

passages.title: A Vainglorious Past
passages.text: It may take some effort to convince Farondis' people to part with the draught; some among them still cling desperately to their past lives.

passages.title: A Vainglorious Past
passages.text: Well done. We can use this to disable the magic protecting the Heart.

passages.title: Tempering Darkness
passages.text:
I do not doubt Senegos' plan, but I do have some concerns about the Heart's volatility, especially when combined with nightmare energy.

Despite its name, Blood of Sargeras is often used as a tempering agent by master craftsmen. I believe it would work for our ritual as well.

You should keep an eye out for it during your travels - we'll need a substantial amount to ensure that everything goes smoothly.

passages.title: Tempering Darkness
passages.text: It can be difficult to extract properly, but I do not wish to leave anything to chance.

passages.title: Tempering Darkness
passages.text: Fantastic! This will do quite nicely.

passages.title: Repaid Debt
passages.text:
The Moon Guard fought against the Legion many years ago, during the War of the Ancients. Their intimate knowledge of our enemies would be invaluable to our cause.

They have remained in Shal'Aran since you saved Thalrenus and his kin. Shall we pay them a visit and see what they can do?

passages.title: Repaid Debt
passages.text: Let us speak with Thalrenus and discuss our plan of action.

passages.title: Planning the Assault
passages.text:
Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion. The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself.

We just need a way inside.

I am working fervently with the rest of the Council of Six to secure an entrance. Once we have, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills.

passages.title: Planning the Assault
passages.text:
We've found a back entrance into the Nighthold that should provide some relief from the armies at the main gate.

'Some' being key.

passages.title: Blood of Sargeras
passages.text:
We will require a powerful reagent to bind the magic in our weapons and armor. A rare material that will do just the trick is Blood of Sargeras.

We will need a plentiful quantity. Bring me whatever you can muster.

passages.title: Blood of Sargeras
passages.text: Have you acquired any Blood of Sargeras?

passages.title: Blood of Sargeras
passages.text: Yes, this is just what we need to complete our preparations. These must have been difficult to come by. Thank you, Highlord.

passages.title: Translation: Danger!
passages.text:
<Delas smears fel blood across the lexicon's pages. Alien sigils blaze forth above the paper. She scribbles them down furiously.>

My goodness... these are detailed records of the Legion invasion force at Felblaze Ingress. They are planning to open a portal directly to their demon world of Niskara! This is quite serious - we need to alert your allies at once.

If you are going back to Light's Hope Chapel, could I accompany you? I would like to offer my services.

passages.title: Translation: Danger!
passages.text: Did you bring back the translation?

passages.title: Translation: Danger!
passages.text: Thank you for bringing Delas with you, <name>. I knew she could help us.

passages.title: Salanar the Horseman
passages.text:
The Four Horsemen will need perfect steeds. This is no simple task.

For the next step of our campaign, I have organized a mission to the Realm of Shadows.

The goal of the mission is to find Salanar the Horseman, leader of the Dark Riders, and summon him to Acherus.

The mission is currently waiting your assignment.

passages.title: Salanar the Horseman
passages.text:
The Ebon Blade champions sent to the Realm of Shadows have successfully returned to Acherus.

Salanar the Horseman will be arriving shortly to begin preparations for the dread steeds. You should meet with him when he arrives.

passages.title: Bindings of the Windlord
passages.text:
With Thunderaan risen again as the lord of Skywall, there may indeed be an arrangement you can make in exchange for those wretched implements. But one binding is of no use on its own.

Return to me with both bindings, and with powerful enough ore to bind them, and I will arrange your audience with Thunderaan the Windlord.

passages.title: Bindings of the Windlord
passages.text: Yes, <race>?

passages.title: Bindings of the Windlord
passages.text: And so you return with the bindings in hand. The Firelord shall be very displeased to have lost these.

passages.title: [DEPRECATED]
passages.text: You bring the cursed bindings of Ragnaros to this place. Speak your intent, <race>.

passages.title: Audience with the Windlord
passages.text:
I have kept my promise. Thunderaan the Windlord awaits.

Know that if betrayal is in your heart, the Windlord will not be deceived. Be silent, and perhaps your audience shall be a fortunate one.

passages.title: Audience with the Windlord
passages.text:
The bindings now belong to me. When the time comes, the Firelord shall be imprisoned as I once was. But that time is not now.

Your reward is this, a small fragment of my power. Unleash it upon your blades, <race>, and you shall have what you seek.

passages.title: I Believe I Can Fly!
passages.text:
Let's not bother explaining how this happened, just know that I have the plan of all plans to escape this... this... <Looks over his hand-crafted outfit, then quickly glances to a pile of droppings nearby.>

This place stinks! But you can help!

These feathers here will help craft my escape plan. If you wouldn't mind, I'm sure there's enough for the both of us!

passages.title: Arluin's Request
passages.text:
I never thought I would need to read this...

<Vanthir hefts a scroll in his hand.>

Arluin made... plans... in the event he fell. It is not much, but I would like to honor his last request.

<Vanthir hands you the scroll.>

Go to the location marked on this map. Take this Arcan'dor Fruit and give it to a woman named Arluelle. Arluin was very specific that all rewards for his work be directed to her.

I think he may have known what his sacrifice meant. I was wrong about him.

passages.title: Arluin's Request
passages.text: Where is Arluin?

passages.title: Arluin's Request
passages.text: I am not hungry any more. I can think- I will live! Oh, Arluin...

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Braid of the Underking
passages.text:
Greetings, Deathlord. Years have passed since we first met, but for me it has been mere days.

The unholy bond between Horseman and steed must not be taken lightly. Power begets power, Deathlord. Never forget this fact!

I can forge an inseparable bond between rider and steed, but components of great power are required.

The first item I require is the Braid of the Underking, a dark shamanic adornment passed down for generations.

Currently, it is possessed by Dargrul the Underking.

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Braid of the Underking
passages.text: Have you acquired the Braid of the Underking?

passages.title: Neltharion's Lair: Braid of the Underking
passages.text:
Well done, Deathlord. The cords of this braid will be used in the fashioning of reins for our steeds.

I assume Dargrul was more than willing to part with it, yes?

<Salanar flashes an evil grin.>

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: The Nightmare Lash
passages.text:
The dark steeds of the apocalypse are indomitable creatures of anguish and cruelty. They can never be tamed... only subjugated.

The next component of power we require is one born of hatred, fashioned within the Emerald Nightmare. It is known as the Nightmare Lash.

The Nightmare Lash has the power to suffocate all hope... all light... from within a living soul.

The Shade of Xavius himself carries the lash. Defeat him and bring the lash to me!

I will use it to dominate the steeds of the damned!

passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: The Nightmare Lash
passages.text: Do you have the Nightmare Lash?
