passages.title: Darkheart Thicket: The Nightmare Lash
passages.text:
At long last, the Nightmare Lash! Holding it in my hands, I can feel the truth of the legends.

Such power... such darkness... such... anguish!

Yes, this will do nicely.

passages.title: Advancing the War Effort
passages.text:
The quest for the Four Horsemen is of the utmost importance, however we must turn our attention to the warfront.

Our continued success on the field of battle has shaken the Burning Legion and as a result, they have increased the frequency and intensity of their assaults.

We must meet the increased aggression with continued resistance!

Only then will we be able to turn our attention back to the Four Horsemen.

passages.title: Advancing the War Effort
passages.text: How goes the war effort?

passages.title: Advancing the War Effort
passages.text:
The Ebon Blade's success on the battlefield has not gone unnoticed by the Burning Legion.

As we continue the war effort, we must be mindful of increased attention from the forces of Sargeras...

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Maul of the Dead
passages.text:
All of the necessary components have been gathered together. Soon, the unholy steeds of the damned will trample the armies of the Burning Legion.

However, our work is not quite done. One item yet remains beyond our grasp...

Lurking within the depths of Helheim, the fallen queen Helya rules over the dead. In her possession is a maul, infused with the souls of countless fallen warriors.

Bring to me the Maul of the Dead and with it, I will forge barding so impenetrable... no demon shall break it!

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Maul of the Dead
passages.text: Have you brought me the Maul of the Dead?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Maul of the Dead
passages.text: The legendary Maul of the Dead... it resonates with the hatred and despair of countless anguished souls. As a tool of misery, it is the embodiment of perfection.

passages.title: Regroup at the Refuge
passages.text:
I cannot think clearly in this place.

Even though the moonwell is still pure, the corrupting influence of the Nightmare remains.

Come, we will return to the refuge and gather our wits. Then we will continue the hunt for my husband.

passages.title: Regroup at the Refuge
passages.text: Already my mind is sharper.

passages.title: The Wisdom of Patience
passages.text:
The horrors you braved in the thicket are only the beginning. Within the Emerald Nightmare you will face the very heart of the corruption that threatens the stability of all life on Azeroth.

But not just yet.

We have not yet managed to permeate the magic protecting Xavius' sinister realm. Once we have, however, you should return here; there is still much to be done.

passages.title: The Wisdom of Patience
passages.text:
Your next steps will be difficult, young one, and more dangerous than any threat you've faced, but they must be taken.

For the good of Azeroth.

passages.title: Shalassic Park
passages.text:
We have a Devilsaur.

I think she sees you as the pack leader now. She should obey your commands.

She looks hungry. Why don't you let her off the leash a little bit?

passages.title: Shalassic Park
passages.text:
That was quite the spectacle, <name>.

Su'esh will be a valuable ally in the days to come. I will keep an eye on her for the time being.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Message to Helya
passages.text:
We cannot fight on two fronts and succeed.

If we're to give ourselves the room we need to fight off the Legion we need to deliver a decisive victory against Helya. Not her armies, not her lieutenants, but the mother of the underworld herself.

Go to the Maw of Souls and defeat Helya, <name>.

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Message to Helya
passages.text: Is it done?

passages.title: Maw of Souls: Message to Helya
passages.text: A glorious victory! It's unfortunate that Helya survived, but she will think twice about moving against us with you leading the armies of Skyhold.

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
passages.text: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Elor'shan
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
passages.text:
<This feed appears to draw power from the leyline in order to become fully operational.

You should be able to imbue it with mana, but it will take a few minutes to draw enough leyline energy to accept the infusion.

Beware, for creatures may notice the surge of arcane energy...>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Kel'balor
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Arcway
passages.text: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Arcway
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Arcway
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Depths
passages.text: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Depths
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Falanaar Depths
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Halls of the Eclipse
passages.text: <The leyline feed appears to be intact and undamaged, but is not functioning. An infusion of Ancient Mana should be enough to render it operational again.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Halls of the Eclipse
passages.text: <The leyline feed pulses softly.>

passages.title: Leyline Feed: Halls of the Eclipse
passages.text: <As you imbue the feed with the mana the structure stirs to life. Your skin tingles as the surrounding air becomes charged with arcane power.>

passages.title: To the Deeps
passages.text:
I assure you the legends are true: Sharas'dal, the Scepter of Tides, was forged around living waters of the Well of Eternity. It gave Azshara dominion over life itself. I have sent shaman throughout the world looking for it, but the only one to ever find it has gone missing.

Wavespeaker Adelee said she had tracked the scepter to the Ruins of Vashj'ir, but we haven't heard from her since.

<name>! Come with me to the ocean depths. Let's track down our missing shaman and get that artifact!

passages.title: To the Deeps
passages.text: I can transport us to the depths. Step into the bubble here... It's mostly safe.

passages.title: To the Deeps
passages.text:
Very good!

If you haven't been to this realm before, I have learned a trick or two to give you your "Sea Legs," allowing you to breathe underwater for the duration of our mission here.

Now, let's find out missing <class> and the scepter she was looking for!

passages.title: Lumenstone
passages.text:
To prepare for the battle ahead, we will need armor and weapons.

We have learned of lumenstone, a rare metal that can negate magic... even fel magic.

It is found in small quantities all over the Broken Isles, and many of the native races use it in their own metalcrafting.

We should send our champions to target enemies around the Broken Isles - there should be plenty of lumenstone to be found in their stockpiles.

passages.title: Lumenstone
passages.text: Have you acquired any lumenstone?

passages.title: Lumenstone
passages.text: There's enough lumenstone here to craft armor and weapons for an army. Thank you, Highlord.

passages.title: Defenders of the World
passages.text:
Requests are pouring in from across the Broken Isles for our aid, Highlord.

I know that we are working to aid the priests at Netherlight Temple, but there are many others who need our help.

We cannot turn our backs on those who need our aid.

passages.title: Defenders of the World
passages.text: Thank you, Highlord. Too many dangers abound in these dark times. With heroes like you out there, we are all a little bit safer.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
<Sir/Mam>, my head would be in a book whether I was supported by the Tirisgarde or not... but my means are limited. Learning more about this weapon of yours is critical to the fight against the Legion, I know it.

If you want more researchers on the job to turn out results faster, we'll need to supply the resources to keep them going.

I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: There's such a wealth of knowledge in these books.  I wish there were more of me to pour through them all at once.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You are lovely. Just lovely. I'll get to work right away.

Keep us in mind with any resources the Tirisgarde can spare. If you can keep the researchers busy, we should unfold everything there is to know about your weapon in no time.

passages.title: The Call of Battle
passages.text:
Once, the mighty titanforged keepers of Ulduar and Odyn acted as one. Ever since Odyn broke off to create the valarjar, not even Odyn's own son Thorim is bound to follow his father's advice.

There is one hope to unite the forces of Skyhold and Ulduar however.

The Gjallarhorn was a gift given to Hymdall before Odyn's departure. The keepers of Ulduar are oathbound to answer the call of the Gjallarhorn were it to be sounded as it would signal that the end times are upon us!

passages.title: The Call of Battle
passages.text: Ah yes, the Gjallarhorn.

passages.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Moon Guard Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Tel'anor'eporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Tel'anor'eporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Tel'anor'eporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Down to Business
passages.text:
First things first, <name>: we must set up our camp.

We do not have the time or resources for a prolonged siege. It is not like we can starve them out. No, we must be swift and sure as an arrow, piercing their heart in one strike.

They are drawing up their battle lines within the city, but could attack us while we are setting up our defenses.

Venture forth and show them what the kaldorei have learned from thousands of years of war. Discover their weaknesses so that we may exploit them.

passages.title: Down to Business
passages.text: Any regret I had for these people vanished when they went under that shield.

passages.title: Lunastre Estate Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Lunastre Estate Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Lunastre Estate Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Down to Business
passages.text:
Time to get to business, <name>. We cannot afford to tarry.

While we are not setting up for a prolonged engagement, we must still have a war camp of some sorts. I do not expect the Nightborne to stay patiently in their city while we plant stakes.

They are starting to build their defenses. Go in there and see what we are up against. You will strike them from within while we finalize our preparations.

passages.title: Down to Business
passages.text: Excellent. We will be able to defend our borders for now.

passages.title: Sanctum of Order Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The telemancy beacon is deactivated, but intact. Some Ancient Mana should get it back up and running.>

passages.title: Sanctum of Order Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon is cold and dark.>

passages.title: Sanctum of Order Teleporter Online!
passages.text: <The beacon glows as you infuse it with Ancient Mana.>

passages.title: Spy vs. Spy
passages.text:
SI:7 is the espionage and intel branch of the Alliance. They are based out of Stormwind City and headed up by Master Mathias Shaw. As of late, they have been acting, shall we say, peculiar.

I would like for you to send some of our people out to assess the situation. It might be nothing, but I am not fond of situations that I do not fully understand.

If we are going to win this war against the Burning Legion, the last thing we need is for something wholly unexpected to occur.

passages.title: Spy vs. Spy
passages.text:
Why is Mathias Shaw stepping up the number of agents that he has in Horde territory?

We must keep a close and watchful eye on this situation.

passages.title: Elixirs of Aid
passages.text:
We can never be too prepared for battle. The Legion will strike at any moment, and we must be ready to deal with a multitude of injuries and afflictions.

Zabra and Yalia have provided me a list of their most potent potions and battle elixirs than can do everything from restore health to blind the enemy.

We have an exhaustive list of ingredients that we'll need in order to craft a respectable supply.

passages.title: Elixirs of Aid
passages.text: You are as dependable as you are resourceful.

passages.title: Convincin' Old Yancey
passages.text:
Avast ye! Th' time be long overdue that we get some more pirate blood into our ranks.

<Crackers gives a sudden squawk in agreement.>

And I know just th' man t' do it.

I'm talkin' about good old Yancey Grillsen, o' course. He's an old salt down Stranglethorn way.

Send some o' your land lovin' scallywags off t' round him up.

passages.title: Convincin' Old Yancey
passages.text:
Arrr! Now that be what I like t' hear.

What do you think, Crackers... will a bunch o' freebooters class up this crow's nest or scuttle th' ship? I say it's a fair toss o' th' bones.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text:
Word of your leadership has spread rather fast. Priests of all sorts have traveled to the temple to lend their aid.

We're lucky enough to have caught the eye of Vicar Eliza. She's quite the leader in her own right, commanding countless devotees that do her bidding without question. 

Speak to her now.

passages.title: Recruiting More Troops
passages.text: It is an honor to serve you, High <class>.

passages.title: Fancy Lads and Buccaneers
passages.text:
Aye, it warms me heart t' know that Yancey's now part o' th' crew.

<Tethys feeds Crackers some cackle fruit from the table.>

Why don't you be a good <lad/lass> and see if he can sponge us up some bilge rats.

passages.title: Fancy Lads and Buccaneers
passages.text:
Are you lookin' t' be shark bait? Where be our new crew of pirates?

<Crackers squawks in agreement.>

passages.title: Fancy Lads and Buccaneers
passages.text:
Now that's more like it. Get them some holystone and put them t' work scrubbin' th' deck.

That and a few black jacks o' rum will put courage in their sails.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
Any death knight worth their salt knows the weapon they wield as if they were born with it. But you now carry a weapon older than any in this hall.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
A demon hunter is nothing without blades with which to cut flesh. Yet those you wield are older than even you... and have power we don't understand yet.

If you truly want to unlock all of their potential, we need to learn more about them. It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. That's where I come in. It's my specialty.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. I promise you it will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can help with that.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I am quite good at such things.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a mighty weapon with a long history, one we barely understand. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can get workin' on that for ya.

Still, it'll take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. I can do this for you.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Excellent. I'll get back to you with the results as soon as I can.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
Your weapons are undeniably powerful, but we know near nothing about'm.

If we want to unlock all of their potential, we need to dig up some dirt on how they work, what they've done... get to know them, ya know? That's where I come in. I dig up dirt all the time. I mean, not literally, but... you know what I mean.

It will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: I like books.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: On it, boss. Will get back to you soon!

passages.title: Speaking to the Wind
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. We know stories of it, but little about its origins.

If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. The winds can help us with this, but we need to know what to ask.

It will take more shaman than just myself to learn everything there is to know about this artifact of yours. We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Speaking to the Wind
passages.text: Thank you. I'll get back to you with what I've learned soon.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You have a weapon both ancient and powerful. And yet, we barely understand it. If we truly want to unlock all of its potential, we need to learn more about it. That is a thing that I can do for you.

Still, it will take time and more eyes than just mine to sift through all this history, translate it, and turn it into something meaningful.

We should prioritize some of the order's resources towards this research. It will be worth every minute.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: Very good. I'll get back to you with the results soon.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text:
You wield ancient steel, strengthened by magics we barely understand.

If you truly want to unlock the potential of your weapons, you need to know more of how they were forged, and of the battles they've fought in. I can help with this.

Any resources that you can prioritize towards this research will be well worth it.

passages.title: Hitting the Books
passages.text: I will have results for you soon.

passages.title: Preparing to Move
passages.text:
Thanks to your tireless efforts the Heart of Zin-Azshari is ready to withstand the full power of the Legion.

The final destination in our journey has stood defiantly in front of us from the moment we began - the Nighthold, now home to none other than Gul'dan himself.

Before we move on the hold, we should reunite with the Moon Guard in Shal'Aran - we still have need of their skills, and I would wager that they have unfinished business with their former brothers and sisters.

passages.title: Preparing to Move
passages.text:
We've found a back entrance into the Nighthold that should provide some relief from the armies at the main gate.

'Some' being key.

passages.title: Steeds of the Damned
passages.text:
Salanar the Horseman has arrived at Ebon Hold from the Realm of Shadows. He alone has the knowledge and power to conjure the steeds of the Four Horsemen.

Salanar has given us the first list of necessary components to create the steeds. I have organized a number of missions to obtain these items.

Use the mission table to assign your chosen champions to the task.

passages.title: Steeds of the Damned
passages.text: Have you completed the necessary missions for Salanar the Horseman?

passages.title: Steeds of the Damned
passages.text: Excellent work, Deathlord. The missions for the Steeds of the Damned were successful. Salanar the Horseman now has the first set of necessary components for conjuring the steeds.

passages.title: Legion: The Legion Returns
passages.text:
Warriors of da Horde! Break out ya axes and sharpen ya spears. Da Burning Legion has returned ta our world!

We be shipping outta Bladefist Bay right away. With da full fury of da Horde, we gonna smash der line so hard dat Sargeras is gonna feel it in da Nether!

Get to da ships. We got demons ta slay!

passages.title: Legion: The Legion Returns
passages.text:
The ships are leaving from the dock in Bladefist Bay.

Before you leave, prepare yourself. I have the feeling that this fight won't be an easy one.

passages.title: Aggregates of Anguish
passages.text:
Our preparations for conjuring the Steeds of the Damned are nearly complete.

Salanar the Horseman has given us a list of the remaining components. The ritual of conjuring requires five unholy essences known as the Aggregates of Anguish.

I have taken it upon myself to organize the necessary missions to obtain these components.

Use the mission table to assign your chosen champions to the task.

passages.title: Aggregates of Anguish
passages.text: With the Aggregates of Anguish procured, our work is nearly complete. Soon, the Steeds of the Damned will rise... and the Burning Legion will fall!

passages.title: A New Path
passages.text:
Highlord <name>, if I could have a moment of your time?

Long have I followed the path of the Light, and for many years I studied under the Priestesses of the Moon. Yet, I have always felt my education incomplete, and a yearning to know more.

When I walked into these halls, I finally felt a spark of what was missing. I believe that a new path lies before me.

I wish to become a paladin of the Silver Hand. Will you allow me to join you?

passages.title: A New Path
passages.text: What do you think?

passages.title: A New Path
passages.text: Thank you, Highlord.

passages.title: A Second Legend
passages.text:
Perhaps it's time to consider improving your flexibility when it comes to powerful artifacts. There are still others that I think are worth pursuing if you are interested.

Let me show you what your options are and you can choose one.

passages.title: A Second Legend
passages.text: Excellent. You can begin as soon as you are ready.

passages.title: Seeking Refuge
passages.text:
The Nightfallen in Suramar were once a part of the Nightborne, but have been exiled by their former brethren and cut off from the Nightwell.

I believe they could be valuable allies in our quest if you can turn them to our side. I know only that they have gone into hiding somewhere in Suramar.

If you can convince the Nightfallen to aid us, they may be able to offer the Moon Guard and us both refuge right under the Legion's nose.

passages.title: Timeworn Artifact
passages.text:
<You've found a strange looking naga artifact on the fallen corpse.
You saw King Mrgl Mrgl as you were walking around Timeworn Strand. Maybe he knows what to do with it?>

passages.title: Timeworn Artifact
passages.text: Just what I've been looking for! <King Mrgl Mrgl studies the artifact> Ah! Yes. But there must be more of these Timeworn Artifacts still on the shore. Any more you can bring back would be greatly appreciated!

passages.title: Expanding Your Horizons
passages.text:
You are a fast study, <class>t <name>. The elements speak through you - it is rare to have such a connection to the world.

A true shaman must walk many paths. For every role, one must have the right tools at hand. Only the most powerful weapons can lead us to victory against the Legion. Perhaps it is time to seek out another?

Speak with me and let us discuss your options.

passages.title: Expanding Your Horizons
passages.text:
Very well. Your allies have gathered here on the precipice - they will know how best to proceed.

May the winds be ever in your favor, Farseer.

passages.title: More Weapons of Legend
passages.text:
It is wise to carry more than one weapon to war. Sometimes one will be better suited than another. You should choose another weapon of legend to carry with you, especially against foes so deadly.

What say you?

passages.title: More Weapons of Legend
passages.text: A powerful weapon for a powerful champion of the Halls. Let us begin.

passages.title: A Body of Evidence
passages.text:
There is an urgent matter that requires your attention, <name>.

The body of a woman with a knife in her back has turned up in the sewers.

Normally, such a matter would be less than newsworthy... but this isn't your average cutthroat. It's an SI:7 operative!

I've got some of our goons guarding the body, but you had better get over there before the word spreads.

If SI:7 finds out about this... it will be bad for business.

passages.title: A Body of Evidence
passages.text: Did you identify the body? Was it an SI:7 operative?

passages.title: A Body of Evidence
passages.text:
So it's true? An SI:7 agent was assassinated in our own backyard?

If SI:7 links us to the murder, this will be bad for business. We'll need to get to the bottom of this sooner rather than later...

passages.title: Blades of Destiny
passages.text:
I'm glad that weapon you've been carrying around has proven useful. Our ally, the Lich King, has offered to provide you with a lead on another weapon should the one you already have somehow be lacking.

Consider the options carefully and let me know which you would like to seek out.

passages.title: Blades of Destiny
passages.text: Very well.

passages.title: Hired Help
passages.text:
I was fond of Margaux. News of her death weighs heavily on many of us.

<Vanthir shakes his head sadly.>

If we are to carry on, we need to send a strong message. We need those like Durant to know that we are watching, and we will hold them accountable.

I know someone who could help us.

His name is Arluin. To call him a reluctant ally would be generously overstating it. He is cautious, and will not risk himself without compensation.

You can find him in the alleys north of the Evermoon Bazaar.

passages.title: Hired Help
passages.text: Best not to lurk if you aren't doing business.

passages.title: Hired Help
passages.text: I will help you, but first I need you to do something for me.

passages.title: Two Paths, Two Weapons
passages.text:
We've searched through our scrolls and have found new leads on a couple of powerful weapons. They may prove beneficial in our efforts.

Here, let me show you what I've found. If any of these interest you then simply let me know.

passages.title: Two Paths, Two Weapons
passages.text: A wise choice.

passages.title: Recruiting Shieldmaidens
passages.text:
The powerful val'kyr Savyn Valorborn has arrived to aid us in bolstering our numbers. She ushers some of the most valorous vrykul shieldmaidens into the Halls of Valor.

Speak to her and recruit powerful troops to add to our roster.

passages.title: Recruiting Shieldmaidens
passages.text: I will rally the worthy in Odyn's name.

passages.title: Another Weapon of Old
passages.text:
You have done well but our foes are powerful and cunning. It would be wise to be prepared for whatever they may unleash upon us. 

You would be wise to consider obtaining another of the weapons of old to aid in our conflict.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

passages.title: Another Weapon of Old
passages.text: A sound choice.

passages.title: The Tome Opens Again
passages.text:
You've been doing well, friend, but you would be unstoppable if you had another weapon at your side.

Here, let me show you what options remain in the book. If either of these interest you then simply let me know.

passages.title: The Tome Opens Again
passages.text: Thoughts, friend?

passages.title: The Tome Opens Again
passages.text: Yes, very good choice!

passages.title: Your Fullest Potential
passages.text:
I see that you walk many paths, as a true shaman should.

Two mighty artifacts are already in your possession. To seek a third would not be greed: it would be the fulfillment of your destiny, the completion of a circle.

Speak with me, and together we will unlock your fullest potential.

passages.title: Your Fullest Potential
passages.text: Where are the spirits guiding you, Farseer?

passages.title: Your Fullest Potential
passages.text: The path ahead is clear. Your allies await you on this ledge. May the spirits walk with you, Farseer!

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text:
<class>t <name>, thank you for coming. I have a matter of some urgency that requires your unique talents.

The Order of the Silver Hand have reported that an extraordinarily luminescent object has emerged from the Felstorm and is currently falling towards the coast of Suramar. What I find most curious about this occurrence is that the object was reported as having "cut a swath" through the Felstorm itself.

Will you investigate? There is a gryphon awaiting your arrival at Krasus' Landing.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text: Show me what you've found.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text: Most curious indeed! This is no object of the Legion's making. Let me have a closer look.

passages.title: Another Worthy Blade
passages.text:
We still have plans prepared to obtain other weapons of incredible power - tools that you may find useful to have on hand as you continue your work.

I would be happy to go over the remaining options with you so that you may make an informed decision.

passages.title: Another Worthy Blade
passages.text:
Yes, I think that will do rather nicely as well.

Good choice.

passages.title: Vote of Confidence
passages.text:
I will endeavor to protect my son until the votes are cast.

Coryn Stelleris is a predator even among the nobility. It does not surprise me that he should stoop to such depths to ensure his own success.

Tell Ly'leth that she has my support. Unequivocally.

You may also choose to tell her that Coryn Stelleris will hurt her, if she gives him a chance.

Be careful.

passages.title: Vote of Confidence
passages.text:
I know of Coryn. We will not underestimate his venom, rest assured.

Thank you for helping Aurore. She is a dear friend of mine.

passages.title: The Bloody Truth
passages.text:
We need to find out who is behind the assassination of Amber Kearnen.

It won't be long before SI:7 realizes that their agent is MIA and comes sniffing around The Hall of Shadows.

Here, take these stylish spy glasses and set them to scan for traces of hemoglobin. I've taken the liberty of calibrating them specifically for Amber Kearnen's blood.

Follow the blood trail back to the culprits, but make sure to stay out of sight!

Report back to us when you've got the information we need.

passages.title: The Bloody Truth
passages.text: Were you able to find out who's behind the assassination attempt?

passages.title: The Bloody Truth
passages.text:
Let me get this straight...

You are saying that Master Mathias Shaw ordered the death of one of his best agents? This is far more serious than I first thought.

We'll need to continue the search for clues...

passages.title: Continuing the Legend
passages.text:
There are still two paths you may walk - two powerful weapons you might yet obtain to aid you in the fight against the Legion.

I will help you recall your remaining options, of course.

passages.title: Continuing the Legend
passages.text: A wise path to follow - may it take you far.

passages.title: Wasted Potential
passages.text:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

passages.title: Wasted Potential
passages.text:
I heard rumors that you intend to leave the City... that there is another place for the Nightborne where we are not beholden to Elisande's insanity.

I wish to go with you.

I can offer my harp and my hands, as they are not wanted here.

Say the word and I will go with you through the teleporter and share my music with whomever awaits me on the other side.

passages.title: And They Will Tremble
passages.text:
There will be consequences for what has transpired this day.

For now, you should return to Thalyssra. Tell her that we have avenged Margaux and that the Dusk Lily has announced itself to all of Suramar.

There will be many more deaths before this is over, rest assured, but this is a death that will teach others like Durant to tread more carefully in the future.

passages.title: And They Will Tremble
passages.text: It is a relief, if a small one. You have done well - rest for now.

passages.title: Friends With Benefits
passages.text:
The Lunastre Attendant, silent as ever, offers you a wax-sealed scroll.

It reads:
"Dearest <name>,

I asked my attendant to catch you, should things go in my favor.

The role of Advisor will keep me away from the estate for some time and I settled on a gift for Thalyssra.

I have sent a detachment of attendants to Shal'Aran with some comfort items. Treat them well- they need someone to wait on and I could think of none better!

Give the others my thanks, and my love,
Advisor Ly'leth Lunastre"

passages.title: Friends With Benefits
passages.text: She certainly is a worthy companion.

passages.title: A "Noble" Event
passages.text:
The invitation appears to be for an exclusive fox hunt. They plan to hunt Volpin, a rare, elusive fox somewhere in the Broken Isles. Perhaps we can take advantage of this?

We need to gather more information about this hunt, but we should do so without alerting the Nightborne to your plans. Your champions can act in your stead and further investigate where the hunt will be.

passages.title: A "Noble" Event
passages.text: Have your champions discovered anything about the fox hunt?

passages.title: A "Noble" Event
passages.text:
Yes, its all here, the location of the hunt for Volpin. 

I'm sure there are better uses for a wonderful creature such as he than a pelt on some Noble's shoulders, don't you agree?

passages.title: Volpin the Elusive
passages.text:
According to the map, the fox hunt will start at the Feathermane Hunting Grounds in Suramar. If the Nightborne succeed, they will kill Volpin, a fox that is the last of his kind in the Broken Isles.

Travel to the Hunting Grounds, and interrupt the hunt.

passages.title: Bolstering Your Arsenal
passages.text:
Highlord, there are still weapons that you might obtain to help you defeat the Legion. We have kept a close eye on them during your time on the Broken Isles.

I would be happy to review them with you if you wish.

passages.title: Bolstering Your Arsenal
passages.text: Excellent. There's no time to waste.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Essence of Balance
passages.text:
Within the Eye of Azshara in Azsuna, a powerful being known as the Wrath of Azshara grows in strength. It is a blasphemy of nature - an infusion of stolen arcane power, and cannot be allowed to exist.

Slay it. In its aftermath, you may find the essence of balance that you seek.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Essence of Balance
passages.text: We follow Elune's path.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: Essence of Balance
passages.text: Wonderful. This is exactly what we need.

passages.title: Knights of the Ebon Blade
passages.text:
Korgaz Deadaxe has arrived at Acherus to aid us in recruiting additional death knights. He has an eye for potential.

I cannot emphasize enough that it is of the utmost importance that we replenish our numbers during the battle with the Burning Legion.

The demon armies are nearly endless and we are few.

Speak with Korgaz when you are ready to recruit additional death knights.

passages.title: Knights of the Ebon Blade
passages.text:
Greetings, Deathlord. It is an honor to serve you.

I have been keeping an eye on the casualties of the Alliance and Horde upon the battlefield. Supply is limited, but there are some very promising prospects...

passages.title: Vengeance for Margaux
passages.text:
<Sylverin sputters, pale-faced with rage.>

How could they? Margaux did everything they asked of her and more! The arcwine never stopped flowing despite everything they did to us! To her!

Such injustice cannot stand. We must take vengeance for Margaux.

passages.title: Vengeance for Margaux
passages.text: <Thalyssra is speechless for a moment.>

passages.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
passages.text:
<name>, Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.

He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.

passages.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
passages.text:
Commander. I am glad to see that Asha was able to find you so quickly.

There is something important that you must attend to as soon as possible.

passages.title: A Greater Arsenal
passages.text:
The tome speaks of one more weapon that friend can use against our foes. 

Do you wish to seek it?

passages.title: A Greater Arsenal
passages.text: Have you made your choice?

passages.title: A Greater Arsenal
passages.text: Friend is very wise! You can never have too many weapons!

passages.title: Pledge of Loyalty
passages.text:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:

To: <name>

I hope this message finds you well.

Word of Ohn'ahra's omen has traveled fast. There are many who wish to pledge their loyalty to the Unseen Path's new leader.

Return to me at Trueshot Lodge, and we can discuss this further.

 -Altar Keeper Biehn

passages.title: Pledge of Loyalty
passages.text: I see you received my message.

passages.title: Needs of the Many
passages.text:
You've seen that the Legion is everywhere. Even with the Illidari as your allies, we are at a great disadvantage.

We need an edge against the Legion... something to send them back to the Nether.

We have heard that Dalaran will be the focal point of our campaign. I suggest you go there. You must do anything necessary to become stronger. ANYTHING.

I have seen Kirin Tor mages near Grommash Hold. They can send you to Dalaran.

Go. Take revenge upon the Legion!

passages.title: Recruiting Apprentices
passages.text:
Grand Conjuror Mimic has arrived to aid us in bolstering our numbers. She seeks out the most promising apprentices and trains them very quickly. Her former students are some of the most powerful conjurors in the land!

Speak to her and recruit some of her apprentices to add to our roster.

passages.title: Recruiting Apprentices
passages.text: Good to see you, <name>. My apprentices are learning rapidly and are ready to serve you.

passages.title: A Mutual Friend
passages.text:
It's good to see you are well.

I've been sent by our mutual friend, Calydus. He is eager to speak with you.

Please return to Dreadscar Rift at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: A Mutual Friend
passages.text: It's so good to see friend once again.

passages.title: Proper Introductions
passages.text:
I'm glad I found you. 

I have a message from Alonsus Faol.

He says introductions are in order, and requests your presence within Netherlight Temple at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Proper Introductions
passages.text: I see you received my message.

passages.title: Archdruid of Lore
passages.text:
Elothir resides in the ancient grove Thas'talah, where he communes with nature and instructs his acolytes in the ways of healing and the preservation of lore.

Seek him out and tell him that he is desperately needed here.

passages.title: Archdruid of Lore
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. News of your heroism spreads from the Dreamgrove.

passages.title: Welcome to Legion!
Mystery at Citrine Bay
passages.text:
The Burning Legion invades Azeroth, and SI:7 is wasting valuable resources hunting down and assassinating one of their top agents?

Something isn't adding up...

We need to find out how deep this goes. Why was Amber Kearnen being hunted by her own organization?

The encrypted letter she was carrying may hold the clues... but we need more information.

The SI:7 assassins you tailed in Dalaran mentioned Citrine Bay... search Citrine Bay for clues and we'll see about getting this letter decrypted.

passages.title: Mystery at Citrine Bay
passages.text: Ye had best keep ye voice below whispers, matey... thar be a band 'o pirates ahead! Fer sure, these be not th' type ye want to mess around wit'...

passages.title: Time Flies When Yer Havin' Rum!
passages.text:
Thar be few pirates ye want to cross swords wit' less than th' Red Blade! They be salty dogs, indeed!

That being said... they does have a way wit' rum! I'll level wit' ye, <name>... thar be few rums as jolly as that 'o th' Red Blade.

Seein' as ye be headin' off in search 'o clues, ye might as well brin' back a few bottles while ye be at it!

Brin' me back as many bottles as ye can find, and I'll reward ye handsomely! Pirates honor, <name>!

passages.title: Time Flies When Yer Havin' Rum!
passages.text: Have ye got th' spiced rum, <name>?

passages.title: Time Flies When Yer Havin' Rum!
passages.text:
<Fleet Admiral Tethys pops the cork from a bottle and takes a long gulp.>

Aye, 'tis be th' stuff, <name>. Ye've done well!

passages.title: Into the Fray
passages.text:
The Burning Legion has beaten us here, but so too have the Illidari. It looks like the demon hunters are holding their own, but just barely.

Come, let's put that weapon of yours to use. I'll figure out our next move while you crush the Legion.

passages.title: Into the Fray
passages.text:
You are a most welcome sight, <name>. And, you brought considerable firepower in the form of Archmage Khadgar.

Malevolence has been portaling us back and forth between here and the Fel Hammer. We pushed the demons out of these ruins, but they are stronger than any we have encountered before.

Your leadership is greatly appreciated. If we do not crush this Legion invasion now, they will overrun Azsuna and then the rest of the Broken Isles.

passages.title: From Within
passages.text:
Our demon hunters, Kor'vas Bloodthorn and Cyana Nightglaive took a small force of the Illidari across to Faronaar. Their mission was to weaken the Legion from within.

I haven't heard from them in a while.

It would be best if you could find and lead them to success. Agreed?

passages.title: From Within
passages.text:
Oh, <name>, it's you. Good, we've got a little problem here.

Kayn didn't think that Cyana and I could handle this on our own? He might have been right this time.

passages.title: Light's Charge
passages.text:
"You did not ask for this burden, but it is what fate has deemed." Turalyon's haunting last words still echo in my mind. I worry about the fate of the draenei... about the fate of my friend, Velen; but we must remain vigilant, <name>!

For now, Light's Heart remains under your watchful eye. There is one place on Azeroth that I would trust with the safekeeping of the object: your order hall. Take it there, <name>. I will remain in Dalaran and continue looking for answers. There must be another way!

passages.title: Light's Charge
passages.text: This is where you must place Light's Heart.

passages.title: Light's Charge
passages.text:
<A force within Light's Heart activates as you lay it down.>

<You feel hopeful.>

passages.title: Searching For Clues
passages.text:
It be no coincidence that we be in Citrine Bay investigatin' a murder, and we find th' band 'o pirates known as th' Red Blade here as well!

Aye, this be no coincidence at all, <name>... but we be needin' proof!

Ye go on ahead and look fer clues and I'll find some scallywags to interrogate.

Aye <name>, we'll get t' 'th bottom o' this t' be sure! Thar be no doubt!

passages.title: Searching For Clues
passages.text: Have ye found evidence 'o th' murder from th' pirates 'o th' Red Blade?

passages.title: Searching For Clues
passages.text:
Aye, what do ye have thar? 'tis be a letter from Master Mathias Shaw himself! Writ' to th' Red Blade no less.

Aye, it be just as I thought... these orders be fishier than a bucket 'o chum!

passages.title: Another Arcan'dor Closes...
passages.text:
I hope you have a better understanding of what is at stake.

Come. There is no more for us to do here.

Meet me in Shal'aran and we will discuss what steps we may take next.

passages.title: Another Arcan'dor Closes...
passages.text: We must find a solution. We are running out of time.

passages.title: A Ticket for Marin
passages.text: This Vault Ticket should be delivered to Marin Noggenfogger.

passages.title: A Ticket for Marin
passages.text: Another <class> shows up with another ticket to take more of my loot. Make your choice.

passages.title: A Ticket for Marin
passages.text: Have at it, <name>. Make your choice.

passages.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
passages.text:
Battlelord Gaardoun has offered to recruit more broken warriors for the cause. He just needs a few things first. He said something about the right tool for the job, or something like that.

Time to put your new champions to the test. I'm sure it will be a grueling mission.

passages.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
passages.text: Did they come back already with whatever it is that Gaardoun needs?

passages.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
passages.text:
Well, at least we're going to have some fresh faces around here. If a broken's face can ever be called fresh, that is.

<Kor'vas smirks.>

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: The blazing star shines upon the land, searing the earth and parching the landscape. This star is relentless, malevolent almost. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: I foresee that you will follow the blazing star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Burning Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: The chill star shines upon the land with its cold light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, sapping warmth and life. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: I foresee that you will follow the chill star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Frozen Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: The Destroyer's star shines upon the land with its piercing light as even the spirits retreat to the shadows. This star is unlike any other in the skies, laying bare the weaknesses of even the boldest heroes. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: I foresee that you will follow the Destroyer's star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Shattered Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: When the sign of the warrior shines in the night sky, fortune favors the daring. Powerful foes may yield even greater rewards. Venture deep into caverns and strongholds to prove your worth.

passages.title: Emissary of War
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I knew you could do it.

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is a dire sign, stirring bloodlust and calling warriors to battle to the death in close quarters. Arena masters turn a tidy profit during these days, likely not understanding why their stands are overflowing. Amidst the excitement, great rewards do await those brave, or foolhardy, enough to venture into the arena....

passages.title: The Arena Calls
passages.text: Well done, <name>. I knew you would do it.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: The favorite star of warlords and generals dominates the sky, offering good fortune to tacticians everywhere. Some say that the battle star hones the instincts of commanders to the point of near-prophecy. If ever you were going to test yourself on the field of battle, now is the time.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: I foresee battle in your future, <name>. And flags, for some reason.

passages.title: A Call to Battle
passages.text: I trust your battles went well. And that's not just a turn of phrase. I know they did. I knew they would.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: This alignment of the stars is truly a strange one, causing the tiniest of creatures to gain unnatural aptitude. None of our sages can explain the phenomenon, but cunning tamers have much to gain, especially by testing their skills against those of their peers.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: I foresee that you will travel across the land, searching far and wide. It's your destiny.

passages.title: The Very Best
passages.text: Well done, <name>. With courage, you have faced every challenge along the way, and battled every day to claim your rightful place.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: When the sign of the emissary shines in the night sky, the stars strengthen existing bonds and forge new ones. Friendship is still not cheaply won, and deeds will prove loyalty, but trust comes more readily during these days. Venture across the Broken Isles, and give aid where you may, to prove your worth.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: I foresee that you will win many friends this week.

passages.title: The World Awaits
passages.text: Well done, <name>.

passages.title: The Conveniences of Home
passages.text: This chest could prove very useful to our efforts. Take the chest back to Shal'aran.

passages.title: The Conveniences of Home
passages.text: The heavy chest offers plenty of room to carry all of your belongings.

passages.title: A Particularly Potent Potion
passages.text:
I've got a proposition for ya, <name>!

Word has it that Trade Prince Gallywix recently acquired a priceless, one-of-a-kind love potion. There's only one goblin who can replicate it and you're looking at him! Get me that potion and I can make us both richer than kings!

The pleasure palace is located in Azshara and it has been on high alert since the war started. Gallywix isn't letting anybody in except his personal staff, but I know a girl on the inside!

Find her and she'll get you to the safe!

passages.title: A Particularly Potent Potion
passages.text: Do you have the goods?

passages.title: A Particularly Potent Potion
passages.text:
Aww, yesss! That's the stuff!

<Noggenfogger pops the cork and dabs some of the potion on his finger.>

Have mercy! WOWZA! I'm going to need some time alone with this stuff!

passages.title: Treasure
City Under Siege
passages.text:
<Khadgar's voice erupts from the elemental once again.>

Obtaining information on the Pillars of Creation before the Legion could stop us was a considerable victory. It won't bring back those we lost on the Broken Shore, but I believe it will help us avenge them.

Dalaran has become a focal point of the Legion's assault. Your presence here is crucial. If the demons are putting this much effort into attacking the city, it means Dalaran will play a pivotal role in the struggle to save Azeroth.

passages.title: City Under Siege
passages.text:
I shored up Karazhan's defenses as best I could, but I have little confidence they'll hold. We have other matters to focus on in any case.

Gul'dan has set his demon dogs loose upon Dalaran. He wants this city gone... but we're not going to let him have his way.

I believe Dalaran will become the focal point of our campaign against the Legion, neutral ground where the heroes of every kingdom can join together against our mutual foe.

Let's get to work, <name>.

passages.title: Workorders for Armaments
passages.text: I can get you the best deals on some slightly... used... equipment.

passages.title: Workorders for Armaments
passages.text: Place a workorder for a shipment of Champion Armaments and Equipment.

passages.title: Workorders for Armaments
passages.text: The orders been sent, my people are on the case.  Check back soon and you can pickup the shipment right here.

passages.title: Seal their Fates
passages.text:
Ever feel like luck just isn't on your side? Well maybe I can help you with that. 

There are some interesting items I've come across in my travels which can be used to swing the dice in your favor, or at least give you another shot at it. It takes some time, and supplies are hard to come by, but I can get you one of them... for a price?

passages.title: Seal their Fates
passages.text:
The order has been sent. Once my people have procured the item, it will be here for you to collect.

Good... luck.

passages.title: Shape Your Fate
passages.text:
The whims of the spirits can be guided, I have seen it.

There were whispers of an item, a way to change the path of destiny. I heard dem, and I went looking. For many years I listened to those whispers on the wind until one day they showed me the way. This is what I offer you. It will take some time, and some valuable resources, but I can perform the ritual to allow you to control this power.

Well? Are you ready?

passages.title: Shape Your Fate
passages.text: Place a work order  for a Seal of Broken Fate.

passages.title: Shape Your Fate
passages.text: The ritual has begun. This will take some time. Return later.

passages.title: The Ascended
passages.text:
These shaman have spent their lives dedicated to the path of Air, Water or Fire. On your request, we will beseech the elements to Ascend them, becoming a powerful, if short lived, force to deploy in this war against the Legion.

The ritual of ascension is not to be requested lightly.

passages.title: The Ascended
passages.text: The ritual has begun, they will Rise.  Return here when the ritual is complete.

passages.title: Portal Full of Shiny Things
passages.text:
When I heard the Hall of the Guardian was open again, I said to myself "Minuette, this is your chance!" I rushed over here thinking I'd be hurled into the front lines. Imagine it, me, little old me, assaulting Demons with missiles, blinking away from Fel Meteors. That would be brilliant!

Instead, they send me over here and say "Hey, open up some portals so we can throw things through, would you?" At least I get to charge something for it.

passages.title: Portal Full of Shiny Things
passages.text:
All those years of study are really paying off...

Once they've sent the shipment through, it will be waiting here for you.

passages.title: Fate and Time
passages.text:
For years we wondered, we conjectured, that it was possible to control the twisting, slipping, streaming threads of fate and destiny. These books tell of powerful mages who embraced the manipulation of time. No no, not like Time Warp, they would laugh at us, think us silly amateurs. No, they were true Chronomancers.

The only spell we've been able to determine is a conjuration. It calls forth what they termed a "Seal of Fate". This allowed them to repeat their actions. Let us try it out shall we?

passages.title: Fate and Time
passages.text: The spell has begun. Return to me when it is complete. Fate is in the hands of time now.

passages.title: The Might of Dalaran pt2
Unseen Armaments
passages.text:
If we gonna win dis war, we need to get these Champions of ours better equipment. 

It won't be cheap, or easy, but I can get dem for you.

passages.title: Unseen Armaments
passages.text: The order has been issued. Once the shipment arrives it will be here for you to collect.

passages.title: Unseen Fate
passages.text:
Our path is a winding, twisting road full of peril. Yet did you know it can be walked many times? There is an item of great power available to us. It allows us another opportunity, a second chance.

Do you wish to acquire one?

passages.title: Unseen Fate
passages.text: Word has been sent. The Seal will arrive soon.

passages.title: You Will Be Prepared!
passages.text:
<name>, your strength and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Illidari are prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: You Will Be Prepared!
passages.text: Our glaives are yours, <name>.

passages.title: One More Thing...
passages.text:
Firstly, allow me to congratulate you. I know of no one more deserving of the title of Shadowblade. But there's one more thing.

Meet me over near the forge.

passages.title: One More Thing...
passages.text: I think you will appreciate this. I must admit to a certain level of envy.

passages.title: Armor Fit For A Deathlord
passages.text:
<name> is strong! <name> is great leader!

Ebon Blade want to give you full set of armor to help with the little demon killing. Get stronger, make demons more dead!

passages.title: Armor Fit For A Deathlord
passages.text: We is with you, <name>!

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text:
This war against the Legion won't be won easily. We will need armaments and equipment for our Champions. 

Give the order sir, I'll get the word out and have a shipment brought in.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: Aye, sir, the men have their orders.  Once the shipment arrives it will be here for you to collect.

passages.title: Fate's Blessing
passages.text:
The Light's blessing is powerful. We use it to mend, to defeat our enemies... we even use it to resurrect our allies. Did you know it can also be used to alter your destiny? 

The Silver Hand is able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny. 

Shall we procure one for you?

passages.title: Fate's Blessing
passages.text: Word has been sent. The Seal will arrive soon.

passages.title: Blessing of the Order
passages.text:
In times of great need, the Order can rally its mightiest forces into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.

On request, we will channel our power into a Libram, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

passages.title: Blessing of the Order
passages.text: Send out the call to bring together the Vanguard, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.

passages.title: Blessing of the Order
passages.text: Well done, though that certainly takes all of our efforts.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text:
A warrior lives and dies by his weapons and armor. For a price, we can provide you with a shipment for armaments to equip your Champions with.

Do we have a deal?

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: The order has been placed.  Once the shipment arrives it will be here for you to collect.

passages.title: The Might of the Val'kyr
passages.text:
In times of great need, the Val'kyr can rally its mightiest forces into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.

On request, these we will channel our power into a Horn, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

passages.title: The Might of the Val'kyr
passages.text: Rise the power of the Val'kyr, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.

passages.title: The Might of the Val'kyr
passages.text: Well done, though that certainly takes all of our efforts.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: We will need armaments and equipment for our Champions.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: The order has been placed.  Once the shipment arrives it will be here for you to collect.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text:
In times of great need, we can rally our mightiest forces into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.

On request, these we will channel our power into an item, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text: Well done, though that certainly takes all of our efforts.

passages.title: Fate Favors Us
passages.text:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny. 

Shall we procure one for you?

passages.title: Fate Favors Us
passages.text: Word has been sent. The Seal will arrive soon.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text:
In times of great need, we can rally our mightiest forces into one pure, destructive form. This is such a time.

On request, these we will begin the ritual to enslave a powerful Infernal in a Demonic Phylactery, which we will impart to you. Use it to unleash that power, completing a quest of great value.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text: Begin the ritual to enslave the infernal, then unleash it to complete a World Quest.

passages.title: Unleashing our Wrath
passages.text: Well done, though that certainly takes all of our efforts.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text:
See Lurr? He big and strong, but not so smart, not like Murr. Murr can make Lurr build good things for you, things for your Champions to wear and be smashier. 

First, you give Murr something?

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: Murr will make Lurr smash fast!  When he done smashing, we put it in box.  Box here for you later.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: We will need armaments and equipment for our Champions.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: The order has been placed.  Once the shipment arrives it will be here for you to collect.

passages.title: The Fates Bless Us
passages.text:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny. 

Shall we procure one for you?

passages.title: The Fates Bless Us
passages.text: Word has been sent. The Seal will arrive soon.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text:
People today see a dead body and they just think its a smelly pile of goo, not me I tell ya. I see it as a little present holding wonderful secrets. 

For a price, Ill share those secrets with you too.

passages.title: Champion Armaments
passages.text: The order has been placed.  Once the shipment arrives it will be here for you to collect.

passages.title: The Grove Provides
passages.text:
<name>, your wisdom and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Dreamweavers are prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: The Grove Provides
passages.text: We are with you, <name>.

passages.title: Walk This Way
passages.text:
<name>, your strength and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Unseen Path is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Walk This Way
passages.text: Yours is the path we will follow, <name>.

passages.title: Essence of Fate
passages.text:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny. 

Shall we procure one for you?

passages.title: Essence of Fate
passages.text: Place a work order for a Seal of Broken Fate.

passages.title: Essence of Fate
passages.text: Word has been sent. The Seal will arrive soon.

passages.title: Essence of Fate
passages.text:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny. 

Shall we procure one for you?

passages.title: Ancients of War
passages.text: The sapling is clearly excited and wants your attention. Perhaps you should help him?

passages.title: Ancients of War
passages.text: Start recruiting an Ancient of War

passages.title: Ancients of War
passages.text: The sapling ignores you, but seems busy at work.  Perhaps you should return later.

passages.title: Meditations on Fate
passages.text:
We are able to procure a valuable item to help you in our war against the Legion. This Seal can be used at the most opportune moments to grant another chance at destiny. 

Shall we procure one for you?

passages.title: Meditations on Fate
passages.text: Word has been sent. The Seal will arrive soon.

passages.title: Echo of a Celestial
passages.text: Tianili is clearly excited and wants your attention. Perhaps you should help him?

passages.title: Echo of a Celestial
passages.text: Tianili seems distracted.  Perhaps you should return later.

passages.title: Orange is the New Purple
passages.text:
<name>, your intelligence and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

Tirisgarde is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Orange is the New Purple
passages.text: Our hearts and minds are with you, <name>.

passages.title: Inner Sanctuary
passages.text:
<name>, your wisdom and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Order of the Broken Temple is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Inner Sanctuary
passages.text: In this fight, our spirits are as one, <name>.

passages.title: Power Word: Armor
passages.text:
<name>, your wisdom and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Conclave is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Power Word: Armor
passages.text: We are with you, <name>.

passages.title: A Sheath For Every Blade
passages.text:
<name>, your cunning and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Uncrowned are prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: A Sheath For Every Blade
passages.text: Our blades are yours, <name>.

passages.title: A Vision of Triumph
passages.text:
<name>, your strength and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Earthen Ring is prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: A Vision of Triumph
passages.text: We stand with you, <name>.

passages.title: Axe and You Shall Receive
passages.text:
<name>, your strength and leadership inspires awe in all of us!

The Valarjar are prepared to furnish you with a full set of armor to aid in the fight against the Burning Legion. Continue expanding your influence across the Broken Isles, and we may yet achieve victory.

passages.title: Axe and You Shall Receive
passages.text: The might of the Valarjar stands with you, <name>.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text:
<Khadgar ponders the information that you brought to him.>

You say that it cut a swath through the Felstorm and was emanating power enough that your scout could feel it coursing through their body?

Something that powerful could prove to be a potent weapon against the Burning Legion!

I will inform the other order leaders of your discovery while you investigate the matter further! A gryphon awaits your command at Krasus' Landing! Light guide you.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text: Show me what you've found.

passages.title: A Falling Star
passages.text: Most curious indeed! This is no object of the Legion's making. Let me have a closer look.

passages.title: Illidari Freedom
passages.text:
<Arduen Soulblade is bleeding from several ghastly wounds. It appears he was left here to die.>

Within the prison are three of our... <cough>... comrades.

We were taken by surprise while scouting the area.

I am not long for this world, <name>, but please... you can still save them.

passages.title: Illidari Freedom
passages.text:
We mourn together brother over the loss of Arduen, Cassiel, and Sirius. But, I owe you my life... again.

There is one thing I learned during my time in the prisons: the demons within Black Rook Hold must die.

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text:
Our allies have made the journey to Orgrimmar to support our war efforts.

Stop and visit with them, <name>. Their assistance will secure our victory today.

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text: Blood and thunder, friend.

passages.title: To Be Prepared
passages.text:
You look quite prepared for battle. Do not let the bloodlust overtake you out there.

The Warchief wishes to present you with this ring before you head to war. May you return with the heads of many demons.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Frozen Soul
passages.text:
Ah, Deathlord. It is good to see you. I happen to have a fascinating task for you, should you be in the mood for adventure.

I recently came across an obscure reference to an ancient amulet that was created by Queen Azshara herself! It is called the Frozen Soul Pendant and it offers tremendous power to those who channel the power of frost.

I have reason to believe that it may be found somewhere within the Eye of Azshara.

Retrieve the pendant for me, and it will prove most useful in my studies.

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Frozen Soul
passages.text: Have you retrieved the pendant?

passages.title: Eye of Azshara: The Frozen Soul
passages.text:
So this is the legendary Frozen Soul Pendant! I sense a great power in this item...

I will begin my study of it at once. You have my gratitude, Deathlord.

passages.title: Blessings of the Order
passages.text: Though it takes time and resources, we are able to, of course, Bless your champions. With this Blessing, their success on their adventures will be greatly improved.

passages.title: Blessings of the Order
passages.text: The Blessings are under way, they will be ready for you to receive here shortly.

passages.title: Thrice the Power
passages.text:
We have information on one last artifact you might seek out, should you seek to weave other types of magic.

All the details are here. Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

passages.title: Thrice the Power
passages.text: So it shall be done.

passages.title: Goddess Watch Over You
passages.text:
I may have found a "key" to unlock Light's Heart, <name>.

I was going through some ancient cosmology tomes when I stumbled upon a passage indicating that the prime naaru may have been created by Elune during the great ordering of Light and Shadow.

If Elune did create Xe'ra, then it stands to reason that we could use the Tears of Elune to unlock the secrets of Light's Heart.

It's a long shot, but we've got nothing left to lose.

Meet me in Dalaran. I will ready the Tears of Elune for you.

passages.title: Goddess Watch Over You
passages.text: If this works, then perhaps there is still hope for Turalyon and the Army of the Light.

passages.title: Goddess Watch Over You
passages.text:
I may have found a "key" to unlock Light's Heart, <name>.

I was going through some ancient cosmology tomes when I stumbled upon a passage indicating that the prime naaru may have been created by Elune during the great ordering of Light and Shadow.

If Elune did create Xe'ra, then it stands to reason that we could use the Tears of Elune to unlock the secrets of Light's Heart.

Now it falls upon you to recover the Tears of Elune from Val'sharah.

passages.title: Goddess Watch Over You
passages.text: If this works, then perhaps there is still hope for Turalyon and the Army of the Light.

passages.title: One Last Adventure
passages.text:
There is still one last path you may yet walk - one more weapon you might wield.

If you wish to seek it out, just say the word.

passages.title: One Last Adventure
passages.text: So it shall be.

passages.title: Completing Your Arsenal
passages.text:
Highlord, there is still one last weapon out there that would aid you against the Legion.

If you would like, I would be happy to go over our latest information on its whereabouts.

passages.title: Completing Your Arsenal
passages.text: Agreed. We must seek it out at once.

passages.title: The Final Blade
passages.text:
As I'm sure you recall, we have retained our final set of plans to obtain a weapon of immense power.

No pressure, of course, but if you wish to pursue it just let me know.

passages.title: The Final Blade
passages.text: I couldn't agree more.

passages.title: In Pursuit of Power
passages.text:
There is one more pair of blades still within reach that would aid you against the Legion.

If you wish to pursue them, just let me know.

passages.title: In Pursuit of Power
passages.text: Good idea. There is no more dependable ally than a worthy blade.

passages.title: In Pursuit of Power
passages.text:
There is still one other pair of blades that could be of great use to you in the battles to come.

I can brief you on what we know if you would like to pursue them.

passages.title: In Pursuit of Power
passages.text: I think that is wise. We need every weapon we can gather to defeat the Legion once and for all.

passages.title: A Weapon For Every Occasion
passages.text:
Our ally, the Lich King, has offered to provide you with a lead on a final weapon should you desire to maximize our offensive options.

Let me know how you would like to proceed.

passages.title: A Weapon For Every Occasion
passages.text: Very well.

passages.title: The Third Legend
passages.text:
You have not one but TWO powerful artifacts to use against the Legion. But can you imagine a world where you have three? Think of what you could do in such a world!

Shall we look at the possibilities?

passages.title: The Third Legend
passages.text: That was probably the easiest decision you've had to make! Let's get started.

passages.title: Strange Humming Crystal
passages.text: <You place the crystal to your ear and hear the disharmonious din of hundreds of voices speaking at once. Perhaps Khadgar might know more about this strange gem.>

passages.title: Strange Humming Crystal
passages.text:
Such a cacophony! I could hear it before you pulled it from your pack.

What you've got there is a highborne memory crystal, somehow still intact. Created by ancient sorcery, they were used to store memories, stories, music, history, and whatnot.

Quite rare! With a little... tinkering... I should be able to create something useful with it.

passages.title: Enemies Everywhere
passages.text:
Hold a moment, <name>. While I look into this orb of yours, why don't you look into something for me?
