I have long suspected an infiltration of Dalaran but after an embarrassing encounter with a local florist I've withheld my accusations until I'm absolutely certain.

Have you noticed citizens among us that seem just too mundane? Almost inhumanly so? Spies, serving dark masters, watch and wait until our backs are turned. Root them out, but try and keep it quiet.

passages.title: Enemies Everywhere
passages.text: Have you disposed of our friends?

passages.title: Enemies Everywhere
passages.text:
I appreciate your discretion, <name>.

Now, look here! I have imparted all of my substantial worldly wisdom into this globe, in addition to my ruggedly handsome features. No doubt you will find my counsel invaluable in your travels.

I could only get it to say a handful of phrases, however, so be VERY SPECIFIC in your questions.

passages.title: Felspawns of Lothros
passages.text:
These Felspawns are endless! I can't cut them down quickly enough to get to the dreadlord within the mausoleum.

Master Illidan, will you come with me so we can take down Lothros together?

passages.title: Felspawns of Lothros
passages.text: A dreadlord poses little danger to you, eh?

passages.title: Felspawns of Lothros
passages.text: We've done it! Without you, I fear I would have eventually succumbed to the onslaught.

passages.title: One More Legend
passages.text:
Two is good, but three would be better. You should pursue another artifact to add to your armory.

What say you?

passages.title: One More Legend
passages.text: That will definitely increase your power greatly.

passages.title: Anomalous Anomalies
passages.text:
Dalaran's move to this location was intended to be a temporary measure, but we may need to depart sooner than expected.

Blinking a city across the world is no mean feat. The magnitude of energies involved can lead to... unexpected side effects.

Arcane anomalies are causing mischief throughout the city. Their presence could destabilize any attempt to blink again.

We don't have time to let them dissipate on their own, <name>. I have a device that will help speed things along.

passages.title: Anomalous Anomalies
passages.text:
Good work. There are still some stray anomalies floating about, but you've negated enough interference that we should no longer be prevented from relocating the city.

Now we just need to determine our destination.

passages.title: Three Paths, Three Weapons
passages.text:
We've searched and found a lead upon another artifact that you might find helpful.

Here, let me show you what I've found. If it interests you then simply let me know.

passages.title: Three Paths, Three Weapons
passages.text: A wise choice.

passages.title: More Weapons of Old
passages.text:
You've had great success against our foes, but you should be ready for any challenge they send your way.

You would be wise to consider obtaining yet another of the weapons of old to aid in our conflict.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

passages.title: More Weapons of Old
passages.text: A sound choice.

passages.title: Weapons of the Ancients
passages.text:
You've proven yourself to be a druid without equal, but if we are to succeed in our battles against the Burning Legion you need you to take advantage of every opportunity to stay ahead of our foes.

You should consider obtaining one final weapon of the Ancients. Its powers will maximize your ability to adapt to whatever the Legion can throw our way.

Let me know how you'd like to proceed.

passages.title: Weapons of the Ancients
passages.text: A sound choice.

passages.title: In the House of Light and Shadow
passages.text:
The Tears of Elune are ready for you, <name>. I am uncertain what to do from here. Take the relic back to your order hall and try to use it on Light's Heart.

Maybe make them touch? Honestly your guess is as good as mine.

Let's hope this works!

passages.title: In the House of Light and Shadow
passages.text: Any news?

passages.title: In the House of Light and Shadow
passages.text:
Dead? The titans are dead?

<Khadgar ponders the news for a minute.>

It explains so much, yet I cannot help but feel an overwhelming sense of sadness. We have been on our own all along. Our gods killed before we were born.

As for the Army of the Light and Illidan, I am at a loss. I have never felt so powerless.

Illidan is dead and the Golden Army fights an endless war in our name from across the cosmos.

I need a moment, <name>. This is too much bad news for an old man to bear.

passages.title: Brotherly Love
passages.text:
Maiev will be somewhere in the prison. I found her discarded armor on my way here.

I know the two of you have a history. I trust that will not be a problem.

Let's split up to search the cells more quickly. We must find her.

passages.title: Brotherly Love
passages.text:
<Maiev's face is bruised, her lips cracked, and her body covered in scars. She looks thin and ragged, but she moves with purpose.>

For weeks they tried to break me. Amateurs!

I kept my silence. I counted the minutes, measured their steps, and listened to the voices beyond my cell.

I have been waiting for my chance to escape, and to strike back at my captors.

Now, you bring my armor AND my blade. It's your turn to set me free, <class>. Let us destroy the Legion together.

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text:
It is just as we suspected, <name>! The demons thought they could take us by surprise.

Quickly, to arms! Warn the King!

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text: Now is not a good time.

passages.title: Demons Among Them
passages.text: I must admit, you saved us from what might have been a terrible tragedy. You have my gratitude, <class>.

passages.title: Awakenings
passages.text:
Light's Heart is to serve as the vessel for Illidan Stormrage's rebirth: my last act of service to the Light.

But Illidan is dead and his soul is lost in the Nether. Before we may attempt to recover his soul, we must prepare the vessel for his return.

Across two worlds exist echoes of Illidan's past. You must venture out and find the echoes.

Start where all life begins, <name>: birth. Find Illidan's birthplace in Val'sharah. Awaken the memory.

passages.title: Awakenings
passages.text: When our work is complete, I will be lost to the Great Dark.

passages.title: Awakenings
passages.text:
An auspicious start to a life of tragedy. Perhaps one of the few joyous memories Illidan would have in his life. While the years that followed tested the prophesied child, they would never break him. You must remember that, despite what you may see as our journey continues.

There is much more to be done, but I am not yet ready. I will call for you when it is time.

passages.title: Recruiting Earthcallers
passages.text:
Felinda Frye has recently joined us at the Heart of Azeroth. She oversees the recruitment and training of our Earthcallers.

I recommend that you speak with her at your soonest convenience, Farseer <name>. The Earthcallers are powerful shaman and will greatly bolster our ranks.

passages.title: Recruiting Earthcallers
passages.text:
Greetings, Farseer <name>. I have been waiting for you.

The Earthcallers are ready and at your command!

passages.title: An Unclear Path
passages.text:
Much of Illidan's formative years were spent in Val'sharah, alongside his twin brother, Malfurion.

As young night elves, the twins vied for the affection of the young priestess, Tyrande, as they underwent the trials of the demi-god, Cenarius.

We must travel to the Dreamgrove now, where Illidan's true path would be forged.

passages.title: An Unclear Path
passages.text: You mustn't lose hope.

passages.title: An Unclear Path
passages.text: Failure. Rejection. From that day, Illidan would be haunted by both. Ever undaunted, he would continue the search for his destiny. Another path would be found.

passages.title: Second Sight
passages.text:
Though young King Anduin is a noble soul, he may lack the conviction of his father. The Alliance needs a leader who will do what needs to be done. The Legion will strike at the first hint of weakness.

Even now, I sense something amiss, <name>. I fear that not all is as it seems.

Quickly, use your Spectral Sight. We must know if there are foes among us!

passages.title: Second Sight
passages.text: Time is precious.

passages.title: Second Sight
passages.text: Of course the Legion would try to infiltrate this funeral. Having all the leaders of the Alliance gathered in one place at one time... it is too tasty a target for the demons to resist!

passages.title: A Weapon of the Alliance
passages.text:
At first I was unsure whether it was wise to allow the Illidari inside the city. But you may have just saved all our lives.

You may establish a camp in the Mage Quarter. The Alliance will have need of your skills if we are to face the Legion.

Make no mistake though. Should your kind give in to the fel energies you toy with, we will treat you like the demons you are becoming.

passages.title: A Weapon of the Alliance
passages.text:
I trust the young king is safe.

We have more work ahead of us, <class>. Much more.

passages.title: In My Father's House
passages.text:
Most mortals cannot comprehend the truth of the Legion. Those that recognize it, often refuse to accept its meaning. Such knowledge carries a weight that the mortal frame cannot bear. To sacrifice that much of ones self changes the soul.

Among your greatest heroes, a rare few understood that type of sacrifice. Let us witness it through Illidan's eyes.

We must go to Azshara, on the continent of Kalimdor.

passages.title: In My Father's House
passages.text: The vessel is nearly ready to take on the soul.

passages.title: In My Father's House
passages.text: Illidan sought out the truth and was blinded by what he saw. He was beginning to understand his destiny, but there was one final sacrifice that he had yet to make.

passages.title: Fel-Ravaged Tome
passages.text:
Much of the elven writing in the tome has been singed by fel fire.

The head of the curators in Dalaran is renowned for his restoration skills. Perhaps he can treat the tome to bring it back to legibility.

passages.title: Fel-Ravaged Tome
passages.text: Oh, what's this one now?

passages.title: Fel-Ravaged Tome
passages.text:
Ah, the burns can be reversed with the right alchemic tinctures.

How interesting.  A formal Darnassian writing style with... demonic affectations.

I suspect I know who penned this.

passages.title: Waterlogged Tome
passages.text:
In spite of its magical nature, the book has been damaged by water.

The head of the curators in Dalaran is renowned for his abilities. Perhaps he can restore it.

passages.title: Waterlogged Tome
passages.text: What have we here?

passages.title: Waterlogged Tome
passages.text: I would recognize that handwriting anywhere.  This is our own Khadgar's journal!

passages.title: Cursed Tome
passages.text:
Much of the elven writing in the tome has been singed by fel fire.

The head of the curators in Dalaran is renowned for his restoration skills. Perhaps he can treat the tome to bring it back to legibility.

passages.title: Cursed Tome
passages.text: Oh, what's this one now?

passages.title: Cursed Tome
passages.text:
Foul magic wards these texts.

Much stronger than anything I've seen before, but nothing that can't be undone by our mages!

passages.title: Lyana Darksorrow
passages.text:
<Your fellow Illidari, Lyana Darksorrow, floats captive in stasis in front of you; her soul slowly draining into the harvester crystal.>

<In order to release her from stasis, you will need to destroy the soul harvester.>

passages.title: Lyana Darksorrow
passages.text:
<name>, you are a sight for sore eyes. You have my gratitude for releasing me.

I do not know how long I have been held captive... but I sense an overwhelming number of demons nearby.

I have much to do here. Care to join me?

passages.title: Leyline Apprentice
passages.text:
Good work finding those additional leyline feeds.

You seem rather competent - for an outlander.

Allow me to share with you a few secrets about the power of the leylines. This should help you in scavenging more ancient mana from the creatures around Suramar. A grisly task, I know - which is why I leave it to you!

passages.title: Leyline Apprentice
passages.text: Now listen closely.

passages.title: Leyline Proficiency
passages.text:
Our leyline feed grows stronger.

The more powerful our feed becomes, the more I learn about ancient mana itself.

Of course, as my apprentice, you may reap the benefits of my discoveries. Listen well, and I will teach you how to extract power from your enemies more reliably.

passages.title: Leyline Proficiency
passages.text: Do your best to pick this up the first time - I do hate repeating myself.

passages.title: Leyline Master
passages.text:
You surprise me, outlander. During our first lesson about the ancient leylines, I half-expected you to be lost in daydreams of adventure, or treasure or... some such nonsense.

But you have proven an apt student.

Our leyline feed has grown extremely powerful. Watching it grow has taught me a great deal about the arcane, and the nature of mana.

I have one final lesson that will help you find even more ancient mana.

passages.title: Leyline Master
passages.text: Perhaps there is hope for outlanders after all.

passages.title: Call of the Earthen Ring
passages.text:
At last, I've found you!

I have a message from Advisor Sevel.

The Earthen Ring has need of you, Farseer. Please return to the Heart of Azeroth at your soonest convenience. Advisor Sevel is eagerly awaiting your return.

passages.title: Call of the Earthen Ring
passages.text: It is good that you are here, Farseer <name>. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Pressing the Assault
passages.text:
<With this Pillar of Creation safely secured, it is time to take advantage of your momentum and continue onward after the next.>

<You recall that your order has gathered information that would aid you in your journey - looking it over once more before setting off would be wise.>

passages.title: Pressing the Assault
passages.text: <Your order's intel in hand, you are well-prepared for your next assault on the Broken Isles.>

passages.title: Isle Hopping
passages.text:
<Victory in hand, you know there are still Pillars of Creation that must be recovered if the Legion is to be defeated once and for all.>

<Your order has identified uncharted regions of the Broken Isles that still house the remaining Pillars - looking over the information would help focus your next effort.>

passages.title: Scouring What Remains
passages.text:
<Looking around the chamber, you know you are well on your way to gathering all of the Pillars of Creation, but your work is not yet complete.>

<Your order has continued to scour the isles below for anything that might be useful - best to check in with them before embarking once more.>

passages.title: Master of the Isles
passages.text:
<Only one region remains from your order's carefully laid plan to assault the Broken Isles and gather the Pillars of Creation.>

<Victory feels close, but studying your order's intelligence one last time couldn't hurt.>

passages.title: Called to Acherus
passages.text:
Deathlord, your presence has been requested on Acherus.

The war against the Burning Legion rages on and the Knights of the Ebon Blade await further orders.

Please return to Acherus at your soonest convenience. Siouxsie the Banshee is awaiting your return.

passages.title: Called to Acherus
passages.text: You have arrived at last, Deathlord. We have much to discuss.

passages.title: Khadgar's Discovery
passages.text:
Champion! Please come to the Violet Citadel immediately.

I have made a discovery that I would like to share with you before the Council of Six.

passages.title: Khadgar's Discovery
passages.text: Thank you for coming, <name>.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan
passages.text:
Karazhan is now in the hands of the Legion, <name>.

The fault is mine. In my haste to retrieve Alodi's book on the Pillars of Creation, the defenses I put in place to protect the tower were ramshackle at best. The Legion was quick to find a weakness.

Thanks to the time Sargeras spent controlling Medivh, he knows the tower's secrets as well as I do. Whatever the Dark Titan's plan is, we must do everything in our power to stop it.

Come at once! I'll meet you outside Karazhan.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan
passages.text: We have work to do!

passages.title: Finite Numbers
passages.text:
It seems not all the protections I put in place have been defeated. The Legion isn't able to open portals inside or near the tower... at least, not yet.

They appear to be bringing reinforcements in through the catacombs running beneath Deadwind Pass. Disable them and you just might buy us the time we need to drive them out of Karazhan.

passages.title: Finite Numbers
passages.text:
Well done! At least now most of the remaining demons we have to deal with are currently inside the tower.

Couldn't be more than a thousand or two, I'm sure.

passages.title: Seed of Hope
passages.text:
Thalyssra was wise to send you in search of the arcan'dor, though she underestimates its power.

She will learn - as will the others.

But it will take time. And with hunger gnawing at their very souls, the Nightfallen will need your help to survive.

passages.title: Seed of Hope
passages.text: The arcan'dor needs time.

passages.title: Seed of Hope
passages.text: In the changing of seasons, the truth will be revealed.

passages.title: Growing Strong
passages.text:
Magic has long been a vice of the elves. It shaped us, and lifted us out of the darkness - but without balance, it also threatens to unmake us.

The shal'dorei are too proud to admit it, but they are the product of indulgence. They live without harmony.

But I sense potential among the Nightfallen. Losing everything has humbled them. It has made them stronger.

Stay the course, adventurer. Help the Nightfallen rise up.

passages.title: Growing Strong
passages.text: Have you felt it? Change is on the wind.

passages.title: Growing Strong
passages.text: We shall help the shal'dorei find harmony.

passages.title: Redemption for the Fallen
passages.text:
Soon the change of seasons will be upon us, and the Nightfallen will take command of their fate.

You have given them hope, and set them on the path to redemption. They need you now more than ever.

We all do.

passages.title: Redemption for the Fallen
passages.text: There is much to be done.

passages.title: Redemption for the Fallen
passages.text:
Finally, my long lost brethren can return to this world. Elves belong beneath a starry sky - not a conjured one.

Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Honor the Flame
passages.text:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements. The element of fire stirs passion within us all. Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions. But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates. Will you honor the flame with us, <name>?

passages.title: Honor the Flame
passages.text: Honor the Spires of Arak flame.

passages.text:

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates. Will you honor the flame with us, <name>?

passages.text: Honor the Talador flame.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates. Will you honor the flame with us, <name>?

passages.text: Honor the Azsuna flame.

passages.text: Honor the Val'Sharah flame.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates. Will you honor the flame with us, <name>?

passages.title: Honor the Flame
passages.text: Honor the Highmountain flame.

passages.title: Honor the Flame
passages.text:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements. The element of fire stirs passion within us all. Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions. But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence or crushing our enemies into dust!

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates. Will you honor the flame with us, <name>?

passages.title: Honor the Flame
passages.text: Honor the Stormheim flame.

passages.title: Honor the Flame
passages.text:
The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements. The element of fire stirs passion within us all. Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions. But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.

We will honor the flame as tradition dictates. Will you honor the flame with us, <name>?

passages.title: Spicing Things Up
passages.text:
Hey, <name>, it's me, Nomi. You know, from Pandaria?

It's fine if you don't remember, it's been ages since you may have seen me last.

I'm a full-fledged cook now and have been coming up with some of my own creations.

Here, take a sample of some of the recipes and dishes I've been working on.

passages.title: We'll Need Some Obliterum
passages.text:
Loramus Thalipedes has offered to improve our armaments. He says that he pried a secret out of Razelikh. Apparently, the demon knows how to work a material known as Obliterum.

I myself have coerced some information out of the demons. One of the souls trapped in my scythe has whispered the name, Camille Kleister. All I know is that she is somewhere in Dalaran. For the rest, you are on your own.

passages.title: We'll Need Some Obliterum
passages.text: A <class>?

passages.title: Will of the Valarjar
passages.text:
As we prepare to launch an attack on the Legion's own world, it is important to not give reprieve to our enemies in this one.

As your armies seek to secure enemy gateways, you would do well to return to the Broken Isles and carry on the battle against those who stand against you.

passages.title: Will of the Valarjar
passages.text: You've returned, <name>.

passages.title: Will of the Valarjar
passages.text: You've done well.  Our enemies tremble before you and your armies.

passages.title: Ancient Mana
passages.text:
Without the Nightwell to feed upon, my comrades and I will have to live off the land itself.

Ancient mana from the underground leylines can reach the surface in many forms, most commonly as crystals or gems.

<Thalyssra picks up a small stone and, whispering words of power, traces a rune upon it with her fingertip.>

This stone will glow when ancient mana is nearby. Please gather as much as possible! It will be a precious resource in the weeks to come.

passages.title: Ancient Mana
passages.text: We need all the ancient mana we can get. Make sure you know how to find it!

passages.title: Ancient Mana
passages.text: Keep a lookout for those crystal formations all over Suramar. We will need them.

passages.title: Leading by Example
passages.text:
We cannot let our current situation overshadow the Unseen Path's mission to protect the people of Azeroth.

There are many in this world who could use our help.

As our leader, you can set the example by aiding those in need.

passages.title: Leading by Example
passages.text: You are an inspiration to us all, <name>.

passages.title: Unparalleled Power
passages.text:
Power is all around us, <name>, waiting to be harnessed.

You must venture out into the world and claim it for the council!

With our First wielding such unparalleled power, our enemies won't stand a chance.

passages.title: Unparalleled Power
passages.text: The power within you grows, <name>. You will serve the council well.

passages.title: The Might of the Tirisgarde
passages.text: The Tirisgarde has received requests from across the Broken Isles for aid in fighting the Burning Legion. While we will continue pursuing Archmage Vargoth, we cannot forget that our primary mission is to repel the demons and protect Azeroth.

passages.title: The Might of the Tirisgarde
passages.text: Azeroth will burn without our help.

passages.title: The Might of the Tirisgarde
passages.text: Well done, conjuror. With heroes like you at the helm, the Tirisgarde is a force to be reckoned with!

passages.title: Hungry Work
passages.text:
We must get Chief Telemancer Oculeth back on his feet as soon as possible.

Find ancient mana, any way you can, and feed it to him.

passages.title: Hungry Work
passages.text:
Ah, I am feeling much better. Thank you!

Now let us get to work.

passages.title: One Battle at a Time
passages.text:
Before I became a demon hunter, I practiced the arcane arts. I still retain some of that knowledge, though the fel makes it all but impossible to use.

One thing I can still manage is the occasional glimpse into faraway places. You've seen me use the nether crucible to do this. I'm afraid that things don't look too good.

The forces that are arrayed against us are not limited to the Burning Legion. You must act quickly to keep the Broken Isles from being overwhelmed.

passages.title: One Battle at a Time
passages.text:
It would seem that you have done an excellent job of eliminating a great many threats on the Broken Isles.

You never fail to impress me, <name>.

passages.title: Stormheim
passages.text:
It is good we found you, <name>!

Sky Admiral Rogers has sent word for you to meet her in Dalaran. It sounded important. She awaits your presence in the Violet Citadel.

Make haste!

passages.title: Stormheim
passages.text: It's an honor, <name>.

passages.title: Stormheim
passages.text:
It is good we found you, <name>!

Nathanos Blightcaller, Champion of the Banshee Queen herself, sent for you in Dalaran. He made it sound urgent. He should be waiting for you in the Violet Citadel.

Make haste!

passages.title: Stormheim
passages.text:
<Nathanos glances over at you, pausing for a moment before acknowledging your presence.>

Yes?

passages.title: Breaching the Sanctum
passages.text:
It is time. Valtrois is ready to destroy the barrier guarding the breach in the Sanctum. I will teleport you to the breach, then it falls on you to secure the area.

Take these telemancy orbs. If you find you need support, use them to summon Withered.

We must strike before the enemy can ready new defenses. Let me know when you are ready and we will begin.

passages.title: Breaching the Sanctum
passages.text: We've done it! Despite the initial failures, we are still in position to enter the Breach and free our comrades.

passages.title: Breaching the Sanctum
passages.text: I must commend your knack for overcoming adversity. Take your time gathering your fellow champions, <name>, but don't take TOO long!

passages.title: A Call to Action
passages.text:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, a familiar voice fills your mind.>

Champion, I require your aid. It seems Helya has shown her hand.

Steel yourself then come to me.

passages.title: A Call to Action
passages.text: It is good of you to come.

passages.title: Disillusioned Defector
passages.text:
The atmosphere in the city has improved little, but we may find this to our advantage today.

Silgryn asks for you at the Terrace. It seems even Elisande's forces are fleeing before her insanity.

A defector has risen from the ranks and seeks to join our cause.

See that this individual is well received, <name>. We need all the friends we can get during these dark times.

passages.title: Disillusioned Defector
passages.text: Glad you could make it.

passages.title: In the Business of Souls
passages.text:
We will hold our position here while you find and slay the demon responsible for this camp.

Ending Aargoss will not permanently stop this smuggling operation, but it may slow them down long enough for us to find another way to help these people.

Go quickly. He is somewhere atop this ridge.

passages.title: In the Business of Souls
passages.text: Have you dealt with Aargoss?

passages.title: In the Business of Souls
passages.text: Well done. Let us leave before they call in reinforcements.

passages.title: Smuggled!
passages.text:
Please get me out of here!

The bars are brittle but I am so weak...

The others! There are so many others! Please help us!

passages.title: Smuggled!
passages.text: Thank you. We had no hope of rescue before you came along.

passages.title: Full Might of the Elves
passages.text:
Thalyssra managed to get all 3 to agree to the same thing? I am impressed with her skills of negotiation.

Alright hero, Liadrin is already marching on Suramar. Join her forces.

Tyrande will flank the city defenders and meet you deeper in.

The Nightborne will bring up the rear and hold the territory for us.

Oculeth and I will move the Kirin Tor forces to Astravar Harbor. With luck, we shall see you on the other side.

passages.title: Full Might of the Elves
passages.text: All this running is exhausting.

passages.title: Full Might of the Elves
passages.text: The telemancy traps you placed prior to the battle are doing wonders for reducing our losses.

passages.title: Staging Point
passages.text:
That is quite a corridor you and our allies have punched through the city. It will be difficult to hold but it will cut a wedge in Elisande's forces.

Oculeth has been busy redirecting a telemancy beacon to this location but wanted to give you the honor of activating it.

passages.title: Staging Point
passages.text: Has the beacon been activated.

passages.title: Staging Point
passages.text:
Well done, hero. With this as our staging ground, our forces have a clear shot at the city gates.

Thalyssra has ordered her rebels to secure our location and cover our rear flank.

Once we have our siege vehicles in place we should be ready to assault the city.

passages.title: Tyrande's Command
passages.text:
Shal'aran is bursting at the seams with refugees and rebels. We practically have an army now but not enough weapons or mana to keep everyone armed and un-withered.

And in all of this, Tyrande has a battery of requests I simply do not have the time to deal with.

Will you go to her? Her growing army is hard to miss in Meredil.

passages.title: Tyrande's Command
passages.text: The Nightfallen insisted on being a part in this conflict. There is more work to be done than people we have.

passages.title: Essence Triangulation
passages.text:
Vanthir... an example! That certainly explains why Elisande chose to hold him this long.

We need to move quickly. I can track him, but I will need to find places where his Arcane Essence is strongest.

This will not be an easy feat, not in a city this old, but with any luck there are a few places important enough to him that he left a little bit of himself behind.

We should start in the promenade- he often visited it for business.

passages.title: Essence Triangulation
passages.text: Did you find them?

passages.title: Essence Triangulation
passages.text: All that remains is to focus on his essence to isolate his location. Good work.

passages.title: On Public Display
passages.text:
Now that I have identified Vanthir's essence from the multitude of Suramar's citizens, it may be that I can find his exact location.

I believe you'll recall a similar ritual with our friend Theryn. Do not worry- there will be less screaming this time. Hopefully.

Come. Let us find our missing tavernkeeper.

passages.title: On Public Display
passages.text: I need to maintain complete focus.

passages.title: On Public Display
passages.text: That was... difficult... but I am glad we succeeded.

passages.title: Sign of the Dusk Lily
passages.text:
Simply... astounding.

I have not felt this clear of mind in so long.

I am still weak... I need to rest. But first...

<Vanthir gestures to the top of his cage with a trembling hand.>

Show them that the Dusk Lily triumphs this day.

passages.title: Sign of the Dusk Lily
passages.text:
I will see that he is made comfortable next chance I get. We made a great stride forward today, <name>.

Elisande will not soon forget that we do not simply abandon our own.

passages.title: What's the Cache?
passages.text:
We're here for a cache of gunpowder. It seems to have been infused with some sort of fel power... it's extremely reactive. One of the leaders of the pirate forces here currently has it.

Master Gunner Prix should be toward the back of the cove, near the water. Take what we need from her.

passages.title: What's the Cache?
passages.text: Did you get the gunpowder?

passages.title: What's the Cache?
passages.text: This gunpowder is the key to my plan. Right good work retrieving it.

passages.title: Demon in Disguise
passages.text:
While you were... working your magic on that demon, I was able to make headway in distilling the corrupted essences down to a simpler, more manageable form.

I've asked Khadgar to provide you with the concoction once he's had a look, but I must remind you - these essences are quite potent, often dangerous if not handled with the utmost of care.

Speak with Khadgar when you are ready to begin.

passages.title: Demon in Disguise
passages.text: The samples have proven to be quite helpful along with your... influence.

passages.title: Backup Plan
passages.text:
Dalaran may appear to be just a floating city, but it is actually our most powerful magical weapon. It will take time to repair the arcane defenses - time the Legion will use to their great advantage.

It is imperative to come up with an interim plan, and quickly! 

Archmage Kalec is very knowledgeable about this sort of thing. Perhaps you should consult with him?

passages.title: Backup Plan
passages.text: Hmm. An interesting challenge!

passages.title: A Celestial Invitation
passages.text:
Greetings, mortal.

For many years I have continued my observation of this planet. The halls of Ulduar have been hollow and silent, save for the occasional clattering whisper from the darkness. I grew so very bored of it!

Thus, I have taken up this "pet battling" you seem so fond of. Truly, an amusing pastime that will sustain my mind for many centuries!

I have been amassing my collection, scouring the stars for tiny beings of cosmic power. Come, let us do battle once more!

passages.title: A Celestial Invitation
passages.text: Greetings, mortal. Do you wish to engage in a battle of the tiny minions?

passages.title: A Celestial Invitation
passages.text: Ah, quite the breath of fresh solar winds. Take this, my favorite constellation, may it remind you of the watchers that watch over us all.

passages.title: Nyell's Workshop
passages.text:
From what I've overheard, this is Master Artificer Nyell's workshop. His skills in construct creation are unparalleled! 

What a shame that he swore fealty to the Legion. I hate to destroy such a renowned craftsman, but we have no choice.

If you are lucky, he might even have a spare shield generator sitting around.

passages.title: Nyell's Workshop
passages.text: Were you successful?

passages.title: Nyell's Workshop
passages.text: That is one less Legion supporter we need to worry about. Oh, and you found a shield generator too? Wonderful!

passages.title: Secrets of the Shal'dorei
passages.text:
This workshop includes an extensive library of rare scrolls written by my people. We all benefit by sharing information, do you not agree? 

Perhaps if we bring back such a treasure trove the Tirisgarde will be more welcoming towards me and my kind...

Please gather whatever you can.

passages.title: Secrets of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: Have you found some scrolls?

passages.title: Secrets of the Shal'dorei
passages.text: Few texts written by the ancient shal'dorei remain. I am sure the Tirisgarde's librarians will be thrilled with these!

passages.title: A Threat Rises
passages.text:
It is time I told you another tale. While you listen, would you be so kind as to pour me some grog? I've grown a terrible thirst.

The keg is very old and the tap is a bit slow.

passages.title: A Threat Rises
passages.text: I've told you my tale, but did you bring the grog?

passages.title: A Threat Rises
passages.text:
Delicious, thank you.

Before we act, we must gather more information onto what Helya is planning.

passages.title: The Peak of Bones
passages.text:
While you were gone, we strategized what to do with the harness. We can utilize its power to bind the spirits of deceased drakes to you, raising them under your will as loyal soldiers.

I sent Minerva to Thorim's Peak in Stormheim, where she has found a brood of deceased Thorignir. They will be prime targets.

Speak to Grimwing for a flight to the mountain, then Minerva will fill you in.

passages.title: The Peak of Bones
passages.text: Finally you're here, Deathlord. I've been waiting so long I could've died again.

passages.title: The Council's Call
passages.text:
<The Council of Six has sought your aid against a 'great threat'.>

<If they have turned their focus on something outside of the demon hordes pouring out of the Tomb of Sargeras, it must be truly dangerous.>

<But how does the object you found on the Broken Shore fit into all of this? You know only that the Council awaits at the Violet Citadel.>

passages.title: From Bones They Rise
passages.text:
Alright, the job is to get the broodmother under our control. But hear me out. A few more drakes would be a boon, right?

While we're here, why don't we use our awesome power over undeath to raise some of her brood as well? Although the peak has claimed their corpses for the ice, I'm sure the embrace of undeath will be much more welcoming. We must find their frozen corpses and breathe your will into them.

passages.title: From Bones They Rise
passages.text: Have you granted the drakes their unbirth?

passages.title: From Bones They Rise
passages.text: I could feel their energy, even in undeath.

passages.title: Holding the Ramparts
passages.text:
With their ground presence weakened the Legion has retaliated with additional forces.

Our allies managed to track several of these demons to the skies above Black Rook. I fear they intend to establish a foothold.

Take this hippogryph and scout the ramparts. Should this fear become a reality I ask that you deal with the threat swiftly.

passages.title: Holding the Ramparts
passages.text: Any word?

passages.title: Holding the Ramparts
passages.text: Our victory here is well deserved. With their forces subdued we can press our attacks to the forward camp and the monstrosity on the horizon.

passages.title: Trial by Demonfire
passages.text:
We are out of time. I have reports that a pitlord has come to Meredil. 

I have dispatched a strike force. We cannot let this demon flank our army here, nor can we let him find Shal'Aran. It is time to temper these recruits in a real battle.

Join our forces in Meredil, engage the demon, and help us ensure this new army of ours is not lost in its first conflict.

passages.title: Trial by Demonfire
passages.text: Well done. Sometimes a single victory is enough to bring an army together. With time, these recruits shall train others, and we can grow our army to many times this size.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Master of the House
passages.text:
Inside the pocket watch is a worn note.

"The next affair will take place in Morgan's Plot, it will cause quite a stir! The following guests will be in attendance:

Lord Ference, his preferred vintage is red.
Baroness Millstipe, she will only attend on the promise of cheese. Strange woman.
Baron Dreuger, a ravenous soul, any well spiced meat should keep him happy.

As always, I shall ring the bell should I need you.

- Medivh"

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Master of the House
passages.text: What do you have there?

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Master of the House
passages.text: Wonderful, you brought dinner! Moroes was worried he would let his master down.

passages.title: Waning Refuge
passages.text:
We have done all we can here.

Let us get everyone into the boat and get out while we still can.

We have bought time for the others but nothing more.

passages.title: Waning Refuge
passages.text: These people owe their lives to your bravery. They will not forget the risks we have taken for them.

passages.title: In Dire Need
passages.text:
The ill tidings you bear only increase the concerns the Council has been having.

I know you have your hands full with the Tomb of Sargeras. Make no mistake, the battle for the tomb remains our top priority--but we must not think the Legion foolish enough to rely on brute force alone. They are far more cunning than that.

Please, hear us out.

passages.title: In Dire Need
passages.text: So what do you say? Up for a challenge?

passages.title: Temporal Investigations
passages.text:
I knew the shal'dorei dabbled in time magic, but this is simply incredible...

Elisande stopped time on our entire army!

Come, let us investigate. Perhaps there is a way to break the spell - or at least discover how it is being maintained.

passages.title: Temporal Investigations
passages.text: We got lucky that time, but trying again could risk all our lives for nothing. We must find another way.

passages.title: Wisp in the Willows
passages.text:
Wisps are the spirits of our Night elven brethren who have become one with the forest. But their minds and the way they perceive things are very different than in life.

You should bond with this little one. See through its eyes as it travels to the hidden pools and grows some trees.

passages.title: Citizens' Army
passages.text:
I can barely get these civilians to stand in a straight line.

They are untrained, undisciplined, and underarmed.

Still, they need to be ready for the real battle.

Khadgar suggested we try some field training at the ruins of Black Rook Hold in Val'sharah. The risen forces of Lord Ravencrest apparently remember how to fight.

Go, hero, and I will send some trainees to support you.

passages.title: Citizens' Army
passages.text:
The trainees you helped cannot seem to stop talking about your fighting prowess. Already they are passing along what you taught them.

I appreciate your help in this.

passages.title: We Need Weapons
passages.text:
So many of the rebels want to help in the coming battle. Our people have the will, they lack only the means.

They need weapons.

From what Khadgar has told me, the fortress of Black Rook has plenty of munitions we could use.

Travel to the fortress and place these beacons on some weapon caches there. Once placed, I can teleport them back.

passages.title: We Need Weapons
passages.text: How goes the search?

passages.title: We Need Weapons
passages.text: These weapons should prove quite useful in the coming conflict. Well done, hero.

passages.title: Taking a Promenade
passages.text:
These people are foreign to us, despite our common heritage. They have changed much in the years they have been cloistered away.

We need to learn more about them, what they are capable of. We dispatched one of our scouts to infiltrate the Promenade and assess the defenses. The blood elves did the same, although I doubt their ability to be discreet.

Both are long past due for reporting back to us. Find them and make sure they are safe or at least did not die in vain.

passages.title: Taking a Promenade
passages.text: It is good to know that they are alive. Their knowledge will be valuable in the coming siege.

passages.title: Scouting the Breach
passages.text:
If Ly'leth's information is accurate, there is a breach in the Sanctum of Order that could be our only way into the Nighthold.

No doubt they have magically sealed it - take Valtrois and protect her while she examines the seal. She is an exceptional talent, and I have total faith in her ability to break whatever enchantment they have cooked up.

Valtrois has her own methods of getting into the city and will meet you inside the Sanctum of Order.

passages.title: Scouting the Breach
passages.text:
It appears Ly'leth was correct. This is an entrance to the Nightwell - and it is well protected. Nothing is impenetrable though.

Let us have a look at the ley lines powering this shield, shall we?

passages.title: Shield, Meet Spell
passages.text:
There you have it, one arcane nullifier! Using their weapon and magical signatures to cloak the spell, it should tear apart the shield as good as any spellbreaker would.

Go teach that amateur spellslinger what it means to wage war against the sin'dorei!

passages.title: Shield, Meet Spell
passages.text: The nullifier should do most of the work for you. Just watch out for his offensive magic!

passages.title: Shield, Meet Spell
passages.text: Good. With him out of the way we will be able to establish a stronger foothold once the main force arrives.

passages.title: Crystal Clearing
passages.text:
This portal is a problem. With it they can summon countless reserves.

The crystals nearby seem to be powering the gate. If we destroy those, we can set them back significantly.

passages.title: Crystal Clearing
passages.text: Nice work. They will not be opening that portal again any time soon.

passages.title: Powering Down the Portal
passages.text:
Destroying the crystals will stop them temporarily, but it will be meaningless if we do not deal with the person controlling the portal itself.

I heard their overseer, Ingra, shouting orders for more power so that she could bring the stronger Legion lieutenants through the gate. We must stop her to truly seal the portal for good.

passages.title: Powering Down the Portal
passages.text: A portal that big will not be reopening any time soon. I would say that counts as weakening their defenses.

passages.title: Break An Arm
passages.text:
The insurgents you marshaled gave me some bad news, <name>.

The arcanists loyal to Elisande have reactivated the Arm of the Magistrix. The most powerful construct ever attempted, it raged out of control and decimated an entire district before it was disabled. Truly they must be desperate to turn it against us.

The scouts have spotted it in the Crimson Thicket to the north. We cannot allow it to reach full power if we are to succeed.

passages.title: Break An Arm
passages.text: We must destroy the Arm!

passages.title: Break An Arm
passages.text: We almost lost the invasion before we could begin. Good work.

passages.title: Recruitment Drive
passages.text:
Helya's kvaldir have been raiding Azeroth's coasts for centuries, and many worthy vrykul who were destined to become my Valarjar were stolen. 

Now that their cursed queen is defeated, the souls held captive in Helheim can finally be freed to join us!

Go to Helheim with Aerylia. I assure you she will bring you back safely.

passages.title: Recruitment Drive
passages.text: Keep your wits about you, <name>. There are many here who will attempt to steal your soul.

passages.title: Arming the Army
passages.text:
The recent battles have greatly depleted our supplies, and we will need arms for our new Valarjar. 

The kvaldir have an abundance of weapons, armor, and other spoils from their raiding stockpiled in stolen crates. 

Confiscate whatever you can!

passages.title: Arming the Army
passages.text: Did you find any supplies we can use in Helheim <name>?

passages.title: Arming the Army
passages.text: Good. These will be invaluable in the coming battles.

passages.title: Liadrin's Command
passages.text:
Shal'Aran is bursting at the seams with refugees and rebels. We practically have an army now but not enough weapons or mana to keep everyone armed and un-withered.

And in all of this, Lady Liadrin has a battery of requests I simply do not have the time to deal with.

Will you go to her? Her growing army is hard to miss in Meredil.

passages.title: Liadrin's Command
passages.text:
I can relate to Thalyssra's frustration.

I remember when I launched my first offensive. I swear I didn't eat or sleep for a week.

passages.title: Arming the Rebels
passages.text:
The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages.

Victoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals, but could use an experienced hand.

Go to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. I want those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.

passages.title: Arming the Rebels
passages.text: Every member of the Duskwatch has had centuries to perfect their fighting techniques. We do not have that much time to get these rebels in to fighting shape.

passages.title: Arming the Rebels
passages.text:
The Nightfallen rebellion is growing in number, but they have not fought a real war in ages.

Victoire and Silgryn are doing their best to train the new arrivals and could use an experienced hand.

Go to them and show them some of the skills in battle you have picked up in your travels. We need those Nightfallen ready for battle when the time comes.

passages.title: Arming the Rebels
passages.text: Every member of the Duskwatch has had centuries to perfect their fighting techniques. We do not have that much time to get these rebels in to fighting shape.

passages.title: Butler to the Great
passages.text: A ghostly dinner party awaits, ready for the spread and its dinner guests.

passages.title: Butler to the Great
passages.text: I can't believe it's finally over.

passages.title: Mouths to Feed
passages.text:
We have rescued many refugees, as you can see. Unfortunately this has revealed a new problem.

The arcan'dor fruit is our salvation, but it does not bear enough fruit right now to cure everyone. We must rely on mana a little longer to tide the refugees over.

Valtrois thinks that she may have a solution. Please go speak with her and see what she plans to do.

passages.title: Mouths to Feed
passages.text: It is good to see you. I could use a helping hand.

passages.title: Oculeth Ex Machina
passages.text:
I have a plan to feed Shal'Aran.

Now that I am no longer starving for mana I have had time to study ley lines in new regions. I detected an eddy of mana in the ley lines of Azsuna. I have plenty of magic at my disposal, but we must visit the ley line in person in order to properly redirect the energy to Shal'Aran.

Oculeth has graciously offered to teleport us there, but I could use an assistant. Care to join me?

passages.title: Oculeth Ex Machina
passages.text: That was a little terrifying. Sometimes I am not entirely sure that Oculeth knows what he is doing.

passages.title: Unbeleyvable
passages.text:
Back to the task at hand!

Take these ley line taps. We can use the resonant energies to properly redirect the flow, but they must be placed in precise locations. I will show you where.

Your friend has agreed to... "supervise" us. Let us hope she just stays out of the way while the professionals take care of this.

passages.title: Unbeleyvable
passages.text: This ley line energy will not move itself. We must give it encouragement.

passages.title: Unbeleyvable
passages.text: That was more infuriating than it should have been. At least her natural talents mostly matched my calculations...

passages.title: The Art of Flow
passages.text:
All done, <name>! We have but one more step and Shal'Aran will have all the mana it needs.

Now that I have better access to the ley line below I can break the pool so that it will flow through properly. Given the chaotic state of this ley line it will require all of my concentration to redirect the energy.

I must warn you that we will attract attention while I am doing this. You will need to protect me while I complete the process.

Speak to me when you are ready.

passages.title: The Art of Flow
passages.text: This ritual will shake the pool of energy loose, allowing it to flow through the ley line unimpeded.

passages.title: The Art of Flow
passages.text: It is done. Shal'Aran will have no want of mana now.

passages.title: A Dance With Dragons
passages.text:
I must say I am impressed, <name>.

You and your friend were able to fix a ley line, and you are not even dragons!

You both seem exhausted by this ordeal. Allow me to help you get back home.

passages.title: A Dance With Dragons
passages.text: That is quite the adventure you had. Thankfully we now have plenty of mana for the refugees. Thank you, <name>.

passages.title: Shipwrecked Survivors
passages.text:
It appears that we have allies here on the Broken Shore.

A small band of shipwrecked soldiers have been surviving here since the first assault. Their strength and tenacity will bolster our ranks.

Make your way to their encampment along the beach and bring them here. Tell them that reinforcements have arrived, and the battle against the Burning Legion waits for no one.

passages.title: Aviana's Grace
passages.text:
If this was only the distraction, where is the main force? Who else is under attack? We need to figure out who else is in danger! Aviana should know, she's got eyes everywhere.

Let's go ask her. We should be able to contact her in the back room.

passages.title: Aviana's Grace
passages.text: Nature is in dire need, mortal. You must fix it.

passages.title: Resource Management
passages.text:
Now that you possess Helya's Horn, the kvaldir are yours to command. We may as well put them to good use for a change. 

I've dispatched my Val'kyr, Danica, to the Broken Shore. She has identified a few Legion targets that should be eliminated.

Aerylia will send you there when you are ready to leave.

passages.title: Resource Management
passages.text: Good to see you made it, Battlelord <name>!

passages.title: Arms: The Thieving Apprentice
passages.text:
The Focusing Iris has been stolen from the Dalaran Vaults! The thief was a mage of some skill, but we've been unable to track him.

Fortunately, the thief dropped a note from his master, addressing him as one of his "apprentici." I know of only one mage who uses that particular pluralization - Archmage Xylem.

I'll need you to investigate. In Azshara you will find his tower where he trains his apprentices. Go there, and see what Xylem is up to.

Specialization: Arms Warrior

passages.title: Arms: The Thieving Apprentice
passages.text:
So someone stole the Focusing Iris and you suspect Xylem might be the culprit? You may be right. 

It is no secret that the archmage has been seeking artifacts of late. However, after the discovery of an ancient grimoire in the Legashi ruins, Xylem has become... unstable. I fear the grimoire may be stealing his mind.

I can help you gain audience with the archmage.  With any luck, you can reclaim the Iris peacefully.

passages.title: 99.0 [reuse me]
passages.text: 99.0 [reuse me]

passages.title: A Message From Our Enemies
passages.text:
<name>! The messages from Ly'leth we traced throughout the Terrace - we could not have known at the time, but somebody was watching.

This crystal was delivered by a courier early this morning. <Pointing to the crystal by her side.>

I am afraid the message contained within is not for the faint of heart. It has not been shown to anyone else, but you deserve to see it for all you have done for us.

passages.title: A Message From Our Enemies
passages.text: We have no time to waste.

passages.title: A Message From Our Enemies
passages.text:
I do not know what lies in store for us, but we cannot sit idly while Ly'leth is missing.

We must act now!

passages.title: A Challenge From Our Enemies
passages.text:
Make no mistake. This message cannot be taken lightly. Any threat made against our people will be dealt with swiftly.

We must travel to the estate at once to discover what has become of Ly'leth.

passages.title: A Challenge From Our Enemies
passages.text:
The withered... defeated so easily.

We must find a way to negate the magic of the felborne. We cannot afford to fight if our own can be turned against us.

passages.title: Lone Wolf
passages.text:
My eyes and ears fly across Azeroth, bringing me back news of many things. My ally Goldrinn took to the barrows of Moonglade in mourning upon the death of Varian Wrynn. He has been untouched in the dream... until now.

Demons have been seen invading the very same barrows, killing many more of our mortal druids in the process. You must go. Save Goldrinn, avenge our people! Take my hatchling Thisalee with you. Her tenacity and bloodlust is welcome in my clutch. You shall have my aid.

passages.title: Lone Wolf
passages.text: If Goldrinn is in the Dream, he's defenseless! We've got to help!

passages.title: The Archmage Accosted
passages.text:
With the barrier dispelled, Archmage Xylem is finally within reach!

Hopefully he'll be cooperative in returning the Iris...

passages.title: The Archmage Accosted
passages.text:
It is as I feared, the archmage is beyond reason... and now he is beyond reach.

You have done a great thing here, freeing his apprentices from his corruption, but this fight is not over yet.

passages.title: A Familiar Axe to Grind
passages.text:
The construction of this blade feels familiar, but you can't quite recall where you may have seen something like it before.

Perhaps someone at Chiselgrip might know more about its construction.

passages.title: A Familiar Axe to Grind
passages.text:
Oh aye! I know the make of that chopper.

Tha master who made it also created the famous Bleakwood Hew. You may 'ave heard of it.

An' it just so happens I know how to make the hew too!

passages.title: Something's Not Quite Right...
passages.text:
Something is troubling me, champion.

Beyond these simple japes, the Kirin Tor has had to break up a few fights between the elves. I am worried something - or someone - might be influencing them.

Your disguise was made by the nightborne, yes? It is not unreasonable to assume they can do something similar.

Fortunately, Thalyssra has told me much about how the illusion works, and I believe this crystal can remove their disguise.

Why don't you check the camps, just to be safe?

passages.title: Something's Not Quite Right...
passages.text: Were you able to find the instigators?

passages.title: Something's Not Quite Right...
passages.text: It is as I feared. Hopefully they will think twice before sending more spies.

passages.title: REUSE
passages.text:
<Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you timidly. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>

passages.title: Dances With Ravenbears (UNUSED)
passages.text:
<The chieftain beckons for the ravenbears to gather the tribute and gestures toward the ritual circle outside.>

Caw! Caw ca-caw!

<It looks like he wants you to follow.>

passages.title: Aura of Uncertainty
passages.text: We may not know the Legion's intent just yet, but after analyzing your findings we will know soon enough.

passages.title: Aura of Uncertainty
passages.text: Have all the information you need?

passages.title: Aura of Uncertainty
passages.text: The time has come, <name>.

passages.title: Raising Your Snowfeather
passages.text: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you timidly. It appears to be looking to you to help it survive and grow.>

passages.title: Raising Your Snowfeather
passages.text: Erk?

passages.title: Raising Your Snowfeather
passages.text: <The hatchling seems to trust you a bit more now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: The Smell of Humans
passages.text: <You've noticed that your snowfeather hatchling shakes whenever humans are nearby. It appears to be utterly terrified of them. Perhaps you could take it somewhere with a lot of humans, so that it can get used to the smell.>

passages.title: The Smell of Humans
passages.text: <Your snowfeather hatchling looks at you uncertainly.>

passages.title: The Smell of Humans
passages.text: <The hatchling seems to be more comfortable around the sights and sounds of a human city. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Visitor in Shal'Aran
passages.text:
Someone came to Shal'Aran while you were in the City. She asked for you specifically.

I did not recognize her face, nor her voice, but she seemed trustworthy and earnest.

She is just outside the cavern. Meet with her and determine her purpose for coming here.

passages.title: Visitor in Shal'Aran
passages.text:
She looked good. The Arcan'dor truly is a miracle for our people.

She is a welcome ally in the fight to come. Silgryn will take good care of her.

passages.text: <Your bloodgazer hatchling looks wary of your critter pets.>

passages.title: Hunting Lesson: Felspider
passages.text: <The hatchling looks much more at ease around insects now. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Skorpyron
passages.text: <Your bloodgazer hatchling growls and hisses at large beasts, seemingly without concern for its own safety. It will need to learn to rely on numbers to keep it safe. Showing it an epic example of teamwork against a great beast might help.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Skorpyron
passages.text: <Your bloodgazer hatchling looks to you for guidance.>

passages.title: Teamwork Lesson: Skorpyron
passages.text: <The hatchling chews on a fragment of the great scorpion thoughtfully. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Sharptalon Team Rumble
passages.text: <Your sharptalon hatchling looks ready to team up with you for another round of battles and show off everything it has learned about teamwork. Commanding it with new allies would be an excellent test of its abilities.>

passages.title: Sharptalon Team Rumble
passages.text: <Your sharptalon hatchling is ready to go!>

passages.title: Sharptalon Team Rumble
passages.text: <The hatchling looks worn out, and spends quite a few minutes drinking after the victory. It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Bloodgazer Team Rumble
passages.text: <Your bloodgazer hatchling looks ready to team up with you for another round of battles and show off everything it has learned about teamwork. Commanding it with new allies would be an excellent test of its abilities.>

passages.title: Bloodgazer Team Rumble
passages.text: <Your bloodgazer hatchling is ready to go!>

passages.title: Bloodgazer Team Rumble
passages.text: <The hatchling looks quite full. What did it eat? It will need some time to recover from this adventure.>

passages.title: Sharptalon Reunion
passages.text: <Your sharptalon hatchling has not been eating recently. It seems to be depressed. Perhaps it is time to return it to its place of origin?>

passages.title: Bloodgazer Reunion
passages.text: <Your bloodgazer hatchling refuses to drink. It seems to be depressed. Perhaps it is time to return it to its place of origin?>

passages.title: Answers Unknown
passages.text:
Have you noticed a change in Jubeka's demeanor? I know she's not the warmest of warlocks, but I fear she's been more withdrawn than usual.

I imagine her mind lingers on Kanrethad, the council's one-time leader. Jubeka was steadfast in her commitment to keeping him banished, until the Burning Legion took her as their prisoner.

His fate is unknown, and it's clearly troubling our friend. The last thing she said to me, was that she felt his presence in Azsuna. Don't let her travel this path alone.

passages.title: Answers Unknown
passages.text:
Shinfel should not have told you of my suspicions. This is my burden to bear.

Nevertheless, I am glad you are here. It would seem my fears are founded.

passages.title: Cult Culling
passages.text:
The lure of Kanrethad is strong. Even when not in this world, there are those who wish to be near him at any cost, hoping to share in his power.

A group of these fanatics are here in Faronaar, working tirelessly to bring Kanrethad back, I've learned as much from my prisoner.

We cannot let them succeed, <name>. Find their compound and kill as many of them as you can.

I will remain here and see what else I can learn about their intentions.

passages.title: Cult Culling
passages.text: Can it be true? Does some sliver of my friend remain within that wretched demon?

passages.title: To the Broken Shore
passages.text:
It would seem that Kanrethad's twisted followers have begun their ritual on the Broken Shore.

We must act quickly. The Burning Legion cannot be allowed to use Kanrethad as their weapon.

We have acolytes on standby, ready to perform a ritual of summoning on the Broken Shore when you're ready.

passages.title: To the Broken Shore
passages.text: You're here, Netherlord! Quickly, there's no time to lose!

passages.title: The Fate of Kanrethad
passages.text:
I can feel his presence, Netherlord! Kanrethad is here! His followers have set up camp in the nearby pass, and are performing the ritual to bring him back as we speak.

Quickly, take the fel crystals. Arrange them in a circle around Kanrethad.

If placed correctly, the crystals should link together and begin to siphon the fel energy.

Now go, before it's too late!

passages.title: The Fate of Kanrethad
passages.text: We cannot allow the Burning Legion to take control of Kanrethad.

passages.title: The Fate of Kanrethad
passages.text:
I have lived with a heavy heart since the day I fulfilled my promise to banish Kanrethad. I never thought I'd live to see the day he would be returned to us.

I thank you, Netherlord. You have lifted the burden of guilt from my shoulders, and in doing so, prevented the Legion from gaining control of one of our own.

passages.title: Fire the Cannons!
Asgrim the Dreadkiller
Weapon No More
passages.text:
The spear you found certainly has the makings of troll designs from other blacksmithing crafts.

Perhaps somebody at one of the camps here in Un'Goro will know more about it.

passages.title: Weapon No More
passages.text:
Ay mon, whatcha got der in your hands?

Dat be da Darkspear! Ya found it?!

passages.title: Infiltration Plans
passages.text:
While the text is hard to follow and covered in demonic runes, it appears to be plans to infiltrate Dalaran. The Council of the Six will want to see this. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45050))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45050))");

passages.title: Reverse Blacksmithing
passages.text:
And 'ere I thought I'd never see dis ting again!

Although, it don't look like it used to. Aw mon, I'm gonna be in big trouble if I show up wit dis in my hand.

Do ya tink you could help me fix it? I don't have da plans for it, cause you see, da first night I spent here, da creatures came up and stole all me tings.

But whadd'ya say? Help a bruddah out?

I tink if you can figure out what it's made from, den you can fix it and I can write down da details on how it's made.

passages.title: Reverse Blacksmithing
passages.text: You're a life saver, bruddah! I'll be forever in your debt after dis.

passages.title: Reverse Blacksmithing
passages.text: Dem's some mighty fine materials dat was made of. No wonda' da boss wants it so bad.

passages.title: Depleted Nether Crystal
passages.text:
This crystal looks like something used in rituals of dark magic. Given that its energy is depleted, whoever this belongs to must have been successful in whatever ritual they were performing.

The mages of the Kirin Tor would likely be interested in investigating this. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45052))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45052))");

passages.title: Thief's Instructions
passages.text:
The hastily scrawled note reads:

"I require the Focusing Iris for one of my spells. Show that you are truly the greatest of my apprentici and fetch it for me.

Oh, and make sure you don't leave this note lying around for some adventurer to find!"

If someone is looking to steal the Focusing Iris, the Kirin Tor will likely want to know. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45053))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45053))");

passages.title: "Ancient" Elven War Orders
passages.text:
These orders look official and bear the Ravencrest sigil, but they are far too new. There is also a hint of fel magic glimmering around the sides.

The Council of Six would be interested in seeing this. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45054))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45054))");

passages.title: Noressa
passages.text:
She is still in there, <name>. Noressa, my wife.

She is in the Promenade while we wait outside, preparing to strike. Who knows what has happened to her?

Please, friend, I fear the worst. Tell her there is hope outside.

We had a small house in the south of the Grand Promenade, by the water gardens. She will probably be there during this madness.

passages.title: Noressa
passages.text: You must find her!

passages.title: Noressa
passages.text: I cannot possibly thank you enough. We will be reunited, and I will see we are never separated again.

passages.title: Saving My Head
passages.text:
Seeing as how you're a blacksmith, I figured it'd be best if ya made da spear. You can use dis forge here to do what ya need to to do.

I'll start writin' down what ya do and den we'll have us both da spear and da recipe!

passages.title: Saving My Head
passages.text: Dis is probably da luckiest day of me life.

passages.title: Saving My Head
passages.text:
Dat's it, mon! Ya did it!

I tink before I head off back to da Isles, I'll be making a few extra copies of dees plans, just in case.

I'll make ya a copy too, in case I be needing your help wit' making another one.

passages.title: Fel Infused Totem Fragment
passages.text:
This appears to be a fragment of a relic or totem from Highmountain. It glows eerily with fel power. This should be brought to the Council of Six in Dalaran at once! 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45059))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45059))");

passages.title: Damaged Kirin Tor Insignia
passages.text:
Whether it was lost or stolen, it is odd that a demon would possess an insignia of the Kirin Tor. 

The Council of Six would no doubt be interested in this finding. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45060))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45060))");

passages.title: Scrolls of the Faldrottin
passages.text:
While it is definitely odd that a demon would carry a scroll of vrykul writings, what is even more interesting are the contents. 

The writings appear to reference a vrykul prophesy of one who would unite the Tideskorn against the Burning Legion. This information should be brought to the Council of Six immediately. 
 See if you've already completed this by typing:

 /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45061))
 WH.clickToCopy(document.currentScript.parentNode, "\/run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(45061))");

passages.title: The Felsoul Experiments
passages.text:
Andaris's control over the withered poses a real threat. If we are to increase the withered's resistance against these effects, we must do so in an environment built from this very magic.

Head for Felsoul Hold at once. When you arrive, I will send withered to aide in your efforts. It is of the utmost importance you do not leave until you are certain the experiments yield the appropriate results.

passages.title: The Felsoul Experiments
passages.text: Making progress I assume?

passages.title: The Felsoul Experiments
passages.text: The withered seem to be adapting quite well.

passages.title: Telemantic Expanse
passages.text:
Understanding fel magic alone may not be enough, <name>.

Speak with Oculeth about diversifying our efforts. I hear he's got something... unique planned for us.

passages.title: Telemantic Expanse
passages.text: Let us begin.

passages.title: Loot and Plunder!
passages.text:
I'm bein' honest here matey, I've got me own motives fer bein' here. Last time there was a bit of a debacle. Some drinkin', some gamblin', and a bit too much rum if ye catch me meanin'. Some words were said, some fists were thrown and... honestly it was quite a haze. I'm not the most welcome pirate here after that.

But they took me stuff! These lyin', dirty ol'... ahem. Could ye just take this torch and... burn their belongin's? I'd be grateful.

passages.title: Loot and Plunder!
passages.text: Thank ye, me friend. I feel better knowin' I have been avenged.

passages.title: The Village of Glenbrook
passages.text:
<The book is a register of the inhabitants of Glenbrook.

All but a few of the names are crossed out.>

passages.title: The Village of Glenbrook
passages.text: <Annie looks at you, her eyes hollow and empty. Her clothes are stained with blood, though she seems to be mostly unscathed. She stutters, but her words are unintelligible.>

passages.title: Crysa's Flyers
passages.text: I have obtained some of the most exotic species of carrion bird ever seen on Azeroth. Do you think you can stand up to them?

passages.title: Crysa's Flyers
passages.text: The carrion birds are circling you!

passages.title: Crysa's Flyers
passages.text: There are feathers everywhere! What a mess.

passages.title: Begin the Assault
passages.text:
The battle for our world has been hard fought, but with the power of your weapon and the combined forces of Azeroth, we have driven the demon invaders back at every turn.

Now we stand once again upon the Broken Shore, poised to do that which we previously failed to accomplish. Let us not forget those who sacrificed everything to give us this chance. 

Our first objective is to take the hill before us, so that we may build a stronghold. Steel yourself, <name>. The assault on the Broken Shore begins now.

passages.title: Your Next Assignment...
Lord Raz'gor
Everyone Loves a Good Fight
passages.text:
The note reads:

"You shouldn't have blabbed about the brawlers, especially to those champions. Now that you have though, I suppose it's ok that they fight here on occasion, but you better prove yourself a true brawler first!"

passages.title: Everyone Loves a Good Fight
passages.text: Compete in the Brawlers Guild to allow your champions to participate.

passages.title: Everyone Loves a Good Fight
passages.text: Ok, I'll let your champions come and prove themselves in the ring. If they manage to win themselves a fight, come talk to me again and we can see about letting them fight harder brawls.

passages.title: Your Next Assignment...
Helya's Horn
passages.text:
<name>, we need to bolster our army by any means necessary. The kvaldir are cursed beyond redemption, but they are fierce warriors and are a resource we should not overlook. 

They are eternally bound to obey Helya even through her death. If we can call them using her voice, they will follow us instead! 

We recovered Helya's Horn from her corpse. Empower it so you can call the kvaldir when we have need of them.

passages.title: Helya's Horn
passages.text: Revenge is sweet. The kvaldir will be forced to obey us, now!

passages.title: Elemental: The Folly of Levia Laurence
passages.text:
Levia Laurence was once a member of the Kirin Tor. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Scribe's Sacellum. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

Specialization: Elemental Shaman

passages.title: Elemental: The Folly of Levia Laurence
passages.text: Have you found any clues to Levia's disappearance?

passages.title: Elemental: The Folly of Levia Laurence
passages.text:
So it seems that Levia has fallen under the spell of a succubus' seduction. I fear her time alone as an outcast must have left her vulnerable to such tactics. I cannot help but feel some guilt for her turning down this path.

In any case, Levia is in great danger. She must be found!

passages.title: Unlikely Seduction
passages.text:
Mo... Modera sent you?

No... you must... leave! Agatha will be back any moment!

Save... yourself...

passages.title: Unlikely Seduction
passages.text: Save... yourself...

passages.title: Unlikely Seduction
passages.text:
Disgusting! I can't believe I let myself fall under the spell of such a creature! 

I was such a fool! She made me think she really cared about me. In the end, it seems nothing I thought I knew about Agatha was true!

passages.title: Fel-Crossed Lovers
passages.text:
That vile imp mother! If I wasn't so weakened I would dive down that pool and give her a piece of my mind!

<Levia takes a deep breath to regain her composure.>

It's only a matter of time until Agatha can make use of the power she stole from me. We had best not be here when she does.

passages.title: Fel-Crossed Lovers
passages.text:
So Levia is safe? That is a relief, though I wish we could have reached her sooner. An imp mother is bad enough - I can't imagine what Agatha will be capable of with Levia's power. And who knows what secrets Levia shared while under her thrall?

I'm afraid that this battle may not be over yet.

For now, we should celebrate whatever victories we can get. Thank you for your assistance, <name>.

passages.title: A Glorious Reunion
passages.text: You have done well, Battlelord <name>. Let us return to Skyhold. Odyn will want to hear of your success here.

passages.title: A Glorious Reunion
passages.text: You have done all that I hoped, and more, Battlelord <name>.

passages.title: Judgment Awaits
passages.text:
Our ongoing offensive within the Broken Shore has drawn the interest of many paladins who wish to fight under your leadership. Some are more worthy than others, but only you can be the judge of that.

The new recruits are lingering in the camp just outside the chapel, awaiting your judgment.

passages.title: Judgment Awaits
passages.text: Not all are worthy of joining the Silver Hand.

passages.title: Judgment Awaits
passages.text:
Your judgment is firm and fair, Highlord.

These new recruits will learn much under your command.

Though I am beginning to wonder, if my worthiness was tested, would I be found lacking?

passages.title: Runic Reading
passages.text:
There is something curious about this scroll. It appears to be an empty page to the untrained eye, but I can see a shimmer of runes appear briefly when I hold it up to the light.

As with most demonic runes, I will need fel blood to undo the magic that's been used to conceal whatever message is within this scroll.

passages.title: Runic Reading
passages.text: I will need to submerge the scroll in demon blood in order for the runes to reveal themselves.

passages.title: Runic Reading
passages.text: It should only take a moment for the runes to appear once I apply the purified blood.

passages.title: Felstone Destruction
passages.text:
<Delas' mouth drops open as the scroll falls from her hands and onto the floor.>

This cannot be... the runes... they detail a pact between the Burning Legion and my ancestors. A dark deal that would grant my ancestors protection from demons in this life, but in return, their spirits would belong to the Legion.

This fel pendant is an embodiment of the pact, and cannot be removed once worn.

Quickly, <name>. You must use your artifact to destroy that cursed piece of jewelry!

passages.title: Felstone Destruction
passages.text: If you were strong enough to destroy the pendant that bound my spirit to the Burning Legion, then there might be hope for my ancestors.

passages.title: Ending the Crescent Curse
passages.text:
We must do whatever we can to break the curse that befalls my ancestors.
