The Burning Legion have set up camp within the ruins that house our dead, ready to make good on the dreadful pact that was drafted so long ago.

Each of my ancestor's is burdened with a pendant that binds them to their demonic overlords. It cannot be removed, but as you have shown, with enough power it can be destroyed. 

End the curse that plagues my ancestors and set their spirits free!

passages.title: Ending the Crescent Curse
passages.text: You are the only one powerful enough to destroy the fel pendants that bind my ancestor's spirits to the Legion.

passages.title: Ending the Crescent Curse
passages.text:
What you have done for my family will never be forgotten.

The spirits of the Moonfang family will forever be in your debt.

passages.title: Cubic Conundrum
passages.text:
<You find a mysterious cube. Its design is unfamiliar, but unmistakably ancient. 

The cube's surface is inlaid with magical runes. Though inert, its properties may be worth investigating.

Perhaps if you show it to Dariness the Learned in Dalaran, she could tell you more about it.>

passages.title: Cubic Conundrum
passages.text:
<Dariness peers at the artifact you hand her.>

A most interesting design! It reminds me of an ancient curio I read about long ago while still in training. I doubt it could be that though. Such a device has never been found.

Hmm, I wonder if it still works. Only one way to find out...

passages.title: Cubic Currents
passages.text:
To determine this cube's purpose, we need to power it up. Hmm, I have an idea...

The Nightborne covet a substance you are no doubt familiar with called ancient mana. Should be just the thing for a relic this old. Gather a sufficient quantity and we'll attempt to get it working.

Be careful in Suramar! It would be a shame if this curious cube were lost and became a memory once more.

passages.title: Cubic Currents
passages.text: I trust you obtained all the ancient mana we need to infuse the cube?

passages.title: We Brought the Hammer
passages.text: Your champions found success in the brawl against the Warhammer Council. Bring this "token" to the Brawler's Guild as proof.

passages.title: We Brought the Hammer
passages.text: Hey not bad, they beat the Council huh? Sure, they can advance to the next level.

passages.title: Cleaning Up
passages.text: Your champions return successful. They tell a grand tale of how they really cleaned up against Bill the Janitor.

passages.title: Cleaning Up
passages.text: You think you guys are tough, beating up a janitor and all? Well ok, I suppose I'll get you into the next fight.

passages.title: To Battle!
passages.text:
Your champions have returned from exploring the battleground with a report detailing wild adventures and death-defying feats of strength and honor. In these ever shifting battles of conquest, more assistance is always required.

Will you answer the call?

passages.title: To Battle!
passages.text: How are you faring in the battleground?

passages.title: To Battle!
passages.text:
Well done!  Battlegrounds are certainly no place for the weak.

With your success, your champions will now look for more opportunities for you to prove your worth.

passages.title: The Hunt for Illidan Stormrage
passages.text:
Allari the Souleater, an oracle of the Illidari, has been on the hunt for Illidan's soul for quite some time. She now believes that she has discovered its location and requires your assistance in its recovery.

Find Allari at Illidari Stand in Azsuna and aid her in any way possible.

If Sargeras truly plans to use Illidan's body as a vessel for his own return then returning Illidan's soul to his body is integral in preventing the dark titan from returning to our world!

passages.title: The Hunt for Illidan Stormrage
passages.text:
The naaru heard my call? Interesting...

Very well, let's get to work. We've found Illidan's soul - finally - and it's not where we expected it to be held.

passages.title: The Nighthold
passages.text:
Illidan's soul rests safely within Light's Heart. Take this vessel and deliver it to Khadgar with the following instructions:

When Gul'dan attempts to tear the sky asunder and bring the dark titan into our world, call forth the power of this vessel and release Illidan's soul into his body.

Go now, <name>. We do not have much time. The dark ritual will begin soon.

passages.title: The Nighthold
passages.text:
I... I will do my best, Battlelord. You will - of course - have to do the hard work and lead the assault on the Nighthold!

FOR AZEROTH!

passages.title: Frost: The Twisted Twin
passages.text:
I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.

Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.

Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.

Specialization: Frost Mage

passages.title: Frost: The Twisted Twin
passages.text: You come from the Kirin Tor? So you'll help me find my brother?

passages.title: Where it's Thinnest
passages.text:
Though I have never heard of this "Nethersworn" cult, what this manifesto speaks of can't be good.

I do have a theory, however. The writing speaks of "the place its skin is thinnest." I think they might be referring to the place where the veil between Azeroth and the Twisting Nether is weakest - the Tomb of Sargeras. 

With our forces having established a foothold at the Broken Shore, this would be an opportune time for Raest and his cultist allies to reach the tomb. I would suggest you stop them.

passages.title: Where it's Thinnest
passages.text: My brother is here!

passages.title: One Step Behind
passages.text:
It looks like Raest is out of our reach, but at least his cultists should prove less of a threat.

We should return to the Kirin Tor. They should be able to help us plan our next move.

passages.title: One Step Behind
passages.text:
So Raest escaped? This is unfortunate. 

Still, I will rest easier knowing the Nethersworn cultists will no longer skulk in the streets of Dalaran. I thank you for that.

The Kirin Tor will set out at once to figure out how we can reach Raest in the Twisting Nether. I will send for you when we find a way to reach him.

passages.title: The Nightborne Apprentice
passages.text:
I would be happy to introduce you to my new apprentice if you do not mind traveling a bit. She is currently in the field keeping an eye on an enclave of Felborne resistance fighters who have sworn loyalty to the Legion. 

As the first nightborne to join the Tirisgarde, I am sure she is eager to prove her skills!

passages.title: The Nightborne Apprentice
passages.text: I've heard so much about you, Archmage <name>. It is a pleasure to finally meet you!

passages.title: Those Scrying Eyes
passages.text:
Until recently, Ly'leth was sending magical messages to us regularly from within the Nighthold. She took care to hide these messages - only the most vigilant scryers could have detected them.

They could not be within the palace... too much interference from the Nightwell...

Of course! The Terrace of Enlightenment! The Duskwatch must have set up a listening post there.

Check the scrying orbs for traces of Ly'leth's messages. We must learn what she was trying to tell us!

passages.title: Those Scrying Eyes
passages.text:
So they did intercept her messages! I hope Ly'leth is okay...

We must investigate this breach she spoke of immediately!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Cubic Cynosure
passages.text:
Drat! The ancient mana doesn't seem to be working. I need to think the problem through, focus and...

Wait, that's it! Focus! We need to focus the energy of the ancient mana to activate the cube.

I've heard tell of a mana wyrm in Karazhan with the means to focus its powers. Might be just what we need!

Watch out, though. My sources tell me this wyrm is humongous!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Cubic Cynosure
passages.text:
You've done it! Was the wyrm truly gargantuan? Oh, nevermind, size is relative...

Let us get this focus into the cube and see what it does!

passages.title: Cubic Coalescing
passages.text:
Success! The cube's magic has been restored! I'm excited to see what it does!

Since you did all the legwork, you should have the honor of activating it. Care to give it a try?

passages.title: Cubic Coalescing
passages.text: <Something about the power coursing through the cube urges you to take it into your possession.>

passages.title: On Daumyr's Wings
passages.text:
The time is nigh, adventurer. With these new dragons in our army, we are prepared for our assault on the Broken Shore. A large detachment of demons have appeared near one of our camps, and there are far too many of them for any of our allies to overcome.

Who better to defeat these demons than those without fear of death? Those with quite the large secret weapon?

Take Daumyr. We will meet you there.

passages.title: On Daumyr's Wings
passages.text: Let's show the Legion true power.

passages.title: Redundancy
passages.text:
A construct progenitor? What a creative solution to our problem!

We probably could channel Kathra'natir's power without releasing him now, but I want to add another layer of protection before we try, just in case. I will not have anyone accusing me of subterfuge!

Meet me on the Broken Shore when you are ready.

passages.title: Redundancy
passages.text: Let us get to work, shall we?

passages.title: One Day at a Time
passages.text:
Thank you for coming, outlander. It is good to see you again.

I have a situation in the city that needs your attention, but first... 

Let us talk of hope.

<Thalyssra gestures toward the arcan'dor.>

The fruit of the arcan'dor can truly free my people from the Nightwell. However, it only grows so fast. It will take time to distribute this cure.

I think it only right that you help me pass out the fruit as it is ready. Please take this, and give it to anyone.

passages.title: One Day at a Time
passages.text: In time, all of the shal'dorei will be free.

passages.title: One Day at a Time
passages.text:
I will ask this of you again, as more fruit is ready.

For now, we have some disturbing news to discuss.

passages.title: Continuing the Cure
passages.text:
Given the events at the Waning Crescent, the refugees here are more eager than ever to receive the gift of the arcan'dor and be free of the Nightwell forever. 

Fortunately, the tree has borne more fruit. Again, I ask that you honor us by giving this fruit to anyone here in Shal'Aran.

When you are finished, we shall discuss further developments within the city. Silgryn reports that Arluelle has proven a fine student, and the two are making progress in evacuating citizens.

passages.title: Continuing the Cure
passages.text:
No matter what crises come up, we must stay the course and free my people from their addiction.

We take it one day at a time.

passages.title: Continuing the Cure
passages.text: Good, now to set our attention to those still suffering within the city.

passages.title: A Message From Ly'leth
passages.text:
The arcan'dor bears fruit once again. Just in time, too - Ly'leth has sent us a message, and it seems she may have a lead on Vanthir. He is long overdue for this gift, assuming we manage to find him.

Give a fruit to another citizen here in Shal'Aran while I finish decrypting Ly'leth's message.

passages.title: A Message From Ly'leth
passages.text: There. I certainly hope Ly'leth has good news...

passages.title: Eating Before the Meeting
passages.text:
Having Vanthir around has done much to lift the spirits of the people here. I dare say some have begun to relish their newfound freedom, even if they miss their beloved city.

I will not rest until I can give it back to them.

You and I have an important meeting to attend. Before we go, let us distribute more of the arcan'dor's fruit. 

I want people to know that although I must leave for now, I have not abandoned them.

passages.title: Eating Before the Meeting
passages.text: Very well, let us go.

passages.title: Feeding the Rebellion
passages.text:
More nightborne flee Suramar every day to join our cause.

Our ranks are swelling, and with the aid of great heroes like yourself and the armies of the Horde and Alliance, our chances have never been better.

Help me hand out more fruit of the arcan'dor - each one is a life free from slavish dependence on the Nightwell!

Afterwards, we shall speak on how best to assist our new allies in their siege.

passages.title: Feeding the Rebellion
passages.text: Good. Now let us see to business at the warfront.

passages.title: A United Front
passages.text:
Our rebel fighters have been armed and morale is high - even the Alliance and Horde elves have ceased their squabbling.

We are nearly ready to march on the city.

Hand out this week's fruit, and then we can begin preparations.

passages.title: A United Front
passages.text: The time has come.

passages.title: Before the Siege
passages.text:
So many years of my life spent studying within the Nighthold... 

Never had I considered that I would one day have to fight my way back in.

Time is short. The battle will be upon us soon. 

Please, continue our tradition and feed another refugee the fruit of the arcan'dor.

passages.title: Before the Siege
passages.text: Just in time. We are ready to begin.

passages.title: The Advisor and the Arcanist
passages.text:
This new First Arcanist appointed by Elisande. This... Andaris. If she is as dangerous as I have heard, then Ly'leth may well be lost.

I am sorry, I should not entertain such thoughts. It is just that we have received a troubling message.

Help me distribute the latest batch of the arcan'dor fruit, then we will discuss the message.

passages.title: The Advisor and the Arcanist
passages.text: Are you ready?

passages.title: The Advisor and the Arcanist
passages.text: I am glad we can still cure my people, but... I have troubling news.

passages.title: A Taste of Freedom
passages.text:
We are as ready as we will ever be. Once we put Valtrois' plan into action, we can attack the Sanctum of Order and put an end to Andaris. She will never expect us to have trained our withered against fel magic, and her hubris will be her downfall.

Come, let us feed the people one last time.

passages.title: A Taste of Freedom
passages.text: Even if our failure means their doom, they deserve a taste of freedom, no matter how fleeting.

passages.title: A Taste of Freedom
passages.text: Very well. Let us begin.

passages.title: Insurrection
passages.text:
First Arcanist Thalyssra has received dark tidings regarding the Nightfallen rebellion and requires your assistance.

Journey to Shal'Aran in Suramar and meet with her.

passages.title: Insurrection
passages.text: Welcome hero. Your arrival could not have been better timed.

passages.title: Insurrection: Missing Persons
passages.text:
First Arcanist Thalyssra has requested your aid in searching for her missing people.

She has a lead from a very unexpected ally.

Meet with her at Shal'Aran in Suramar.

passages.title: Insurrection: Missing Persons
passages.text: Welcome hero. Your arrival could not have been better timed.

passages.title: Insurrection: Waxing Crescent
passages.text:
First Arcanist Thalyssra has sent word: there has been communication from Ly'leth. Your help is needed.

Journey to Shal'Aran in Suramar and lend what aid you can.

passages.title: Insurrection: Waxing Crescent
passages.text: You are going to want to hear this.

passages.title: Insurrection: An Elven Problem
passages.text:
The Alliance and Horde have arrived in Suramar. First Arcanist Thalyssra needs your help in providing an introduction.

Meet with Thalyssra in Shal'Aran.

passages.title: Insurrection: An Elven Problem
passages.text: It would seem the elves have returned to Suramar.

passages.title: Insurrection: Crafting War
passages.text:
Refugees are flooding in to Shal'Aran, and many are willing to fight for Thalyssra's rebel army.

They need weapons, training and help from anyone who can provide it.

Go to Shal'Aran and lend your assistance.

passages.title: Insurrection: Crafting War
passages.text: This is an unexpected problem, but we have more soldiers than food or weapons.

passages.title: Insurrection: March on Suramar
passages.text:
First Arcanist Thalyssra has sent word: the time has come to launch our assault on Suramar. The elven armies of the Horde, Alliance, Kirin Tor and Nightfallen are assembled.

They only await your arrival to begin their assault.

Report to Shal'Aran and meet with First Arcanist Thalyssra and prepare for battle.

passages.title: Insurrection: March on Suramar
passages.text: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

passages.title: Insurrection: Elisande's Retort
passages.text:
The combined forces of the elves stand ready to begin their siege on the gates of the Nighthold.

Report to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran to begin the siege.

passages.title: Insurrection: Elisande's Retort
passages.text: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

passages.title: Insurrection: As Strong As Our Will
passages.text:
In the wake of Elisande's attack, the need is stronger than ever to add to the ranks of the Nightfallen rebellion.

Plans are in motion that may help with this in an unconventional way.

Report to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Shal'Aran for more details.

passages.title: Insurrection: As Strong As Our Will
passages.text: Thank you for coming. Your skills will prove to be invaluable for this next part of our plan.

passages.title: Insurrection: Breaking the Nighthold
passages.text:
First Arcanist Thalyssra sends word that her forces are ready. It is time for you to lead the attack against the Nighthold.

Report to Shal'Aran in Suramar for details.

passages.title: Insurrection: Breaking the Nighthold
passages.text: The time for our attack has come. It is time for us to take back Suramar from Elisande and her demonic allies!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Book Wyrms
passages.text:
My incorporeal condition has allowed me to enter the tower safely for the first time. I must say, it's a bit of a shambles in there!

I could use some help tackling my cleaning checklist. We should start with the library. All those musty tomes are bound to attract mana wyrms!

Please shelve any books that have fallen to the floor, or worse, taken flight. And if you find mana wyrms nibbling at the pages... step on them!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Book Wyrms
passages.text: How did it go?

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Book Wyrms
passages.text:
You were HOW small? Gracious! That must have complicated things.

It looks like there are more books on the floor than when we started. It's as if the books keep jumping off the shelves or something...

This is going to be harder than I thought!

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Clearing Out the Cobwebs
passages.text:
I admit it... even as a spirit, I am deathly afraid of spiders. All those legs! Dripping fangs! Sticky webs coming out of their...

<Darius does a squirming sort of shimmy that is uncomfortable to watch.>

I'm sure a world-saving hero like you doesn't mind them, though. Which is good, since a whole brood of spiders has taken over the Servant's Quarters.

You'll handle this, right? If you don't get them all, they'll keep multiplying.

passages.title: Return to Karazhan: Clearing Out the Cobwebs
passages.text:
You got every single spider, right?

Either way, I'll just check that one off the list. No need to check up on your work.

<Darius makes a squinched-up face.>

passages.title: No Bones About It
passages.text: The Charred Bone Fragments still smolder with ancient power. Darius would be extremely interested in examining them and hearing of your defeat of Nightbane.

passages.title: No Bones About It
passages.text:
Nightbane has been defeated! I'm in awe!

Many years have passed since the blue dragon Arcanagos was slain by the corrupted Medivh. Archmage Alturus sought out the remains of the fallen dragon in an effort to study the Guardian's power. 

In retrospect, maybe not the best idea. 

Your help has been invaluable.

I still have a lot of work ahead to clean up Karazhan, but for now I dare ask no more of you. Thank you again for your assistance, <name>.

passages.title: Taking Charge
passages.text:
Mardum has been quiet for months. I wonder why the Legion is attacking us now? Could be in retaliation for destroying their battleship on the Broken Shore...

We had better head down ourselves and save the day, don't you agree?

passages.title: Taking Charge
passages.text: Good, you made it.

passages.title: Attacking the Darkness
passages.text: Your champions have returned looking somewhat shaken by their encounter with the Shadowmaster.

passages.title: Attacking the Darkness
passages.text: Between you and me I'm glad they won, that guy always creeps me out. Ready for the final challenge?

passages.title: You Beat the Ball of Meat
passages.text: Your champions return with a scrap of bloody, tangled, and quite smelly hair.

passages.title: You Beat the Ball of Meat
passages.text: I can't believe you beat him! Meatball was so impressed he now insists he wants to work for you. Hope you don't regret it!

passages.title: Stabilizing Suramar
passages.text:
Elisande's plan has backfired. She thought to stamp out our rebellion by making an example of the Waning Crescent. 

Instead, she ignited the flame of the shal'dorei better than I ever could.

We must maintain a cohesive campaign against Elisande and the Legion by fighting them in every corner of Suramar. 

Show the people that there is still hope - that there are still heroes willing to fight for them!

passages.title: Stabilizing Suramar
passages.text: Now is the time for action!

passages.title: Stabilizing Suramar
passages.text: Thank you, <name>. Every day we come closer to freedom for Suramar.

passages.title: Fighting on All Fronts
passages.text:
We are nearly ready to siege the gates. Your efforts here have been monumental, <name>.

But let us not forget that you are also the <class>t. Your forces rely on you to command them. No single person can stand against the Legion.

Continue your duty. Guide the <class>s of Azeroth, and victory will be assured.

passages.title: Fighting on All Fronts
passages.text:
Leadership is a difficult burden, <name>.

We must often split our attention - be sure to keep the big picture in mind.

passages.title: Scouting Party
passages.text:
We will have our work cut out for us finding the missing scouts and Lady S'theno. I suspect that one does not wish to be found.

Do your best, <name>!

passages.title: Scouting Party
passages.text: You got most of our scouts out alive. And Lady S'theno appears somewhat chastened, at least. Well done!

passages.title: Return to Acherus
passages.text: You've grown a lot since we last met, <name>. Now that we have the harness, let's see if Mograine has a plan to use it.

passages.title: Return to Acherus
passages.text: Welcome back, Deathlord. I see you were successful.

passages.title: A Curious Contagion
passages.text:
It has been brought to my attention that a rather curious contagion is spreading through a small coastal region within Highmountain.

The local tribes have abandoned the area for fear of catching this ailment that currently has no known cure.

One of our own was traveling through the area when her companion fell ill. She has requested the Conclave's assistance. Seek her out, High Priest, and do whatever you can to stop this sickness from spreading.

passages.title: A Curious Contagion
passages.text: Ah, good. So the Conclave received my request. I didn't expect they'd send their leader!

passages.title: To the Broken Shore
passages.text:
We've received word from those fighting on the Broken Shore. It seems the source of the contagion can be pinpointed to a specific island off the western coast.

Many of our allies have already been infected. We must work quickly to ensure that the contagion doesn't spread.

passages.title: To the Broken Shore
passages.text: You're here, High <class>! Quickly, there's no time to lose!

passages.title: Fate of the Nightborne
passages.text:
Shortly after your victorious return from the Nighthold, urgent business took Thalyssra back to the palace.

She has requested that you meet her there.

Speak to me when you are prepared to join her.

passages.title: Fate of the Nightborne
passages.text: Thank you for coming.

passages.title: Fate of the Nightborne
passages.text:
Thank you for being here, <name>.

Ultimately the Nightborne must shape their own destiny, regardless of the help we have received from Outlanders like yourself.

It is no easy burden we bear, but Elisande has shown us that we must stand alone, without the Nightwell, to properly rejoin the world.

Thank you for all you have done for us.

passages.title: We Must be Prepared!
passages.text:
The Legion ships are gone, for now. It's only a matter of time before they attack again, and we must be prepared.

We need to get going on repairs immediately! Lady S'theno took the lead on the search for parts. That one will do anything to remain on solid ground, ha! 

She is waiting for you on the Broken Shore.

passages.title: We Must be Prepared!
passages.text: About time, Sslayer <name>. We have work to do.

passages.title: Dark Memento
passages.text:
The flowers were... a nice gesture.

<Velonara sniffs one of the black roses.>

I have a spare hood. Nothing fancy, but perhaps Moorgoth would like to have it.

Just don't let him get his hopes up or anything. I'm merely repaying a kindness.

I would appreciate it if you kept all this between us. Giving presents to admirers falls a bit outside the dark ranger rules of conduct.

passages.title: Dark Memento
passages.text:
Velonara asked you to deliver this to me personally?

<Moorgoth's eyes sparkle as he grins from ear to ear.>

She DOES care! She DOES care!

<Moorgoth settles down and clears his throat.>

That was kind of her. Say, it is a nice hood. I bet I could mass-produce this and offer it to my fellow dark ranger aficionados.

Would you like to browse my wares?

passages.title: Severing the Sveldrek
passages.text:
So here's the order of things, as far as I've been told. Mortal walks into Icecrown. Mortal is brutally defeated. Mortal gets raised as Scourge.

These fools can't expect to trounce in here, do whatever they want, and leave without any consequence. Time to make them truly as mindless as they act.

passages.title: Severing the Sveldrek
passages.text: Watching those vrykul shamble off mindlessly made my dead heart go "pitter patter".

passages.title: Panic at the Brewery
passages.text:
We were not prepared for a surprise attack. I fear Brewmaster Blanche has been captured, or worse...

Please help me, Grandmaster!

passages.title: Panic at the Brewery
passages.text:
How could this have happened to us; to me? I never thought I would die so young... and so violently...

We have tried to Detox our fallen friends, but this poison is too advanced.

I cannot rest while our order's very survival is still at stake. I am so sorry I let you down, Grandmaster <name>.

passages.title: Breaching the Sanctum
Protection: Aid of the Illidari
passages.text:
Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city.

Kor'vas Bloodthorn of the Illidari has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks.

I do not entirely trust these 'demon hunters', but they have at least proved adept at their namesake. I suggest you find her and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.

Specialization: Protection Warrior

passages.title: Protection: Aid of the Illidari
passages.text:
You - I've seen you out on the isles.

We need to move quickly!

passages.title: Confirming Suspicions
passages.text:
That heart is the last remaining piece of Highlord Kruul - once one of the Legion's best warlords.

Many years ago Kruul's armies nearly descended upon the Dark Portal to crush the Azerothian assault on Outland. We Illidari intercepted before he could strike.

I fear that the Legion aims to use the heart to hasten Kruul's resurrection in the nether. We must find the Prophet Velen at once - only he can tell us for sure.

passages.title: Confirming Suspicions
passages.text: This is deeply concerning.

passages.title: Confirming Suspicions
passages.text: Kruul must not be allowed entrance into this world.

passages.title: Edict of the God-King
passages.text:
Our scouts send troubling reports from Stormheim.

God-King Skovald has received a new directive from Gul'dan. In response, Skovald's forces have stepped up their attacks.

We must know the details of Gul'dan's message, <name>.

Despite his new orders, the god-king remains obsessed with the titan keeper Odyn. Intercept Skovald in the Halls of Valor and you may determine what his Legion masters have demanded of him.

passages.title: Nature's Advance
passages.text:
<name>, you must return to the Dreamgrove and bring the news of my attack. Tell the other druids that aggressions such as this will continue against us unless we find a way to stop the Legion.

I thank you for the aid. I feel the fel energies leaving my veins, though it may take some time.

passages.title: Nature's Advance
passages.text: What news do you have of the attack on Aviana's shrine?

passages.title: An Urgent Situation
passages.text: Archmage, <name>! We have an important guest. Please meet me in my chamber when you have a moment.

passages.title: An Urgent Situation
passages.text: I have been unfairly maligned by many. I am glad the Tirisgarde does not fall prey to petty rumors!

passages.title: Adacic Grubs - REWORK
passages.text:
Your request to harvest wood does not seem unreasonable, <name>. There is something you can do for me, too.

There is a species of moth whose grubs feed on trees. Normally their numbers are too low to cause damage, but once a century they reproduce in overwhelming numbers. 

They have just begun their mass emergence. All of my keepers are fighting the nightmare and cannot be spared. I fear I am unable to protect the forest giants on my own.

Will you stomp the grubs out?

passages.title: Not Felling Well
passages.text:
Let's see... Yseralline Seed for healing, Bruiseweed for curing poison, and Elemental Earth for disease resistance. Oh and just a touch of ground Felwort for attunement. 

Yes, I think this will counteract the Legion's poison. It will probably taste terrible, but what medicine doesn't?

Hurry, Grandmaster <name>. Our most stricken friends don't have much time left.

passages.title: Not Felling Well
passages.text: Did our Curative Brew work?

passages.title: Not Felling Well
passages.text: It makes my heart glad to see our order returning to health.

passages.title: Alchemist Korlya
passages.text:
The zealots within the Garrison of the Fel are led by Alchemist Korlya. It seems likely that's the Felskorn Brewmaster Blanche observed poisoning our brew.

Please kill her.

passages.title: Alchemist Korlya
passages.text: Thank you. That's one less demon working against us.

passages.title: Storming the Legion
passages.text:
I did my best to fight the demons off, but there were too many even for my skill...

As I lay dying, I overheard the dreadlord commanding a Felskorn alchemist to contaminate my brew and then return to the Broken Shore. 

If you could acquire some of the poison, I'm sure we can concoct an antidote!

passages.title: Storming the Legion
passages.text: Good, you made it!

passages.title: Arcane: Fate of the Tideskorn
passages.text:
A scout from Stormheim arrived yesterday with a significant discovery - these ancient scrolls. Within they contain a Valkyra prophecy of a new vrykul ruler - one who could turn the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It complicates matters that this vrykul may in fact be Skovald's heir.

Take the scrolls, find the heir, and bring her to the Valkyra. I think the outcasts they refer to are the vrykul of Jandvik, so that would be a good place to start.

Specialization: Arcane Mage

passages.title: Arcane: Fate of the Tideskorn
passages.text: Yes, outsider? What business do you have here?

passages.title: The Reluctant Queen
passages.text:
Wait, how is it you know about my parentage? Be careful what you say around here, there are those who would hunt me down if they knew my bloodline.

I don't know who you are, nor do I believe I'm part of any prophecy. However, if you seek to undo the damage my father has wrought on the Tideskorn, then I feel obliged to assist you.

Meet me in Valdisdall, <class>. From there we can make our way to Skold-Ashil and request an audience with Eyir. Perhaps she can shed some light on this prophecy.

passages.title: The Reluctant Queen
passages.text:
I thank you for bringing Sigryn to me, outsider. She truly is the future of our people.

Though you have already done so much, I would ask another favor of you. Please accompany Sigryn in her challenges. She has grown to trust you, and will need guidance through the trials she must face.

passages.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
passages.text:
You see those big eredar guys? That's the barrow that Goldrinn is in! I don't know what the Legion is doing to him in there, but I'm sure we don't want them to succeed.

Let's get in there and save Goldrinn!

passages.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
passages.text: Who knows what the Legion could be doing to Goldrinn!

passages.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
passages.text: We did it! We saved Goldrinn!

passages.title: To Silence the Bonespeakers
passages.text:
Sigryn's claim to the throne will be challenged by two rivals - Runeseer Faljar of the Bonespeakers and Jarl Velbrand of the Drekirjar.

I would begin in Haustvald with the Runeseer. He was a close ally of Skovald and is a powerful mystic. With the Bonespeakers at his charge, he would prove a staunch opponent if he cannot be made to yield.

Go now, and claim your destiny in the name of the Valkyra!

passages.title: To Silence the Bonespeakers
passages.text:
The Bonespeakers yield. Our clan will not interfere with Sigryn's claim to the throne.

Be careful of this one, <class>. I can see the darkness that consumed Skovald dwelling in this girl's heart. How she has resisted it this far, I do not know.

You had best hope she can control it.

passages.title: To Tame the Drekirjar
passages.text:
The Bonespeaker's words trouble me, outsider. The darkness he speaks of, Skovald's fel curse, could he have passed it onto me somehow?

No, it cannot be so. The Runeseer must be mistaken...

Come, the next challenger awaits. I will no doubt need your assistance bringing him to heel as well.

passages.title: To Tame the Drekirjar
passages.text:
You have the backing of the Dragon-Riders, but a greater rival to the throne still lives in secret.

The God-King's son yet lives. My riders spotted him among the outcasts of Vrekt. He would be the true heir to Skovald's throne.  

The vrykul would never follow you were he to contend your claim!

passages.title: The Forgotten Heir
passages.text:
My brother... lives?

The last time I saw him, the assassins were closing in on him. I can't imagine how he defeated them...

We should travel to Vrekt. I would look upon my brother with my own eyes.

passages.title: The Forgotten Heir
passages.text: Let us go to Vrekt.

passages.title: The Forgotten Heir
passages.text:
I cannot believe that I find my brother alive, only to see him fall by my own blade. 

How can fate be so cruel?

passages.title: Unanswered Questions
passages.text:
What is done, is done. There are none left to challenge the throne of the Tideskorn. 

My brother's words still haunt me, though. If Eyir knows who ordered my family killed, I deserve to know it.

Come, let us return.

passages.title: Unanswered Questions
passages.text:
Sigryn has taken the path of Skovald before her. Only, I fear she is more powerful than her father ever was. 

I fear that Sigryn's thirst for revenge may lead to her undoing. Though truly powerful, she would be no match for Odyn.

She must be stopped before it is too late.

passages.title: Eyir's Forgiveness
passages.text:
I'm sorry for everything I've put you through, outsider. After my actions here, I fear all of this may have been in vain.

Come with me back to Skold-Ashil. There I will accept whatever judgment Eyir deems fit of me.

passages.title: Eyir's Forgiveness
passages.text:
To think, when you met me I had all intentions of living out my days as a farmer. Little did I know that the gods had other plans for me.

Thank you, outsider, for showing me my true purpose. I only hope I can live up to Eyir's visions and truly unite the Tideskorn once more.

If that day comes, the Legion will regret ever setting foot in Stormheim.

passages.title: Mother's Orders
passages.text: That big ugly thing looks like it's leading the attack here. Let's take her down!

passages.title: Mother's Orders
passages.text: What did she say about a distraction?! This isn't sounding good...

passages.title: A Common Enemy
passages.text:
I have one more request to ask of you, outsider.

Return to your leaders and report to them what transpired here. Though your people may never truly be allies with the Tideskorn, know that we have a common enemy - one which my people will fight to the last vrykul. 

When the time comes, I hope to see you on the battlefield.

passages.title: A Common Enemy
passages.text:
Remarkable! So there really was something to that prophecy after all!

I am glad that Sigryn will lead the vrykul instead of the brutes who challenged her. Let us just hope she can unite the Tideskorn under her banner before the Legion has this place overrun.

Well done, <name>!

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Wailing Caverns
passages.text:
The deviate critters of the Wailing Caverns continue to flourish in the damp darkness, but I've been doing my best to keep their numbers down.

I've found a few pets and supplies while clearing out the caverns, I might be willing to part with a sack of supplies if you can beat my best run.

You'll have to clear out the cavern without healing or reviving any of your pets to best me. Good luck!

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Wailing Caverns
passages.text: How is the battle for Wailing Caverns going?

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Wailing Caverns
passages.text: Wow, that's impressive! Here's the sack of supplies, you earned it! Sorry about the dampness.

passages.title: A Call from the Caverns
passages.text:
Oh, good, I'm glad you stopped by. We've heard disturbing rumors of corruption continuing to flourish in the Wailing Caverns. You seem like just the right person to investigate.

Since Naralex's awakening, one of his disciples has been watching over the area to ensure that deviate creatures remain in check. She is the one that has been sending us these dire warnings.

Meet up with her in the eye of the skull-shaped rock above Wailing Caverns and see if you can help her handle this situation.

passages.title: A Call from the Caverns
passages.text: Thank you for coming, I have some interesting news about what's been going on in the Wailing Caverns since Naralex has awakened.

passages.title: Barrel Toss
passages.text:
The Legion is defending the Felskorn lair with fel emitters. Fortunately we have Storm Brew to spare, so there should be plenty available with which to destroy them. 

Take this barrel, throw it at the spreaders, and watch them go BOOM!

passages.title: Barrel Toss
passages.text: Blowing up demons never gets old, does it? Ha!

passages.title: Devastating Effects
passages.text:
The Burning Legion will not rest until they have destroyed everything and everyone. Their presence here has had a devastating effect on our lands, and now it seems our wildlife as well. 

I have heard numerous reports of sickly animals in the thicket that surrounds the demon-infested city of Suramar. 

Make your way there and see if the rumors are true.

passages.title: Devastating Effects
passages.text: <Nighthuntress Syrenne's pet is too weak to react to your presence.>

passages.title: The Nighthuntress Beckons
passages.text: <D'Bynn becomes alert at the sound of his master's voice. Using his muzzle, he nudges your hand with a sense of urgency, inviting you to hop on his back.>

passages.title: The Nighthuntress Beckons
passages.text: I suppose I have you to thank for saving my beloved companion.

passages.title: Felbound Beasts
passages.text:
So Reyln is taking orders from Lexera? Why am I not surprised. She seemed far too comfortable with the demons who infested our city.

We cannot let her succeed in corrupting Suramar's wildlife. I swore to protect the city of Suramar from all enemies, even those within its walls.

If you can deal with her trappers, I will do my best to track Nighthuntress Lexera down.

passages.title: Felbound Beasts
passages.text: You continue to surprise me, outsider.

passages.title: Ready to Strike
passages.text:
I followed one of the trappers, who unknowingly led me to the Broken Shore. 

Lexera was there, surrounded by an army of demons and loyal nightborne.

I wasn't able to get close, but from what I could tell, she and her army of trappers are taming the fel-corrupted beasts.

It is an abomination of nature, and she must be stopped!

Meet me on the Broken Shore and be ready to strike. I will gather additional manaroot. I have a feeling we'll need it.

passages.title: Ready to Strike
passages.text: Let's make this quick. It won't be long before more demons come rushing through this pass.

passages.title: Unnatural Consequences
passages.text:
Lexera and her trappers have taken over the valley.

She is stronger than she looks, <name>, and she fights with the strength of a dreadlord. Do not go in unprepared. 

I can handle these demons. Go, find Lexera, and make her feel the consequences of her unnatural endeavors.

passages.title: Unnatural Consequences
passages.text: Lexera and her trappers must be stopped.

passages.title: Unnatural Consequences
passages.text: There is no joy when a Nighthuntress falls, but it had to be done. The truth is, she died the moment she aligned herself with the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Destruction: Rumblings Near Feltotem
passages.text:
The Highmountain have passed along a dire warning from their drogbar allies. The Feltotem are spreading their demonic corruption into the wildlife around them, infecting the land itself. We believe this is something that should be looked into sooner rather than later.

The drogbar chieftain, Navarrogg, is handling this personally and we'd like you to meet him near the Feltotem village.

Specialization: Destruction Warlock

passages.title: Destruction: Rumblings Near Feltotem
passages.text: Thank you for coming. I am glad you are treating this threat seriously.

passages.title: Seek Me Out
passages.text: The letter from Maximillian is written on something which looks to be torn off a ship's sail. Included are directions to the beach in northern Highmountain.

passages.title: Seek Me Out
passages.text: Look for Maximillian of Northshire in Highmountain.

passages.title: Seek Me Out
passages.text: Are you ready to begin?

passages.title: Kneel and Be Squired!
passages.text: You must kneel before me if we are to begin our journey together once more. Kneel, squire, and be squired!

passages.title: Kneel and Be Squired!
passages.text: Very good, now we can begin!

passages.title: The Burning Birds
passages.text:
The Feltotem are experimenting on these falcosaurs! They didn't get the results that they wanted and have carelessly left their experiments lying around to further poison the animals.

We should collect their leftover totems to prevent further corruption and to find out what they were doing.

passages.title: The Burning Birds
passages.text: These animals are unable to be infused with fel magic, but I doubt the Feltotem stopped here.

passages.title: The Burning Birds
passages.text:
There were quite a few guards as I scouted around. I noticed more strange things on the other side.

Let me see those totems.

passages.title: Further Training
passages.text:
The journey here was perilous, Squire. It was fraught with danger. Storms, demons, storm demons... I shudder at the memory. Of course, I overcame all such dangers at great loss to my person. This is where I need your assistance.

You must venture forth--nay, sally forth--and recover my armor, my weapon, and of course my grand steed. Once you have successfully completed these tasks three, will you be promoted to Squire, First Class!

passages.title: Further Training
passages.text: Very good, Squire- First Class!  Now the real journey begins!

passages.title: A Knight's Belongings
passages.text:
Amidst the squalls and the crashing waves, my mighty ship swayed and tumbled. Lesser knights would have trembled in terror, frozen stiff. Not me! Nay! Heroically, I stripped my armor off my back and stored it safely in my sack. 

Why did I strip down to these simple undergarments, you ask? Only an ignorant squire would. I was wary of sinking to the bottom should my ship fall foul of course! Ha ha! 

Unfortunately, the sacks of armor were thrown overboard by the waves.

passages.title: A Knight's Belongings
passages.text: Fetch Maximillians armor.

passages.title: A Knight's Belongings
passages.text: Excellent, you found my armor.

passages.title: My Kingdom for a Horse
passages.text: Oh, woe is me! Soon after making landfall I began exploring, riding my trusty steed Pimento into the heart of a demon infested village to the north. While performing my investigations, I tied Pimento up to go further on foot, only to return and discover a powerful demon had captured her! There he was, riding her like she was his own. Please find her and send her back to me.

passages.title: My Kingdom for a Horse
passages.text: Pimento!  You found him!

passages.title: They Stole Excaliberto!
passages.text: I was scouting the nearby demon village when I was attacked. They took my artifact! Of course, if I leave here, the shore will be undefended. The nearby demons have it. Go, slay them and bring it back to me!

passages.title: They Stole Excaliberto!
passages.text: Find Maximillians "Artifact" weapon, Excaliberto

passages.title: They Stole Excaliberto!
passages.text: Yes!

passages.title: In Safer Hands
passages.text:
There is still the matter of the Focusing Iris. Please return it to your Kirin Tor friends, with my apologies.

As for myself, I think I'm done chasing artifacts for a while. One possession by immortal shadowy evil is enough for me, thank you.

passages.title: In Safer Hands
passages.text:
At last, the Focusing Iris is returned! I will rest easier knowing it is once again safe in the vaults.

I'm sorry to hear about Xylem, though I'm happy he survived the ordeal. He may be eccentric, but his heart is in the right place. 

We can use more allies like him in the wars to come.

passages.title: Rise Up
passages.text:
Here we are, <class>t. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it.

There's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Tess has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.

passages.title: Rise Up
passages.text: Easy as pie, Shadowblade. Now is when the plan kicks into action!

passages.title: Village of the Corruptors
passages.text:
The Feltotem continue to create these totems for further "experiments". Let us deal with these infusers in the traditional manner.

Their deaths will right a great wrong and provide clues as to their ultimate goal.

passages.title: Village of the Corruptors
passages.text: These Feltotem need to be dealt with.

passages.title: Village of the Corruptors
passages.text:
Tugar... I thought he was dead. He was a nasty Bloodtotem even before the Legion arrived.

We have to get to him.

passages.title: Rise Up
passages.text:
Here we are, <class>t. On this island is a cavern full of exceptionally powerful demons and their leaders. If our plan succeeds, these demons will be... "blown to smithereens", as Tethys so nicely put it.

There's no time to explain the plan in full right now, but Lilian has agreed to walk you through it. First you must get up to the top of this ramp. Slaughter a few on your way.

passages.title: Rise Up
passages.text: Ah, my blade sings. Time to put this plan into action, Shadowblade.

passages.title: The Feltotem Menace
passages.text:
If I had known Tugar was alive and behind this I would've alerted you sooner! He is a hateful creature, and an easy recruit to the Legion's cause.

If he is truly successful with his fel experiments we need to stop him now. He is taunting us from up there. Let's go!

passages.title: The Feltotem Menace
passages.text: That was powerful fel magic. If it is true, if he is raising an army of such beasts... Thunder Totem is in peril!

passages.title: Lady Remor'za
passages.text:
Our allies reported a coven of extremely powerful Felborne abjurers occupying the Weeping Terrace. 

Their leader, Lady Remor'za, and her followers are specialists in ancient nightborne magic and can become nearly invincible to attacks. 

However, as mages, we should be able to defeat them using Spellsteal. Let us show them the power of the Tirisgarde!

passages.title: Lady Remor'za
passages.text: The Felborne will respect the Tirisgarde now, do you not agree?

passages.title: Finders Keepers
passages.text:
Would you look at this place? It's a mess! Everywhere you look there's just pile after pile of arcane dust!

<Akazamzarak smiles broadly.>

These poor saps don't realize what that stuff's worth!

I tell ya what, if you help me summon up some brooms to collect this powdered gold, I'll split the profits with you 80/20.

passages.title: Finders Keepers
passages.text: Say, how's that dust coming along?

passages.title: Finders Keepers
passages.text: Now that's what I'm talking about! You know what they say - where there's mages, there's dust!

passages.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
passages.text: Are you ready, <class>t? I will walk you through every step of the plan. You'll be perfectly safe! First thing's first: You see that rappel point behind me? That's your way down into the cave. Good luck!

passages.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
passages.text: That couldn't have gone better if I had done it myself. Good work, Shadowblade.

passages.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
passages.text:
Here goes nothing, <class>t. If anybody can pull this off, you can! ...Probably. Just use the rappel point behind me to get into the cave.

What? Don't make that face. I'll give you more instructions once you're in the cave.

passages.title: This Time, Leave a Trail
passages.text: That couldn't have gone better if I had done it myself. Good work, Shadowblade.

passages.title: Servant to No One
passages.text:
I like workin' with ya, <name>. How's about we keep this gold train a-rollin'?

Archmage Khadgar spends an inordinate amount of time sending his servants off to do who knows what. What if an enterprising duo such as ourselves found a cheaper alternative?

<Akazamzarak hands you a small crystal.>

This bad boy will form a servant right out of thin air - and a few pounds of the dust you swept up.

Why not take it into town and try her out? See for yourself!

passages.title: Servant to No One
passages.text: Good stuff, am I right?

passages.title: Servant to No One
passages.text:
You make a pretty good business partner, bud! I'll see what I can do to get ol' Khadgar on board with these new servants. 

I tell ya I'm gonna make a fortune!

Oh, don't think I forgot you. I've got somethin' special in mind for ya!

passages.title: Missing in Action: Eitrigg
passages.text:
Are you familiar with Eitrigg? He is the worthy orc warrior who was leading our forces against the Felrage naga nearby.

Unfortunately the naga captured many of our soldiers during a recent skirmish. Eitrigg went after them and has not returned. I fear something terrible has happened to him.

Please try to find him!

passages.title: Missing in Action: Eitrigg
passages.text: The filthy naga ambushed me. I will not fail again.

passages.title: Operation Felrage
passages.text:
I do not like to see naga aligned with the Burning Legion. That is something new and cannot be ignored.

The naga warlord, Kaz'jatar, and his skrog toady, Felbeard, are responsible for the Felrage's attacks on our forces.

We must teach them that it does not pay to consort with demons!

passages.title: Operation Felrage
passages.text: Warlord Kaz'jatarand Felbeard must pay for their crimes against us!

passages.title: Operation Felrage
passages.text: With their leaders defeated, the Felrage naga will not be preying on our warriors again. Still, we should keep an eye on them in the future.

passages.title: Oh Doloria, My Sweet Doloria
passages.text:
What ho! We are quite the dashing pair of adventurers, aren't we?

Now that we have secured my belongings, a new path unfolds before us. I did not journey here simply to thwart the demon invasion, no! I came here in search of my beloved, my loved, Doloria. Whilst resting between slaying of dragons, I had a dream, nay, a vision. It told me Doloria had been kidnapped and taken to a floating city in the sky!

It must be Dalaran. Quickly, squire! Mount up and meet me at Dalaran's famous inn. Make haste!

passages.title: Oh Doloria, My Sweet Doloria
passages.text: Blast, I didn't think he would find me again so fast.

passages.title: A Fool's Errand
passages.text:
Oh yea sure, I'm, um, held here against my, you know, will, or something.

Look bud, between you and me old Max here has no chance, but his heart is in the right place. I keep trying to run away and hide but he keeps finding me! I just don't have it in me to upset him with the truth.

I've got an idea. Why don't you go kill some of those really big two headed "Hill Bandits" for me. Let's say they stole some jewelery from me, and you can use it to buy my freedom.

Take your time, don't get hurt. Much.

passages.title: A Fool's Errand
passages.text: Kill "Hill Bandits" to find Dolorias stolen "Jewelry" and buy her "release"

passages.title: A Fool's Errand
passages.text:
<Doloria gives you a sly wink from behind her mask>

Uh, no, haven't seen her for a few days, not sure who you're talking about.

passages.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
passages.text:
I will make these naga pay for their audacity. 

They and their skrog lackeys captured our warriors while we were fighting the Legion. They have no honor!

We must rescue our fallen soldiers before they are sold as slaves, or worse...

passages.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
passages.text: Have we found them all?

passages.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
passages.text: Our soliders will be back in action soon, and the Felrage naga will think twice before messing with us again!

passages.title: Missing in Action: Lord Darius Crowley
passages.text:
Are you familiar with Lord Darius Crowley? He is the worthy Gilnean warrior who was leading our forces against the Felrage naga nearby. 

Unfortunately the naga captured many of our soldiers during a recent skirmish. Lord Darius went after them and has not returned. I fear something terrible has happened to him.

Please try to find him!

passages.title: Missing in Action: Lord Darius Crowley
passages.text: Thanks. I was ambushed by a dozen naga and skrog! At least I took quite a few down before they overwhelmed me...

passages.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
passages.text:
I will make these naga pay for their audacity. 

They and their skrog lackeys captured our warriors while we were fighting the Legion. They have no honor!

We must rescue our fallen soldiers before they are sold as slaves, or worse...

passages.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
passages.text: Have we found them all?

passages.title: Mission: Search and Rescue
passages.text: Our soliders will be back in action soon, and the Felrage naga will think twice before messing with us again!

passages.title: Operation Felrage
passages.text:
I am very concerned to discover naga aligned with the Burning Legion. That is something new and cannot be ignored.

The naga warlord, Kaz'jatar, and his skrog toady, Felbeard, are responsible for the Felrage's attacks on our forces.

We must teach them that it does not pay to consort with demons!

passages.title: Operation Felrage
passages.text: Warlord Kaz'jatarand Felbeard must pay for their crimes against us!

passages.title: Operation Felrage
passages.text: With their leaders defeated, the Felrage naga won't be launching any more raids for awhile! Still, we should keep an eye on them in the future.

passages.title: A "Humble" Request
passages.text:
<class>t, we've received a... visitor. She orders entry, but the guards will not let her pass without approval.

Please head up to the overlook as soon as you are able.

passages.title: A "Humble" Request
passages.text: Our "guest" is waiting for you. You may want to hurry.

passages.title: A "Humble" Request
passages.text: You're in charge here?

passages.title: The Power of Thousands
passages.text:
I know I am not well liked here, and my Grimtotem and I were not invited to join you and your shaman here. However, I come to you with a proposition.

The Legion is attacking my home. I've lost possession of some things that are... dear to me, and I have nowhere else to turn to. It pains me to ask... but I request your aid. If you help, I offer my people in service against the Legion.

passages.title: The Power of Thousands
passages.text: Let's not keep my tribe waiting.

passages.title: The Crone's Wrath
passages.text: These demons come into my home, take my things, and capture my people? They will see my wrath. Destroy them, child. Surely you are capable of at least that.

passages.title: The Crone's Wrath
passages.text: Fel blood has never been sweeter.

passages.title: Breaking Chains
passages.text: The Legion shall not make fools of the Grimtotem. Free my people, and we will grace you with our aid in the coming battle.

passages.title: Breaking Chains
passages.text: The Legion cannot break the Grimtotem.

passages.title: The Tainted Marsh
passages.text:
I wasn't able to scout inside the village yet, however, there are more dangerous experiments going on to the south. They were befouling the unquiet spirits in the marshlands with more fel magic!

I will rework this fel totem to draw out the fel energies they infused in those spirits.

Please, cure what spirits you can, perhaps it will even give them some peace.

If you want, I can even send you there!

passages.title: The Tainted Marsh
passages.text: I'm tired of these monsters abusing everything around them!

passages.title: The Tainted Marsh
passages.text:
You've done those souls a great favor. I hope they find peace.

Let's cut off these experiments at the source now.

passages.title: Cinder of Cynders
passages.text: The cinder seethes with the hatred that its former owner held for you.

passages.title: Cinder of Cynders
passages.text: Have you brought me trophies of war?

passages.title: Cinder of Cynders
passages.text: Well done, <race>. For the Horde!

passages.title: Pearl of Fathoms
passages.text: The pearl is immaculately smooth, and surprisingly dense.

passages.title: Pearl of Fathoms
passages.text: I'm not in the market for jewelry, <class>...

passages.title: Pearl of Fathoms
passages.text:
Oh, I see. This is a trophy of battle.

We will add it to the many treasures you and your fellow adventurers have brought. For the Horde!

passages.title: Salt of Shards
passages.text: The Abyssal Lord left behind a small pile of faintly-iridescent sand.

passages.title: Salt of Shards
passages.text: What do you have there? That isn't Silithyst, is it?

passages.title: Salt of Shards
passages.text: Ahh, the trophy of an epic battle. Well fought, <class>!

passages.title: Song of Zephyrs
passages.text: A swirling essence coalesces at the feet of the Duke.

passages.title: Song of Zephyrs
passages.text: You wrote me a song? How thoughtful.

passages.title: Song of Zephyrs
passages.text: Ah, I see, it is a hard-earned reward from one of your many battles. Well done, <class>!

passages.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
passages.text: The sigils of the Abyssal High Council are crafted from the distilled essence of the element of their holder. This sigil was crafted from coral and smoothed by the tides.

passages.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
passages.text: What have we here?

passages.title: Tidal Sigil of Skwol
passages.text:
A sigil from the Abyssal High Council? You've outdone yourself today, <race>.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Cinder of Cynders
passages.text: The cinder seethes with the hatred that its former owner held for you.

passages.title: Cinder of Cynders
passages.text: Have you brought me trophies of war?

passages.title: Cinder of Cynders
passages.text: Well done, <race>. For the Alliance!

passages.title: Pearl of Fathoms
passages.text: The pearl is immaculately smooth, and surprisingly dense.

passages.title: Pearl of Fathoms
passages.text: I'm not in the market for jewelry, <class>...

passages.title: Pearl of Fathoms
passages.text:
Oh, I see. This is a trophy of battle.

We will add it to the many treasures you and your fellow adventurers have brought. For the Alliance!

passages.title: Salt of Shards
passages.text: The Abyssal Lord left behind a small pile of faintly-iridescent sand.

passages.title: Salt of Shards
passages.text: What do you have there? That isn't Silithyst, is it?

passages.title: Salt of Shards
passages.text: Ahh, the trophy of an epic battle. Well fought, <class>!

passages.title: Song of Zephyrs
passages.text: A swirling essence coalesces at the feet of the Duke.

passages.title: Song of Zephyrs
passages.text: You wrote me a song? How thoughtful.

passages.title: Song of Zephyrs
passages.text: Ah, I see, it is a hard-earned reward from one of your many battles. Well done, <class>!

passages.title: Restoring Equilibrium
passages.text:
Kor'vass sent a report on the status of the Fel Hammer. It suffered major damage, and is now even uglier than before if that'ss even possible...

It hass also begun listing to one side - rather comically, I might add. For some reason, Kor'vass doesn't find this nearly as entertaining as she should.

Anyway, there are stabilizer crystalss around the Tomb of Sargerass she could use for repairss.

Say the word and I will direct a squadron of illidari batriderss to accompany you. I'd come too, but...

passages.title: Restoring Equilibrium
passages.text: Have you secured the materialss for repairing the Fel Hammer, <name>?

passages.title: Restoring Equilibrium
passages.text: It'ss a shame the batriderss didn't make it. Even more reason to blast the hell out of the Legion as soon as the Fel Hammer'ss weaponss core iss operational again.

passages.title: Brothers and Sisters
passages.text: Your people were trying to stop the Legion before you arrived, but flesh is weak and they accumulated too many wounds. Without your aid, they will surely perish at the hands of the demons. Go, help them.

passages.title: Brothers and Sisters
passages.text: Rock may chip, but it does not bleed as flesh does.

passages.title: Brothers and Sisters
passages.text: I provided cover as the weaker of your people retreated. They will return to the Maelstrom safely.

passages.title: Conflagration
passages.text:
That fiend! Up on the hill, a demon who calls himself "The Flameripper" is using the power of my realm. Your shaman die as he draws power from the Firelands, mixing the fire of our world with the unholy flame of his.

He is extremely powerful, Farseer. You must take him down, whatever the cost!

passages.title: Conflagration
passages.text: Ah, you've awoken. I have heard tale of what happened.

passages.title: A Time for Everything
passages.text:
Our order is recovering thanks to your quick actions, Grandmaster. 

There is just one more monk we need to attend to before it is too late!

passages.title: A Time for Everything
passages.text:
Grandmaster <name>, these old bones grow weary. Our future depends on you to continue the fight against the Legion.

So long as you remain a beacon of light in the darkness, hope remains!

passages.title: Call of the Scarab
passages.text: The Call of the Scarab event is occurring today. Speak with your faction's leader near the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

passages.title: Call of the Scarab
passages.text:
And who are you? <name>?

Ahh... yes, I believe I've heard mention of you before. Welcome to Silithus, <name>.

Today, we celebrate our heritage as sons of Kalimdor. Furthermore, we prove that the Horde will always grind those puny Alliance into the ground.

Are you with me?

passages.title: Call of the Scarab
passages.text: The Call of the Scarab event is occurring today. Speak with your faction's leader near the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

passages.title: Call of the Scarab
passages.text:
And who are you? <name>?

Ahh... yes, I believe I've heard mention of you before. Welcome to Silithus, <name>.

Today, we celebrate the fabled war history of Kalimdor. Furthermore, we prove that the Alliance will always show the Horde their inferiority.

Are you with me?

passages.title: The Speaker Awaits
passages.text:
High Priest, we've received word from Netherlight Temple of a most curious visitor: Magni Bronzebeard, the very Speaker himself!

What could he want from our order? You'd best head back to Netherlight, we'll hold down the front here.

passages.title: The Speaker Awaits
passages.text: Thank ye for coming so quickly, High <class>. King Magni, or I suppose I should say 'The Speaker,' thinks he's found a hidden Titan vault!

passages.title: Informing the Council
passages.text:
I'll deal with this prisoner, but you should head back to Dreadscar Rift. 

Let the others know what we've discovered. We will need their help dealing with Kanrethad on the Broken Shore.

passages.title: Informing the Council
passages.text:
Thank you for bringing me news of Jubeka. It could not have come at a better time.

We've received information on Kanrethad's whereabouts.

passages.title: Destroying the Nest
passages.text:
We have to put an end to Tugar's plot. These abominations must be destroyed, as well as their source!

I think I know where. A group of neutral drogbar had a settlement nearby, but were pushed out by concerted demon and fel tauren attacks. That must be the place.

Go there and stop their fel monster production at its source!

passages.title: Destroying the Nest
passages.text: A tough fight to be sure, have you prevailed?

passages.title: Destroying the Nest
passages.text:
You have saved Thunder Totem and we owe you yet another debt.

It's a shame that Tugar wasn't there. As long as he lives, we are in danger.

I will do everything I can to find him, and then we will finish this... together.

passages.title: War'zuul the Provoker
passages.text:
There'ss some obnoxious demon lord up there who's been yelling for hourss. 

Would you please shut him up already? I'm getting a terrible headache!

passages.title: War'zuul the Provoker
passages.text: It'ss about time you shut that demon up. Thanksss...

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: The shrouded star flickers upon the land with its intermittent light ushering in an eerie mist upon the land. This star and the mists bring deep shadows to the land hiding its secrets and dangers. While its influence holds, new paths may open up, to distant places and even distant times. No sage truly understands the nature of this sign, but fortune favors the daring.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: I foresee that you will follow the shrouded star, and walk the paths it reveals.

passages.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time
passages.text: Ah, <name>, you have returned. An otherworldly air hangs heavy about you.

passages.title: The Pirate's Bay
passages.text:
While we've made some progress on the Broken Shore, I think it is time for the more subtle tactics of the Uncrowned.

We've received word of a large cave off the main island, where powerful demons meet to plot our downfall. Tess and Tethys have formulated a plan, but they need your help to see it through.They are waiting for you at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.

passages.title: The Pirate's Bay
passages.text: Straighten up, Shadowblade. We've got work to do.

passages.title: Stolen Souls
passages.text:
Odyn's worthy are held captive by soul fonts scattered around the Eternal Battlefield. They were destined to become Valarjar before their futures were stolen.

Now, you can restore them to their rightful places. Destroy the soul fonts to release them!

passages.title: Stolen Souls
passages.text: With the Valarjar leading the vanguard, our offensives will be glorious!

passages.title: False Orders
passages.text:
As soon as you take down Prix, word will spread like wildfire amongst the crew in the area. I had Tethys forge some orders in her handwriting that should send them away and buy us some more time.

Plant the orders in the marked locations. You should see the results rather quickly.

passages.title: False Orders
passages.text: They ran right past us on their way out.

passages.title: A Triumphant Report
passages.text: You should return to your Kirin Tor. I have no doubt they will want to hear the good news!

passages.title: A Triumphant Report
passages.text:
I am relieved that you have dealt with immediate threat. We barely have enough resources for the Broken Shore as it is!

Still we have something for you...

passages.title: Dark Omens
passages.text:
We won't be able to defeat Kruul alone.

Once the portal has stabilized I will send word so we can bring the Highlord to justice.

In the meantime, you should inform the Kirin Tor of Vazuun's death - and Kruul's return.

passages.title: Dark Omens
passages.text: Any luck out there?

passages.title: Avocation of Antonidas
passages.text:
Archmage Kalec has requested your presence back in the Hall of the Guardian. He's discovered something he wishes to urgently speak with you about.

Please see him at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Avocation of Antonidas
passages.text:
Archmage, I've found something you may be interested in. An old journal of the late Archmage Antonidas. In it, he speaks of a project he was working on that I think we may be able to finish.

It was a sort of flying disc that could attune itself to the rider's magical specialization.

But I need your help tracking down the pieces. From what I could gather, he gave them to trusted friends and allies through the years. Perhaps you could persuade them to give us the pieces.

passages.title: Battle for Val'sharah
passages.text:
From the very start of these attacks I've felt as though the demons knew our plans, as if they anticipated our every move. If we are to put an end to this we must focus our attacks at the heart of the beast.

Your efforts have shown these battles are not won by bravery alone, but willingness and sacrifice. I ask that you stand on the battlefield once more among allies to bring this madness to an end.

passages.title: Battle for Val'sharah
passages.text:
You have sacrificed for our lands, brave <class>.

Your perseverance has inspired our brothers and sisters to stand against the Burning Legion.

passages.title: The Firelord's Offense
passages.text:
Smolderon calls from across the battlefield, shaman. Now it is his realm being violated.

It seems urgent. I will clean up here.

passages.title: The Firelord's Offense
passages.text: I will not allow such insolence!

passages.title: The Imp Mother's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: The Imp Mother's Gift
passages.text: It is small compensation for the deed you have accomplished, I hope it is enough.

passages.title: The God-Queen's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: The God-Queen's Gift
passages.text: I cannot thank you enough, hero.

passages.title: Kruul's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: Kruul's Gift
passages.text: Your competence in these matters is greatly appreciated.

passages.title: Jarod's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: Jarod's Gift
passages.text: Once this is all over, the Council hopes to thank you properly.

passages.title: Xylem's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: Xylem's Gift
passages.text: Your talent for this sort of thing is astounding!

passages.title: Navarrogg's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: Navarrogg's Gift
passages.text: We hope the increased power to your weapon will prove useful on the Broken Shore and beyond.

passages.title: Raest's Gift
passages.text:
While we have already given you what power we can, we would like to present to you a... cosmetic... upgrade to your artifact.

On behalf of the Council of Six, Dalaran, and Azeroth, we thank you again, <name>.

passages.title: Raest's Gift
passages.text: Once again you have proven to be a capable agent against the Legion.

passages.title: The Folly of Levia Laurance
passages.text:
Levia Laurance was once a member of the Kirin Tor, long ago, and a good friend. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous for all of us if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Militant Mystic. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

passages.title: The Acolyte Imperiled
passages.text:
Truthfully, the Council knows little of Agatha, but she is more than just your average succubus. She has many allies within the sayaad, and is known to command armies of imps that swarm and overwhelm her foes.

To seek her out is folly, but Ritssyn Flamescowl repays his debts.

Come, let us examine what manner of fel powers this little mage of yours was stumbling her way through...

passages.title: The Acolyte Imperiled
passages.text: Keep these imps off me!

passages.title: The Acolyte Imperiled
passages.text:
The amount of power this Levia channeled into this portal is impressive, if unnecessary. Unfortunately, if we don't get it stable, it's likely to collapse and take us with it. 

Sufficed to say, that would end your mission pretty quick.

I have to concentrate to keep this open, so I'll need your help...

passages.title: Following the Scent
passages.text:
You will have to continue through the portal without me, <class>. I have assisted you in locating your mage's whereabouts, so I consider my debt to Modera paid.

However, I will lend you one of my felhounds to help track this mage down. If she is as powerful as Modera says, then it would be in everyone's best interest that Agatha not be allowed to keep her.

Best of luck, <class>, and try to bring Fhambar back in one piece.

passages.title: Following the Scent
passages.text:
What... what is going on? 

Who are you?

passages.title: Infernal Phenomena
passages.text:
Do you hear that, shaman? The rumble of the earth as it tries to fight against the Legion's will. Their half-witted eredar are attempting to bend the forces of Azeroth to their will.

How dare the Legion think they can corrupt my domain? They have assembled their infernals from Azeroth's stone - MY stone! Now they try to bring these new infernals to life.

Sabotage their foolish rituals. Crush them! Show them Azeroth's true power!

passages.title: Infernal Phenomena
passages.text: The earth is my domain, NOT the Legion's!

passages.title: Infernal Phenomena
passages.text: I laughed as their infernals crumbled. They return to Azeroth, as they belong.

passages.title: An Urgent Warning
passages.text:
<The soldier is wan and wounded, obviously in tremendous pain.>

Been held prisoner... since the assault on... the Broken Shore...

<He shudders.>

The demons... th-they are gathering... preparing...

Had to escape... to warn you. They must... be stopped!

passages.title: An Urgent Warning
passages.text:
Greetings, Highlord. I've just been informed about the wounded soldier who escaped from the Broken Shore.

What he must have endured...

passages.title: Investigate the Broken Shore
passages.text:
All of us know the price we paid the last time we set foot upon the Broken Shore.

<Tyrosus turns his eyes to the ground.>

I recommend dispatching a scouting team to investigate the Legion's strength. We need to know what we're facing in that accursed place.

passages.title: Investigate the Broken Shore
passages.text:
Grim tidings indeed.

I suggest we continue sending our champions to scout out the dangers that await.

passages.title: Arming Dalaran
passages.text:
Kathra'natir is powerless to stop us from harnessing his energy within the Nightborne Soulstone. We have been lucky thus far - our allies have kept news of the sabotage from spreading. 

We should repair Dalaran's weapons array immediately while luck is still on our side.

Oh - the weapon platform is a bit inaccessible. I trust you are not afflicted by a fear of heights? I will open a portal.

passages.title: Arming Dalaran
passages.text: Use the Control Crystal to activate the Soulstone!

passages.title: Arming Dalaran
passages.text:
Well done, Archmage <name>! Dalaran can defend herself once again.

For all of our sakes, let us hope that the shields keeping Kathra'natir imprisoned do not fail before we are able to find a safer solution.
