passages.title: Salvation
passages.text:
The valley is swarming with fel-corrupted creatures who are beyond saving, yet there still may be some that could use our help.

Take this manaroot salve and apply it to any animals you see. If the fel magic hasn't taken hold, the salve might be able to mend their wounds.

passages.title: Salvation
passages.text: You risked your life freeing those animals from a life worse than death. I commend you, <name>.

passages.title: Adopt a Tadpole
passages.text:
One day every year, usually in mid-spring, the Winterfin tadpoles are given free reign of the village. I'm not sure why this tradition persists, as it usually results in heavy damage to buildings and food stores.

I usually try not to interfere too much with the goings-on of the tribe, but today, I take exception. Go out and see if you can keep an eye on one of the tadpoles.

passages.title: Adopt a Tadpole
passages.text: Glrm. Mrr glrg.

passages.title: A Tadpole's Request
passages.text:
Glrrrr! Mrr, mrr, glrrgli!

<Your favorite little tadpole is getting reckless. Maybe he might like some clams?>

passages.title: A Tadpole's Request
passages.text: Mrglr?

passages.title: A Tadpole's Request
passages.text: Glrrrrms!

passages.title: The Ways of the World
passages.text:
Mrrga!

<Your tadpole cowers and hides, as he observes the shadowy figure of a large orca passing through the Westrift.>

Mrrga... Mrrga...

passages.title: The Ways of the World
passages.text: Mrrga mr?

passages.title: The Ways of the World
passages.text: Mrrga mr. Gll-mrrr!

passages.title: Worthy of the Title
passages.text:
Highlord, Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker wishes to speak with you about an important matter.

Please seek him out at Light's Hope Chapel in your order hall at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Worthy of the Title
passages.text: Highlord! I'd like to speak with you about obtaining a special mount...

passages.title: The Hammer of Dalaran
passages.text:
Should we wish to make this barding worthy of the steed who will bear it, we'll need to upgrade it. Right now it's just good for not getting you kicked off your mount.

Speak with Alard Schmied in Dalaran. He's a fine smith and will know how to modify this barding into something more befitting our needs.

passages.title: The Hammer of Dalaran
passages.text:
Greetings, Highlord. What can I help you with?

<You explain what you need to Alard as he looks over the barding.>

I see. I can certainly help you with your upgrading this, but I'll need a few things first.

passages.title: Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation
passages.text:
We have uncovered forged orders from the Shore. They have a fel influence about them. They guide the reader to believe they are legitimate. It orders Black Rook Hold to attack a "demonic enclave" just south of their walls. There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!

Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.

Specialization: Holy Priest

passages.title: Holy: The Bradensbrook Investigation
passages.text: A bit late for the warning, eh? Still, I appreciate that we haven't been forgotten.

passages.title: Quieting the Spirits
passages.text:
An overwhelming attack on Bradensbrook is imminent. Together I believe we can blunt the spear before it is cast.

While we are dealing with the commanders, we should put down as many unquiet spirits as we can.

With their leaders down and their numbers culled, that should give us time to find Erdris Thorn.

passages.title: Quieting the Spirits
passages.text: I can see you've brought a lot of "peace" in your day, <class>.

passages.title: Quieting the Spirits
passages.text:
We realize these spirits are misguided, but we have to care about the living more than the dead at this point.

The attacks should ease off for a while.

passages.title: Shadowsong's Return
passages.text:
Well our lines are doing a lot better, thanks to you. A good thing too, because we need the rest!

That being said, we noticed a big group of bigger, meaner risen coming from the farmstead. They would've given us a hard time, but that Shadowsong fellow has returned and killed them all. He's holding off reinforcements coming from the hold.

I'm guessing he could use a hand. We can hold here until you and Shadowsong sort this out.

passages.title: Shadowsong's Return
passages.text: I had hoped this town had found peace after what we've all been through. Somehow restless dead have been stirred into a fury. We need to stop it.

passages.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
passages.text:
Greetings, Shadowblade.

I hope you are not too upset that I began without you, I have a bit of trouble controlling myself around the mindless undead.

Yes, you heard me right. Taerir, the very Taerir that has been standing in the Hall of Shadows for many months now, was the undead pawn of a dreadlord.

And there are more of them - in our cities, rising through the ranks of the aristocracy, growing in power and influence, and nearly undetectable.

passages.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
passages.text: Your blade is not yet bloody enough.

passages.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
passages.text: We have shown the demons why they should truly fear the darkness. Now, Lord Ravenholdt has something for you from his personal collection.

passages.title: Dread Infiltrators
passages.text:
Shadowblade, we have received a raven with most troubling news.

One of our own, an ally that walked our very Hall of Shadows, is not who they seem.

I believe Lilian has already begun dissecting their corpse. You'd best hurry.

passages.title: Dread Infiltrators
passages.text: You don't really know if an ally is an undead pawn under the control of a dreadlord until you carve into them a bit.

passages.title: Cutting off the Heads
passages.text:
Erdris Thorn was a key commander of Ravencrest's forces. To hear him confusing us for the Legion fills me with a great sadness. He will be a difficult foe to defeat.

We must stop his squad leaders from forming up for a focused assault on Bradensbrook. Defeating them should delay his forces long enough for us to find and deal with him. Let us begin our grim task.

passages.title: Cutting off the Heads
passages.text: It is difficult to bring peace to old friends.

passages.title: Cutting off the Heads
passages.text: That should disorganize the assault for some time, but we must get to the bottom of this. I sensed a fel taint about those leaders, did you?

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must hasten our efforts.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Shall we begin, <class>t?

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text: Applying the resources gathered by our order will allow us to make quick progress.

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Learning more about your artifact weapon will help hasten our victory over the Legion.

If you supply me with order resources, I can provide research notes on your weapon. Read them, and learn how to take greater advantage of the power you infuse into your artifact.

Death to our enemies!

passages.title: Battle for Stormheim
passages.text:
Your efforts have destroyed the Legion's forces upon Shield's Rest, yet they continue to press their assault.

There is only one way to end this - you must venture into the midst of our foe, find their commander, and remove his vile head!

passages.title: Battle for Stormheim
passages.text:
Well done, <name>! Well done indeed!

The Legion will rue the day they set their sights on the land of Stormheim.

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Boss, you've been working every angle on the Broken Isles, infusing that ancient artifact of yours with power. But those demons won't give up, and we really need to unlock more of your weapon's potential... and I mean pronto!

Slow, steady progress is one thing. But today, we need to get busy.

Here's the deal. You fork over our order's resources so I can study the weapon's history, and I'll get you a way to up the value of the power you apply to that artifact.

How does that sound, <class>t?

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text: This is a great deal, boss! Applying the resources gathered by our order will let us make big-time progress.

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Learning more about your artifact weapon will sure speed up our victory over the Legion, boss.

If you supply me with order resources, I can whip up research notes on your weapon. Read 'em, and in no time you'll be taking greater advantage of the power you infuse into your artifact.

Let's do this!

For Azeroth!

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
You are truly the scourge of the Broken Isles, wresting power from our enemies and infusing it into your ancient artifact. But we must not become complacent! Let us unlock further depths of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we will redouble our efforts.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact. And power is intoxicating.

Shall we begin, <class>t?

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text: Applying the resources gathered by our order will allow us to make quick progress toward empowering your artifact and dominating our foes.

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Knowledge of your artifact is the key to bending the demons to your will.

If you supply me with order resources, I can provide research notes on your weapon. Read them, Netherlord, and the power you infuse into your artifact will magnify.

Your foes will quake in fear... as it should be!

There's a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we'd best hasten our efforts.

By devotin' our order's resources to studyin' the weapon's history, we can rapidly enhance the value of the power ye apply to the artifact.

We best get started, <class>t!

For Azeroth!

passages.text:
In the course of trouncing foe after foe in the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But the Legion fights without honor, and to defeat them we must unlock even more of your weapon's potential.

Slow, steady progress will wait for another time. Today, we must hasten the path to victory.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we will rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Glory awaits us, <class>t!

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text: Applying the resources gathered by our order will allow us to make quick progress. Our foes will tremble!

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
There is power in old tales. Learning the legend of your artifact weapon will hasten our victory over the Legion.

If you supply me with order resources, I can scribe tales of might and wonder. Read them, and the power you infuse into your artifact will echo through the Halls of Valor.

For Odyn!

Shall we find the story within, <class>t?

In stories, we find strength!

passages.title: Sterile Surroundings
passages.text:
With the threat of infection dismissed, your allies should be able to press their assault here on the Broken Shore and gain an advantage over the Burning Legion.

Let's leave this place and speak somewhere more... sterile. I hear your order occupies an impressive temple.

passages.title: Sterile Surroundings
passages.text: What a charming place this is. Much more hospitable than that demon-infested island.

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Throughout our campaign on the Broken Isles, you have infused your ancient artifact with power. But as the Legion invasion intensifies, it becomes crucial to unlock more of your weapon's potential.

There is a time for slow, steady progress. But today, we must move with the wind at our backs.

By devoting our order's resources to studying the weapon's history, I believe we can rapidly enhance the value of the power you apply to the artifact.

Shall we begin, <class>t?

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text: I believe applying the resources gathered by our order will allow us to make quick progress.

passages.title: Knowledge is Power
passages.text:
Learning more about your artifact weapon will help speed us on the path to victory over the Legion.

If you supply me with order resources, I can provide research notes on your weapon. Read them, and learn how to take greater advantage of the power you infuse into your artifact.

Let the wind guide your way!

passages.title: An Urgent Message
passages.text: We received an urgent message from one of Belath's scouts down on Mardum! I think you had better listen to it.

passages.title: An Urgent Message
passages.text: What do you think?

passages.title: An Urgent Message
passages.text: Lady S'theno went down to lend a hand, but this sounds like it's getting serious!

passages.title: Tactical Planning
passages.text: Battlelord <name>! We should discuss our next moves!

passages.title: Tactical Planning
passages.text: It is good to see you again, my friend.

passages.title: A Portal Away
passages.text:
Xylem may have escaped, but a trace of his portal remains.

Now that you have freed his apprentices from his corruption, I will set them to work trying to find a way to reach him. Once I find something, I will alert the Kirin Tor.

I only ask that when you do confront the Archmage, that you try to spare his life. I believe that the good man he once was still exists beneath the shadow that has taken him.

Farewell, <name>.

passages.title: A Portal Away
passages.text:
So Xylem has been corrupted by shadow magic and has escaped with the Focusing Iris? This is not good.

The Kirin Tor will pool our efforts with those of his apprentici-- I mean, apprentices. We must track down the archmage before he does something drastic.

We will be in touch.

passages.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
passages.text:
Greetings, Shadowblade.

I hope you are not too upset that I began without you, I have a bit of trouble controlling myself around the mindless undead.

Yes, you heard me right. Taerir, the very Taerir that has been standing in the Hall of Shadows for many months now, was the undead pawn of a dreadlord.

And there are more of them - in our cities, rising through the ranks of the aristocracy, growing in power and influence, and nearly undetectable.

passages.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
passages.text: Your blade is not yet bloody enough.

passages.title: Hiding In Plain Sight
passages.text: We have shown the demons why they should truly fear the darkness. Now, Lord Ravenholdt has something for you from his personal collection.

passages.title: Battle for Highmountain
passages.text: Our defenses have grown in strength, yet the Legion continues to press their assault on Thunder Totem. There is but one way to put an end to this madness - we must strike at the heart of their forces together and bring these attacks to an end.

passages.title: Battle for Highmountain
passages.text: Our efforts today have prevailed over the Legion's presence, though let us not be remiss - our journey has only just begun.

passages.title: Battle for Azsuna
passages.text: The vile demon commanding the assault must be stopped. I can get us close, but once we're there I'll rely on you and your allies to help bring down the demonic forces.

passages.title: Battle for Azsuna
passages.text: With the fall of their commander the Legion's presence in Azsuna will be more manageable for our defenders to make headway. For your efforts, we may see the end of these attacks once and for all.

passages.title: The Matter Resolved... For Now...
passages.text: You should return to the Kirin Tor. I have no doubt they will want to hear of our success. I will find Lord Erdris, and then I will contact you.

passages.title: The Matter Resolved... For Now...
passages.text:
I am relieved that you have dealt with immediate threat. We barely have enough resources for the Broken Shore as it is!

Still we have something for you...

passages.title: Whispers of a Frightened World
passages.text:
"Champion! Azeroth needs our help."

<Magni Bronzebeard's words echo in your mind, as if rising from somewhere deep and ancient. Azeroth's world soul seeks to deliver a warning to the Speaker, but some force is interfering with the message.>

<Magni has urged you to travel to Sholazar Basin, the vibrant heart of frozen Northrend, to aid him.>

passages.title: Whispers of a Frightened World
passages.text:
This warning is an ill omen indeed, <name>. It seems the fate of Azeroth is tied to that of Argus, the homeworld of the Legion.

We must uncover the Dark Titan's plan! I believe the Speaker's connection to the world soul will prove crucial to our efforts.

Stay vigilant, Archdruid. We must trust in Magni's guidance... and Azeroth's as well.

passages.title: A Godly Invitation
passages.text:
Battlelord adventurer, Odyn has requested an audience with you back in Skyhold.

Please meet with him at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: A Godly Invitation
passages.text: Battlelord <name>, I have an offer you may be interested in...

passages.title: Secured Surroundings
passages.text:
With Lexera defeated, her band of trappers will quickly disband. Those that refuse will meet my blade.

These shores will be free of those who wish to corrupt Azeroth's wildlife.

Our work here is done for now. Let us meet at Deliverance Point. There is more I wish to discuss in secured surroundings.

passages.title: Secured Surroundings
passages.text: You've done so much so quickly here on the Broken Shore. Impressive, <name>.

passages.title: Bloodbringer's Missive
passages.text:
Warlock! We have news from Dreadscar Rift. 

A message arrived by raven from Mor'zul Bloodbringer, with instructions that you meet him in Dreadscar Rift immediately!

passages.title: Bloodbringer's Missive
passages.text: Will you not hear me out, <class>?

passages.title: Bloodbringer's Missive
passages.text: Our task will not be easy, but when this is over it is we who will be the true masters of Xoroth.

passages.title: Darkbinder Dilemma
passages.text:
Ah, Delas sent you. I see.

It's good she didn't come herself. It would break her heart to see what is happening to our family.

A demon is defiling our dead in the ruins nearby. She's using her fel magic on our ancestors, turning them into mindless horrors that do the bidding of the Burning Legion.

I can't deal with the harpies and this demon, but maybe you could help?

Get rid of the darkbinder that torments our dead, and I will grant you access to whatever's left of the Moonfang family relics.

passages.title: Darkbinder Dilemma
passages.text: Our dead will never know peace until Darkbinder Elissath is killed.

passages.title: Darkbinder Dilemma
passages.text: You have my thanks, <name>. The Moonfang family has certainly seen better days.

passages.title: Return of the Slayer
passages.text:
If you're anything like me, I'm sure you'd prefer to remain here on solid ground.

Unfortunately, it is probably best to return to the Fel Hammer right away so Kor'vass can finish the repairss.

passages.title: Return of the Slayer
passages.text:
Your quick blades have proven your worth to the Illidari yet again, Slayer <name>. We will begin the repairs to the Fel Hammer immediately. 

We cannot allow the Legion to catch us with our pants down again!

passages.title: Return of the Battlelord
passages.text:
Battlelord <name>, Odyn will want to hear the tale of your glorious victories here!

I will assist you in returning to Skyhold when you are ready.

passages.title: Return of the Battlelord
passages.text:
Your return is triumphant indeed, Battlelord <name>!

Under your leadership, the warriors of Skyhold are truly a force to be reckoned with!

passages.title: A Found Memento
passages.text:
<The trinket's fine brass exterior is inlaid with intricate filigree, though much of the detail has been battered by rocks and waves. Clearing away the grime and salt encrusting the clasp, you manage to open it.

It is a compass--or was, at least. The glass face is shattered, the needle bent, unmoving.

Set into the lid is a portrait. The paint is faded and waterlogged, but the subject is unmistakable: the face of a young Anduin Wrynn.>

passages.title: A Found Memento
passages.text: Well met, <name>. What brings you to Stormwind this day?

passages.title: A Found Memento
passages.text:
<As the king examines the compass, his expression turns from recognition to sorrow.>

When I went through my father's things and didn't find this compass, I assumed it was with him on the Broken Shore when Gul'dan...

<The king's voice breaks.>

passages.title: Summons to the Keep
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>.

Your presence has been requested in the royal court. The crown has urgent need of you!

Please return to Stormwind at your earliest convenience.

King Greymane is anticipating your swift arrival.

passages.title: Summons to the Keep
passages.text:
You've arrived at last, Huntmaster!

You may have noticed that King Anduin is conspicuous by his absence.

This is a situation that only you can rectify.

passages.title: The Giver of Quests
Consoling the King
passages.text:
Anduin hasn't been the same since you brought him his father's compass. He has become listless... distracted.

We attempted to console him, to no avail. Yesterday morning, he left the keep without so much as a word.

I ordered the guards to follow him, of course. He went to pray at the cathedral, where he's remained ever since.

You brought this melancholy upon him! You must convince the boy to resume his duties. There's a war to be won!

passages.title: Consoling the King
passages.text:
Let me guess... Genn sent you.

I wonder which he's more concerned about... my well-being, or keeping up the appearance that everything is normal?

passages.title: A Kingdom's Heart
passages.text:
My father was a legend. He oversaw the rebuilding of Stormwind, stood toe-to-toe with dragons, led the Alliance to numerous victories.

Then, one day, he was just... gone.

I wear his crown, I hold his title. But I've done nothing to earn them... or the faith of my people.

I've spent the war sequestered in the keep, surrounded by guards and advisors. I need to walk the streets of Stormwind, to know whether it is hope or fear that beats in the hearts of my people.

I welcome your company.

passages.title: A Kingdom's Heart
passages.text: They're right. They're absolutely right.

passages.title: Return to Sender
passages.text:
You've arrived just in time!

Unlike the mail as of late, I'm afraid.

We are severely understaffed, and demand is at an all-time high. We simply can't keep up!

I'd love to chat, but I need help catching up before I can rest for even a moment.

First thing's first. Several parcels of rejected mail have broken loose again; will you help me round them all up and return them to their senders?

passages.title: Return to Sender
passages.text:
You're an absolute natural!

Say, do you mind sticking around for awhile? I could sure use a helping hand!

passages.title: The King's Path
passages.text:
Now that I have seen the Broken Shore and the terror of the Burning Legion first hand, my eyes have been opened to the truth.

I speak not of the unfathomable evil of the enemy, but of the bravery and sacrifice that such evil brings about in the hearts of our people.

My father once told me that every king must carry the weight of his own crown. Mine has never felt heavier than it does at this very moment...

Please take me to the place where my father died, so that I may honor his sacrifice.

passages.title: The King's Path
passages.text: You have helped me more than I can say, <name>. For that, you will always have my thanks.

passages.title: Return of the Archmage
passages.text:
With Dalaran protected once again, we can all breathe a little easier. 

It is time for us to return to the Hall of the Guardian. I'm sure Meryl is anxiously awaiting word of our success.

passages.title: Return of the Archmage
passages.text:
We must not forget that this is a temporary measure. I cannot overstate the devastation that will ensue if Kathra'natir escapes... 

Still, thanks to you, Dalaran's teeth are sharpened once more. Well done, Archmage <name>!

passages.title: The Deadmines Strike Back
passages.text:
Breanni sent you? For her, info is always free. Just don't call me a snitch.

I've been hangin' around the Deadmines for years. For the most part, it's a pretty easy livin'. But a few days ago, I started hearing noises of all sorts comin' from the mines. If you want to get in unnoticed, I'll grab us a mine cart and we can get most of the way down without so much as an awkward glace in our direction.

Just let me know when you're ready to head in.

passages.title: The Deadmines Strike Back
passages.text: I can sneak you in. Getting out might be more of a challenge.

passages.title: The Deadmines Strike Back
passages.text: Someone took something from Cookies' cauldron? I'll report this to Breanni immediately. It seems the Wailing Caverns was not a singular incident. There is something big going on and I feel you have unknowingly stepped into the middle of it.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Deadmines
passages.text:
The Deadmines could still use some cleaning up, seems you didn't clear the place out last time.

We'll use the ol' mine cart trick again. Cept, we're going to put some flair into it. How do you feel about fire? No? Okay, fine. Just let me know when you're ready.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Deadmines
passages.text: I can sneak you in. Getting out might be more of a challenge.

passages.title: Pet Battle Challenge: Deadmines
passages.text: Impressive work. Here's the supplies I promised you. I believe that shadowy figure left it behind.

passages.title: Deadmines, Part Three?
passages.text:
I've heard suspicious rumors of movement in the Deadmines. After everything you pulled off in the Wailing Caverns, you'd be the perfect person to look into this!

I have a friend in Westfall. He may not look like much, but he's quick as a whip and may have more information on what is happening in Westfall. We've already dealt with the Van Cleefs... twice. So what could be making that sort of ruckus down there?

passages.title: Deadmines, Part Three?
passages.text:
I don't know nothing about nothing! Better get going before my shiv finds your face! Don't test me, cause I ain't all that bright!

Oh, Breanni? Yeah, sure! She's an old friend!

passages.title: Overwhelming Power
passages.text:
We will find no sanctuary on this world. Even now the full might of the Burning Legion rises to defend Argus.

The siege camp below overflows with demon filth that stand between us and the weapon trained on the Vindicaar.

They must be dealt with before it can fully charge, or Argus will be our grave.

passages.title: Overwhelming Power
passages.text: Is the way to the weapon clear?

passages.title: Overwhelming Power
passages.text: Now for the main weapon.

passages.title: Thorim's Flame
passages.text:
Not too long ago, the Drekirjar and the Thorignir respected each other. This only changed when Skovald came into power. An ancient Drekirjar spirit watches over this peak, which seems to be a sacred graveyard of some sort. He is the keeper of the ceremonial flame, which happens to be exactly what we need to call down the broodmother.

Why don't we go convince him to let us take the flame? I'm sure he'll be nothing but... amiable.

passages.title: Thorim's Flame
passages.text: Although the spirit might stand unconvinced that raising the bodies of his deceased allies for our own bidding is necessary, we could always slaughter him to get our way. Seems normal for us.

passages.title: Thorim's Flame
passages.text: See? Totally convinced. Let's take this torch down to the beacon.

passages.title: Vengeance: Seeking Kor'vas
passages.text:
Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city.

One of your Illidari, Kor'vas Bloodthorn, has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks.

I do not entirely trust your kind, but I will concede that you have at least proved adept at your namesake. I suggest you find Kor'vas and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.

Specialization: Vengeance Demon Hunter

passages.title: Vengeance: Seeking Kor'vas
passages.text:
Slayer <name>, you're a sight for sore eyes.

We need to move quickly!

passages.title: Talon's Call
passages.text:
The Legion is launching a renewed assault against the Shrine of Aviana in Hyjal!

Thisalee Crow is organizing a counter-offensive, she requests your presence in the Dreamgrove at once.

We will handle the offensive here. Good luck, Archdruid!

passages.title: Talon's Call
passages.text: Archdruid! We don't have much time, the shrine burns as we speak!

passages.title: Hope For a Cure
passages.text:
Hopefully you found enough fel poison samples with which to brew a cure.

Let's meet back to the Temple of Five Dawns!

passages.title: Hope For a Cure
passages.text: Hmm let me take a look... Yes, I think I can counter these!

passages.title: The Pirate's Bay
passages.text:
While we've made some progress on the Broken Shore, I think it is time for the more subtle tactics of the Uncrowned.

We've received word of a large cave off the main island, where powerful demons meet to plot our downfall. One of our rogues, Lilian Voss, has formulated a plan with Tethys to take care of them, but they require your aid. They are waiting for you at Dead Man's Bay in Azsuna.

passages.title: The Pirate's Bay
passages.text: Finally... my time to shine. Let's do this right.

passages.title: What's the Cache?
passages.text:
Our goal is to retrieve a cache of gunpowder which has been infused with some sort of fel power. I don't know how the pirates here acquired it, but it is more dangerous than they know. I assure you that it will be more... effective in our hands.

Master Gunner Prix should be toward the back of the cove, near the water. Take what we need from her.

passages.title: What's the Cache?
passages.text: Did you get it?

passages.title: What's the Cache?
passages.text: Yes... the gunpowder. It is the key to my plan!

passages.title: False Orders
passages.text:
We must take some precautions. As soon as you assassinate the gunner, the crew will be looking for you. I had Tethys forge some orders in her handwriting that should buy us some time.

Plant the orders in the marked locations. That will take care of the danger.

passages.title: False Orders
passages.text: They left with such purpose... fools.

passages.title: Livin' on the Ledge
passages.text: Slayer adventurer, Matron Mother Malevolence requests an audience with you back at the Fel Hammer. Please see her at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Livin' on the Ledge
passages.text: Slayer <name>, I have something I would like to speak with you about when you have a moment.

passages.title: The Vault of the Tirisgarde
passages.text:
Dalaran's weapons are arcane in origin, but that doesn't mean we can't try something different. 

Our order's vaults contain a vast store of magical devices... Why don't you take a look around and see if there's anything we can use?

passages.title: The Vault of the Tirisgarde
passages.text: Have you found anything promising?

passages.title: The Vault of the Tirisgarde
passages.text:
Now that's quite the eclectic collection if I ever saw one!

These are all powerful in their own way to be sure, but none are useable for our needs. At least not in their current form.

I wonder...

passages.title: A Golden Ticket
passages.text:
Huntmaster, we've gotten word from the Lodge that there is a letter wrought from golden light sitting on one of the tables, and it's got your name on it.

No one is sure how it got there, and someone's wolf may have tried to open it and gotten a mouth full of singed fur. Seems like it's meant only for you.

We'll hold down the fort here while you investigate.

passages.title: A Golden Ticket
passages.text: <You gingerly pick up the shimmering letter and open it.>

passages.title: A Creative Solution
passages.text:
The Nightborne Soulstone may be our best hope if we can come up with a way to safely use it without Kathra'natir escaping. If he were to get loose in Dalaran...

We should consult with our friend, Ari. She will know what modifications need to be done.

passages.title: A Creative Solution
passages.text: Well? What did Ari think?

passages.title: A Creative Solution
passages.text: So word has gotten out about Ryanna already? Ha!

passages.title: Keymaster Orlis
passages.text:
The Felborne insurgents appear to be guarding a teleporter pad within the glade ahead. I wonder where it leads?

It is probably safe to assume that we'll need to kill Keymaster Orlis in order to gain access.

passages.title: Keymaster Orlis
passages.text: Did you find anything?

passages.title: Keymaster Orlis
passages.text: This appears to be some sort of attunement crystal. Perfect.

passages.title: The Gates Are Closed
passages.text:
Sigryn must be reached before she can confront Odyn, but our path is blocked. Odyn will close the Gates of Valor as soon as he becomes aware of Sigryn's assault. You will have to find another way into the Halls.

I have no talent with portals, but your friends at the Kirin Tor seem to be very adept. Go now to them, and find a way through.

I thank you for what you've done to help Sigryn this far, <class>. I only hope we can save her from herself.

passages.title: The Gates Are Closed
passages.text:
So the daughter of Skovald followed in her father's footsteps? A pity, but it may have been inevitable. I believe this may be the "fall" the scrolls mentioned.

If this is true, there may still be hope! I will work on a way to get us into the Halls of Valor to pursue this Sigryn. I will be in touch when we find a way.

In the meantime, you have done a great service to bring her this far. I would not let that go unrewarded.

passages.title: The Tale of Ban-Lu
passages.text:
Oh, hello, you must be the new Grandmaster.

<Master Bu squints at you and sniffs.>

You young ones have no patience these days, always running off to fight your great battles.

No time for stories, even good ones, eh?

Why don't you put your fists down for a moment and allow an old man to tell you a tale.

Maybe buy an old man a drink while you are at it?

passages.title: The Tale of Ban-Lu
passages.text: Thank you for listening, and for paying for this beverage.

passages.title: Return to the Broken Peak
passages.text:
Of course, this is no mere story. Ban-Lu served as the personal mount of each of the previous Grandmasters, accompanying them through their travels as a faithful and trusted companion.

But... he has not revealed himself since you have become Grandmaster. This is troubling.

The last time he was seen was at the Peak of Serenity, after the fall of Grandmaster Hight.

It is there that we must begin our search for him.

passages.title: Return to the Broken Peak
passages.text:
A senseless loss of life, and for what?

<Master Bu looks heavily at the portal and shakes his head.>

passages.title: The Trail of Ban-Lu
passages.text:
It seems a lifetime ago that Grandmaster Hight was walking these grounds. 

While Ban-Lu has served every previous Grandmaster, he and Hight were the greatest of friends.

For many years they traveled the land, connecting with its people and maintaining our fragile peace.

I cannot imagine how deeply Ban-Lu must have been affected by his passing.

There must be some clues to his whereabouts around here. Look sharply.

passages.title: The Trail of Ban-Lu
passages.text: Have you found any more clues, Grandmaster?

passages.title: The Trail of Ban-Lu
passages.text:
These old bones just need a little rest. But we appear to be one step further on our journey.

That grummle over there looks like he could use some assistance. Why don't you talk to him while I get some rest?

passages.title: Into the Hornet's Nest
passages.text: I hope you are up for an adventure. Shall we see where that teleporter goes?

passages.title: Into the Hornet's Nest
passages.text: I think we have stumbled upon their headquarters. Be careful in here!

passages.title: The Shadow of Ban-Lu
passages.text:
That was good of you to assist Smelly Mountaintop, Grandmaster, and we have learned more about the fate of Ban-lu.

I won't bother you with escorting me to Shado-Pan Monastery. I can manage on my own.

Meet me there and we'll continue our search.

passages.title: The Shadow of Ban-Lu
passages.text: I've just begun my meditation, Grandmaster. But we may have another lead...

passages.title: Clean-up on Aisle Sha
passages.text:
I've spoken with the Shado-pan and they are willing to give us information if we can assist them with a task of their own.

Speak with Commander Shen-Li. While you're assisting them, I shall continue to meditate.

passages.title: Clean-up on Aisle Sha
passages.text: Ooohhmmmm... Ooooohhhhmmmm...

passages.title: Clean-up on Aisle Sha
passages.text:
The Shado-pan appear greatful, Grandmaster.

Shall we cont... what is that black residue on your foot?

passages.title: The River to Ban-Lu
passages.text:
We still do not know where Ban-Lu has gone to, but I do know who might.

To the southeast lives a jinyu, Waterspeaker Ryuli.

Perhaps he has seen Ban-Lu, or can ask him to inquire with the river about where Ban-Lu has been seen recently?

All this travel has done a number on my old joints, Grandmaster. I shall rest here a bit longer, and then catch up with you later on.

passages.title: The River to Ban-Lu
passages.text: Greetings. It is not every day that a Grandmaster <class> comes to visit me. How can I be of service?

passages.title: Lilies for Ryuli
passages.text:
I have not seen Ban-Lu, but the waters will surely know where he is.

There is a flower that grows in the lakes of the mountain slopes near the Temple of the White Tiger, that only blooms in the presence of someone pure of heart.

Bring me six of these Moon Lilies and I shall use them to speak to the river.

passages.title: Lilies for Ryuli
passages.text: How goes the Moon Lily collection, Grandmaster?

passages.title: Lilies for Ryuli
passages.text: Thank you. Allow me to search for answers for you.

passages.title: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe
passages.text:
The shield generator you found is much more than it appears. I do not think my elders would approve of such advanced technology being shared with outlanders...

And yet... We owe you our lives and our freedom. 

You may use it, with my blessing. Just... please be discreet about its existence, Archmage <name>.

passages.title: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe
passages.text:
What is this?

This is not just any old shield generator - it is almost... a sentient entity...

And it is very eager for a job to do. Yes, I think it will be quite content to work with us.

passages.title: Master Who?
passages.text:
Greetings. I've just received word that Master Bu has returned from a long spirit journey, and is currently resting his feet at Morning Breeze Village outside of the Temple of Five Dawns.

It's been quite a long time since anyone has seen or heard from him, but he's asking to speak to you.

We will handle the situation here while you are absent, Grandmaster.

passages.title: Master Who?
passages.text: Thank you for coming, Grandmaster.

passages.title: The Preservation of Nature
passages.text:
I fear this attack on Goldrinn is only the beginning, <name>. Whoever is ordering these attacks must be found and defeated.

Wasn't Thisalee with you? She never returned... brash child. I assume she is already on the Broken Shore, trying to track down this commander. Please, find her. Do not let her take this on alone.

passages.title: The Preservation of Nature
passages.text: Look at him squirm. He gave in easily!

passages.title: Nature's Touch
passages.text:
Apparently we're not the only druids that have run into these demons. The Legion took a ton of captives and brought them back to their camp. Our brothers and sisters lay wounded and hurting...

You can heal! Let's go save them!

passages.title: Nature's Touch
passages.text: We can't let the other druids suffer any longer!

passages.title: Nature's Touch
passages.text: I feel a lot better knowing we were able to save some of the other druids. We did what we could.

passages.title: Prick of a Thistle
passages.text:
Their commander's name is Katith'rax. He's the one who organized these attacks, and now the one who leads them. Luckily, it doesn't seem as though he's far off.

Right off the coast is a small island. Seems as though he hides there, barking orders without getting his hands dirty.

I, on the other hand, enjoy getting my hands a little dirty. Don't you?

passages.title: Prick of a Thistle
passages.text: This guy is going to pay for what he's done!

passages.title: Prick of a Thistle
passages.text:
Revenge feels so good.

But stopping the attacks on the ancients feels even better.

passages.title: Starweave and Shadowcloth
passages.text:
At last, you are ready for true tailoring knowledge. I truly think you've earned it. 

I've fashioned the materials you've gathered into a satchel of Legendary Tailor's Materials. 

Go to the Queen's Grace Loom and weave two bolts of cloth. With my careful research of fashion, heroes, and legends. I believe the new cloth you will make will echo through the ages. Hurry!

passages.title: Starweave and Shadowcloth
passages.text: Please make a bolt of Starweave and a bolt of Shadowcloth at the loom as soon as you can and bring it back to me for final inspection.

passages.title: Starweave and Shadowcloth
passages.text:
The cloth you've created is like none I've ever seen. Beautiful! 

Take these elements and make something wonderful with them. I will be the first to write of your accomplishments and I truly believe you will become, at last, an icon of heroic style, <name>!

passages.title: The Legend of the Elderhide
passages.text:
Leatherworking is one of the oldest forms of craftsmanship in the world. Hides of animals were the first clothing. Legends tell of a particular form of leather curing that has been lost to us in modern times. 

Combining magic of the earth with some of the finest leathers ever found, this technique has been recreated by yours truly through careful analysis and my understanding of style. 

To begin, you must capture some ancient wisps to channel the exact nature magic for the curing process.

passages.title: The Legend of the Elderhide
passages.text: Have you found an Ancient Wisp?

passages.title: The Legend of the Elderhide
passages.text: Ancient wisps? Beautiful! This is a strong start, <name>.

passages.title: The Wisp and the Nightmare
passages.text:
Xavius, the Nightmare Lord in Val'Sharah, derives some of his power from his spellsash. It is enchanted and tied to the world beneath his feet and cannot be removed from his body. 

However, with the ancient wisp's help, the spellsash can be removed if you can but defeat Xavius in combat. Trivial for one of your skill, I'm sure. 

Take the wisp to the Emerald Nightmare, take the spellsash, and use your skills to repair any damage you've caused in the battle.

passages.title: The Wisp and the Nightmare
passages.text: <name>, defeat Xavius and obtain his spellsash for me. Make sure that it is repaired to perfect condition!

passages.title: The Wisp and the Nightmare
passages.text: The spellsash looks perfect, <name>! I couldn't have done a better repair myself.

passages.title: Leather of the Ancients
passages.text:
<name>, we are going to need high quality leather to work with. Ancient Dreadleather is the best hereabouts and local tanning techniques were exceptional in the past. To the untrained eye, it may look like normal dreadleather. That is where the wisp comes in. 

Many of your enemies across Broken Shore will have some amount of Ancient Dreadleather. As you defeat them, you will start to recognize armor made from it and you can harvest the leather for our purposes.

passages.title: Leather of the Ancients
passages.text: Keep your eye out for ancient dreadleather. We will need a good amount for our purposes.

passages.title: Leather of the Ancients
passages.text: That is, indeed, dreadleather. Should be enough for our needs, <name>. My thanks!

passages.title: The Owl and the Traitor
passages.text:
I've scoured the tales and legends for armor that might have Wardenscale components and one Cordana Felsong is a name that caught my attention. 

Evidently she has a family mantle that has what we need. Kill her and find it on her traitor's corpse. The owl will make sure that you spot it. 

It is likely chipped from years of hard use so restore it to prime condition and bring it back to me.

passages.title: The Owl and the Traitor
passages.text: Have you gotten Cordana's mantle and restored it yet? Rumor has it she is in the Vault of the Wardens.

passages.title: The Owl and the Traitor
passages.text: The mantle looks brand new! Excellent craftsmanship, <name>!

passages.title: The Hellslayer
passages.text:
The Hellslayer's tale is a classic story of revenge. Odyn wished to take the souls of the bravest as champions but Helya sent her kvaldir to take the souls first. The people of Stormheim suffered as their pawns. 

The kvaldir came to the Hellslayer's ship at night and killed her son and took his soul to serve Helya for eternity. The Hellslayer took up her axe and the spear of her son and sought vengeance. Finish her quest. Defeat Helya and forge a hammer from the Frostveined Shale.

passages.title: The Hellslayer
passages.text: The Frostveined Shale is what remains of the Hellslayer's weapons after they were destroyed on Helya's cold forge. It is powerful stuff and we need it.

passages.title: The Hellslayer
passages.text: The hammer is perfect but rather cold. I do respect your craftsmanship!

passages.title: Retaliation
passages.text:
Of course I will help you! Although to be honest, I am not certain where a new arcane shield generator can be found these days. So many of our craftspeople have been executed... I will think on it.

Would you mind helping me as well? I have been observing a nearby group of Felborne for some time. Their activities have become increasingly brazen of late.

I think it's time to teach them how it feels to be violently suppressed.

passages.title: Retaliation
passages.text: Revenge is so sweet. Thank you.

passages.title: Amal'thazad's Message
passages.text:
Deathlord, Amal'thazad has requested your presence at Acherus.

He has been in contact with the Lich King, and making improvements on the citadel.

For his benefit, or yours, I know not.

passages.title: Amal'thazad's Message
passages.text:
Ah, Deathlord, you have returned.

I have inscribed a series of frozen runes above Acherus. Once attuned, you will be able to communicate with the Lich King more... completely.

He will be able to show you things he could not before.

<Amal'thazad emits a horrible, rasping noise, that you can only assume is a chuckle.>

passages.title: Nothing Up My Sleeve
passages.text:
Now, you may think that a sack of gold would be a good reward for your troubles, but I've got something better in mind for you.

I'm gonna teach you my best trick!

I know, I know, I'm a very generous goblin. Let me show you how it's done!

passages.title: Nothing Up My Sleeve
passages.text: You gonna do the trick or not?

passages.title: Nothing Up My Sleeve
passages.text:
This is a catastrophe! Something must be wrong with my rabbit dimension!

Okay, I'm gonna need your help again.

passages.title: Power Outage
passages.text:
Kor'vass asked for a bunch of other stuff, but it won't hurt her to learn a bit of patience. Don't you agree?

She did mentioned that the ship'ss weaponss array is severely damaged and dangerously low on power. Knowing her, I'm sure that'ss an exaggeration.

I suppose you may as well take this power core I confiscated. You can replenish it from those disgusting Legion geyserss and energy globess floating around the Tomb.

passages.title: Power Outage
passages.text: I alwayss hated heightss. I'm glad you're the one who has to do the dirty work.

passages.title: The Prophet's Gambit
passages.text:
I can feel their presence just ahead. It is as faint as the lightest breeze that once rolled across these hills, but it is not of the Legion, of that I am certain.

We must see if these broken are potential allies. It is a great risk, but our numbers are too few to ignore the chance.

passages.title: The Prophet's Gambit
passages.text: Turalyon yet lives! Perhaps there is still hope after all.

passages.title: Greater Power for Greater Threats
passages.text:
<name>, the war against the Legion grows in intensity beyond what we have imagined. It is critical that we increase our strength to match that of our foes.

It is imperative that you strengthen your artifact as much as possible. It is the only way you can stay ahead of the threat the Legion poses.

passages.title: Greater Power for Greater Threats
passages.text: Is your artifact as powerful as you can make it?

passages.title: Greater Power for Greater Threats
passages.text:
Excellent! Your artifact is as powerful as you can make it... for now.

We are working on a solution for that, but in the meantime you should continue your efforts on the Broken Shore.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Einar the Runecaster to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Winstone Wolfe to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Seek out Winstone Wolfe.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Loramus Thalipedes to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text: Seek out Loramus Thalipedes.

passages.text: Our power grows.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Journeyman Goldmine to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text: Seek out Journeyman Goldmine.

passages.text: Our power grows.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Chronicler Elrianne to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text: Seek out Chronicler Elrianne.

passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.text: Seek out Survivalist Bahn.

passages.text: Our power grows.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Archivist Melinda to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text: Seek out Archivist Melinda

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Number Nine Jia to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Seek out Number Nine Jia

passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Leafbeard the Storied to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text: Seek out Leafbeard the Storied

passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Sir Alamande Graythorn to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Archon Torias to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.text: Seek out Archon Torias

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.text:
As the war against our enemies progresses, so must we.

We are now able to perform new research. Seek out Archivist Zubashi to continue advancing the Order Hall.

passages.title: Further Advancement
passages.text: Our power grows.

passages.title: Carried On the Wind
passages.text: Farseer adventurer, Consular Celestos has requested your presence back at the Maelstrom. Please see him at your earliest convenience.

passages.title: Carried On the Wind
passages.text: Thank you for coming, Farseer.

passages.title: Paragon of the Court
passages.text: The grateful Court of Farondis has requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of the Court
passages.text:
Greetings Deathlord <name>.

For some time now you have been a Paragon to our prince and to our people. Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Paragon of Highmountain
passages.text: The grateful Highmountain Tribes have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of Highmountain
passages.text:
Greetings Huntmaster <name>.

For some time now you have been a Paragon to our people. Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Paragon of the Dreamweavers
passages.text: The grateful druids of the Dreamweavers have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of the Dreamweavers
passages.text:
Greetings Highlord <name>.

For some time now you have been a Paragon to Nature and to our people. Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Paragon of the Valarjar
passages.text: The impressed vrykul of the Valarjar have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of the Valarjar
passages.text:
Greetings Highlord <name>.

For some time now you have been a Paragon to Odyn and a hero to the Valarjar. Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Paragon of the Nightfallen
passages.text: A very grateful Thalyssra has requested your presence. She wishes to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of the Nightfallen
passages.text:
Greetings outlander, liberator, Huntmaster, friend.

.Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Paragon of the Wardens
passages.text: The impressed Wardens have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of the Wardens
passages.text:
Greetings Huntmaster.

For some time now you have been a Paragon in your efforts against the Legion and your aid of the Wardens. Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Paragon of the Legionfall Armies
passages.text: Your loyal forces in the Armies of Legionfall have requested your presence. They wish to reward you for your exceptional aid.

passages.title: Paragon of the Legionfall Armies
passages.text:
Greetings, Deathlord.

For some time now you have been a paragon in your efforts against the Legion, the beacon that unites our armies together. Our gratitude goes beyond anything mere words can define.

Take these trophies as a token of our gratitude and a share in the spoils of war. The more you aid us, the more we can provide you.

passages.title: Fashion History and a Philosophy of Style
passages.text:
Greetings, <name>. I am a fashion historian and I have astonishing advancements in tailoring, leatherworking, and blacksmithing that I must share with you. Why? 

A true legend is only as good as their ability to form an epic silhouette on the battlefield and--let's be honest--this is not where you shine. 

Speak to me again if you wish to learn.

passages.title: Fashion History and a Philosophy of Style
passages.text: Let me know when you are ready to begin your education. You sorely need it!

passages.title: Fashion History and a Philosophy of Style
passages.text: Glad I could share the Hammerbeard System of Style and Taste with you. Are you ready to work for your legacy in your chosen profession?

passages.title: Draconic Secrets
passages.text:
<The Lich King's icy presence enters your mind once more.>

Arthas never found the prize he sought, Deathlord.

It is ours by right.

The dragons must know where the resting place of their kin resides.

Find a member of the bronze flight, the tenders of history. Do not be merciful.

<The presence fades.>

passages.title: The Lost Glacier
passages.text:
<The Lich King's presence is overwhelming.>

Do you know why the red dragonflight seeks to prevent us from finding our prize?

The bones of a great red dragon teem with the essence of life, even decades after its passing.

You will consume this life essence, blight it, and turn it to undeath.

And then you will raise a dragon.

Fly now into the north. Find this glacier, and your destiny.

<The presence fades.>

passages.title: The Lost Glacier
passages.text: Go, now, and find your frozen destiny.

passages.title: The Lost Glacier
passages.text: <A crack in the ice beneath the snow, it's very deep. You feel the unholy power surge within you, this would be the ideal location to unleash the energy to raise the dragon.>

passages.title: Eredath, Jewel of Argus
passages.text:
The shattered ruin below us is all that remains of Eredath.

We called it the Jewel of Argus. It was here that my fellows in the triumvirate guided our people to prosperity. That was a long time ago.

<Velen lapses into a moment of silence.>

Join me on the surface. We will begin our search for the Crown of the Triumvirate.

passages.title: Eredath, Jewel of Argus
passages.text: It is as if the battle never ceased. How long have they suffered like this?

passages.title: From Darkness
passages.text:
I'm afraid it's only a matter of time before our presence is known.

We must begin our preparations at once.

passages.title: From Darkness
passages.text: So it begins.

passages.title: Prisoners No More
passages.text:
Hatuun's people have endured arduous times. Their numbers dwindle as those ripped from beyond the walls of their sanctuary become servants to the annihilan lords in the pits just beyond, sentenced to a life of labor, torture and ultimately, death.

Seek out these captives, release them from their bonds and show our allies we stand as one against the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Prisoners No More
passages.text: Hatuun's people will greatly appreciate what you've done for them.

passages.title: Threat Reduction
passages.text:
In time, Hatuun and his people will set aside their bitterness and become valuable allies. But their trust must be earned.

He says their village is beset by a demon called Aggonar and his cruel kin.

We need these fiends out of the way before we can seek out Alleria and the others.

The chieftain lent us his horn. Use it to call down his people's vengeance upon the demon lieutenants while I carve a path to Aggonar's lair.

passages.title: Threat Reduction
passages.text: Has the threat been dealt with?

passages.title: Threat Reduction
passages.text: Now that their lords have been reduced to ash, we may strike at the heart of their power.

passages.title: A Strike at the Heart
passages.text:
These pits have long been a blight upon the lives of our new allies. The demons hunt them down and torture the poor souls for sport.

<Turalyon shakes his head with disgust, fixing his gaze upon the beast before him.>

It is time to make them pay for their cruelty and restore hope to this Light-forsaken place.

We strike on your mark, <name>.

passages.title: A Strike at the Heart
passages.text: No rest until the deed is done.

passages.title: A Strike at the Heart
passages.text: This victory is only the first link in a long chain, Slayer.

passages.title: Return to the Vindicaar
passages.text:
That pit lord won't trouble our new allies any longer.

<Turalyon's brow furrows.>

Until another takes its place, at least. If there's one thing I've learned in our endless war against the Legion, it's to savor victories as you find them.

Come, let us take a moment to regroup back at your vessel. Alleria and I have been waiting a long time for a reunion with our son.

passages.title: Return to the Vindicaar
passages.text:
Our absence has wounded Arator. We knew it would. But we had to know that he was safe while we fought the Legion.

Now that we are reunited, I will not let us be separated again.

passages.title: The Wolf's Tale
passages.text:
Goldrinn sure didn't take any time getting out of here, did he?

Let's go see if we can find him outside.

passages.title: The Wolf's Tale
passages.text: We must warn the Dreamgrove of what is happening.

passages.title: Alone in the Abyss
passages.text:
Champion, we will suffer the same fate as the Army of the Light if the Legion fires that infernal weapon upon us.

We must descend into the siege camp below and destroy it while we still can!

passages.title: Alone in the Abyss
passages.text: Welcome to Argus, homeworld of the Burning Legion.

passages.title: Using Lost Knowledge
passages.text:
I'm not sure you realize what this tome could mean for us. We can find even more knowledge on your artifacts to help the war effort!

Let's begin immediately. On your command, we stand by to begin researching again.

passages.title: Using Lost Knowledge
passages.text: Yes, Highlord?

passages.title: Using Lost Knowledge
passages.text: Excellent! Please check back in a while for a progress update.

passages.title: The Path Forward
passages.text:
<Velen stares beyond the arena for a time.>

We must continue on, but I feel Eredath is far from finished with us. We should take advantage of this relative safety while we still can.

I will place a signal beacon that will allow the Vindicaar to lock onto our location. Romuul will send us our means of returning to the Vindicaar if there is a need.

passages.title: The Path Forward
passages.text: Much remains to be seen, <name>. Argus has not forgotten us.

passages.title: The Path Forward
passages.text: The way forward is clear, and we have the Army of the Light at our side.

passages.title: The Council's Call
passages.text:
I'm sorry that I haven't kept your apprised of the situation. We needed more actionable information before bringing the matter before you.

The Council of the Six has been investigating Legion threats outside of the Broken Shore. I believe this scroll to be the final piece of information we need.

Meet me in Dalaran at the Violet Citadel. We will need the other members of the Council.

passages.title: The Council's Call
passages.text:
<Khadgar gives you a knowing nod.>

I'm glad you came, Huntmaster.

passages.title: The Crown of the Triumvirate
passages.text:
We begin our search now, <name>.

The Crown of the Triumvirate was created to spread the Light's touch to all. With it, our culture thrived.

When I fled Argus with the Draenei, I took one shard of the Crown with me to ensure that it would not fall into the wrong hands.

<Velen tips his staff forward and gestures to the central crystal.>

Kil'jaeden and Archimonde's fragments are still here. I will seek them out, but you will need to safeguard me while I search.

Stay close, my friend.

passages.title: Restoration: The Bradensbrook Investigation
passages.text:
We have uncovered forged orders from the Shore. They have a fel influence about them. They guide the reader to believe they are legitimate. It orders Black Rook Hold to attack a "demonic enclave" just south of their walls. There's only one enclave they could be talking about, Bradensbrook!

Is it possible these would be able to convince the undead to attack Bradensbrook? You should head there immediately and either warn them, or render aid.

Specialization: Restoration Shaman

passages.title: Restoration: The Bradensbrook Investigation
passages.text: A bit late for the warning, eh? Still, I appreciate that we haven't been forgotten.

passages.title: Beast Mastery: Rumblings Near Feltotem
passages.text:
The Highmountain have passed along a dire warning from their drogbar allies. The Feltotem are spreading their demonic corruption into the wildlife around them, infecting the land itself. We believe this is something that should be looked into sooner rather than later.

The drogbar chieftain, Navarrogg, is handling this personally and we'd like you to meet him near the Feltotem village.

Specialization: Beast Mastery Hunter

passages.title: Beast Mastery: Rumblings Near Feltotem
passages.text: Thank you for coming. I am glad you are treating this threat seriously.

passages.title: Protection: Aid of the Illidari
passages.text:
Thankfully, we are not quite alone in uncovering the Legion's plots to infiltrate the city.

Kor'vas Bloodthorn of the Illidari has taken to patrolling the city streets on her own to find the source behind the recent attacks.

I do not entirely trust these 'demon hunters', but they have at least proved adept at their namesake. I suggest you find her and see what she has uncovered before the Legion strikes once more.

Specialization: Protection Paladin

passages.text:
You - I've seen you out on the isles.

We need to move quickly!

passages.title: Balance: The Twisted Twin
passages.text:
I have a request from an old friend, Karam Magespear, to help find his brother, Raest. Karam fears that Raest is dealing with dark powers, and wishes to stop him.

Originally Raest trained with the Kirin Tor, but such were his aspirations of power that he turned to the forbidden art of Necromancy. He was discovered and expelled from our order.

Find Karam in the Legerdemain Lounge and see if you can lend a hand.

Specialization: Balance Druid

passages.title: Balance: The Twisted Twin
passages.text: You come from the Kirin Tor? So you'll help me find my brother?

passages.title: Havoc: The Thieving Apprentice
passages.text:
The Focusing Iris has been stolen from the Dalaran Vaults! The thief was a mage of some skill, but we've been unable to track him.

Fortunately, the thief dropped a note from his master, addressing him as one of his "apprentici." I know of only one mage who uses that particular pluralization - Archmage Xylem.

I'll need you to investigate. In Azshara you will find his tower where he trains his apprentices. Go there, and see what Xylem is up to.

Specialization: Havoc Demon Hunter

passages.title: Havoc: The Thieving Apprentice
passages.text:
So someone stole the Focusing Iris and you suspect Xylem might be the culprit? You may be right. 

It is no secret that the archmage has been seeking artifacts of late. However, after the discovery of an ancient grimoire in the Legashi ruins, Xylem has become... unstable. I fear the grimoire may be stealing his mind.

I can help you gain audience with the archmage.  With any luck, you can reclaim the Iris peacefully.

passages.title: Demonology: Fate of the Tideskorn
passages.text:
A scout from Stormheim arrived yesterday with a significant discovery - these ancient scrolls. Within they contain a Valkyra prophecy of a new vrykul ruler - one who could turn the Tideskorn against the Legion.

It complicates matters that this vrykul may in fact be Skovald's heir.

Take the scrolls, find the heir, and bring her to the Valkyra. I think the outcasts they refer to are the vrykul of Jandvik, so that would be a good place to start.

Specialization: Demonology Warlock

passages.title: Demonology: Fate of the Tideskorn
passages.text: Yes, outsider? What business do you have here?

passages.title: Fire: The Folly of Levia Laurence
passages.text:
Levia Laurence was once a member of the Kirin Tor. Dabbling in shadow magic got her banned from the city, but she knows the streets too well to keep her out for good.

Levia has disappeared, and I'm gravely concerned. Her work may have attracted the attention of the Legion. It has before. It would be very dangerous if her knowledge fell into their hands.

She was last seen at the Scribe's Sacellum. Ask around there and see if you can pick up her trail.

Specialization: Fire Mage

passages.title: Fire: The Folly of Levia Laurence
passages.text: Have you found any clues to Levia's disappearance?

passages.title: Fire: The Folly of Levia Laurence
passages.text:
So it seems that Levia has fallen under the spell of a succubus' seduction. I fear her time alone as an outcast must have left her vulnerable to such tactics. I cannot help but feel some guilt for her turning down this path.

In any case, Levia is in great danger. She must be found!
