passages.title: Targets of Opportunity: Terminus
passages.text:
Those Legion ships are a problem, <name>.

Even now they dock perilously close to the Vindicaar, threatening us with their presence.

Sometimes when fighting the Legion it is better to go straight to the top rather than thinning their numbers.

Go to the shipyards of Terminus and slay their officers and commanders. That should rattle their forces and put them back on the defensive.

passages.title: Invasion of Space
passages.text:
We are on the Legion home world, but we must not let ourselves get caught unawares.

These invasion points can bolster their forces and ruin our plans. By defeating them on their territory we also damage their command and infrastructure.

Slay the commanders and stop their invading forces. The fight to push the Legion back begins now!

passages.title: Out With The Inquisitors
passages.text:
Of all of the demons at the Legion's disposal, the inquisitors are some of the most terrible.

Even feared by some of the lesser demons, these monsters delight in cruelty and torturing their captives.

Inquisitors revel in the terror they cause, but perhaps we can make that work to our advantage.

Find the most powerful inquisitors you can and defeat them. Their deaths will not only improve the morale of our troops, but also send a message to their lesser forces.

passages.title: Moments of Reflection
passages.text:
<The crystal calls to you, resonating with sorcerous magic.

As you take hold of it, you hear the echo of a message left behind, a duty Illidan entrusted to you.>

passages.title: Intact Demon Eyes
passages.text: Yes... I shall see what they saw, mortal. Would you care for a taste?

passages.title: The Netherlight Crucible
passages.text:
The crucible thrums with power. Soon our weapons will shine like the stars themselves!

We will need that strength if we are to have any hope of defeating the Legion here.

<name>, you have endured great hardship to bring us to this moment. The honor of first tapping the crucible's power must be yours.

passages.title: The Netherlight Crucible
passages.text: We need every advantage we can muster if we are to see the Legion's end.

passages.title: The Netherlight Crucible
passages.text: As your weapon increases in strength we will be able to infuse it with even greater power, but its new strength should be more than enough for now.

passages.title: Forge of Aeons
passages.text:
The Lightforged have long stood as a beacon of hope against the Legion.

But few truly know what it takes to become the embodiment of Light's wrath.

These few champions among the Army of the Light are ready to undergo their final trial.

Will you do us the honor of bearing witness?

passages.title: Forge of Aeons
passages.text: It fills me with hope that we have found allies such as you.

passages.title: Forge of Aeons
passages.text: T'paartos is... enthusiastic. He means well, and he has a fire within him that few even among the Lightforged possess. Thank you for keeping him safe, <race>.

passages.title: Remember the Sunwell
passages.text:
The Regent Lord intends to show First Arcanist Thalyssra our Sunwell.

I do not know if he will allow Alleria Windrunner to attend the meeting, but we are invited to join them.

passages.title: Remember the Sunwell
passages.text: That was not wholly expected.

passages.title: A Titanic Effort
passages.text:
Illidan may have forced fate's hand, but bringing Argus so near to Azeroth has accelerated the reaction triggered by the Nightwell's collapse.

I believe the Legion's actions on Argus are further destabilizing the powers we've drawn upon unknowingly for many years.

It is clear that further studies are required.

passages.title: A Titanic Effort
passages.text: Illidan may believe that no price is too high to pay for banishing the Legion, but fate might prove him wrong.

passages.title: A Titanic Effort
passages.text:
The changes this substance has undergone since the Vindicaar departed for Argus are alarming.

What will the outcome mean for Azeroth? I fear this to be an ill omen, <name>.

passages.title: The Cursed Shard
passages.text:
<A unnatural metallic shard catches your eye as it shifts from color to color. At your touch, one end of the shard swells in size before melting away. Droplets hit the ground with a hiss and a noxious stench invades your nostrils.

Someone in Dalaran who works with metals should be able to tell you more.>

passages.title: The Cursed Shard
passages.text: The Betrayer lives up to his name once more.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Shadowmoon Valley!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Blood Guard Gulmok at Shadowmoon Valley in Outland.

The Burning Legion is attempting to lay siege to Shadowmoon Village, but our elite Kor'kron force is showing them what it means to fight against the Horde.

Crush the Legion.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Shadowmoon Valley!
passages.text: Welcome to the battlefield, grunt!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Howling Fjord!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Apothecary Lysander in Howling Fjord.

The Forsaken have established a stronghold on the eastern shores of Northrend.

Now is the time to strike at the Scourge with our military might and a new plague that is being developed by the Royal Apothecary Society.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Howling Fjord!
passages.text:
Ah, <name>, you have arrived!

Let's get to work.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Zul'Drak!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Crusader Lord Lantinga in Zul'Drak.

The Scourge is massacring the local population in Zul'Drak and converting them over to be part of the Scourge army.

Assist the Argent Crusade and the Ebon Blade in stopping this threat.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Zul'Drak!
passages.text:
Death and acts of sacrilege pervert this land.

<Lantinga lets out a drawn-out sigh.>

Thankfully, we're here to stop it.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Sholazar Basin!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Archmage Pentarus in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.

Hemet Nesingwary, along with his expeditionary force, was sent to explore Sholazar Basin, but has gone missing.

We do not know much about the lush landscape of Sholazar, but there might be secrets in the basin that can give us an advantage in our fight against the Lich King.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Sholazar Basin!
passages.text: I am glad you're here, <race>. Hemet has not been heard from for quite some time, and I could really use your help finding him.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Storm Peaks!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Rin Duoctane in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.

The goblins of K3 have built a city in Storm Peaks and have sent their ambassador to recruit adventurers.

Speak with Rin and see what the people of K3 need. They would make valuable allies in our fight against the Lich King.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Storm Peaks!
passages.text: Yo! Do I have an explosive proposition for you, pal....

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Icecrown!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Sky-Reaver Klum in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.

The Warsong Offensive needs more adventurers to bolster their assault on assault Icecrown Citadel and Arthas himself.

It is time to make the Lich King pay for his crimes.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Icecrown!
passages.text: The Warsong Offensive is ready to strike at the heart of the Scourge, <class>. Are you up to the challenge?

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Jade Forest!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to General Nazgrim in Orgrimmar.

Recent victories in our naval battles against the Alliance strengthens our resolve.

Report to Grommash Hold and assist the Horde's invasion fleet.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Jade Forest!
passages.text: Lok'tar ogar, <name>. You've arrived not a moment too soon....

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Valley of the Four Winds!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Chen Stormstout in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The adventuring spirit of the Stormstouts is something that the Horde can learn from.

Travel with the Stormstouts and discover what secrets Pandaria holds.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Valley of the Four Winds!
passages.text: You seem like someone who needs some excitement in their life. Excitement... and beer!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Krasarang Wilds!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Zhu's Watch in Krasarang Wilds.

There have been rumors that the pandaren living in Krasarang Wilds are not their usual self.

Speak with Ken-Ken at Zhu's Watch. Perhaps he has a better idea of what has happened to cause the pandaren to become lethargic.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Krasarang Wilds!
passages.text:
What the dook is going on here, <race>?!

Why are pandaren so sad?!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Kun-Lai Summit!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to assist Lorewalker Cho in Kun-Lai Summit.

Speak with a messenger grummle in Valley of the Four Winds. They will show you the way to Kun-Lai Summit.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Kun-Lai Summit!
passages.text: Traveling to Kun-Lai? Right this way, wanderer, right this way!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Townlong Steppes!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Taran Zhu in Townlong Steppes.

The Shado-Pan want to reclaim their land from the clutches of the yaungol, but lack the numbers to do so.

Assist them with their assault against the yaungol.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Townlong Steppes!
passages.text:
Welcome to Townlong Steppes, outsider.

If you insist on wandering in to the darkest places of Pandaria then far be it from me to not put you to good use.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dread Wastes!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

The Shado-Pan are attempting to stop the mantid army from invading the entirety of Pandaria.

You can reach Bowmistress Li by securing a kite and flying to the Serpent's Spine.

Destiny calls!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Dread Wastes!
passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Gorgrond!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Durotan in Gorgrond.

Durotan is seeking allies to help us navigate the savage landscape of Gorgrond in hopes that we will find ancient powers to help us destroy the Iron Horde.

Speak with him and see what secrets the lands hold.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Gorgrond!
passages.text: Gorgrond is no place for armies. We are now stepping into the domain of legends.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Talador!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Foreman Grobash in Talador.

The Iron Horde seek to control Talador. The area is perfect to send reinforcements to any other part of Draenor quickly and without resistance.

Foreman Grobash is currently establishing an outpost in Talador. Travel there and stop the Iron Horde.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Talador!
passages.text: It is good to see you, Commander <name>. I require your advisement.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Spires of Arak!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Azik in Spires of Arak.

There have been wingless arakkoa seen fleeing from Spires of Arak. Rumors suggest that they are running from an Iron Horde superweapon.

We need to find out what is causing them to leave their homeland, and why their wings have withered.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Spires of Arak!
passages.text:
<Azik looks you up and down.>

Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.

Come closer, friend. Azik could use your help.

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
passages.text:
All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Stone Guard Brox in Nagrand on Draenor.

Thrall is establishing a Horde outpost and needs help to stop the Warsong clan.

Speak with Bron Skyhorn to fly to Nagrand and meet up with the supply caravan.

For the Horde!

passages.title: Warchief's Command: Nagrand!
passages.text:
They came at us... from... nowhere.

<The stone guard nearly passes out.>

passages.title: Hero's Call: Shadowmoon Valley!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Wing Commander Nuainn in Shadowmoon Valley on Outland.

The Burning Legion are laying siege to Wildhammer Stronghold, endagering our people and threatening their lives.

We need to reinforce the stronghold and stop the Burning Legion's relentless assault!

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Shadowmoon Valley!
passages.text:
We're gettin' hammered out here, lad.

I hope you're here to help.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Howling Fjord!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Macalroy in Howling Fjord.

The port town of Valgarde is located in the heart of the Howling Fjord, and it allows for the Alliance to have an advantageous position to strike at the Scourge.

Assist the soldiers stationed there.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Howling Fjord!
passages.text:
What is it?!

Can't you see I'm already busy trying to get this port ready, <race>?

passages.title: Hero's Call: Zul'Drak!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Crusader Lord Lantinga in Zul'Drak.

The Scourge is massacring the local population in Zul'Drak and converting them over to be part of the Scourge army.

Assist the Argent Crusade and the Ebon Blade in stopping this threat.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Zul'Drak!
passages.text:
Death and acts of sacrilege pervert this land.

<Lantinga lets out a drawn-out sigh.>

Thankfully, we're here to stop it.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Sholazar Basin!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Archmage Pentarus in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.

Hemet Nesingwary, along with his expeditionary force, was sent to explore Sholazar Basin, but has gone missing.

We do not know much about the lush landscape of Sholazar, but there might be secrets in the basin that can give us an advantage in our fight against the Lich King.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Sholazar Basin!
passages.text: I am glad you're here, <race>. Hemet has not been heard from for quite some time, and I could really use your help finding him.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Storm Peaks!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Rin Duoctane in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.

The goblins of K3 have built a city in Storm Peaks and have sent their ambassador to recruit adventurers.

Speak with Rin and see what the people of K3 need. They would make valuable allies in our fight against the Lich King.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Storm Peaks!
passages.text: Yo! Do I have an explosive proposition for you, pal....

passages.title: Hero's Call: Icecrown!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Officer Van Rossem in Dalaran over Crystalsong Forest.

The Valiance Expedition needs more adventurers to bolster their assault on assault Icecrown Citadel and Arthas himself.

It is time to make the Lich King pay for his crimes.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Icecrown!
passages.text: The Valiance Expedition is ready to strike at the heart of the Scourge, <class>. Are you up to the challenge?

passages.title: Hero's Call: Jade Forest!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.

Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth is assembling a team for a high priority mission.

Head to Stormwind Keep immediately to be briefed.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Jade Forest!
passages.text:
Our role is of utmost importance, <name>.

Admiral Taylor and his flagship have gone missing.... More importantly, the young Prince was with him, and it is our primary objective to bring him back home safely.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Valley of the Four Winds!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Chen Stormstout in the Valley of the Four Winds.

The adventuring spirit of the Stormstouts is something that the Alliance can learn from.

Travel with the Stormstouts and discover what secrets Pandaria holds.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Valley of the Four Winds!
passages.text: You seem like someone who needs some excitement in their life. Excitement... and beer!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Krasarang Wilds!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Zhu's Watch in Krasarang Wilds.

There have been rumors that the pandaren living in Krasarang Wilds are not their usual self.

Speak with Ken-Ken at Zhu's Watch. Perhaps he has a better idea of what has happened to cause the pandaren to become lethargic.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Krasarang Wilds!
passages.text:
What the dook is going on here, <race>?!

Why are pandaren so sad?!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Kun-Lai Summit!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to assist Lorewalker Cho in Kun-Lai Summit.

Speak with a messenger grummle in Valley of the Four Winds. They will show you the way to Kun-Lai Summit.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Kun-Lai Summit!
passages.text: Traveling to Kun-Lai? Right this way, wanderer, right this way!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Townlong Steppes!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Taran Zhu in Townlong Steppes.

The Shado-Pan want to reclaim their land from the clutches of the yaungol, but lack the numbers to do so.

Assist them with their assault against the yaungol.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Townlong Steppes!
passages.text:
Welcome to Townlong Steppes, outsider.

If you insist on wandering in to the darkest places of Pandaria then far be it from me to not put you to good use.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Dread Wastes!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

The Shado-Pan are attempting to stop the mantid army from invading the entirety of Pandaria.

You can reach Bowmistress Li by securing a kite and flying to the Serpent's Spine.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Dread Wastes!
passages.text:
A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.

Pleased to meet you.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Shadowmoon Valley!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Prophet Velen in Shadowmoon Valley on Draenor.

The destruction of the Dark Portal has stopped the Iron Horde invasion of Azeroth, but now we must to take the fight to them.

With Prophet Velen's blessing, we will be able to establish a strategic position in Draenor to fight against the enemies of Azeroth.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Shadowmoon Valley!
passages.text:
<Prophet Velen welcomes you with a curious look, then a warm nod.>

So it begins....

passages.title: Hero's Call: Gorgrond!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Yrel in Gorgrond.

Yrel and Maraad are requesting for a small expedition to be sent into the wilds of Gorgrond.

We hope to gain a better understanding of the land in hopes that it will show us how to exploit weaknesses in the Iron Horde.

Assist them with their expedition.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Gorgrond!
passages.text:
Welcome to Gorgrond, commander.

We have just arrived ourselves.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Talador!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Foreman Eksos in Talador.

The Iron Horde seek to control Talador. The area is perfect to send reinforcements to any other part of Draenor quickly and without resistance.

Foreman Eksos is currently establishing an outpost in Talador. Travel there and stop the Iron Horde.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Talador!
passages.text: It is good to see you, Commander <name>. I require your advisement.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Spires of Arak!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Azik in Spires of Arak.

There have been wingless arakkoa seen fleeing from Spires of Arak. Rumors suggest that they are running from an Iron Horde superweapon.

We need to find out what is causing them to leave their homeland, and why their wings have withered.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Spires of Arak!
passages.text:
<Azik looks you up and down.>

Azik is betting you are someone of importance to your people.

Come closer, friend. Azik could use your help.

passages.title: Hero's Call: Nagrand!
passages.text:
All able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Balfor in Nagrand on Draenor.

Yrel is recommending that the Alliance establish an outpost in Nagrand to help in our fight against the Warsong clan.

Secure a flight to Nagrand and meet up with Lieutenant Balfor and the supply caravan.

Glory to the Alliance!

passages.title: Hero's Call: Nagrand!
passages.text:
They came at us... from... nowhere.

<The lieutenant nearly passes out.>

passages.title: Silvermoon City
passages.text:
The nightborne have been isolated from the world for thousands of years. Now that they have reemerged, it is up to us to guide them along the right path.

Regent Lord Theron has extended an invitation to the nightborne to meet with us in Silvermoon.

Come, <name>, let us travel to Silvermoon with Thalyssra.

passages.title: Silvermoon City
passages.text: Good, we're all here. Our guests should be arriving shortly.

passages.title: The Nightborne
passages.text:
The Warchief will be pleased with our success.

Thalyssra and her nightborne will prove strong allies, I am sure.

passages.title: The Nightborne
passages.text: You return with good news, <name>.

passages.title: The Lightforged
passages.text:
Do you wish to hear how the Lightforged draenei joined the Alliance? It might be one of my favorite stories.

Most likely since it involves seeing our beautiful world from space!

It all began when High Exarch Turalyon invited members of the Alliance onto the Vindicaar...

passages.title: The Lightforged
passages.text: This ritual has never been witnessed by an outsider.

passages.title: The Lightforged
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. You are about to bear witness to a ritual none but members of the Army of the Light have seen.

passages.title: Dark Forces
passages.text:
The Old Gods have inflicted one of their faceless ones upon Thunder Bluff. The fiend desecrates my people's city!

We must fight together to rid this place of such filth.

I believe that destroying this herald will drive our enemies from Mulgore. May our weapons strike true, <name>!

passages.title: Dark Forces
passages.text: This herald of the Old Gods must be stopped.

passages.title: Dark Forces
passages.text: A fine kill, <name>. My people can clean up from here.

passages.title: Heritage of the Lightforged
passages.text:
Your service to the Alliance has been most impressive, adventurer. I could not have done better myself. Well, I could... but not by much.

Come, meet with me at the Vindicaar. It is time that we reward your diligence.

passages.title: Heritage of the Lightforged
passages.text: Welcome aboard, <name>.

passages.title: Heritage of the Lightforged
passages.text:
Duty. Honor. Sacrifice. The Lightforged strive to embody these qualities. You have done so with aplomb.

It is my pleasure to award you with a symbol of your service, <name>.

passages.title: Heritage of Highmountain
passages.text:
Your sojourn through Azeroth has been long, adventurer. And through it all, you have brought honor to Highmountain.

Now Thunder Totem calls you home. It is time we thank you for all that you have done for us.

passages.title: Heritage of Highmountain
passages.text:
You have brought great honor to our tribes, <name>. It is fitting that we give you a symbol of our thanks.

Highmountain stands... because you have the courage to fight for it.

passages.title: Heritage of the Nightborne
passages.text:
You are among the first shal'dorei to venture forth and explore the wilds of Azeroth. But now it is time to come home.

Return to Suramar so that we may thank you for helping our people reclaim a place in this world.

passages.title: Heritage of the Nightborne
passages.text:
When we were liberated from the Legion, some among the shal'dorei believed we should remain isolated. Alone.

Your accomplishments in Azeroth have shown that we made the right decision in reclaiming our place in this world. It pleases me to honor you with this symbol of Suramar's gratitude.

passages.title: The Ghostlands
passages.text:
Are you familiar with how the Void elves joined the Alliance? 

It began with Alleria Windrunner finding out about a blood elf named Umbric. 

He and his followers were banished from Silvermoon City for researching void magic.

Alleria believed she could convince Umbric and his followers to join the Alliance and prevent the void from corrupting them.

It all began when she opened up a portal to go into the Ghostlands...

passages.title: The Ghostlands
passages.text: These lands bring back memories. Some good, some bad.

passages.title: The Ghostlands
passages.text: Umbric's methods are a bit cavalier, but he seems competent. We must get to him before things become too dangerous.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text:
Mastering the whispers requires constant focus and discipline. Your dedication inspires all who bear the name ren'dorei--for we have become children of the Void.

You have learned many lessons here, but the time has come to venture beyond Telogrus Rift.

Go to Stormwind, the heart of the Alliance. There, the king's ambassador will greet you and guide you along your journey.

Azeroth must be defended. I can think of no one better suited to answer that call than you, adventurer.

passages.title: For the Alliance
passages.text: Ah, there you are, <name>! We've been inspecting--err--expecting you!

passages.title: The Pledge
Delas in Dalaran
passages.text:
Delas Moonfang needs our help. In-turn, she will aid us to decrypt the Codex of Command.

I implore you to seek her out as soon as possible. She is known to enjoy the memorial dedicated to the fallen, great leader of the Kirin Tor, Antonidas.

passages.title: Delas in Dalaran
passages.text: Goddess be praised that you are here, <name>. I'm hoping that you can aid me.

passages.title: Adventure Calls
passages.text:
Tales of your heroism have spread to the ends of Azeroth... and beyond. Your skills have been requested elsewhere.

Will you travel through the Dark Portal, fighting the Burning Legion on the sundered world of Outland?

Or will you fly north, joining the battle against the Lich King in Northrend?

The choice is yours, adventurer.

passages.title: Wars on Two Fronts
passages.text:
<name>! You have been called upon once again to assist the Horde in matters of great import.

Will you assist the Horde's efforts against Deathwing and the Twilight Hammer?

Or will you fly south to Pandaria, claiming its resources before the Alliance does first?

Make your choice and head into battle!

passages.title: Cataclysm First Responder
passages.text:
Deathwing, the draconic aspect of death, has sent his minions out to scour Azeroth of life.

Farseer Krogar in Orgrimmar can tell you more about Mount Hyjal, Vashj'ir, and other areas that Deathwing has targeted.

passages.title: Cataclysm First Responder
passages.text: Ah, <name>. Thank you for responding to my request.

passages.title: To Pandaria!
passages.text:
You are hereby ordered to present yourself at Grommash Hold immediately.

We have received word of a new, resource-rich continent in the south, and we intend to send you and a small contingent of soldiers to claim it for the Horde.

passages.title: To Pandaria!
passages.text: Lok'tar, <name>.

passages.title: Adventure Calls
passages.text:
Tales of your heroism have spread to the ends of Azeroth... and beyond. Your skills have been requested elsewhere.

Will you travel through the Dark Portal, fighting the Burning Legion on the sundered world of Outland?

Or will you fly north, joining the battle against the Lich King in Northrend?

The choice is yours, adventurer.

passages.title: Wars on Two Fronts
passages.text:
<name>! You have been called upon once again to assist the Alliance in matters of great import.

Will you assist the Alliance's efforts against Deathwing and the Twilight Hammer?

Or will you fly south to Pandaria, claiming its resources before the Horde does first?

Make your choice and head into battle!

passages.title: Cataclysm: First Responder
passages.text:
Deathwing, the draconic aspect of death, has sent his minions out to scour Azeroth of life.

Naraat the Earthspeaker can tell you more about Mount Hyjal, Vashj'ir, and other areas that Deathwing has targeted.

passages.title: Cataclysm: First Responder
passages.text: Ah, <name>. Thank you for responding to my request.

passages.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
passages.text:
Please come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn.

We have received word of a conflict in the seas to the south, and we need the help of an experienced <class> to assist in the investigation.

passages.title: Mists of Pandaria: To Pandaria!
passages.text: Greetings, <name>.

passages.title: Heritage of the Void
passages.text:
Throughout your journeys across Azeroth, you have achieved mastery over the forces that constantly seek to control you.

You have become a formidable weapon of the Alliance, adventurer. Return to the void rift so that we may honor your accomplishment.

passages.title: Heritage of the Void
passages.text:
Though some continue to doubt us, your deeds have proven that the ren'dorei serve the Alliance with honor.

Your will is strong, <name>. Accept this gift as a symbol of the powers you command.

passages.title: The Call for Allies
passages.text:
The Alliance has been beset by dangers growing throughout all of Azeroth.

The only way we will keep our friends safe is if we seek out new allies.

I have been tasked as an ambassador to help seek these allies. Come to our embassy in Stormwind, I could use your help.

passages.title: The Call for Allies
passages.text: Welcome, <name>. I am pleased you answered the call.

passages.title: The Call for Allies
passages.text:
Greetings, champion! I have been appointed as the Horde's diplomatic ambassador to our allies far and wide. 

It is my duty to seek out those of like mind and spirit, and speak to them about joining the Horde.

As a renowned hero of the Horde yourself, your aid would be most appreciated! Come see me at the embassy in Orgrimmar when you are able.

passages.title: The Call for Allies
passages.text: Ah, <name>. Now we can begin.

passages.title: Thalyssra's Estate
passages.text:
Would you like to hear how the nightborne came to join the Horde?

We earned their trust when we aided them in liberating Suramar from the tyranny of Grand Magistrix Elisande and the Burning Legion.

Lor'themar Theron later asked them to join him in Quel'Thalas. Lady Liadrin made the journey to extend the invitation to First Arcanist Thalyssra...

passages.title: Thalyssra's Estate
passages.text: The city of Suramar is beautiful to behold. I hope Silvermoon City is not a disappointment to them.

passages.title: Gifts of the Fallen
passages.text:
Earlier today, King Wrynn addressed the citizens of Stormwind at Lion's Rest in a speech given to formally announce the end of the war.

After the crowd departed, I met privately with the King and his advisors to discuss a mysterious substance that has been found in Silithus.

This glowing ore appears to be most powerful and the Horde has wasted no time in extracting it from the great wound.

The king has ordered me to fill you in on the details, in preparation for an important mission.

passages.title: Gifts of the Fallen
passages.text: If this strange substance is as powerful as it appears to be, we cannot allow it to fall into the wrong hands. Your presence will be needed in Silithus.

passages.title: Witness to the Wound
passages.text:
I've already sent operatives to Silithus to establish a base camp.

Their orders are to monitor the operations of the Horde and gather any information they can find on this mysterious substance.

One of my SI:7 commanders is currently awaiting your arrival. Go with speed.

passages.title: Witness to the Wound
passages.text: Well met, <name>. It's good to have someone of your renown here with us in Silithus.

passages.title: Witness to the Wound
passages.text:
The Bilgewater Cartel have already begun mining operations in Silithus to extract this mysterious substance.

The Warchief has insisted that you personally oversee the extraction efforts in Silithus and prevent the Alliance from interfering.

Gallywix seemed less than pleased with your appointment, but nobody refuses Sylvanas...

You must go to Silithus at once. The base commander is awaiting your arrival.

passages.title: Witness to the Wound
passages.text: Greetings, <name>. I was told you'd be coming. The mining operation is currently underway.

passages.title: It's a Sabotage
passages.text:
The Horde has wasted no time in shamelessly extracting this mysterious ore from the great wound.

Luckily for us, goblin engineering is not nearly as sophisticated as what we create in Gnomeregan! All it takes is a little bit of old fashioned dynamite to completely disable a goblin shredder.

What unsophisticated machinery!

Take these dynamite bundles and plant them on the inactive shredders around the mining camp.

It'll take those greedy goblins weeks to get back up and running again!

passages.title: It's a Sabotage
passages.text: Great work, <name>! With the shredders sabotaged, the Bilgewater Cartel mining operation will grind to a halt!

passages.title: Free Samples
passages.text:
The crown has ordered SI:7 to infiltrate the goblin mining operation and collect any information we can find on this mysterious new substance.

My agents have infiltrated the camp, but the clock is ticking and we need to get our hands on some extracted ore samples fast.

In other words, I need someone who can take the direct approach. Someone who can handle a fight against overwhelming odds and come out alive.

Take the ore samples to Khargus Stonemantle for analysis when you return.

passages.title: Free Samples
passages.text: What have ye got for me?

passages.title: Free Samples
passages.text: I've never seen anythin' like this before... I'll get to work examinin' it at once!

passages.title: The Seething Shore
passages.text:
We've received reports of an island off the coast of Silithus that is ripe with Azerite deposits.

It is vital that we secure the island before the Horde learns of its existence.

Master Mathias Shaw is personally leading the expedition force and has requested that you report for duty. Good luck!

passages.title: The Seething Shore
passages.text: You made it back alive. That's good news, indeed! I trust the expedition went well?

passages.title: The Speaker's Perspective
passages.text:
Sargeras has left a scar upon our world, <name>. A scar that will not soon heal...

It appears that the scars between the Alliance and Horde have yet to heal as well.

Too many lives have already been lost fighting to save Azeroth from destruction. I will not stay and watch this world lose more.

I have a request for you before I go. Take this letter to Magni Bronzebeard. He is in Silithus seeking a way to heal the wound.

The letter contains information that may prove valuable to him.

passages.title: The Speaker's Perspective
passages.text: Thank you for delivering Khadgar's letter ta me. I'm goin' ta need some time ta consider his words. If what he says is correct, we may be able ta save Azeroth... but at a great cost.

passages.title: No Spies Allowed
passages.text:
Hey <name>, I'm glad you're here.

I'm in way over my head! Killer bugs, a strange substance... that GIANT sword sticking outta the ground... I don't have a good feelin' about this place!

To make matters worse, I've been gettin' reports of Alliance spies snoopin' around the camp!

Look kid, the Dark Lady has plans for this mysterious ore and I ain't going to be the one to dissapoint her, know what I mean?

Get over to the mining camp and take out those SI:7 spies before they ruin the whole operation!

passages.title: No Spies Allowed
passages.text:
You did well, <name>... Crisis averted! But we better keep an eye out for reinforcements.

If this stuff is as valuable as Gallywix says it is, the Alliance is going to be all over this place in no time!

passages.title: Lazy Prospectors!
passages.text:
I've been around long enough to know you can never trust a goblin with an orc's work.

Gallywix and his cartel may be serving the warchief, but we need to keep a close eye on them if we're going to get anything done!

I've already noticed many of the workers loafing about and sleeping on the job. The Horde does not tolerate laziness!

Get out there and put those lazy prospectors in their place!

passages.title: Lazy Prospectors!
passages.text: Hmmpf! I hope you didn't go easy on them. If it were up to me they'd be getting more than a simple beating!

passages.title: The Speaker's Perspective
passages.text:
Sargeras has left a scar upon our world, <name>. A scar that will not soon heal...

It appears that the scars between the Alliance and Horde have yet to heal as well.

Too many lives have already been lost fighting to save Azeroth from destruction. I will not stay and watch this world lose more.

I have a request for you before I go. Take this letter to Magni Bronzebeard. He is in Silithus seeking a way to heal the wound.

The letter contains information that may prove valuable to him.

passages.title: The Speaker's Perspective
passages.text: What do ye have for me, <class>?

passages.title: The Speaker's Perspective
passages.text: Thank you for delivering Khadgar's letter ta me. I'm goin' ta need some time ta consider his words. If what he says is correct, we may be able ta save Azeroth... but at a great cost.

passages.title: The Power in Our Hands
passages.text:
That sword of Sargeras is surgin' with dark energies. They're seepin' into Azeroth's heart like poison.

The blade's power must be snuffed out.

The Pillars o' Creation could do it, but they're keepin' the tomb sealed. So we need other vessels capable o' harnessin' vast energies.

Vessels like those artifact weapons you and the other champions wield.

It's a risk, adventurer. We don't know what Sargeras' power will do ta those weapons. But unless we act now, the heart of Azeroth is sure ta die.

passages.title: A Friendly Gesture
passages.text:
Life in the marsh has not been easy, <name>. We want to live in harmony with those that call it home, but our enemies out here threaten our existence.

Work with us. Help the people of Sporeggar thrive.

passages.title: A Friendly Gesture
passages.text: Thank you for helping the people of Sporeggar, <race>. You are always welcomed here.

passages.title: An Outside Perspective
passages.text:
Thank you for everything you have done for my people, but they are still scared of outsiders.

Fight the bog lords and rescue the spore sacs in the Spawning Glen. The future of my people is at stake!

passages.title: An Outside Perspective
passages.text: Thank you, <name>! Thank you.

passages.title: The Source of Power
passages.text:
Although the silithid disappeared for a time immediately following the destruction of Silithus, they have recently returned from beneath the ground.

These new silithid seem stronger than before!

My hypothesis is that the silithid are feeding on some kind of power source beneath the blade of Sargeras.

I've been tasked with studying the effects that this mysterious power is having on the silithid hives.

Bring me as many intact silithid brains as you can carry and I'll begin the research!

passages.title: The Source of Power
passages.text: Do you have the brains?

passages.title: The Source of Power
passages.text: Oh! Look at these big, beautiful brains! I can't wait to dig in... thanks for your help, <name>! You can stay and watch if you want, but it may get a bit messy!

passages.title: Larvae By The Dozen
passages.text:
How did the silithid survive the blade of Sargeras? I'm perplexed!

I've never encountered a species that can adapt to changes in the environment as quickly as the silithid can.

The larvae, or broodlings as they are often called, can evolve into a variety of silithid creature types based on the needs of the hive.

Is it the hive mind that signals the evolutionary development of the larvae, or is some environmental factor at play?

Science must find the answer!

passages.title: Larvae By The Dozen
passages.text: Do you have the silithid larvae?

passages.title: Larvae By The Dozen
passages.text: I see you have the broodlings! These will do nicely. Would you like to stay and watch me carefully dissect and catalog every detail of their anatomy?

passages.title: The Twilight Survivor
passages.text:
Silithus used to be overrun with members of the Twilight's Hammer.

The cult was presumed to be exterminated, but it has always survived in the shadows. Their numbers have dwindled, but the cult remains no less fanatical than at their peak.

Most of the cultists here were destroyed by Sargeras in the attack, but a few still remain. Their leader, Michiel Voidstrider has been emboldened by the destruction of Silithus.

We cannot let Michiel rally the remaining survivors to action. He must be stopped!

passages.title: The Twilight Survivor
passages.text: We cannot allow the Twilight's Hammer to regain their foothold in Silithus.

passages.title: The Twilight Survivor
passages.text: I see you have brought the head of Michiel Voidstrider. A gruesome task, but a necessary one. The Alliance thanks you for your service, <name>.

passages.title: The Source of Power
passages.text:
The silithid are all riled up and stronger than ever!

My guess is that they are feeding off of some kind of power beneath the ground. Probably near the blade of Sargeras!

I've been ordered to study the effects that this mysterious power is having on the sillithid.

Bring me as many intact silithid brains as you can carry and I'll begin the research!

passages.title: The Source of Power
passages.text: Hey kid! You got the stuff?

passages.title: The Source of Power
passages.text: Holy moly! Look at the size of these big, beautiful brains! Where's my scalpel?! Wait... no... bring me the electric hacksaw. It's time for the big guns baby!

passages.title: Larvae By The Dozen
passages.text:
How did the silithid survive the blade of Sargeras?!

I've never encountered a species that can adapt to changes in the environment as quickly as the silithid!

There's gotta be a way to tame these suckers! Harness their evolutionary biology for our profit!

We gotta start training 'em young! Forget about the old crusty adults, we need babies!

Steal me as many of the silithid larvae as you can carry, and I'll find a way to train 'em!

passages.title: Larvae By The Dozen
passages.text: Do you have the silithid larvae?

passages.title: Larvae By The Dozen
passages.text: You've got the larvae! These are gonna make us a boatload o' money! I can already hear the gold jinglin' in my pockets!

passages.title: The Twilight Survivor
passages.text:
This land was once overrun with members of the Twilight's Hammer.

The cult was presumed to be exterminated, but darkness always survives in the shadows.

Most of the cultists were destroyed by Sargeras in the attack, but a few yet live. Their leader, Michiel Voidstrider has been emboldened by the destruction of Silithus.

We cannot let this fanatic rally the remaining survivors to action! Bring me his head!

passages.title: The Twilight Survivor
passages.text: We cannot allow the Twilight's Hammer to regain their foothold in Silithus!

passages.title: The Twilight Survivor
passages.text: I see you have brought the head of Michiel Voidstrider. It will look glorious mounted on a spike! The Horde thanks you for your service, <name>.

passages.title: A Choice of Allies
passages.text:
I was chosen to act as an ambassador to our new allies due to my experience with the pandaren joining the Alliance.

I've made some notes about some potential allies that may be willing to join the Alliance.

Learn more about them, then speak with me.

passages.title: A Choice of Allies
passages.text: Hard choices must be made, <class>.

passages.title: A Choice of Allies
passages.text: Your wisdom is always appreciated, <name>. The choice you make today will strengthen the Alliance.

passages.title: A Choice of Allies
passages.text:
As ambassador, it is my duty to bolster the Horde's ranks and strengthen our numbers in the face of danger.

Your adventures have led you to many different people who can aid the Horde if we can convince them to join our cause.

I've kept a record of the most promising potential allies. The choice of which to approach first is yours.

passages.title: A Choice of Allies
passages.text: Is there a problem with my notes?

passages.title: A Choice of Allies
passages.text: I have come to value your wisdom, <name>. The choice you make today will strengthen the Horde.

passages.title: The Mail Must Flow
passages.text:
Due to all of the recent shenanigans, I'm running short on mailementals to sort letters.

It's a simple job, really - just toss the letter into the proper portal, where it will be whisked away to the far corners of Azeroth and beyond.

I like to make a little game out of it. How many can you sort in one minute?

passages.title: The Mail Must Flow
passages.text:
Well done! 

Is it not fulfilling? To see each letter safely to its destination?

Come by and help any time!

passages.title: A Second Ally For the Cause
A Second Ally For the Cause
passages.text:
One new ally will prove useful. A second will make us even stronger.

Even now, the Alliance plots and schemes against us. We must move quickly, or they will strike before we are prepared to counter their aggression.

Say the word when you are ready to begin pursuit of our next ally. There must be no hesitation.

passages.title: The Speaker's Call
passages.text:
I been travelin' the land, seekin' out anyone who might know how ta heal Azeroth. I've consulted ancient sages, druids, shamans... from dragons ta titan keepers. Nobody's seen anythin' like this before.

Went ta Karazhan ta speak with Khadgar. Studyin' those old tomes o' his, we came up with an idea. No tellin' if it's gonna work, but we gotta try.

Come ta Silithus. Meet me at the wound. Time is runnin' out fer Azeroth, adventurer.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, <race>.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Not quite as beautiful as Suramar, is it?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
So this is Orgrimmar. The orcs have made some... interesting aesthetic choices. Be careful of the spikes, <name>.

And the smells. So many smells.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind, <race>. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who enjoys the night life. We have many popular taverns and a vibrant music scene! 

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of the ren'dorei is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, <name>!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: So, how does Stormwind suit you?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind. Though it is no Silvermoon, the city does have its charms.

If you came here expecting a warm welcome, I cannot say I have received one myself. But most folk are polite enough.

No matter. I am off to seek adventure! And perhaps a stiff drink.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to Stormwind, <race>. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like the devout sort. We have a lovely cathedral that will no doubt be of interest! 

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of the Lightforged is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, <name>!

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: I can feel the Light in this place.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Welcome to this beautiful city, <name>. I am sure you will feel as welcome by the other members of the Alliance as I do.

I have met a number of the city guards. Good people, though there are a few things they could learn from us.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, <race>.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text: Not quite as beautiful as Highmountain, is it?

passages.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
passages.text:
So many tauren! I think I've seen more tauren since I got here than in my entire life in Highmountain.

They all ask to touch my antlers. It's weird at first, but now I kind of like it.

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text:
I'd keep my distance from B.E Barechus and Murd Doc, neither is terribly stable.

Let's get you to work! Go down into this tunnel until you get to Tinkers' Court. Hopefully you'll know what to do when you meet Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Our leader, Commando Hann Ibal waits somewhere in there. He'll reward you handsomely for all your work.

Probably....

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text:
I'd love for you to come aboard as a full G-Team Commando, but our bylaws specifically prohibit Horde team members; however, I CAN enroll you in the G-Team Fan Club!

Here's something for your trouble.

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text:
That Murd Doc is crazy, <class>. Never, ever, let you find yourself in an aircraft with that gnome.

Stealth usually isn't my thing, and it's certainly not going to be yours. Go down this hallway to the Launch Bay and dispose of the Electrocutioner 6000.

The Electrocutioner is in charge of the aircraft...

...and I hate aircraft. I'm not getting in any sort of aircraft!

Use this parachute to drop down afterwards and speak with Commando Face for your next job.

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text: Woah! How did you see me!?

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text: Took you long enough. Get behind the pillar before you blow our cover!

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text:
How did you get in here, <name>?

I'm Murd Doc of the G-Team and we could use the help of a <race> like you.

Help us defeat the irradiated inhabatants that now call Gnomeregan home, and I'll make you an honorary G-Team Commando!

Take this parachute, jump down into the Hall of Gears, and take out the Viscous Fallout. After you're done, report to Commando B.E Barechus by the west hallway. You two will get along great, I'm sure.

passages.title: The G-Team
passages.text: The mission is far from over!

passages.title: A Recent Discovery
passages.text:
Earlier today, the leaders of the Horde gathered together for a feast in celebration of our victory over the Burning Legion.

As the others were feasting, Gallywix requested a private audience with the Dark Lady.

It seems that he has found a mysterious substance in Silithus... a magical ore unlike any we have ever encountered before. 

The warchief has ordered me to fill you in on the details, in preparation for a special assignment.

passages.title: A Recent Discovery
passages.text: The Dark Lady has given orders that you are to personally oversee the operation in Silithus.

passages.title: Desert Research
passages.text:
The dark blade of Sargeras has cast a shadow of destruction over this land.

It seemed that the silithid hives were destroyed in the attack, but I have received reports that the silithid are returning.

If it were up to me, I'd burn those wretched hives once and for all! However, it is not up to me.

The Dark Lady wants the surviving silithid dissected and studied. 

Pixni Rustbomb is conducting the research and is in need of a "collector."

passages.title: Desert Research
passages.text: You're here to collect the samples? It's about time they sent someone to help me out!

passages.title: Khadgar's Request
passages.text:
Archmage Khadgar arrived while you were away. It seems that he is here to speak with you, <name>.

Hurry and see what it is that he wants. I want him gone as soon as possible.

The last thing we need is a human nosing around in Horde business!

passages.title: Khadgar's Request
passages.text: It's good to see you, <name>. I suspect that my welcome among the Horde is wearing thin...

passages.title: The Blood of Azeroth
passages.text:
Do the leaders of the Alliance and Horde even know what they're fightin' over?

This substance that is risin' up from the wound is the lifeblood of Azeroth!

We need ta heal the wound, not exploit it fer power! Azeroth is the only home we've got. We cannot allow her ta die!

I trust ye, <name>, and I know that yer voice carries great weight among the Horde. Ye must reason with 'em ta stop this madness!

'Tis the only hope our world has...

passages.title: The Blood of Azeroth
passages.text:
The blood of Azeroth? Hmph.

I'll make sure this news reaches the warchief, but this operation must continue until I'm ordered to cease!

passages.title: Desert Research
passages.text:
The dark blade of Sargeras has cast a shadow of destruction over this land.

It seemed that the silithid hives were destroyed in the attack, but I have received reports that the silithid are returning.

We need to find out how the silithid avoided destruction and what effect the blade is having on their hives.

The crown wants the surviving silithid dissected and studied. 

Tammy Tinkspinner is conducting the research and is in need of a "collector."

passages.title: Desert Research
passages.text: You're here to collect the samples? Let's get started!

passages.title: A Recent Arrival
passages.text:
The situation in Silithus appears to be gaining more attention.

Archmage Khadgar just arrived while you were away. It seems that he is here to speak with you, <name>.

It appears urgent. I would speak with him as soon as possible.

passages.title: A Recent Arrival
passages.text: It's good to see you, <name>. I wish that I were here under more pleasant circumstances...

passages.title: The Blood of Azeroth
passages.text:
Do the leaders of the Alliance and Horde even know what they're fightin' over?

This substance that is risin' up from the wound is the lifeblood of Azeroth!

We need ta heal the wound, not exploit it fer power! Azeroth is the only home we've got. We cannot allow her ta die!

I trust ye, <name>, and I know that yer voice carries great weight among the Alliance. Ye must reason with 'em ta stop this madness!

'Tis the only hope our world has...

passages.title: The Blood of Azeroth
passages.text: The blood of Azeroth? I'll make sure this news reaches Stormwind, but I must continue the operation until I am ordered otherwise.
